verses.en: Now these are the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt; every man and his household came with Jacob.
verses.fr: Voici les noms des fils d''Israël, venus en Egypte avec Jacob et la famille de chacun d''eux:
verses.am: ከያዕቆብ ጋር ወደ ግብፅ የገቡት የእስራኤል ልጆች ስሞች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ሰው ሁሉ ከቤተ ሰቡ ጋር ገባ።

verses.en: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah,
verses.fr: Ruben, Siméon, Lévi, Juda,
verses.am: ሮቤል፥

verses.en: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin,
verses.fr: Issacar, Zabulon, Benjamin,
verses.am: ስምዖን፥ ሌዊ፥ ይሁዳ፥ ይሳኮር፥ ዛብሎን፥

verses.en: Dan, and Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
verses.fr: Dan, Nephthali, Gad et Aser.
verses.am: ብንያም፥ ዳን፥ ንፍታሌም፥ ጋድ፥ አሴር።

verses.en: And all the souls that came out of the loins of Jacob were seventy souls: for Joseph was in Egypt already.
verses.fr: Les personnes issues de Jacob étaient au nombre de soixante-dix en tout. Joseph était alors en Egypte.
verses.am: ከያቆብ ጕልበት የወጡት ሰዎች ሁሉ ሰባ ነፍሶች ነበሩ፤ ዮሴፍም አስቀድሞ በግብፅ ነበረ።

verses.en: And Joseph died, and all his brethren, and all that generation.
verses.fr: Joseph mourut, ainsi que tous ses frères et toute cette génération-là.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም ሞተ፥ ወንድሞቹም፥ ያም ትውልድ ሁሉ።

verses.en: And the children of Israel were fruitful, and increased abundantly, and multiplied, and waxed exceeding mighty; and the land was filled with them.
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël furent féconds et multiplièrent, ils s''accrurent et devinrent de plus en plus puissants. Et le pays en fut rempli.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች አፈሩ፥ እጅግም በዙ፥ ተባዙም፥ አጅግም ጸኑ፤ ምድሪቱም በእነርሱ ሞላች።

verses.en: Now there arose up a new king over Egypt, which knew not Joseph.
verses.fr: Il s''éleva sur l''Egypte un nouveau roi, qui n''avait point connu Joseph.
verses.am: በግብፅም ዮሴፍን ያላወቀ አዲስ ንጉሥ ተነሣ።

verses.en: And he said unto his people, Behold, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we:
verses.fr: Il dit à son peuple: Voilà les enfants d''Israël qui forment un peuple plus nombreux et plus puissant que nous.
verses.am: እርሱም ሕዝቡን። እነሆ፥ የእስራኤል ልጆች ሕዝብ ከእኛ ይልቅ በዝተዋል በርትተውማል፤

verses.en: Come on, let us deal wisely with them; lest they multiply, and it come to pass, that, when there falleth out any war, they join also unto our enemies, and fight against us, and so get them up out of the land.
verses.fr: Allons! montrons-nous habiles à son égard; empêchons qu''il ne s''accroisse, et que, s''il survient une guerre, il ne se joigne à nos ennemis, pour nous combattre et sortir ensuite du pays.
verses.am: እንዳይበዙ፥ ሰልፍም በተነሳብን ጊዜ ጠላቶቻችንን አግዘው እንዳይወጉን ከምድሪቱም እንዳይወጡ፥ ኑ እንጠበብባቸው አለ።

verses.en: Therefore they did set over them taskmasters to afflict them with their burdens. And they built for Pharaoh treasure cities, Pithom and Raamses.
verses.fr: Et l''on établit sur lui des chefs de corvées, afin de l''accabler de travaux pénibles. C''est ainsi qu''il bâtit les villes de Pithom et de Ramsès, pour servir de magasins à Pharaon.
verses.am: በብርቱ ሥራም ያስጨንቁአቸው ዘንድ ግብር አስገባሪዎችን ሾመባቸው፤ ለፈርዖንም ፊቶምንና ራምሴን ጽኑ ከተሞች አድርገው ሠሩ።

verses.en: But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and grew. And they were grieved because of the children of Israel.
verses.fr: Mais plus on l''accablait, plus il multipliait et s''accroissait; et l''on prit en aversion les enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እንዳስጨነቁአቸው መጠን እንዲሁ በዙ፥ እጅግም ጸኑ፤ ከእስራኤልም ልጆች የተነሣ ተጸይፈዋቸው ነበር።

verses.en: And the Egyptians made the children of Israel to serve with rigour:
verses.fr: Alors les Egyptiens réduisirent les enfants d''Israël à une dure servitude.
verses.am: ግብፃውያንም የእስራኤልን ልጆች በመከራ ገዙአቸው።

verses.en: And they made their lives bitter with hard bondage, in morter, and in brick, and in all manner of service in the field: all their service, wherein they made them serve, was with rigour.
verses.fr: Ils leur rendirent la vie amère par de rudes travaux en argile et en briques, et par tous les ouvrages des champs: et c''était avec cruauté qu''ils leur imposaient toutes ces charges.
verses.am: በጽኑ ሥራ፥ በጭቃ፥ በጡብም በእርሻም ሥራ ሁሉ፥ በመከራም በሚያሠሩአቸው ሥራ ሁሉ፥ ሕይወታቸውን ያስመርሩአቸው ነበር።

verses.en: And the king of Egypt spake to the Hebrew midwives, of which the name of the one was Shiphrah, and the name of the other Puah:
verses.fr: Le roi d''Egypte parla aussi aux sages-femmes des Hébreux, nommées l''une Schiphra, et l''autre Pua.
verses.am: የግብፅም ንጉሥ አንዲቱ ሲፓራ ሁለተኛይቱም ፉሐ የሚባሉትን የዕብራውያንን አዋላጆች እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረ።

verses.en: And he said, When ye do the office of a midwife to the Hebrew women, and see them upon the stools; if it be a son, then ye shall kill him: but if it be a daughter, then she shall live.
verses.fr: Il leur dit: Quand vous accoucherez les femmes des Hébreux et que vous les verrez sur les sièges, si c''est un garçon, faites-le mourir; si c''est une fille, laissez-la vivre.
verses.am: እናንተ የዕብራውያንን ሴቶች ስታዋልዱ፥ ለመውለድ እንደደረሱ ባያችሁ ጊዜ፥ ወንድ ቢሆን ግደሉት፤ ሴት ብትሆን ግን በሕይወት ትኑር።

verses.en: But the midwives feared God, and did not as the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved the men children alive.
verses.fr: Mais les sages-femmes craignirent Dieu, et ne firent point ce que leur avait dit le roi d''Egypte; elles laissèrent vivre les enfants.
verses.am: አዋላጆች ግን እግዚአብሔርን ፈሩ፥ የግብፅ ንጉሥም እንዳዘዛቸው አላደረጉም፥ ወንዶቹን ሕፃናትንም አዳኑአቸው።

verses.en: And the king of Egypt called for the midwives, and said unto them, Why have ye done this thing, and have saved the men children alive?
verses.fr: Le roi d''Egypte appela les sages-femmes, et leur dit: Pourquoi avez-vous agi ainsi, et avez-vous laissé vivre les enfants?
verses.am: የግብፅም ንጉሥ አዋላጆችን ጠርቶ። ለምን እንዲህ አደረጋችሁ? ወንዶቹን ሕፃናትንስ ለምን አዳናችሁ? አላቸው።

verses.en: And the midwives said unto Pharaoh, Because the Hebrew women are not as the Egyptian women; for they are lively, and are delivered ere the midwives come in unto them.
verses.fr: Les sages-femmes répondirent à Pharaon: C''est que les femmes des Hébreux ne sont pas comme les Egyptiennes; elles sont vigoureuses et elles accouchent avant l''arrivée de la sage-femme.
verses.am: አዋላጆቹም ፈርዖንን። የዕብራውያን ሴቶች እንደ ግብፅ ሴቶች ስላልሆኑ፤ እነርሱ ጠንካሮች ናቸውና አዋላጆች ሳይገቡ ስለሚወልዱ ነው አሉት።

verses.en: Therefore God dealt well with the midwives: and the people multiplied, and waxed very mighty.
verses.fr: Dieu fit du bien aux sages-femmes; et le peuple multiplia et devint très nombreux.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ለአዋላጆች መልካም አደረገላቸው፤ ሕዝቡም በዛ፥ እጅግም ጸና።

verses.en: And it came to pass, because the midwives feared God, that he made them houses.
verses.fr: Parce que les sages-femmes avaient eu la crainte de Dieu, Dieu fit prospérer leurs maisons.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ አዋላጆች እግዚአብሔርን ስለ ፈሩ ቤቶችን አደረገላቸው።

verses.en: And Pharaoh charged all his people, saying, Every son that is born ye shall cast into the river, and every daughter ye shall save alive.
verses.fr: Alors Pharaon donna cet ordre à tout son peuple: Vous jetterez dans le fleuve tout garçon qui naîtra, et vous laisserez vivre toutes les filles.
verses.am: ፈርዖንም። የሚወለደውን ወንድ ልጅ ሁሉ ወደ ወንዝ ጣሉት፥ ሴትን ልጅ ሁሉ ግን በሕይወት አድኑአት ብሎ ሕዝቡን ሁሉ አዘዘ።

verses.en: And there went a man of the house of Levi, and took to wife a daughter of Levi.
verses.fr: Un homme de la maison de Lévi avait pris pour femme une fille de Lévi.
verses.am: ከሌዊ ወገንም አንድ ሰው ሄዶ የሌዊን ልጅ አገባ።

verses.en: And the woman conceived, and bare a son: and when she saw him that he was a goodly child, she hid him three months.
verses.fr: Cette femme devint enceinte et enfanta un fils. Elle vit qu''il était beau, et elle le cacha pendant trois mois.
verses.am: ሴቲቱም ፀነሰች፥ ወንድ ልጅም ወለደች፤ መልካምም እንደሆነ ባየች ጊዜ ሦስት ወር ሸሸገችው።

verses.en: And when she could not longer hide him, she took for him an ark of bulrushes, and daubed it with slime and with pitch, and put the child therein; and she laid it in the flags by the river's brink.
verses.fr: Ne pouvant plus le cacher, elle prit une caisse de jonc, qu''elle enduisit de bitume et de poix; elle y mit l''enfant, et le déposa parmi les roseaux, sur le bord du fleuve.
verses.am: ደግሞም ልትሸሽገው ባልቻለች ጊዜ፥ የደንገል ሣጥን ለእርሱ ወስዳ ዝፍትና ቅጥራን ለቀለቀችው፤ ሕፃኑንም አኖረችበት፥ በወንዝም ዳር ባለ በቄጠማ ውስጥ አስቀመጠችው።

verses.en: And his sister stood afar off, to wit what would be done to him.
verses.fr: La soeur de l''enfant se tint à quelque distance, pour savoir ce qui lui arriverait.
verses.am: እኅቱም የሚደረግበትን ታውቅ ዘንድ በሩቅ ቆማ ትጎበኘው ነበር።

verses.en: And the daughter of Pharaoh came down to wash herself at the river; and her maidens walked along by the river's side; and when she saw the ark among the flags, she sent her maid to fetch it.
verses.fr: La fille de Pharaon descendit au fleuve pour se baigner, et ses compagnes se promenèrent le long du fleuve. Elle aperçut la caisse au milieu des roseaux, et elle envoya sa servante pour la prendre.
verses.am: የፈርዖንም ልጅ ልትታጠብ ወደ ወንዝ ወረደች፤ ደንገጥሮችዋም በወንዝ ዳር ይሄዱ ነበር፤ ሣጥኑንም በቄጠማ ውስጥ አየች፥ ደንገጥርዋንም ልካ አስመጣችው።

verses.en: And when she had opened it, she saw the child: and, behold, the babe wept. And she had compassion on him, and said, This is one of the Hebrews' children.
verses.fr: Elle l''ouvrit, et vit l''enfant: c''était un petit garçon qui pleurait. Elle en eut pitié, et elle dit: C''est un enfant des Hébreux!
verses.am: በከፈተችውም ጊዜ ሕፃኑን አየች፥ እነሆም ሕፃኑ ያለቅስ ነበር፤ አዘነችለትም። ይህ ከዕብራውያን ልጆች አንድ ነው አለች።

verses.en: Then said his sister to Pharaoh's daughter, Shall I go and call to thee a nurse of the Hebrew women, that she may nurse the child for thee?
verses.fr: Alors la soeur de l''enfant dit à la fille de Pharaon: Veux-tu que j''aille te chercher une nourrice parmi les femmes des Hébreux, pour allaiter cet enfant?
verses.am: እኅቱም ለፈርዖን ልጅ። ሕፃኑን ታጠባልሽ ዘንድ ሄጄ የምታጠባ ሴት ከዕብራውያን ሴቶች ልጥራልሽን? አለቻት።

verses.en: And Pharaoh's daughter said to her, Go. And the maid went and called the child's mother.
verses.fr: Va, lui répondit la fille de Pharaon. Et la jeune fille alla chercher la mère de l''enfant.
verses.am: የፈርዖንም ልጅ። ሂጂ አለቻት፤ ብላቴናይቱም ሄዳ የሕፃኑን እናት ጠራች።

verses.en: And Pharaoh's daughter said unto her, Take this child away, and nurse it for me, and I will give thee thy wages. And the women took the child, and nursed it.
verses.fr: La fille de Pharaon lui dit: Emporte cet enfant, et allaite-le-moi; je te donnerai ton salaire. La femme prit l''enfant, et l''allaita.
verses.am: የፈርዖንም ልጅ። ይህን ሕፃን ወስደሽ አጥቢልኝ፥ ዋጋሽንም እሰጥሻለሁ አለቻት። ሴቲቱም ሕፃኑን ወስዳ አጠባችው።

verses.en: And the child grew, and she brought him unto Pharaoh's daughter, and he became her son. And she called his name Moses: and she said, Because I drew him out of the water.
verses.fr: Quand il eut grandi, elle l''amena à la fille de Pharaon, et il fut pour elle comme un fils. Elle lui donna le nom de Moïse, car, dit-elle, je l''ai retiré des eaux.
verses.am: ሕፃኑም አደገ፥ ወደ ፈርዖንም ልጅ ዘንድ አመጣችው፥ ለእርስዋም ልጅ ሆነላት። እኔ ከውኃ አውጥቼዋለሁና ስትልም ስሙን ሙሴ ብላ ጠራችው።

verses.en: And it came to pass in those days, when Moses was grown, that he went out unto his brethren, and looked on their burdens: and he spied an Egyptian smiting an Hebrew, one of his brethren.
verses.fr: En ce temps-là, Moïse, devenu grand, se rendit vers ses frères, et fut témoin de leurs pénibles travaux. Il vit un Egyptien qui frappait un Hébreu d''entre ses frères.
verses.am: በዚያም ወራት እንዲህ ሆነ፤ ሙሴ ጎበዝ በሆነ ጊዜ ወደ ወንድሞቹ ወጣ፥ የሥራቸውንም መከራ ተመለከተ፤ የግብፅም ሰው የወንድሞቹን የዕብራውያንን ሰው ሲመታ አየ።

verses.en: And he looked this way and that way, and when he saw that there was no man, he slew the Egyptian, and hid him in the sand.
verses.fr: Il regarda de côté et d''autre, et, voyant qu''il n''y avait personne, il tua l''Egyptien, et le cacha dans le sable.
verses.am: ወዲህና ወዲያም ተመለከተ፥ ማንንም አላየም፥ ግብፃዊውንም ገደለ፥ በአሸዋም ውስጥ ሸሸገው።

verses.en: And when he went out the second day, behold, two men of the Hebrews strove together: and he said to him that did the wrong, Wherefore smitest thou thy fellow?
verses.fr: Il sortit le jour suivant; et voici, deux Hébreux se querellaient. Il dit à celui qui avait tort: Pourquoi frappes-tu ton prochain?
verses.am: በሁለተኛውም ቀን ወጣ፥ ሁለቱም የዕብራውያን ሰዎች ሲጣሉ አየ፤ በዳዩንም። ለምን ባልንጀራህን ትመታዋለህ? አለው።

verses.en: And he said, Who made thee a prince and a judge over us? intendest thou to kill me, as thou killedst the Egyptian? And Moses feared, and said, Surely this thing is known.
verses.fr: Et cet homme répondit: Qui t''a établi chef et juge sur nous? Penses-tu me tuer, comme tu as tué l''Egyptien? Moïse eut peur, et dit: Certainement la chose est connue.
verses.am: ያም። በእኛ ላይ አንተን አለቃ ወይስ ዳኛ ማን አደረገህ? ወይስ ግብፃዊውን እንደ ገደልኸው ልትገድለኝ ትሻለህን? አለው። ሙሴም። በእውነት ይህ ነገር ታውቆአል ብሎ ፈራ።

verses.en: Now when Pharaoh heard this thing, he sought to slay Moses. But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh, and dwelt in the land of Midian: and he sat down by a well.
verses.fr: Pharaon apprit ce qui s''était passé, et il cherchait à faire mourir Moïse. Mais Moïse s''enfuit de devant Pharaon, et il se retira dans le pays de Madian, où il s''arrêta près d''un puits.
verses.am: ፈርዖንም ይህን ነገር በሰማ ጊዜ ሙሴን ሊገድለው ፈለገ። ሙሴ ግን ከፈርዖን ፊት ኰበለለ፥ በምድያምም ምድር ተቀመጠ፤ በውኃም ጕድጓድ አጠገብ ዐረፈ።

verses.en: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters: and they came and drew water, and filled the troughs to water their father's flock.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur de Madian avait sept filles. Elles vinrent puiser de l''eau, et elles remplirent les auges pour abreuver le troupeau de leur père.
verses.am: ለምድያምም ካህን ሰባት ሴቶች ልጆች ነበሩት፤ እነርሱም መጥተው ውኃ ቀዱ፥ የአባታቸውንም በጎች ሊያጠጡ የውኃውን ገንዳ ሞሉ።

verses.en: And the shepherds came and drove them away: but Moses stood up and helped them, and watered their flock.
verses.fr: Les bergers arrivèrent, et les chassèrent. Alors Moïse se leva, prit leur défense, et fit boire leur troupeau.
verses.am: እረኞችም መጥተው ገፉአቸው፤ ሙሴ ግን ተነሥቶ ረዳቸው፥ በጎቻቸውንም አጠጣላቸው።

verses.en: And when they came to Reuel their father, he said, How is it that ye are come so soon to day?
verses.fr: Quand elles furent de retour auprès de Réuel, leur père, il dit: Pourquoi revenez-vous si tôt aujourd''hui?
verses.am: ወደ አባታቸው ወደ ራጉኤልም በመጡ ጊዜ። ስለ ምን ዛሬ ፈጥናችሁ መጣችሁ? አላቸው።

verses.en: And they said, An Egyptian delivered us out of the hand of the shepherds, and also drew water enough for us, and watered the flock.
verses.fr: Elles répondirent: Un Egyptien nous a délivrées de la main des bergers, et même il nous a puisé de l''eau, et a fait boire le troupeau.
verses.am: እነርሱም። አንድ የግብፅ ሰው ከእረኞች እጅ አዳነን፥ ደግሞም ቀዳልን፥ በጎቻችንንም አጠጣ አሉ።

verses.en: And he said unto his daughters, And where is he? why is it that ye have left the man? call him, that he may eat bread.
verses.fr: Et il dit à ses filles: Où est-il? Pourquoi avez-vous laissé cet homme? Appelez-le, pour qu''il prenne quelque nourriture.
verses.am: ልጆቹንም። እርሱ ወዴት ነው? ለምንስ ያንን ሰው ተዋችሁት? ጥሩት እንጀራም ይብላ አላቸው።

verses.en: And Moses was content to dwell with the man: and he gave Moses Zipporah his daughter.
verses.fr: Moïse se décida à demeurer chez cet homme, qui lui donna pour femme Séphora, sa fille.
verses.am: ሙሴም ከዚያ ሰው ጋር ሊቀመጥ ወደደ፤ ልጁንም ሲፓራን ለሙሴ ሚስት ትሆነው ዘንድ ሰጠው።

verses.en: And she bare him a son, and he called his name Gershom: for he said, I have been a stranger in a strange land.
verses.fr: Elle enfanta un fils, qu''il appela du nom de Guerschom, car, dit-il, j''habite un pays étranger.
verses.am: ወንድ ልጅም ወለደች። በሌላ ምድር መጻተኛ ነኝ ሲል ስሙን ጌርሳም ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.en: And it came to pass in process of time, that the king of Egypt died: and the children of Israel sighed by reason of the bondage, and they cried, and their cry came up unto God by reason of the bondage.
verses.fr: Longtemps après, le roi d''Egypte mourut, et les enfants d''Israël gémissaient encore sous la servitude, et poussaient des cris. Ces cris, que leur arrachait la servitude, montèrent jusqu''à Dieu.
verses.am: ከዚያም ከብዙ ቀን በኋላ እንዲህ ሆነ፤ የግብፅ ንጉሥ ሞተ፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች ከባርነት የተነሣ አለቀሱ፥ ጮኹም፥ ስለ ባርነታቸውም ጩኸታቸው ወደ እግዚአብሔር ወጣ።

verses.en: And God heard their groaning, and God remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.
verses.fr: Dieu entendit leurs gémissements, et se souvint de son alliance avec Abraham, Isaac et Jacob.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም የለቅሶአቸውን ድምፅ ሰማ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ከአብርሃምና ከይስሐቅ ከያዕቆብም ጋር ያደረገውን ቃል ኪዳን አሰበ።

verses.en: And God looked upon the children of Israel, and God had respect unto them.
verses.fr: Dieu regarda les enfants d''Israël, et il en eut compassion.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም የእስራኤልን ልጆች አየ፥ እግዚአብሔርም በእነርሱ ያለውን ነገር አወቀ።

verses.en: Now Moses kept the flock of Jethro his father in law, the priest of Midian: and he led the flock to the backside of the desert, and came to the mountain of God, even to Horeb.
verses.fr: Moïse faisait paître le troupeau de Jéthro, son beau-père, sacrificateur de Madian; et il mena le troupeau derrière le désert, et vint à la montagne de Dieu, à Horeb.
verses.am: ሙሴም የዮቶርን የአማቱን የምድያምን ካህን በጎች ይጠብቅ ነበር፤ ወደ ምድረ በዳ ዳርቻም በጎቹን ነዳ፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ተራራ ወደ ኮሬብ መጣ።

verses.en: And the angel of the Lord appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush: and he looked, and, behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed.
verses.fr: L''ange de l''Eternel lui apparut dans une flamme de feu, au milieu d''un buisson. Moïse regarda; et voici, le buisson était tout en feu, et le buisson ne se consumait point.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ በእሳት ነበልባል በእሾህ ቍጥቋጦ መካከል ታየው፤ እነሆም ቍጥቋጦው በእሳት ሲነድድ ቍጥቋጦውም ሳይቃጠል አየ።

verses.en: And Moses said, I will now turn aside, and see this great sight, why the bush is not burnt.
verses.fr: Moïse dit: Je veux me détourner pour voir quelle est cette grande vision, et pourquoi le buisson ne se consume point.
verses.am: ሙሴም። ልሂድና ቍጥቋጦው ስለ ምን አልተቃጠለም ይህን ታላቅ ራእይ ልይ አለ።

verses.en: And when the Lord saw that he turned aside to see, God called unto him out of the midst of the bush, and said, Moses, Moses. And he said, Here am I.
verses.fr: L''Eternel vit qu''il se détournait pour voir; et Dieu l''appela du milieu du buisson, et dit: Moïse! Moïse! Et il répondit: Me voici!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እርሱ ይመለከት ዘንድ እንደ መጣ ባየ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር ከቍጥቋጦው ውስጥ እርሱን ጠርቶ። ሙሴ፥ ሙሴ ሆይ አለ።

verses.en: And he said, Draw not nigh hither: put off thy shoes from off thy feet, for the place whereon thou standest is holy ground.
verses.fr: Dieu dit: N''approche pas d''ici, ôte tes souliers de tes pieds, car le lieu sur lequel tu te tiens est une terre sainte.
verses.am: እርሱም። እነሆኝ አለ። ወደዚህ አትቅረብ፤ አንተ የቆምህባት ስፍራ የተቀደሰች መሬት ናትና ጫማህን ከእግርህ አውጣ አለው።

verses.en: Moreover he said, I am the God of thy father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. And Moses hid his face; for he was afraid to look upon God.
verses.fr: Et il ajouta: Je suis le Dieu de ton père, le Dieu d''Abraham, le Dieu d''Isaac et le Dieu de Jacob. Moïse se cacha le visage, car il craignait de regarder Dieu.
verses.am: ደግሞም። እኔ የአባትህ አምላክ፥ የአብርሃም አምላክ የይስሐቅም አምላክ የያዕቆብም አምላክ ነኝ አለው። ሙሴም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ያይ ዘንድ ፈርቶአልና ፊቱን ሸፈነ።

verses.en: And the Lord said, I have surely seen the affliction of my people which are in Egypt, and have heard their cry by reason of their taskmasters; for I know their sorrows;
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit: J''ai vu la souffrance de mon peuple qui est en Egypte, et j''ai entendu les cris que lui font pousser ses oppresseurs, car je connais ses douleurs.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አለ። በግብፅ ያለውን የሕዝቤን መከራ በእውነት አየሁ፥ ከአስገባሪዎቻቸውም የተነሣ ጩኸታቸውን ሰማሁ፤ ሥቃያቸውንም አውቄአለሁ፤

verses.en: And I am come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land unto a good land and a large, unto a land flowing with milk and honey; unto the place of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites.
verses.fr: Je suis descendu pour le délivrer de la main des Egyptiens, et pour le faire monter de ce pays dans un bon et vaste pays, dans un pays où coulent le lait et le miel, dans les lieux qu''habitent les Cananéens, les Héthiens, les Amoréens, les Phéréziens, les Héviens et les Jébusiens.
verses.am: ከግብፃውያንም እጅ አድናቸው ዘንድ፥ ከዚያችም አገር ወተትና ማር ወደምታፈስሰው አገር ወደ ሰፊይቱና ወደ መልካሚቱ አገር ወደ ከነዓናውያንም ወደ ኬጢያውያንም ወደ አሞራውያንም ወደ ፌርዛውያንም ወደ ኤዊያውያንም ወደ ኢያቡሳውያንም ስፍራ አወጣቸው ዘንድ ወረድሁ።

verses.en: Now therefore, behold, the cry of the children of Israel is come unto me: and I have also seen the oppression wherewith the Egyptians oppress them.
verses.fr: Voici, les cris d''Israël sont venus jusqu''à moi, et j''ai vu l''oppression que leur font souffrir les Egyptiens.
verses.am: አሁንም እነሆ የእስራኤል ልጆች ጩኸት ወደ እኔ ወጣ፤ ግብፃውያንም የሚያደርጉባቸውን ግፍ ደግሞ አየሁ።

verses.en: Come now therefore, and I will send thee unto Pharaoh, that thou mayest bring forth my people the children of Israel out of Egypt.
verses.fr: Maintenant, va, je t''enverrai auprès de Pharaon, et tu feras sortir d''Egypte mon peuple, les enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: አሁንም ና፥ ሕዝቤን የእስራኤልን ልጆች ከግብፅ ታወጣ ዘንድ ወደ ፈርዖን እልክሃለሁ።

verses.en: And Moses said unto God, Who am I, that I should go unto Pharaoh, and that I should bring forth the children of Israel out of Egypt?
verses.fr: Moïse dit à Dieu: Qui suis-je, pour aller vers Pharaon, et pour faire sortir d''Egypte les enfants d''Israël?
verses.am: ሙሴም እግዚአብሔርን። ወደ ፈርዖን የምሄድ የእስራኤልንም ልጆች ከግብፅ የማወጣ እኔ ማን ነኝ? አለው።

verses.en: And he said, Certainly I will be with thee; and this shall be a token unto thee, that I have sent thee: When thou hast brought forth the people out of Egypt, ye shall serve God upon this mountain.
verses.fr: Dieu dit: Je serai avec toi; et ceci sera pour toi le signe que c''est moi qui t''envoie: quand tu auras fait sortir d''Egypte le peuple, vous servirez Dieu sur cette montagne.
verses.am: እርሱም። በእውነት እኔ ከአንተ ጋር እሆናለሁ፤ እኔም እንደ ላክሁህ ምልክትህ ይህ ነው፤ ሕዝቡን ከግብፅ ባወጣህ ጊዜ በዚህ ተራራ ላይ ለእግዚአብሔር ትገዛላችሁ አለ።

verses.en: And Moses said unto God, Behold, when I come unto the children of Israel, and shall say unto them, The God of your fathers hath sent me unto you; and they shall say to me, What is his name? what shall I say unto them?
verses.fr: Moïse dit à Dieu: J''irai donc vers les enfants d''Israël, et je leur dirai: Le Dieu de vos pères m''envoie vers vous. Mais, s''ils me demandent quel est son nom, que leur répondrai-je?
verses.am: ሙሴም እግዚአብሔርን። እነሆ፥ እኔ ወደ እስራኤል ልጆች በመጣሁ ጊዜ። የአባቶቻችሁ አምላክ ወደ እናንተ ላከኝ ባልሁም ጊዜ። ስሙስ ማን ነው? ባሉኝ ጊዜ፥ ምን እላቸዋለሁ? አለው።

verses.en: And God said unto Moses, I Am That I Am: and he said, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, I Am hath sent me unto you.
verses.fr: Dieu dit à Moïse: Je suis celui qui suis. Et il ajouta: C''est ainsi que tu répondras aux enfants d''Israël: Celui qui s''appelle "je suis" m''a envoyé vers vous.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። <<ያለና የሚኖር>>እኔ ነኝ አለው፤ እንዲህ ለእስራኤል ልጆች። <<ያለና የሚኖር>>ወደ እናንተ ላከኝ ትላለህ አለው።

verses.en: And God said moreover unto Moses, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, the Lord God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, hath sent me unto you: this is my name for ever, and this is my memorial unto all generations.
verses.fr: Dieu dit encore à Moïse: Tu parleras ainsi aux enfants d''Israël: L''Eternel, le Dieu de vos pères, le Dieu d''Abraham, le Dieu d''Isaac et le Dieu de Jacob, m''envoie vers vous. Voilà mon nom pour l''éternité, voilà mon nom de génération en génération.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ደግሞ ሙሴን አለው። ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ ትላለህ። የአባቶቻችሁ አምላክ፥ የአብርሃም አምላክ የይስሐቅም አምላክ የያዕቆብም አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ወደ እናንተ ላከኝ፤ ይህ ለዘላለሙ ስሜ ነው፥ እስከ ልጅ ልጅ ድረስም መታሰቢያዬ ይህ ነው።

verses.en: Go, and gather the elders of Israel together, and say unto them, The Lord God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, appeared unto me, saying, I have surely visited you, and seen that which is done to you in Egypt:
verses.fr: Va, rassemble les anciens d''Israël, et dis-leur: L''Eternel, le Dieu de vos pères, m''est apparu, le Dieu d''Abraham, d''Isaac et de Jacob. Il a dit: Je vous ai vus, et j''ai vu ce qu''on vous fait en Egypte,
verses.am: ሂድ የእስራኤልንም ሽማግሌዎች ሰብስብ። እግዚአብሔር የአባቶቻችሁ አምላክ የአብርሃም የይስሐቅም የያዕቆብም አምላክ። መጐብኘትን ጐበኘኋችሁ፥ በግብፅም የሚደረግባችሁን አየሁ፤

verses.en: And I have said, I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt unto the land of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, unto a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.fr: et j''ai dit: Je vous ferai monter de l''Egypte, où vous souffrez, dans le pays des Cananéens, des Héthiens, des Amoréens, des Phéréziens, des Héviens et des Jébusiens, dans un pays où coulent le lait et le miel.
verses.am: ከግብፅም መከራ ወደ ከነዓናውያን ወደ ኬጢያውያንም ወደ አሞራውያንም ወደ ፌርዛውያንም ወደ ኤዊያውያንም ወደ ያቡሳውያንም አገር ወተትና ማር ወደምታፈስስ አገር አወጣችኋለሁ አልሁ ብሎ ተገለጠልኝ በላቸው።

verses.en: And they shall hearken to thy voice: and thou shalt come, thou and the elders of Israel, unto the king of Egypt, and ye shall say unto him, The Lord God of the Hebrews hath met with us: and now let us go, we beseech thee, three days' journey into the wilderness, that we may sacrifice to the Lord our God.
verses.fr: Ils écouteront ta voix; et tu iras, toi et les anciens d''Israël, auprès du roi d''Egypte, et vous lui direz: L''Eternel, le Dieu des Hébreux, nous est apparu. Permets-nous de faire trois journées de marche dans le désert, pour offrir des sacrifices à l''Eternel, notre Dieu.
verses.am: እነርሱም ቃልህን ይሰማሉ፤ አንተና የእስራኤል ሽማግሌዎች ወደ ግብፅ ንጉሥ ትገባላችሁ። የዕብራውያን አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ተገለጠልን፤ አሁንም ለአምላካችን ለእግዚአብሔር እንሠዋ ዘንድ የሦስት ቀን መንገድ በምድረ በዳ እንሂድ ትሉታላችሁ።

verses.en: And I am sure that the king of Egypt will not let you go, no, not by a mighty hand.
verses.fr: Je sais que le roi d''Egypte ne vous laissera point aller, si ce n''est par une main puissante.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በጽኑ እጅ ካልሆነ በቀር ትሄዱ ዘንድ የግብፅ ንጉሥ እንደማይፈቅድላችሁ እኔ አውቃለሁ።

verses.en: And I will stretch out my hand, and smite Egypt with all my wonders which I will do in the midst thereof: and after that he will let you go.
verses.fr: J''étendrai ma main, et je frapperai l''Egypte par toutes sortes de prodiges que je ferai au milieu d''elle. Après quoi, il vous laissera aller.
verses.am: እኔም እጄን እዘረጋለሁ፥ በማደርግባቸውም ተአምራቴ ሁሉ ግብፅን እመታለሁ፤ ከዚያም በኋላ ይለቅቃችኋል።

verses.en: And I will give this people favour in the sight of the Egyptians: and it shall come to pass, that, when ye go, ye shall not go empty.
verses.fr: Je ferai même trouver grâce à ce peuple aux yeux des Egyptiens, et quand vous partirez, vous ne partirez point à vide.
verses.am: በግብፃውያንም ፊት ለዚህ ሕዝብ ሞገስን እሰጣለሁ፤ እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ በሄዳችሁ ጊዜ ባዶ እጃችሁን አትሄዱም፤

verses.en: But every woman shall borrow of her neighbour, and of her that sojourneth in her house, jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment: and ye shall put them upon your sons, and upon your daughters; and ye shall spoil the Egyptians.
verses.fr: Chaque femme demandera à sa voisine et à celle qui demeure dans sa maison des vases d''argent, des vases d''or, et des vêtements, que vous mettrez sur vos fils et vos filles. Et vous dépouillerez les Egyptiens.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እያንዳንዲቱ ሴት ከጎረቤትዋ በቤትዋም ካለችው ሴት የብር ዕቃ የወርቅ እቃ ልብስም ትለምናለች፤ በወንዶችና በሴቶች ልጆቻችሁ ላይ ታደርጉታላችሁ፤ ግብፃውያንንም ትበዘብዛላችሁ።

verses.en: And Moses answered and said, But, behold, they will not believe me, nor hearken unto my voice: for they will say, The Lord hath not appeared unto thee.
verses.fr: Moïse répondit, et dit: Voici, ils ne me croiront point, et ils n''écouteront point ma voix. Mais ils diront: L''Eternel ne t''est point apparu.
verses.am: ሙሴም መለሰ። እነሆ አያምኑኝም ቃሌንም አይሰሙም። እግዚአብሔር ከቶ አልተገለጠልህም ይሉኛል አለ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto him, What is that in thine hand? And he said, A rod.
verses.fr: L''Eternel lui dit: Qu''y a-t-il dans ta main? Il répondit: Une verge.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። ይህች በእጅህ ያለችው ምንድር ናት? አለው። እርሱም። በትር ናት አለ።

verses.en: And he said, Cast it on the ground. And he cast it on the ground, and it became a serpent; and Moses fled from before it.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit: Jette-la par terre. Il la jeta par terre, et elle devint un serpent. Moïse fuyait devant lui.
verses.am: ወደ መሬት ጣላት አለው፤ እርሱም በመሬት ጣላት፥ እባብም ሆነች፤ ሙሴም ከእርሷ ሸሸ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Put forth thine hand, and take it by the tail. And he put forth his hand, and caught it, and it became a rod in his hand:
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse: Etends ta main, et saisis-le par la queue. Il étendit la main et le saisit et le serpent redevint une verge dans sa main.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። የአባቶቻቸው አምላክ፥ የአብርሃም አምላክ የይስሐቅም አምላክ የያዕቆብም አምላክ፥ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ተገለጠልህ እንዲያምኑ እጅህን ዘርግተህ ጅራትዋን ያዝ አለው። እጁንም ዘርግቶ ያዛት በእጁም ውስጥ በትር ሆነች።

verses.en: That they may believe that the Lord God of their fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, hath appeared unto thee.
verses.fr: C''est là, dit l''Eternel, ce que tu feras, afin qu''ils croient que l''Eternel, le Dieu de leurs pères, t''est apparu, le Dieu d''Abraham, le Dieu d''Isaac et le Dieu de Jacob.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። የአባቶቻቸው አምላክ፥ የአብርሃም አምላክ የይስሐቅም አምላክ የያዕቆብም አምላክ፥ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ተገለጠልህ እንዲያምኑ እጅህን ዘርግተህ ጅራትዋን ያዝ አለው። እጁንም ዘርግቶ ያዛት በእጁም ውስጥ በትር ሆነች።

verses.en: And the Lord said furthermore unto him, Put now thine hand into thy bosom. And he put his hand into his bosom: and when he took it out, behold, his hand was leprous as snow.
verses.fr: L''Eternel lui dit encore: Mets ta main dans ton sein. Il mit sa main dans son sein; puis il la retira, et voici, sa main était couverte de lèpre, blanche comme la neige.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ደግሞ። እጅህን ወደ ብብትህ አግባ አለው። እጁንም ወደ ብብቱ አገባት፤ ባወጣትም ጊዜ እነሆ፥ እጁ እንደ በረዶ ለምጽ ሆነች።

verses.en: And he said, Put thine hand into thy bosom again. And he put his hand into his bosom again; and plucked it out of his bosom, and, behold, it was turned again as his other flesh.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit: Remets ta main dans ton sein. Il remit sa main dans son sein; puis il la retira de son sein, et voici, elle était redevenue comme sa chair.
verses.am: እርሱም። እጅህን ወደ ብብትህ መልስ አለው። እጁንም ወደ ብብቱ መለሳት፥ ከብብቱም ባወጣት ጊዜ እነሆ ተመልሳ ገላውን መሰለች።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe thee, neither hearken to the voice of the first sign, that they will believe the voice of the latter sign.
verses.fr: S''ils ne te croient pas, dit l''Eternel, et n''écoutent pas la voix du premier signe, ils croiront à la voix du dernier signe.
verses.am: ደግሞም አለው። እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ ባያምኑህ የፊተኛይቱንም ምልክት ነገር ባይሰሙ፥ የሁለተኛይቱን ምልክት ነገር ያምናሉ።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe also these two signs, neither hearken unto thy voice, that thou shalt take of the water of the river, and pour it upon the dry land: and the water which thou takest out of the river shall become blood upon the dry land.
verses.fr: S''ils ne croient pas même à ces deux signes, et n''écoutent pas ta voix, tu prendras de l''eau du fleuve, tu la répandras sur la terre, et l''eau que tu auras prise du fleuve deviendra du sang sur la terre.
verses.am: እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ እነዚህን ሁለት ምልክቶች ባያምኑ ቃልህንም ባይሰሙ፥ ከወንዙ ውኃን ውሰድ፥ በደረቁም መሬት ላይ አፍስሰው፤ ከወንዙም የወሰድኸው ውኃ በደረቁ መሬት ላይ ደም ይሆናል።

verses.en: And Moses said unto the Lord, O my Lord, I am not eloquent, neither heretofore, nor since thou hast spoken unto thy servant: but I am slow of speech, and of a slow tongue.
verses.fr: Moïse dit à l''Eternel: Ah! Seigneur, je ne suis pas un homme qui ait la parole facile, et ce n''est ni d''hier ni d''avant-hier, ni même depuis que tu parles à ton serviteur; car j''ai la bouche et la langue embarrassées.
verses.am: ሙሴም እግዚአብሔርን። ጌታ ሆይ፥ እኔ አፌ ኰልታፋ ምላሴም ጸያፍ የሆነ ሰው ነኝ፤ ትናንት ከትናንት ወዲያ ባሪያህንም ከተናገርኸኝ ጀምሮ አፈ ትብ ሰው አይደለሁም።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto him, Who hath made man's mouth? or who maketh the dumb, or deaf, or the seeing, or the blind? have not I the Lord?
verses.fr: L''Eternel lui dit: Qui a fait la bouche de l''homme? et qui rend muet ou sourd, voyant ou aveugle? N''est-ce pas moi, l''Eternel?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። የሰውን አፍ የፈጠረ ማን ነው? ዲዳስ ደንቆሮስ የሚያይስ ዕውርስ ያደረገ ማን ነው? እኔ እግዚአብሔር አይደለሁምን?

verses.en: Now therefore go, and I will be with thy mouth, and teach thee what thou shalt say.
verses.fr: Va donc, je serai avec ta bouche, et je t''enseignerai ce que tu auras à dire.
verses.am: እንግዲህ አሁን ሂድ፥ እኔም ከአፍህ ጋር እሆናለሁ፥ የምትናገረውንም አስተምርሃለሁ አለው።

verses.en: And he said, O my Lord, send, I pray thee, by the hand of him whom thou wilt send.
verses.fr: Moïse dit: Ah! Seigneur, envoie qui tu voudras envoyer.
verses.am: እርሱም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ በምትልከው ሰው እጅ ትልክ ዘንድ እለምንሃለሁ አለ።

verses.en: And the anger of the Lord was kindled against Moses, and he said, Is not Aaron the Levite thy brother? I know that he can speak well. And also, behold, he cometh forth to meet thee: and when he seeth thee, he will be glad in his heart.
verses.fr: Alors la colère de l''Eternel s''enflamma contre Moïse, et il dit: N''y a t-il pas ton frère Aaron, le Lévite? Je sais qu''il parlera facilement. Le voici lui-même, qui vient au-devant de toi; et, quand il te verra, il se réjouira dans son coeur.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቍጣ በሙሴ ላይ ነደደ እንዲህም አለ። ሌዋዊው ወንድምህ አሮን አለ አይደለምን? እርሱ ደህና እንዲናገር አውቃለሁ፤ እነሆም ደግሞ ሊገናኝህ ይመጣል፤ ባየህም ጊዜ በልቡ ደስ ይለዋል።

verses.en: And thou shalt speak unto him, and put words in his mouth: and I will be with thy mouth, and with his mouth, and will teach you what ye shall do.
verses.fr: Tu lui parleras, et tu mettras les paroles dans sa bouche; et moi, je serai avec ta bouche et avec sa bouche, et je vous enseignerai ce que vous aurez à faire.
verses.am: አንተም ትናገረዋለህ ቃሉንም በአፉ ታደርገዋለህ፤ እኔ ከአፍህና ከአፉ ጋር እሆናለሁ፥ የምታደርጉትንም አስተምራችኋለሁ።

verses.en: And he shall be thy spokesman unto the people: and he shall be, even he shall be to thee instead of a mouth, and thou shalt be to him instead of God.
verses.fr: Il parlera pour toi au peuple; il te servira de bouche, et tu tiendras pour lui la place de Dieu.
verses.am: እርሱ ስለ አንተ ከሕዝቡ ጋር ይናገራል፤ እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ እርሱ አፍ ይሆንልሃል አንተም በእግዚአብሔር ፋንታ ትሆንለታለህ።

verses.en: And thou shalt take this rod in thine hand, wherewith thou shalt do signs.
verses.fr: Prends dans ta main cette verge, avec laquelle tu feras les signes.
verses.am: ይህችንም ተአምራት የምታደርግባትን በትር በእጅህ ይዘሃት ሂድ።

verses.en: And Moses went and returned to Jethro his father in law, and said unto him, Let me go, I pray thee, and return unto my brethren which are in Egypt, and see whether they be yet alive. And Jethro said to Moses, Go in peace.
verses.fr: Moïse s''en alla; et de retour auprès de Jéthro, son beau-père, il lui dit: Laisse-moi, je te prie, aller rejoindre mes frères qui sont en Egypte, afin que je voie s''ils sont encore vivants. Jéthro dit à Moïse: Va en paix.
verses.am: ሙሴም ሄደ፥ ወደ አማቱ ወደ ዮቶር ተመለሰ። እስከ ዛሬ በሕይወት እንዳሉ አይ ዘንድ ተመልሼ ወደ ግብፅ ወደ ወንድሞቼ ልሂድ አለው። ዮቶርም ሙሴን። በሰላም ሂድ አለው።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses in Midian, Go, return into Egypt: for all the men are dead which sought thy life.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse, en Madian: Va, retourne en Egypte, car tous ceux qui en voulaient à ta vie sont morts.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን በምድያም። ነፍስህን የሚሹአት ሰዎች ሁሉ ሞተዋልና ተመልሰህ ወደ ግብፅ ሂድ አለው።

verses.en: And Moses took his wife and his sons, and set them upon an ass, and he returned to the land of Egypt: and Moses took the rod of God in his hand.
verses.fr: Moïse prit sa femme et ses fils, les fit monter sur des ânes, et retourna dans le pays d''Egypte. Il prit dans sa main la verge de Dieu.
verses.am: ሙሴም ሚስቱንና ልጆቹን ወሰደ፥ በአህያ ላይም አስቀመጣቸው፥ ወደ ግብፅም አገር ተመለሰ፤ ሙሴም የእግዚአብሔርን በትር ይዞ ሄደ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, When thou goest to return into Egypt, see that thou do all those wonders before Pharaoh, which I have put in thine hand: but I will harden his heart, that he shall not let the people go.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse: En partant pour retourner en Egypte, vois tous les prodiges que je mets en ta main: tu les feras devant Pharaon. Et moi, j''endurcirai son coeur, et il ne laissera point aller le peuple.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን አለው። ወደ ግብፅ ስትመለስ በእጅህ ያደረግሁትን ተአምራት ሁሉ በፈርዖን ፊት ታደርገው ዘንድ ተመልከት፤ እኔ ግን ልቡን አጸናዋለሁ፥ ሕዝቡንም አይለቅቅም።

verses.en: And thou shalt say unto Pharaoh, Thus saith the Lord, Israel is my son, even my firstborn:
verses.fr: Tu diras à Pharaon: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Israël est mon fils, mon premier-né.
verses.am: ፈርዖንንም። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል።

verses.en: And I say unto thee, Let my son go, that he may serve me: and if thou refuse to let him go, behold, I will slay thy son, even thy firstborn.
verses.fr: Je te dis: Laisse aller mon fils, pour qu''il me serve; si tu refuses de le laisser aller, voici, je ferai périr ton fils, ton premier-né.
verses.am: እስራኤል የበኵር ልጄ ነው፤ ይገዛልኝ ዘንድ ልጄን ልቀቅ አልሁህ፤ አንተም ትለቅቀው ዘንድ እንቢ አልህ፤ እነሆ እኔ የበኵር ልጅህን እገድላለሁ ትለዋለህ።

verses.en: And it came to pass by the way in the inn, that the Lord met him, and sought to kill him.
verses.fr: Pendant le voyage, en un lieu où Moïse passa la nuit, l''Eternel l''attaqua et voulut le faire mourir.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በመንገድ ላይ ባደረበት ስፍራ እግዚአብሔር ተገናኘው፥ ሊገድለውም ፈለገ።

verses.en: Then Zipporah took a sharp stone, and cut off the foreskin of her son, and cast it at his feet, and said, Surely a bloody husband art thou to me.
verses.fr: Séphora prit une pierre aiguë, coupa le prépuce de son fils, et le jeta aux pieds de Moïse, en disant: Tu es pour moi un époux de sang!
verses.am: ሲፓራም ሚስቱ ባልጩት ወሰደች፥ የልጅዋንም ሸለፈት ገረዘች፥ ወደ እግሩም ጣለችው። አንተ ለእኔ የደም ሙሽራ ነህ አለች።

verses.en: So he let him go: then she said, A bloody husband thou art, because of the circumcision.
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel le laissa. C''est alors qu''elle dit: Epoux de sang! à cause de la circoncision.
verses.am: ከእርሱም ፈቀቅ አለ። የዚያን ጊዜ። ስለ ግርዛቱ አንተ የደም ሙሽራ ነህ አለች።

verses.en: And the Lord said to Aaron, Go into the wilderness to meet Moses. And he went, and met him in the mount of God, and kissed him.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Aaron: Va dans le désert au-devant de Moïse. Aaron partit; il rencontra Moïse à la montagne de Dieu, et il le baisa.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አሮንን። ሄደህ በምድረ በዳ ሙሴን ተገናኘው አለው፤ ሄዶም በእግዚአብሔር ተራራ ተገናኘው፥ ሳመውም።

verses.en: And Moses told Aaron all the words of the Lord who had sent him, and all the signs which he had commanded him.
verses.fr: Moïse fit connaître à Aaron toutes les paroles de l''Eternel qui l''avait envoyé, et tous les signes qu''il lui avait ordonné de faire.
verses.am: ሙሴም እግዚአብሔር በእርሱ ዘንድ የላከውን ቃል ሁሉ ያዘዘውንም ተአምራት ሁሉ ለአሮን ተናገረው።

verses.en: And Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of the children of Israel:
verses.fr: Moïse et Aaron poursuivirent leur chemin, et ils assemblèrent tous les anciens des enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: ሙሴና አሮንም ሄዱ የእስራኤልንም ልጆች ሽማግሌዎች ሁሉ ሰበሰቡ።

verses.en: And Aaron spake all the words which the Lord had spoken unto Moses, and did the signs in the sight of the people.
verses.fr: Aaron rapporta toutes les paroles que l''Eternel avait dites à Moïse, et il exécuta les signes aux yeux du peuple.
verses.am: አሮንም እግዚአብሔር ለሙሴ የነገረውን ቃል ሁሉ ተናገረ፥ ተአምራቱንም በሕዝቡ ፊት አደረገ።

verses.en: And the people believed: and when they heard that the Lord had visited the children of Israel, and that he had looked upon their affliction, then they bowed their heads and worshipped.
verses.fr: Et le peuple crut. Ils apprirent que l''Eternel avait visité les enfants d''Israël, qu''il avait vu leur souffrance; et ils s''inclinèrent et se prosternèrent.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም አመኑ፤ እግዚአብሔርም የእስራኤልን ልጆች እንደ ጐበኘ ጭንቀታቸውንም እንዳየ በሰሙ ጊዜ፥ አጐነበሱ ሰገዱም።

verses.en: And afterward Moses and Aaron went in, and told Pharaoh, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Let my people go, that they may hold a feast unto me in the wilderness.
verses.fr: Moïse et Aaron se rendirent ensuite auprès de Pharaon, et lui dirent: Ainsi parle l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël: Laisse aller mon peuple, pour qu''il célèbre au désert une fête en mon honneur.
verses.am: ከዚህም በኋላ ሙሴና አሮን መጥተው ፈርዖንን እንዲህ አሉት። የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በምድረ በዳ በዓል ያደርግልኝ ዘንድ ሕዝቤን ልቀቅ።

verses.en: And Pharaoh said, Who is the Lord, that I should obey his voice to let Israel go? I know not the Lord, neither will I let Israel go.
verses.fr: Pharaon répondit: Qui est l''Eternel, pour que j''obéisse à sa voix, en laissant aller Israël? Je ne connais point l''Eternel, et je ne laisserai point aller Israël.
verses.am: ፈርዖንም። ቃሉን እሰማ ዘንድ እስራኤልንስ እለቅቅ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ማን ነው? እግዚአብሔርን አላውቅም፥ እስራኤልንም ደግሞ አልለቅቅም አለ።

verses.en: And they said, The God of the Hebrews hath met with us: let us go, we pray thee, three days' journey into the desert, and sacrifice unto the Lord our God; lest he fall upon us with pestilence, or with the sword.
verses.fr: Ils dirent: Le Dieu des Hébreux nous est apparu. Permets-nous de faire trois journées de marche dans le désert, pour offrir des sacrifices à l''Eternel, afin qu''il ne nous frappe pas de la peste ou de l''épée.
verses.am: እነርሱም። የዕብራውያን አምላክ ተገናኘን፤ ቸነፈር ወይም ሰይፍ እንዳይጥልብን የሦስት ቀን መንገድ በምድረ በዳ እንድንሄድ፥ ለአምላካችን ለእግዚአብሔር እንድንሠዋ እንለምንሃለን አሉት።

verses.en: And the king of Egypt said unto them, Wherefore do ye, Moses and Aaron, let the people from their works? get you unto your burdens.
verses.fr: Et le roi d''Egypte leur dit: Moïse et Aaron, pourquoi détournez-vous le peuple de son ouvrage? Allez à vos travaux.
verses.am: የግብፅ ንጉሥም። አንተ ሙሴ አንተም አሮን፥ ሕዝቡን ለምን ሥራቸውን ታስተዋላችሁ? ወደ ተግባራችሁ ሂዱ አላቸው።

verses.en: And Pharaoh said, Behold, the people of the land now are many, and ye make them rest from their burdens.
verses.fr: Pharaon dit: Voici, ce peuple est maintenant nombreux dans le pays, et vous lui feriez interrompre ses travaux!
verses.am: ፈርዖንም። እነሆ የምድሩ ሕዝብ አሁን በዝቶአል፥ እናንተም ሥራቸውን ታስፈቱአቸዋላችሁ አለ።

verses.en: And Pharaoh commanded the same day the taskmasters of the people, and their officers, saying,
verses.fr: Et ce jour même, Pharaon donna cet ordre aux inspecteurs du peuple et aux commissaires:
verses.am: ፈርዖንም በዚያን ቀን የሕዝቡን አስገባሪዎች ሹማምቶቹንም እንዲህ ሲል አዘዘ።

verses.en: Ye shall no more give the people straw to make brick, as heretofore: let them go and gather straw for themselves.
verses.fr: Vous ne donnerez plus comme auparavant de la paille au peuple pour faire des briques; qu''ils aillent eux-mêmes se ramasser de la paille.
verses.am: እንደ ወትሮው ለጡብ ሥራ ደግሞ ገለባ ለሕዝቡ አትስጡ፤ ነገር ግን እነርሱ ሄደው ገለባ ይሰብስቡ።

verses.en: And the tale of the bricks, which they did make heretofore, ye shall lay upon them; ye shall not diminish ought thereof: for they be idle; therefore they cry, saying, Let us go and sacrifice to our God.
verses.fr: Vous leur imposerez néanmoins la quantité de briques qu''ils faisaient auparavant, vous n''en retrancherez rien; car ce sont des paresseux; voilà pourquoi ils crient, en disant: Allons offrir des sacrifices à notre Dieu!
verses.am: ቀድሞ ያደርጉት የነበረውን የጡብ ቍጥር በእነርሱ ላይ አድርጉት፤ ምንም ከእርሱ አታጕድሉ፤ ሥራ ሰልችተዋልና ስለዚህ። ለአምላካችን እንድንሰዋ እንሂድ እያሉ ይጮኻሉ።

verses.en: Let there more work be laid upon the men, that they may labour therein; and let them not regard vain words.
verses.fr: Que l''on charge de travail ces gens, qu''ils s''en occupent, et ils ne prendront plus garde à des paroles de mensonge.
verses.am: እርሱንም ያደርጉ ዘንድ በሰዎች ላይ ሥራው ይክበድባቸው፤ ከንቱ ቃልም አያስቡ።

verses.en: And the taskmasters of the people went out, and their officers, and they spake to the people, saying, Thus saith Pharaoh, I will not give you straw.
verses.fr: Les inspecteurs du peuple et les commissaires vinrent dire au peuple: Ainsi parle Pharaon: Je ne vous donne plus de paille;
verses.am: የሕዝቡም አስገባሪዎች ሹማምቶቹም ወጡ፥ ሕዝቡንም። ፈርዖን እንዲህ ይላል። ገለባ አልሰጣችሁም።

verses.en: Go ye, get you straw where ye can find it: yet not ought of your work shall be diminished.
verses.fr: allez vous-mêmes vous procurer de la paille où vous en trouverez, car l''on ne retranche rien de votre travail.
verses.am: እናንተ ሂዱ፥ ከምታገኙበትም ስፍራ ገለባ ሰብስቡ፤ ከሥራችሁ ግን ምንም አይጐድልም አሉአቸው።

verses.en: So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble instead of straw.
verses.fr: Le peuple se répandit dans tout le pays d''Egypte, pour ramasser du chaume au lieu de paille.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ስለ ገለባ እብቅ ሊሰበስቡ በግብፅ ምድር ሁሉ ተበተኑ።

verses.en: And the taskmasters hasted them, saying, Fulfil your works, your daily tasks, as when there was straw.
verses.fr: Les inspecteurs les pressaient, en disant: Achevez votre tâche, jour par jour, comme quand il y avait de la paille.
verses.am: አስገባሪዎቹም። ገለባ ትቀበሉበት እንደ ነበረ ጊዜ የቀን ሥራችሁን ጨርሱ እያሉ አስቸኰሉአቸው።

verses.en: And the officers of the children of Israel, which Pharaoh's taskmasters had set over them, were beaten, and demanded, Wherefore have ye not fulfilled your task in making brick both yesterday and to day, as heretofore?
verses.fr: On battit même les commissaires des enfants d''Israël, établis sur eux par les inspecteurs de Pharaon: Pourquoi, disait-on, n''avez-vous pas achevé hier et aujourd''hui, comme auparavant, la quantité de briques qui vous avait été fixée?
verses.am: የፈርዖንም አስገባሪዎች። ቀድሞ ታደርጉ እንደ ነበራችሁ ትናንትናና ዛሬ የተቈጠረውን ጡብ ስለ ምን አትጨርሱም? እያሉ በእስራኤል ልጆች ላይ የተሾሙትን አለቆቹን ገረፉ።

verses.en: Then the officers of the children of Israel came and cried unto Pharaoh, saying, Wherefore dealest thou thus with thy servants?
verses.fr: Les commissaires des enfants d''Israël allèrent se plaindre à Pharaon, et lui dirent: Pourquoi traites-tu ainsi tes serviteurs?
verses.am: የእስራኤል ልጆች አለቆችም ወደ ፈርዖን መጡ። ለምን በባሪያዎችህ እንዲህ ታደርጋለህ?

verses.en: There is no straw given unto thy servants, and they say to us, Make brick: and, behold, thy servants are beaten; but the fault is in thine own people.
verses.fr: On ne donne point de paille à tes serviteurs, et l''on nous dit: Faites des briques! Et voici, tes serviteurs sont battus, comme si ton peuple était coupable.
verses.am: ገለባ አይሰጡንም፥ የጡቡንም ሥራ እንድንሠራ ያዝዙናል፤ እነሆም ባሪያዎችህን ይገርፉናል፤ ግድፈቱ ግን በአንተ ሕዝብ ላይ ነው ብለው ጮኹ።

verses.en: But he said, Ye are idle, ye are idle: therefore ye say, Let us go and do sacrifice to the Lord.
verses.fr: Pharaon répondit: Vous êtes des paresseux, des paresseux! Voilà pourquoi vous dites: Allons offrir des sacrifices à l''Eternel!
verses.am: እርሱ ግን። ሰልችታችኋል፥ ሰልችታችኋል፤ ስለዚህም። እንሂድ ለእግዚአብሔርም እንሠዋ ትላላችሁ።

verses.en: Go therefore now, and work; for there shall no straw be given you, yet shall ye deliver the tale of bricks.
verses.fr: Maintenant, allez travailler; on ne vous donnera point de paille, et vous livrerez la même quantité de briques.
verses.am: አሁንም ሂዱ፥ ሥሩ፤ ገለባ አይሰጡአችሁም፥ የጡቡን ቍጥር ግን ታመጣላችሁ አላቸው።

verses.en: And the officers of the children of Israel did see that they were in evil case, after it was said, Ye shall not minish ought from your bricks of your daily task.
verses.fr: Les commissaires des enfants d''Israël virent qu''on les rendait malheureux, en disant: Vous ne retrancherez rien de vos briques; chaque jour la tâche du jour.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች አለቆች። ዕለት ዕለት ከምትሰሩት ከጡቡ ቍጥር ምንም አታጕድሉ ባሉአቸው ጊዜ ነገሩ እንደ ከፋባቸው አዩ።

verses.en: And they met Moses and Aaron, who stood in the way, as they came forth from Pharaoh:
verses.fr: En sortant de chez Pharaon, ils rencontrèrent Moïse et Aaron qui les attendaient.
verses.am: ከፈርዖንም ዘንድ ሲወጡ ሙሴንና አሮንን በፊታቸው ቆመው ተገናኙአቸው።

verses.en: And they said unto them, The Lord look upon you, and judge; because ye have made our savour to be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of his servants, to put a sword in their hand to slay us.
verses.fr: Ils leur dirent: Que l''Eternel vous regarde, et qu''il juge! Vous nous avez rendus odieux à Pharaon et à ses serviteurs, vous avez mis une épée dans leurs mains pour nous faire périr.
verses.am: እነርሱም። በፈርዖንና በባሪያዎቹ ፊት ሽታችንን አግምታችሁታልና፥ ይገድሉንም ዘንድ ሰይፍን በእጃቸው ሰጥታችኋቸዋልና እግዚአብሔር ይመልከታችሁ ይፍረድባችሁም አሉአቸው።

verses.en: And Moses returned unto the Lord, and said, Lord, wherefore hast thou so evil entreated this people? why is it that thou hast sent me?
verses.fr: Moïse retourna vers l''Eternel, et dit: Seigneur, pourquoi as-tu fait du mal à ce peuple? pourquoi m''as-tu envoyé?
verses.am: ሙሴም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ተመለሰና። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ስለ ምን ይህን ሕዝብ አስከፋህ? ስለ ምንስ ላክኸኝ?

verses.en: For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in thy name, he hath done evil to this people; neither hast thou delivered thy people at all.
verses.fr: Depuis que je suis allé vers Pharaon pour parler en ton nom, il fait du mal à ce peuple, et tu n''as point délivré ton peuple.
verses.am: በስምህ እናገር ዘንድ ወደ ፈርዖን ከገባሁ ወዲህ፥ ይህን ሕዝብ አስከፍቶታልና፤ አንተም ሕዝብህን ከቶ አላዳንኸውም አለ።

verses.en: Then the Lord said unto Moses, Now shalt thou see what I will do to Pharaoh: for with a strong hand shall he let them go, and with a strong hand shall he drive them out of his land.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse: Tu verras maintenant ce que je ferai à Pharaon; une main puissante le forcera à les laisser aller, une main puissante le forcera à les chasser de son pays.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን አለው። በጸናች እጅ ይለቅቃችኋልና፥ በጸናችም እጅ ከምድሩ አስወጥቶ ይሰድዳቸዋልና አሁን በፈርዖን የማደርገውን ታያለህ።

verses.en: And God spake unto Moses, and said unto him, I am the Lord:
verses.fr: Dieu parla encore à Moïse, et lui dit: Je suis l''Eternel.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን ተናገረው አለውም። እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ፤

verses.en: And I appeared unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, by the name of God Almighty, but by my name Jehovah was I not known to them.
verses.fr: Je suis apparu à Abraham, à Isaac et à Jacob, comme le Dieu tout-puissant; mais je n''ai pas été connu d''eux sous mon nom, l''Eternel.
verses.am: ለአብርሃምም ለይስሐቅም ለያዕቆብም ሁሉን እንደሚችል አምላክ ተገለጥሁ፤ ነገር ግን ስሜ እግዚአብሔር አልታወቀላቸውም ነበር።

verses.en: And I have also established my covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their pilgrimage, wherein they were strangers.
verses.fr: J''ai aussi établi mon alliance avec eux, pour leur donner le pays de Canaan, le pays de leurs pèlerinages, dans lequel ils ont séjourné.
verses.am: የተሰደዱባትንም ምድር፥ የእንግድነታቸውን የከነዓንን ምድር፥ እሰጣቸው ዘንድ ከእነርሱ ጋር ቃል ኪዳኔን አቆምሁ።

verses.en: And I have also heard the groaning of the children of Israel, whom the Egyptians keep in bondage; and I have remembered my covenant.
verses.fr: J''ai entendu les gémissements des enfants d''Israël, que les Egyptiens tiennent dans la servitude, et je me suis souvenu de mon alliance.
verses.am: ደግሞ እኔ ግብፃውያን የገዙአቸውን የእስራኤልን ልጆች ልቅሶ ሰማሁ፤ ቃል ኪዳኔንም አሰብሁ።

verses.en: Wherefore say unto the children of Israel, I am the Lord, and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians, and I will rid you out of their bondage, and I will redeem you with a stretched out arm, and with great judgments:
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi dis aux enfants d''Israël: Je suis l''Eternel, je vous affranchirai des travaux dont vous chargent les Egyptiens, je vous délivrerai de leur servitude, et je vous sauverai à bras étendu et par de grands jugements.
verses.am: ስለዚህም ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ በላቸው። እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ፥ ከግብፃውያንም ባርነት አወጣችኋለሁ፥ ከተገዥነታቸውም አድናችኋለሁ፤ በተዘረጋ ክንድ በታላቅ ፍርድም እታደጋችኋለሁ፥

verses.en: And I will take you to me for a people, and I will be to you a God: and ye shall know that I am the Lord your God, which bringeth you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.
verses.fr: Je vous prendrai pour mon peuple, je serai votre Dieu, et vous saurez que c''est moi, l''Eternel, votre Dieu, qui vous affranchis des travaux dont vous chargent les Egyptiens.
verses.am: ለእኔም ሕዝብ እንድትሆኑ እቀበላችኋለሁ፥ አምላክም እሆናችኋለሁ፤ እኔም ከግብፃውያን ባርነት ያወጣኋችሁ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ እንደሆንሁ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.en: And I will bring you in unto the land, concerning the which I did swear to give it to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; and I will give it you for an heritage: I am the Lord.
verses.fr: Je vous ferai entrer dans le pays que j''ai juré de donner à Abraham, à Isaac et à Jacob; je vous le donnerai en possession, moi l''Eternel.
verses.am: ለአብርሃምና ለይስሐቅ ለያዕቆብም እሰጣት ዘንድ ወደ ማልሁባት ምድር አገባችኋለሁ፤ እርስዋንም ርስት አድርጌ እሰጣችኋለሁ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ።

verses.en: And Moses spake so unto the children of Israel: but they hearkened not unto Moses for anguish of spirit, and for cruel bondage.
verses.fr: Ainsi parla Moïse aux enfants d''Israël. Mais l''angoisse et la dure servitude les empêchèrent d''écouter Moïse.
verses.am: ሙሴም ይህን ለእስራኤል ልጆች ተናገረ፤ እነርሱ ግን ከሰውነታቸው መጨነቅ ከከባዱም ሥራ የተነሣ ቃሉን አልሰሙትም።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Go in, speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.
verses.fr: Va, parle à Pharaon, roi d''Egypte, pour qu''il laisse aller les enfants d''Israël hors de son pays.
verses.am: ግባ፥ የእስራኤልንም ልጆች ከአገሩ ይለቅቅ ዘንድ ለግብፅ ንጉሥ ለፈርዖን ንገር።

verses.en: And Moses spake before the Lord, saying, Behold, the children of Israel have not hearkened unto me; how then shall Pharaoh hear me, who am of uncircumcised lips?
verses.fr: Moïse répondit en présence de l''Eternel: Voici, les enfants d''Israël ne m''ont point écouté; comment Pharaon m''écouterait-il, moi qui n''ai pas la parole facile?
verses.am: ሙሴም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት። እነሆ የእስራኤል ልጆች አልሰሙኝም፤ እንዴትስ ፈርዖን ይሰማኛል? ይልቁንም እኔ ከንፈረ ቈላፍ ነኝ ብሎ ተናገረ።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, and gave them a charge unto the children of Israel, and unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse et à Aaron, et leur donna des ordres au sujet des enfants d''Israël et au sujet de Pharaon, roi d''Egypte, pour faire sortir du pays d''Egypte les enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴንና አሮንን ተናገራቸው፥ የግብፅ ንጉሥ ፈርዖንም የእስራኤልን ልጆች ከግብፅ እንዲያወጣቸው ይነግሩት ዘንድ አዘዛቸው።

verses.en: These be the heads of their fathers' houses: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel; Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi: these be the families of Reuben.
verses.fr: Voici les chefs de leurs familles. Fils de Ruben, premier-né d''Israël: Hénoc, Pallu, Hetsron et Carmi. Ce sont là les familles de Ruben.
verses.am: የአባታቸውም ቤት አለቆች እነዚህ ናቸው። የእስራኤል የበኵር ልጅ የሮቤል ልጆች፤ ሄኖኅ፥ ፈሉስ፥ አስሮን፥ ከርሚ፤ እነዚህ የሮቤል ወገኖች ናቸው።

verses.en: And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman: these are the families of Simeon.
verses.fr: Fils de Siméon: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin et Tsochar; et Saül, fils de la Cananéenne. Ce sont là les familles de Siméon.
verses.am: የስምዖንም ልጆች፤ ይሙኤል፥ ያሚን፥ ኦሃድ፥ ያኪን፥ ዶሐር፥ የከነዓናዊቱም ልጅ ሳኡል፤ እነዚህ የስምዖን ወገኖች ናቸው።

verses.en: And these are the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations; Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari: and the years of the life of Levi were an hundred thirty and seven years.
verses.fr: Voici les noms des fils de Lévi, avec leur postérité: Guerschon, Kehath et Merari. Les années de la vie de Lévi furent de cent trente-sept ans. -
verses.am: እነዚህም እንደ ወገኖቻቸው የሌዊ ልጆች ስሞች ጌድሶን፥ ቀዓት፥ ሜራሪ ናቸው። የሌዊም የሕይወት ዘመን መቶ ሠላሳ ሰባት ዓመት ነው።

verses.en: The sons of Gershon; Libni, and Shimi, according to their families.
verses.fr: Fils de Guerschon: Libni et Schimeï, et leurs familles. -
verses.am: የጌድሶንም ልጆች እንደ ወገኖቻቸው ሎቤኒ፥ ሰሜኢ ናቸው።

verses.en: And the sons of Kohath; Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel: and the years of the life of Kohath were an hundred thirty and three years.
verses.fr: Fils de Kehath: Amram, Jitsehar, Hébron et Uziel. Les années de la vie de Kehath furent de cent trente-trois ans. -
verses.am: የቀዓትም ልጆች እንበረም፥ ይስዓር፥ ኬብሮን፥ ዑዝኤል ናቸው፤ የቀዓትም የሕይወቱ ዘመን መቶ ሠላሳ ሦስት ዓመት ነው።

verses.en: And the sons of Merari; Mahali and Mushi: these are the families of Levi according to their generations.
verses.fr: Fils de Merari: Machli et Muschi. -Ce sont là les familles de Lévi, avec leur postérité.
verses.am: የሜራሪ ልጆች ሞሖሊ፥ ሙሲ ናቸው። እነዚህ እንደ ትውልዳቸው የሌዊ ወገኖች ናቸው።

verses.en: And Amram took him Jochebed his father's sister to wife; and she bare him Aaron and Moses: and the years of the life of Amram were an hundred and thirty and seven years.
verses.fr: Amram prit pour femme Jokébed, sa tante; et elle lui enfanta Aaron, et Moïse. Les années de la vie d''Amram furent de cent trente-sept ans. -
verses.am: እንበረምም የአጎቱን ልጅ ዮካብድን አገባ፥ አሮንና ሙሴንም ወለደችለት፤ የእንበረምም የሕይወቱ ዘመን መቶ ሠላሳ ሰባት ዓመት ነው።

verses.en: And the sons of Izhar; Korah, and Nepheg, and Zichri.
verses.fr: Fils de Jitsehar: Koré, Népheg et Zicri. -
verses.am: የይስዓር ልጆች ቆሬ፥ ናፌግ፥ ዝክሪ ናቸው።

verses.en: And the sons of Uzziel; Mishael, and Elzaphan, and Zithri.
verses.fr: Fils d''Uziel: Mischaël, Eltsaphan et Sithri.
verses.am: የዑዝኤል ልጆች ሚሳኤል፥ ኤልዳፋን፥ ሥትሪ ናቸው።

verses.en: And Aaron took him Elisheba, daughter of Amminadab, sister of Naashon, to wife; and she bare him Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.fr: Aaron prit pour femme Elischéba, fille d''Amminadab, soeur de Nachschon; et elle lui enfanta Nadab, Abihu, Eléazar et Ithamar.
verses.am: አሮንም የአሚናዳብን የነአሶንን እኅት ኤልሳቤጥን አገባ፥ እርስዋም ናዳብንና አብዮድን አልዓዛርንና ኢታምርን ወለደችለት።

verses.en: And the sons of Korah; Assir, and Elkanah, and Abiasaph: these are the families of the Korhites.
verses.fr: Fils de Koré: Assir, Elkana et Abiasaph. Ce sont là les familles des Korites.
verses.am: የቆሬ ልጆች አሴር፥ ሕልቃና፥ አብያሳፍ ናቸው፤ እነዚህ የቆሬ ልጆች ወገኖች ናቸው።

verses.en: And Eleazar Aaron's son took him one of the daughters of Putiel to wife; and she bare him Phinehas: these are the heads of the fathers of the Levites according to their families.
verses.fr: Eléazar, fils d''Aaron, prit pour femme une des filles de Puthiel; et elle lui enfanta Phinées. Tels sont les chefs de famille des Lévites, avec leurs familles.
verses.am: የአሮንም ልጅ አልዓዛር ከፉትኤል ልጆች ሚስት አገባ፥ እርስዋም ፊንሐስን ወለደችለት። እነዚህ እንደ ወገኖቻቸው የሌዋውያን አባቶች አለቆች ናቸው።

verses.en: These are that Aaron and Moses, to whom the Lord said, Bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their armies.
verses.fr: Ce sont là cet Aaron et ce Moïse, à qui l''Eternel dit: Faites sortir du pays d''Egypte les enfants d''Israël, selon leurs armées.
verses.am: እነዚህ አሮንና ሙሴ እግዚአብሔር። ከግብፅ ምድር በየሠራዊቶቻቸው የእስራኤልን ልጆች አውጡ ያላቸው ናቸው።

verses.en: These are they which spake to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt: these are that Moses and Aaron.
verses.fr: Ce sont eux qui parlèrent à Pharaon, roi d''Egypte, pour faire sortir d''Egypte les enfants d''Israël. Ce sont là ce Moïse et cet Aaron.
verses.am: እነዚህ የእስራኤልን ልጆች ከግብፅ ያወጡ ዘንድ ከግብፅ ንጉሥ ከፈርዖን ጋር የተነጋገሩ ናቸው፤ እነዚህ ሙሴና አሮን ናቸው።

verses.en: And it came to pass on the day when the Lord spake unto Moses in the land of Egypt,
verses.fr: Lorsque l''Eternel parla à Moïse dans le pays d''Egypte,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በግብፅ አገር ሙሴን በተናገረው ቀን እንዲህ ሆነ፤

verses.en: That the Lord spake unto Moses, saying, I am the Lord: speak thou unto Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I say unto thee.
verses.fr: l''Eternel dit à Moïse: Je suis l''Eternel. Dis à Pharaon, roi d''Egypte, tout ce que je te dis.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን። እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ፤ እኔ የምነግርህን ሁሉ ለግብፅ ንጉሥ ለፈርዖን ንገር ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: And Moses said before the Lord, Behold, I am of uncircumcised lips, and how shall Pharaoh hearken unto me?
verses.fr: Et Moïse répondit en présence de l''Eternel: Voici, je n''ai pas la parole facile; comment Pharaon m''écouterait-il?
verses.am: ሙሴም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት። እነሆ እኔ ከንፈረ ቈላፍ ነኝ፤ እንዴትስ ፈርዖን ይሰማኛል? አለ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, See, I have made thee a god to Pharaoh: and Aaron thy brother shall be thy prophet.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse: Vois, je te fais Dieu pour Pharaon: et Aaron, ton frère, sera ton prophète.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን አለው። እይ፥ እኔ ለፈርዖን አምላክ አድርጌሃለሁ፤ ወንድምህም አሮን ነቢይ ይሆንልሃል።

verses.en: Thou shalt speak all that I command thee: and Aaron thy brother shall speak unto Pharaoh, that he send the children of Israel out of his land.
verses.fr: Toi, tu diras tout ce que je t''ordonnerai; et Aaron, ton frère, parlera à Pharaon, pour qu''il laisse aller les enfants d''Israël hors de son pays.
verses.am: ያዘዝሁህን ነገር ሁሉ አንተ ትነግረዋለህ፤ ወንድምህም አሮን የእስራኤልን ልጆች ከአገሩ ይለቅቅ ዘንድ ከፈርዖን ጋር ይናገራል።

verses.en: And I will harden Pharaoh's heart, and multiply my signs and my wonders in the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: Et moi, j''endurcirai le coeur de Pharaon, et je multiplierai mes signes et mes miracles dans le pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: እኔም የፈርዖንን ልብ አጸናለሁ፥ በግብፅ ምድርም ድንቄንና ተአምራቴን አበዛለሁ።

verses.en: But Pharaoh shall not hearken unto you, that I may lay my hand upon Egypt, and bring forth mine armies, and my people the children of Israel, out of the land of Egypt by great judgments.
verses.fr: Pharaon ne vous écoutera point. Je mettrai ma main sur l''Egypte, et je ferai sortir du pays d''Egypte mes armées, mon peuple, les enfants d''Israël, par de grands jugements.
verses.am: ፈርዖንም አይሰማችሁም፥ እጄንም በግብፅ ላይ አደርጋለሁ፥ ሠራዊቴንም የእስራኤልን ልጆች ሕዝቤን በታላቅ ፍርድ ከግብፅ አገር አወጣለሁ።

verses.en: And the Egyptians shall know that I am the Lord, when I stretch forth mine hand upon Egypt, and bring out the children of Israel from among them.
verses.fr: Les Egyptiens connaîtront que je suis l''Eternel, lorsque j''étendrai ma main sur l''Egypte, et que je ferai sortir du milieu d''eux les enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: ግብፃውያንም፥ እጄን በግብፅ ላይ በዘረጋሁ ጊዜ፥ የእስራኤልንም ልጆች ከመካከላቸው ባወጣሁ ጊዜ፥ እኔ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆነሁ ያውቃሉ።

verses.en: And Moses and Aaron did as the Lord commanded them, so did they.
verses.fr: Moïse et Aaron firent ce que l''Eternel leur avait ordonné; ils firent ainsi.
verses.am: ሙሴና አሮንም እንዲህ አደረጉ፤ እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዛቸው አደረጉ።

verses.en: And Moses was fourscore years old, and Aaron fourscore and three years old, when they spake unto Pharaoh.
verses.fr: Moïse était âgé de quatre-vingts ans, et Aaron de quatre-vingt-trois ans, lorsqu''ils parlèrent à Pharaon.
verses.am: ፈርዖንንም በተናገሩት ጊዜ ሙሴ የሰማንያ ዓመት ሰው ነበረ፥ አሮንም የሰማንያ ሦስት ዓመት ሰው ነበረ።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse et à Aaron:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴንና አሮንን እንዲህ ሲል ተናገራቸው።

verses.en: When Pharaoh shall speak unto you, saying, Shew a miracle for you: then thou shalt say unto Aaron, Take thy rod, and cast it before Pharaoh, and it shall become a serpent.
verses.fr: Si Pharaon vous parle, et vous dit: Faites un miracle! tu diras à Aaron: Prends ta verge, et jette-la devant Pharaon. Elle deviendra un serpent.
verses.am: ፈርዖን። ተአምራትን አሳዩኝ ሲላችሁ፥ አሮንን። በትርህን ወስደህ እባብ እንድትሆን በፈርዖን ፊት ጣላት በለው።

verses.en: And Moses and Aaron went in unto Pharaoh, and they did so as the Lord had commanded: and Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh, and before his servants, and it became a serpent.
verses.fr: Moïse et Aaron allèrent auprès de Pharaon, et ils firent ce que l''Eternel avait ordonné. Aaron jeta sa verge devant Pharaon et devant ses serviteurs; et elle devint un serpent.
verses.am: ሙሴና አሮንም ወደ ፈርዖን ገቡ፥ እግዚአብሔርም እንዳዘዛቸው እንዲሁ አደረጉ፤ አሮንም በትሩን በፈርዖንና በባሮቹ ፊት ጣለ፥ እባብም ሆነች።

verses.en: Then Pharaoh also called the wise men and the sorcerers: now the magicians of Egypt, they also did in like manner with their enchantments.
verses.fr: Mais Pharaon appela des sages et des enchanteurs; et les magiciens d''Egypte, eux aussi, en firent autant par leurs enchantements.
verses.am: ፈርዖንም ጠቢባንንና መተተኞችን ጠራ፤ የግብፅም ጠንቋዮች በአስማታቸው እንዲሁ ደግሞ አደረጉ።

verses.en: For they cast down every man his rod, and they became serpents: but Aaron's rod swallowed up their rods.
verses.fr: Ils jetèrent tous leurs verges, et elles devinrent des serpents. Et la verge d''Aaron engloutit leurs verges.
verses.am: እያንዳንዳቸውም በትራቸውን ጣሉ፥ እባቦችም ሆኑ፤ የአሮን በትር ግን በትራቸውን ዋጠች።

verses.en: And he hardened Pharaoh's heart, that he hearkened not unto them; as the Lord had said.
verses.fr: Le coeur de Pharaon s''endurcit, et il n''écouta point Moïse et Aaron selon ce que l''Eternel avait dit.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንደ ተናገረ፥ የፈርዖን ልብ ጸና፥ አልሰማቸውምም።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Pharaoh's heart is hardened, he refuseth to let the people go.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse: Pharaon a le coeur endurci; il refuse de laisser aller le peuple.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን አለው። የፈርዖን ልብ ደነደነ፥ ሕዝቡንም ለመልቀቅ እንቢ አለ።

verses.en: Get thee unto Pharaoh in the morning; lo, he goeth out unto the water; and thou shalt stand by the river's brink against he come; and the rod which was turned to a serpent shalt thou take in thine hand.
verses.fr: Va vers Pharaon dès le matin; il sortira pour aller près de l''eau, et tu te présenteras devant lui au bord du fleuve. Tu prendras à ta main la verge qui a été changée en serpent,
verses.am: ማልደህ ወደ ፈርዖን ሂድ፤ እነሆ ወደ ውኃ ይወጣል፥ ትገናኘውም ዘንድ አንተ በወንዝ ዳር ትቆማለህ፤ እባብም ሆና የተለወጠችውን በትር በእጅህ ትወስዳለህ።

verses.en: And thou shalt say unto him, The Lord God of the Hebrews hath sent me unto thee, saying, Let my people go, that they may serve me in the wilderness: and, behold, hitherto thou wouldest not hear.
verses.fr: et tu diras à Pharaon: L''Eternel, le Dieu des Hébreux, m''a envoyé auprès de toi, pour te dire: Laisse aller mon peuple, afin qu''il me serve dans le désert. Et voici, jusqu''à présent tu n''as point écouté.
verses.am: እንዲህም ትለዋለህ። የዕብራውያን አምላክ እግዚአብሔር። በምድረ በዳ እንዲያገለግሉኝ ሕዝቤን ልቀቅ ብሎ ወደ አንተ ላከኝ፤ እነሆም እስከ ዛሬ አልሰማህም።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord, In this thou shalt know that I am the Lord: behold, I will smite with the rod that is in mine hand upon the waters which are in the river, and they shall be turned to blood.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: A ceci tu connaîtras que je suis l''Eternel. Je vais frapper les eaux du fleuve avec la verge qui est dans ma main; et elles seront changées en sang.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እኔ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ በዚህ ታውቃለህ፤ እነሆ እኔ የወንዙን ውኃ በእጄ ባለችው በትር እመታለሁ፥ ውኃውም ተለውጦ ደም ይሆናል።

verses.en: And the fish that is in the river shall die, and the river shall stink; and the Egyptians shall lothe to drink of the water of the river.
verses.fr: Les poissons qui sont dans le fleuve périront, le fleuve se corrompra, et les Egyptiens s''efforceront en vain de boire l''eau du fleuve.
verses.am: በወንዙም ያሉት ዓሦች ይሞታሉ፥ ወንዙም ይገማል፤ ግብፃውያንም የወንዙን ውኃ ለመጠጣት ይጠላሉ።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Take thy rod, and stretch out thine hand upon the waters of Egypt, upon their streams, upon their rivers, and upon their ponds, and upon all their pools of water, that they may become blood; and that there may be blood throughout all the land of Egypt, both in vessels of wood, and in vessels of stone.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse: Dis à Aaron: Prends ta verge, et étends ta main sur les eaux des Egyptiens, sur leurs rivières, sur leurs ruisseaux, sur leurs étangs, et sur tous leurs amas d''eaux. Elles deviendront du sang: et il y aura du sang dans tout le pays d''Egypte, dans les vases de bois et dans les vases de pierre.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን አለው። አሮንን። በትርህን ውሰድ፥ ደምም እንዲሆኑ በግብፅ ውኆች በወንዞቻቸውም በመስኖቻቸውም በኩሬዎቻቸውም በውኃ ማከማቻዎቻቸውም ሁሉ ላይ እጅህን ዘርጋ በለው፤ በግብፅም አገር ሁሉ በእንጨት ዕቃና በድንጋይ ዕቃ ሁሉ ደም ይሆናል።

verses.en: And Moses and Aaron did so, as the Lord commanded; and he lifted up the rod, and smote the waters that were in the river, in the sight of Pharaoh, and in the sight of his servants; and all the waters that were in the river were turned to blood.
verses.fr: Moïse et Aaron firent ce que l''Eternel avait ordonné. Aaron leva la verge, et il frappa les eaux qui étaient dans le fleuve, sous les yeux de Pharaon et sous les yeux de ses serviteurs; et toutes les eaux du fleuve furent changées en sang.
verses.am: ሙሴና አሮንም እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዛቸው እንዲሁ አደረጉ፤ በትሩንም አነሣ፥ በፈርዖንና በባሪያዎቹም ፊት የወንዙን ውኃ መታ፤ የወንዙም ውኃ ሁሉ ተለውጦ ደም ሆነ።

verses.en: And the fish that was in the river died; and the river stank, and the Egyptians could not drink of the water of the river; and there was blood throughout all the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: Les poissons qui étaient dans le fleuve périrent, le fleuve se corrompit, les Egyptiens ne pouvaient plus boire l''eau du fleuve, et il y eut du sang dans tout le pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: በወንዙም የነበሩ ዓሦች ሞቱ፤ ወንዙም ገማ፥ ግብፃውያንም ከወንዙ ውኃ ይጠጡ ዘንድ አልቻሉም ደሙም በግብፅ አገር ሁሉ ነበረ።

verses.en: And the magicians of Egypt did so with their enchantments: and Pharaoh's heart was hardened, neither did he hearken unto them; as the Lord had said.
verses.fr: Mais les magiciens d''Egypte en firent autant par leurs enchantements. Le coeur de Pharaon s''endurcit, et il n''écouta point Moïse et Aaron, selon ce que l''Eternel avait dit.
verses.am: የግብፅም ጠንቋዮች በአስማታቸው እንዲሁ አደረጉ፤ እግዚአብሔርም እንደተናገረ የፈርዖን ልብ ጸና፥ አልሰማቸውምም።

verses.en: And Pharaoh turned and went into his house, neither did he set his heart to this also.
verses.fr: Pharaon s''en retourna, et alla dans sa maison; et il ne prit pas même à coeur ces choses.
verses.am: ፈርዖንም ተመልሶ ወደ ቤቱ ገባ፥ ይህንም ደግሞ በልቡ አላኖረውም።

verses.en: And all the Egyptians digged round about the river for water to drink; for they could not drink of the water of the river.
verses.fr: Tous les Egyptiens creusèrent aux environs du fleuve, pour trouver de l''eau à boire; car ils ne pouvaient boire de l''eau du fleuve.
verses.am: ግብፃውያንም ሁሉ የወንዙን ውኃ ይጠጡ ዘንድ አልቻሉምና በወንዙ አጠገብ ውኃ ሊጠጡ ቆፈሩ።

verses.en: And seven days were fulfilled, after that the Lord had smitten the river.
verses.fr: Il s''écoula sept jours, après que l''Eternel eut frappé le fleuve.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ወንዙን ከመታ በኋላ ሰባት ቀን ተፈጸመ።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, Go unto Pharaoh, and say unto him, Thus saith the Lord, Let my people go, that they may serve me.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse: Va vers Pharaon, et tu lui diras: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Laisse aller mon peuple, afin qu''il me serve.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን ተናገረው። ወደ ፈርዖን ግባ እንዲህም በለው። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ያገለግለኝ ዘንድ ሕዝቤን ልቀቅ።

verses.en: And if thou refuse to let them go, behold, I will smite all thy borders with frogs:
verses.fr: Si tu refuses de le laisser aller, je vais frapper par des grenouilles toute l''étendue de ton pays.
verses.am: ለመልቀቅ እንቢ ብትል ግን እነሆ እኔ አገርህን ሁሉ በጓጕንቸሮች እመታለሁ፤

verses.en: And the river shall bring forth frogs abundantly, which shall go up and come into thine house, and into thy bedchamber, and upon thy bed, and into the house of thy servants, and upon thy people, and into thine ovens, and into thy kneadingtroughs:
verses.fr: Le fleuve fourmillera de grenouilles; elles monteront, et elles entreront dans ta maison, dans ta chambre à coucher et dans ton lit, dans la maison de tes serviteurs et dans celles de ton peuple, dans tes fours et dans tes pétrins.
verses.am: ወንዙም ጓጕንቸሮችን ያፈላል፥ ወጥተውም ወደ ቤትህ፥ ወደ መኝታ ቤትህ፥ ወደ አልጋህም፥ ወደ ባሪያዎችህም ቤት፥ በሕዝብህም ላይ፥ ወደ ምድጆችህም፥ ወደ ቡሃቃዎችህም ይገባሉ፤

verses.en: And the frogs shall come up both on thee, and upon thy people, and upon all thy servants.
verses.fr: Les grenouilles monteront sur toi, sur ton peuple, et sur tous tes serviteurs.
verses.am: ጓጕንቸሮችም በአንተ በሕዝብህም በባሪያዎችም ሁሉ ላይ ይወጣሉ።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Stretch forth thine hand with thy rod over the streams, over the rivers, and over the ponds, and cause frogs to come up upon the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse: Dis à Aaron: Etends ta main avec ta verge sur les rivières, sur les ruisseaux et sur les étangs, et fais monter les grenouilles sur le pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን አለው። አሮንን። በትርህን ይዘህ በወንዞቹና በመስኖቹ በውኃ ማከማቻዎቹም ላይ እጅህን ዘርጋ፥ በግብፅም አገር ላይ ጓጕንቸሮችን አውጣ በለው።

verses.en: And Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt; and the frogs came up, and covered the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: Aaron étendit sa main sur les eaux de l''Egypte; et les grenouilles montèrent et couvrirent le pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: አሮንም በግብፅ ውኆች ላይ እጁን ዘረጋ፤ ጓጕንቸሮቹም ወጡ፥ የግብፅንም አገር ሸፈኑ።

verses.en: And the magicians did so with their enchantments, and brought up frogs upon the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: Mais les magiciens en firent autant par leurs enchantements. Ils firent monter les grenouilles sur le pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: ጠንቋዮችም በአስማታቸው እንዲህ አደረጉ፥ በግብፅም አገር ላይ ጓጕንቸሮችን አወጡ።

verses.en: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron, and said, Intreat the Lord, that he may take away the frogs from me, and from my people; and I will let the people go, that they may do sacrifice unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Pharaon appela Moïse et Aaron, et dit: Priez l''Eternel, afin qu''il éloigne les grenouilles de moi et de mon peuple; et je laisserai aller le peuple, pour qu''il offre des sacrifices à l''Eternel.
verses.am: ፈርዖንም ሙሴንና አሮንን ጠርቶ። ጓጕንቸሮቹን ከእኔ ከሕዝቤም እንዲያርቅ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጸልዩልኝ፤ ለእግዚአብሔርም ይሠዋ ዘንድ ሕዝቡን እለቅቃለሁ አላቸው።

verses.en: And Moses said unto Pharaoh, Glory over me: when shall I intreat for thee, and for thy servants, and for thy people, to destroy the frogs from thee and thy houses, that they may remain in the river only?
verses.fr: Moïse dit à Pharaon: Glorifie-toi sur moi! Pour quand prierai-je l''Eternel en ta faveur, en faveur de tes serviteurs et de ton peuple, afin qu''il retire les grenouilles loin de toi et de tes maisons? Il n''en restera que dans le fleuve.
verses.am: ሙሴም ፈርዖንን። ጓጕንቸሮቹ ከአንተ ከቤቶችህም እንዲጠፉ፥ በወንዙም ብቻ እንዲቀሩ፥ ለአንተ ለባሪያዎችህም ለሕዝብህም መቼ እንድጸልይ አስታውቀኝ አለው። እርሱም። ነገ አለ።

verses.en: And he said, To morrow. And he said, Be it according to thy word: that thou mayest know that there is none like unto the Lord our God.
verses.fr: Il répondit: Pour demain. Et Moïse dit: Il en sera ainsi, afin que tu saches que nul n''est semblable à l''Eternel, notre Dieu.
verses.am: ሙሴም። አምላካችንን እግዚአብሔርን የሚመስል እንደሌለ ታውቅ ዘንድ እንደ ቃልህ ይሁን።

verses.en: And the frogs shall depart from thee, and from thy houses, and from thy servants, and from thy people; they shall remain in the river only.
verses.fr: Les grenouilles s''éloigneront de toi et de tes maisons, de tes serviteurs et de ton peuple; il n''en restera que dans le fleuve.
verses.am: ጓጕንቸሮቹም ከአንተ ከቤቶችህም ከባርያዎችህም ከሕዝብህም ይሄዳሉ፤ በወንዙም ብቻ ይቀራሉ አለ።

verses.en: And Moses and Aaron went out from Pharaoh: and Moses cried unto the Lord because of the frogs which he had brought against Pharaoh.
verses.fr: Moïse et Aaron sortirent de chez Pharaon. Et Moïse cria à l''Eternel au sujet des grenouilles dont il avait frappé Pharaon.
verses.am: ሙሴና አሮንም ከፈርዖን ዘንድ ወጡ፤ ሙሴም በፈርዖን ላይ ስላመጣቸው ጓጕንቸሮች ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኸ።

verses.en: And the Lord did according to the word of Moses; and the frogs died out of the houses, out of the villages, and out of the fields.
verses.fr: L''Eternel fit ce que demandait Moïse; et les grenouilles périrent dans les maisons, dans les cours et dans les champs.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴ እንዳለ አደረገ፤ ጓጕንቸሮቹም ከቤት ከወጀድም ከሜዳም ሞቱ።

verses.en: And they gathered them together upon heaps: and the land stank.
verses.fr: On les entassa par monceaux, et le pays fut infecté.
verses.am: እንደ ክምርም አድርገው ሰበሰቡአቸው፤ ምድርም ገማች።

verses.en: But when Pharaoh saw that there was respite, he hardened his heart, and hearkened not unto them; as the Lord had said.
verses.fr: Pharaon, voyant qu''il y avait du relâche, endurcit son coeur, et il n''écouta point Moïse et Aaron, selon ce que l''Eternel avait dit.
verses.am: ፈርዖንም ጸጥታ እንደሆነ ባየ ጊዜ ልቡን አደነደነ፤ እግዚአብሔርም እንደተናገረ አልሰማቸውም።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Stretch out thy rod, and smite the dust of the land, that it may become lice throughout all the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse: Dis à Aaron: Etends ta verge, et frappe la poussière de la terre. Elle se changera en poux, dans tout le pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን አለው። አሮንን። በትርህን ዘርጋ፥ በግብፅም አገር ሁሉ ቅማል እንዲሆን የምድሩን ትቢያ ምታ በለው።

verses.en: And they did so; for Aaron stretched out his hand with his rod, and smote the dust of the earth, and it became lice in man, and in beast; all the dust of the land became lice throughout all the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: Ils firent ainsi. Aaron étendit sa main, avec sa verge, et il frappa la poussière de la terre; et elle fut changée en poux sur les hommes et sur les animaux. Toute la poussière de la terre fut changée en poux, dans tout le pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: እንዲሁም አደረጉ፤ አሮንም እጁን ዘረጋ፥ በበትሩም የምድሩን ትቢያ መታው፥ በሰውና በእንስሳም ላይ ቅማል ሆነ፤ በግብፅ አገር ሁሉ የምድር ትቢያ ሁሉ ቅማል ሆነ።

verses.en: And the magicians did so with their enchantments to bring forth lice, but they could not: so there were lice upon man, and upon beast.
verses.fr: Les magiciens employèrent leurs enchantements pour produire les poux; mais ils ne purent pas. Les poux étaient sur les hommes et sur les animaux.
verses.am: ጠንቋዮችም በአስማታቸው ያወጡ ዘንድ እንዲሁ አደረጉ፥ ነገር ግን አልቻሉም፤ ቅማሉም በሰውና በእንስሳ ላይ ነበረ።

verses.en: Then the magicians said unto Pharaoh, This is the finger of God: and Pharaoh's heart was hardened, and he hearkened not unto them; as the Lord had said.
verses.fr: Et les magiciens dirent à Pharaon: C''est le doigt de Dieu! Le coeur de Pharaon s''endurcit, et il n''écouta point Moïse et Aaron, selon ce que l''Eternel avait dit.
verses.am: ጠንቋዮችም ፈርዖንን። ይህስ የእግዚአብሔር ጣት ነው አሉት፤ የፈርዖን ልብ ግን ጸና፥ እግዚአብሔርም እንደ ተናገረ አልሰማቸውም።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh; lo, he cometh forth to the water; and say unto him, Thus saith the Lord, Let my people go, that they may serve me.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse: Lève-toi de bon matin, et présente-toi devant Pharaon; il sortira pour aller près de l''eau. Tu lui diras: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Laisse aller mon peuple, afin qu''il me serve.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን አለው። ማልደህ ተነሣ፥ በፈርዖንም ፊት ቁም፤ እነሆ እርሱ ወደ ውኃ ይወርዳል፤ እንዲህም በለው። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እንዲያገለግለኝ ሕዝቤን ልቀቅ።

verses.en: Else, if thou wilt not let my people go, behold, I will send swarms of flies upon thee, and upon thy servants, and upon thy people, and into thy houses: and the houses of the Egyptians shall be full of swarms of flies, and also the ground whereon they are.
verses.fr: Si tu ne laisses pas aller mon peuple, je vais envoyer les mouches venimeuses contre toi, contre tes serviteurs, contre ton peuple et contre tes maisons; les maisons des Egyptiens seront remplies de mouches, et le sol en sera couvert.
verses.am: ሕዝቤንም ባትለቅቅ፥ እነሆ በአንተ በባሪያዎችህም በሕዝብህም በቤቶችህም ላይ የዝንብ መንጎች እሰድዳለሁ፤ የግብፃውያን ቤቶች የሚኖሩባትም ምድር ሁሉ በዝንብ መንጎች ይሞላሉ።

verses.en: And I will sever in that day the land of Goshen, in which my people dwell, that no swarms of flies shall be there; to the end thou mayest know that I am the Lord in the midst of the earth.
verses.fr: Mais, en ce jour-là, je distinguerai le pays de Gosen où habite mon peuple, et là il n''y aura point de mouches, afin que tu saches que moi, l''Eternel, je suis au milieu de ce pays.
verses.am: በዚያን ቀን በምድር መካከል እኔ እግዚአብሔር እንደሆንሁ ታውቅ ዘንድ፥ በዚያ የዝንብ መንጋ እንዳይሆን ሕዝቤ የሚቀመጥባትን የጌሤምን ምድር እለያለሁ።

verses.en: And I will put a division between my people and thy people: to morrow shall this sign be.
verses.fr: J''établirai une distinction entre mon peuple et ton peuple. Ce signe sera pour demain.
verses.am: በሕዝቤና በሕዝብህ መካከል እለያለሁ፤ ይህም ተአምራት ነገ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And the Lord did so; and there came a grievous swarm of flies into the house of Pharaoh, and into his servants' houses, and into all the land of Egypt: the land was corrupted by reason of the swarm of flies.
verses.fr: L''Eternel fit ainsi. Il vint une quantité de mouches venimeuses dans la maison de Pharaon et de ses serviteurs, et tout le pays d''Egypte fut dévasté par les mouches.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እንዲሁ አደረገ፤ በፈርዖንም ቤት በባሪያዎቹም ቤቶች ውስጥ ብዙ የዝንብ መንጋ መጣ፤ በግብፅም አገር ሁሉ ላይ ከዝንቡ መንጋ የተነሣ ምድር ጠፋች።

verses.en: And Pharaoh called for Moses and for Aaron, and said, Go ye, sacrifice to your God in the land.
verses.fr: Pharaon appela Moïse et Aaron et dit: Allez, offrez des sacrifices à votre Dieu dans le pays.
verses.am: ፈርዖንም ሙሴንና አሮንን ጠርቶ። ሂዱ፥ በአገሩ ውስጥ ለአምላካችሁ ሠዉ አላቸው።

verses.en: And Moses said, It is not meet so to do; for we shall sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians to the Lord our God: lo, shall we sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians before their eyes, and will they not stone us?
verses.fr: Moïse répondit: Il n''est point convenable de faire ainsi; car nous offririons à l''Eternel, notre Dieu, des sacrifices qui sont en abomination aux Egyptiens. Et si nous offrons, sous leurs yeux, des sacrifices qui sont en abomination aux Egyptiens, ne nous lapideront-ils pas?
verses.am: ሙሴም። ለእግዚአብሔር ለአምላካችን የግብፃውያንን ርኵሰት እንሰዋለንና እንዲህ ይደረግ ዘንድ አይገባም፤ እነሆ እኛ የግብፃውያንን ርኵሰት በፊታቸው ብንሠዋ አይወግሩንምን?

verses.en: We will go three days' journey into the wilderness, and sacrifice to the Lord our God, as he shall command us.
verses.fr: Nous ferons trois journées de marche dans le désert, et nous offrirons des sacrifices à l''Eternel, notre Dieu, selon ce qu''il nous dira.
verses.am: እኛስ ለእግዚአብሔር ለአምላካችን እንሠዋ ዘንድ እንደሚያዝዘን የሦስት ቀን መንገድ ወደ ምድረ በዳ እንሄዳለን አለ።

verses.en: And Pharaoh said, I will let you go, that ye may sacrifice to the Lord your God in the wilderness; only ye shall not go very far away: intreat for me.
verses.fr: Pharaon dit: Je vous laisserai aller, pour offrir à l''Eternel, votre Dieu, des sacrifices dans le désert: seulement, vous ne vous éloignerez pas, en y allant. Priez pour moi.
verses.am: ፈርዖንም። ለእግዚአብሔር ለአምላካችሁ በምድረ በዳ ትሠዉ ዘንድ እለቅቃችኋለሁ፤ ነገር ግን ርቃችሁ አትሂዱ፥ ጸልዩልኝ አለ።

verses.en: And Moses said, Behold, I go out from thee, and I will intreat the Lord that the swarms of flies may depart from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people, to morrow: but let not Pharaoh deal deceitfully any more in not letting the people go to sacrifice to the Lord.
