verses.fr: Moïse répondit: Je vais sortir de chez toi, et je prierai l''Eternel. Demain, les mouches s''éloigneront de Pharaon, de ses serviteurs et de son peuple. Mais, que Pharaon ne trompe plus, en refusant de laisser aller le peuple, pour offrir des sacrifices à l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሙሴም። እነሆ ከአንተ ዘንድ እወጣለሁ፥ የዝንቡም መንጎች ከፈርዖን ከባሪያዎቹም ከሕዝቡም ነገ እንዲሄዱ ወደ እግዚአብሔር እጸልያለሁ፤ ነገር ግን ለእግዚአብሔር ይሠዋ ዘንድ ሕዝቡን እንዳይለቅቅ ፈርዖን እንደገና አያታልለን አለ።

verses.en: And Moses went out from Pharaoh, and intreated the Lord.
verses.fr: Moïse sortit de chez Pharaon, et il pria l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሙሴም ከፈርዖን ዘንድ ወጣ፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ጸለየ።

verses.en: And the Lord did according to the word of Moses; and he removed the swarms of flies from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people; there remained not one.
verses.fr: L''Eternel fit ce que demandait Moïse; et les mouches s''éloignèrent de Pharaon, de ses serviteurs et de son peuple. Il n''en resta pas une.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴ እንዳለ አደረገ፤ የዝንቡንም መንጎች ከፈርዖን ከባሪያዎቹም ከህዝቡም አስነሣ፤ አንድ ስንኳ አልቀረም።

verses.en: And Pharaoh hardened his heart at this time also, neither would he let the people go.
verses.fr: Mais Pharaon, cette fois encore, endurcit son coeur, et il ne laissa point aller le peuple.
verses.am: ፈርዖንም በዚህ ጊዜ ደግሞ ልቡን አደነደነ፥ ሕዝቡንም አልለቀቀም።

verses.en: Then the Lord said unto Moses, Go in unto Pharaoh, and tell him, Thus saith the Lord God of the Hebrews, Let my people go, that they may serve me.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse: Va vers Pharaon, et tu lui diras: Ainsi parle l''Eternel, le Dieu des Hébreux: Laisse aller mon peuple, afin qu''il me serve.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን አለው። ወደ ፈርዖን ዘንድ ገብተህ ንገረው። የዕብራውያን አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ያገለግሉኝ ዘንድ ሕዝቤን ልቀቅ።

verses.en: For if thou refuse to let them go, and wilt hold them still,
verses.fr: Si tu refuses de le laisser aller, et si tu le retiens encore,
verses.am: ልትለቅቃቸውም እንቢ ብትል ብትይዛቸውም፥

verses.en: Behold, the hand of the Lord is upon thy cattle which is in the field, upon the horses, upon the asses, upon the camels, upon the oxen, and upon the sheep: there shall be a very grievous murrain.
verses.fr: voici, la main de l''Eternel sera sur tes troupeaux qui sont dans les champs, sur les chevaux, sur les ânes, sur les chameaux, sur les boeufs et sur les brebis; il y aura une mortalité très grande.
verses.am: እነሆ የእግዚአብሔር እጅ በሜዳ ውስጥ ባሉት በከብቶችህ፥ በፈረሶችም በአህዮችም በግመሎችም በበሬዎችም በበጎችም ላይ ትሆናለች፤ ብርቱ ቸነፈርም ይወርዳል።

verses.en: And the Lord shall sever between the cattle of Israel and the cattle of Egypt: and there shall nothing die of all that is the children's of Israel.
verses.fr: L''Eternel distinguera entre les troupeaux d''Israël et les troupeaux des Egyptiens, et il ne périra rien de tout ce qui est aux enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በእስራኤልና በግብፅ ከብቶች መካከል ይለያል፤ ከእስራኤልም ልጆች ከብት አንዳች አይጠፋም።

verses.en: And the Lord appointed a set time, saying, To morrow the Lord shall do this thing in the land.
verses.fr: L''Eternel fixa le temps, et dit: Demain, l''Eternel fera cela dans le pays.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። ነገ እግዚአብሔር ይህን ነገር በምድር ላይ ያደርጋል ብሎ ጊዜን ወሰነ።

verses.en: And the Lord did that thing on the morrow, and all the cattle of Egypt died: but of the cattle of the children of Israel died not one.
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel fit ainsi, dès le lendemain. Tous les troupeaux des Egyptiens périrent, et il ne périt pas une bête des troupeaux des enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ያንን ነገር በነጋው አደረገ፥ የግብፅም ከብት ሁሉ ሞተ፤ ከእስራኤል ልጆች ከብት ግን አንድ ስንኳ አልሞተም።

verses.en: And Pharaoh sent, and, behold, there was not one of the cattle of the Israelites dead. And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened, and he did not let the people go.
verses.fr: Pharaon s''informa de ce qui était arrivé; et voici, pas une bête des troupeaux d''Israël n''avait péri. Mais le coeur de Pharaon s''endurcit, et il ne laissa point aller le peuple.
verses.am: ፈርዖንም ላከ፥ እነሆም ከእስራኤል ልጆች ከብት አንድ ስንኳ አልሞተም። የፈርዖን ልብ ግን ደነደነ፥ ሕዝቡንም አልለቀቀም።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses and unto Aaron, Take to you handfuls of ashes of the furnace, and let Moses sprinkle it toward the heaven in the sight of Pharaoh.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse et à Aaron: Remplissez vos mains de cendre de fournaise, et que Moïse la jette vers le ciel, sous les yeux de Pharaon.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴንና አሮንን። እጃችሁን ሞልታችሁ ከምድጃ አመድ ውሰዱ፥ ሙሴም በፈርዖን ፊት ወደ ሰማይ ይበትነው።

verses.en: And it shall become small dust in all the land of Egypt, and shall be a boil breaking forth with blains upon man, and upon beast, throughout all the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: Elle deviendra une poussière qui couvrira tout le pays d''Egypte; et elle produira, dans tout le pays d''Egypte, sur les hommes et sur les animaux, des ulcères formés par une éruption de pustules.
verses.am: እርሱም በግብፅ አገር ሁሉ ትቢያ ይሆናል፥ በግብፅም አገር ሁሉ በሰውና በእንስሳ ላይ ሻህኝ የሚያመጣ ቍስል ይሆናል አላቸው።

verses.en: And they took ashes of the furnace, and stood before Pharaoh; and Moses sprinkled it up toward heaven; and it became a boil breaking forth with blains upon man, and upon beast.
verses.fr: Ils prirent de la cendre de fournaise, et se présentèrent devant Pharaon; Moïse la jeta vers le ciel, et elle produisit sur les hommes et sur les animaux des ulcères formés par une éruption de pustules.
verses.am: ከምድጃውም አመድ ወስደው በፈርዖን ፊት ቆሙ፤ ሙሴም ወደ ሰማይ በተነው፥ በሰውና በእንስሳም ላይ ሻህኝ የሚያወጣ ቍስል ሆነ።

verses.en: And the magicians could not stand before Moses because of the boils; for the boil was upon the magicians, and upon all the Egyptians.
verses.fr: Les magiciens ne purent paraître devant Moïse, à cause des ulcères; car les ulcères étaient sur les magiciens, comme sur tous les Egyptiens.
verses.am: ጠንቋዮችም ቍስል ስለ ነበረባቸው በሙሴ ፊት መቆም አልቻሉም፤ ቍስል በጠንቋዮችና በግብፃያን ሁሉ ላይ ነበረና።

verses.en: And the Lord hardened the heart of Pharaoh, and he hearkened not unto them; as the Lord had spoken unto Moses.
verses.fr: L''Eternel endurcit le coeur de Pharaon, et Pharaon n''écouta point Moïse et Aaron, selon ce que l''Eternel avait dit à Moïse.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም የፈርዖንን ልብ አጸና፤ እግዚአብሔር ለሙሴ እንደተናገረው አልሰማቸውም።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh, and say unto him, Thus saith the Lord God of the Hebrews, Let my people go, that they may serve me.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse: Lève-toi de bon matin, et présente-toi devant Pharaon. Tu lui diras: Ainsi parle l''Eternel, le Dieu des Hébreux: Laisse aller mon peuple, afin qu''il me serve.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን አለው። ማልደህ ተነሣ፥ በፈርኦንም ፊት ቆመህ በለው። የዕብራውያን አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እንዲያገለግሉኝ ሕዝቤን ልቀቅ።

verses.en: For I will at this time send all my plagues upon thine heart, and upon thy servants, and upon thy people; that thou mayest know that there is none like me in all the earth.
verses.fr: Car, cette fois, je vais envoyer toutes mes plaies contre ton coeur, contre tes serviteurs et contre ton peuple, afin que tu saches que nul n''est semblable à moi sur toute la terre.
verses.am: በምድር ሁሉ እንደ እኔ ያለ እንደሌለ ታውቅ ዘንድ በሰውነትህ በባሪያዎችህም በሕዝብህም ላይ መቅሠፍቴን ሁሉ አሁን እልካለሁ።

verses.en: For now I will stretch out my hand, that I may smite thee and thy people with pestilence; and thou shalt be cut off from the earth.
verses.fr: Si j''avais étendu ma main, et que je t''eusse frappé par la mortalité, toi et ton peuple, tu aurais disparu de la terre.
verses.am: አሁን እጄን ዘርግቼ አንተን ሕዝብህንም በቸነፈር በመታሁህ ነበር፥ አንተም ከምድር በጠፋህ ነበር፤

verses.en: And in very deed for this cause have I raised thee up, for to shew in thee my power; and that my name may be declared throughout all the earth.
verses.fr: Mais, je t''ai laissé subsister, afin que tu voies ma puissance, et que l''on publie mon nom par toute la terre.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ኃይሌን እገልጥብህ ዘንድ ስሜም በምድር ሁሉ ላይ ይነገር ዘንድ ስለዚህ አስነሥቼሃለሁ።

verses.en: As yet exaltest thou thyself against my people, that thou wilt not let them go?
verses.fr: Si tu t''élèves encore contre mon peuple, et si tu ne le laisses point aller,
verses.am: እንዳትለቅቃቸው ገና በሕዝቤ ላይ ትታበያለህን?

verses.en: Behold, to morrow about this time I will cause it to rain a very grievous hail, such as hath not been in Egypt since the foundation thereof even until now.
verses.fr: voici, je ferai pleuvoir demain, à cette heure, une grêle tellement forte, qu''il n''y en a point eu de semblable en Egypte depuis le jour où elle a été fondée jusqu''à présent.
verses.am: እነሆ ነገ በዚህ ጊዜ፥ ከተመሰረተች ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ እንደ እርሱ ያለ በግብፅ ሆኖ የማያውቅ፥ እጅግ ታላቅ በረዶ አዘንብብሃለሁ።

verses.en: Send therefore now, and gather thy cattle, and all that thou hast in the field; for upon every man and beast which shall be found in the field, and shall not be brought home, the hail shall come down upon them, and they shall die.
verses.fr: Fais donc mettre en sûreté tes troupeaux et tout ce qui est à toi dans les champs. La grêle tombera sur tous les hommes et sur tous les animaux qui se trouveront dans les champs et qui n''auront pas été recueillis dans les maisons, et ils périront.
verses.am: በሜዳ የተገኘ ወደ ቤት ያልገባ ሰውና እንስሳ ሁሉ በረዶ ወርዶበት ይሞታልና አሁን እንግዲህ ላክ፥ ከብቶችህንም በሜዳም ያለህን ሁሉ አስቸኵል።

verses.en: He that feared the word of the Lord among the servants of Pharaoh made his servants and his cattle flee into the houses:
verses.fr: Ceux des serviteurs de Pharaon qui craignirent la parole de l''Eternel firent retirer dans les maisons leurs serviteurs et leurs troupeaux.
verses.am: ከፈርዖንም ባሪያዎች የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል የፈራ ባሪያዎቹንና ከብቶቹን ወደ ቤቶቹ አሸሸ፤

verses.en: And he that regarded not the word of the Lord left his servants and his cattle in the field.
verses.fr: Mais ceux qui ne prirent point à coeur la parole de l''Eternel laissèrent leurs serviteurs et leurs troupeaux dans les champs.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርንም ቃል ያላሰበ ባሪያዎቹንና ከብቶቹን በሜዳ ተወ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Stretch forth thine hand toward heaven, that there may be hail in all the land of Egypt, upon man, and upon beast, and upon every herb of the field, throughout the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse: Etends ta main vers le ciel; et qu''il tombe de la grêle dans tout le pays d''Egypte sur les hommes, sur les animaux, et sur toutes les herbes des champs, dans le pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። በግብፅ አገር በሰው በእንስሳም በእርሻም ቡቃያ ሁሉ ላይ፥ በግብፅ አገር ሁሉ በረዶ ይሆን ዘንድ እጅህን ወደ ሰማይ ዘርጋ አለው።

verses.en: And Moses stretched forth his rod toward heaven: and the Lord sent thunder and hail, and the fire ran along upon the ground; and the Lord rained hail upon the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: Moïse étendit sa verge vers le ciel; et l''Eternel envoya des tonnerres et de la grêle, et le feu se promenait sur la terre. L''Eternel fit pleuvoir de la grêle sur le pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: ሙሴም በትሩን ወደ ሰማይ ዘረጋ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ነጎድጓድና በረዶ ላከ፥ እሳትም ወደ ምድር ወረደ፤ እግዚአብሔርም በግብፅ አገር ላይ በረዶ አዘነበ።

verses.en: So there was hail, and fire mingled with the hail, very grievous, such as there was none like it in all the land of Egypt since it became a nation.
verses.fr: Il tomba de la grêle, et le feu se mêlait avec la grêle; elle était tellement forte qu''il n''y en avait point eu de semblable dans tout le pays d''Egypte depuis qu''il existe comme nation.
verses.am: በረዶም ነበረ፥ በበረዶውም መካከል እሳት ይቃጠል ነበር፥ በረዶውም በግብፅ አገር ሁሉ ሕዝብ ከሆነ ጀምሮ እንደ እርሱ ያልሆነ እጅግ ታላቅ ነበረ።

verses.en: And the hail smote throughout all the land of Egypt all that was in the field, both man and beast; and the hail smote every herb of the field, and brake every tree of the field.
verses.fr: La grêle frappa, dans tout le pays d''Egypte, tout ce qui était dans les champs, depuis les hommes jusqu''aux animaux; la grêle frappa aussi toutes les herbes des champs, et brisa tous les arbres des champs.
verses.am: በረዶውም በግብፅ አገር ሁሉ በሜዳ ያለውን ሁሉ ሰውንና እንስሳን መታ፤ በረዶውም የእርሻን ቡቃያ ሁሉ መታ፥ የአገሩንም ዛፍ ሁሉ ሰበረ።

verses.en: Only in the land of Goshen, where the children of Israel were, was there no hail.
verses.fr: Ce fut seulement dans le pays de Gosen, où étaient les enfants d''Israël, qu''il n''y eut point de grêle.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ልጆች ተቀምጠው በነበሩባት በጌሤም አገር ብቻ በረዶ አልወረደም።

verses.en: And Pharaoh sent, and called for Moses and Aaron, and said unto them, I have sinned this time: the Lord is righteous, and I and my people are wicked.
verses.fr: Pharaon fit appeler Moïse et Aaron, et leur dit: Cette fois, j''ai péché; c''est l''Eternel qui est le juste, et moi et mon peuple nous sommes les coupables.
verses.am: ፈርዖንም ልኮ ሙሴንና አሮንን ጠራ። በዚህ ጊዜ በደልሁ፤ እግዚአብሔር ጻድቅ ነው፥ እኔና ሕዝቤም ኃጢያተኞች ነን።

verses.en: Intreat the Lord (for it is enough) that there be no more mighty thunderings and hail; and I will let you go, and ye shall stay no longer.
verses.fr: Priez l''Eternel, pour qu''il n''y ait plus de tonnerres et de grêle; et je vous laisserai aller, et l''on ne vous retiendra plus.
verses.am: የአምላክ ነጎድጓድ በረዶውም በዝቶአልና ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጸልዩ፤ እለቅቃችሁማለሁ፥ ከዚያም በኋላ በዚህ አትቀመጡም አላቸው።

verses.en: And Moses said unto him, As soon as I am gone out of the city, I will spread abroad my hands unto the Lord; and the thunder shall cease, neither shall there be any more hail; that thou mayest know how that the earth is the Lord's.
verses.fr: Moïse lui dit: Quand je sortirai de la ville, je lèverai mes mains vers l''Eternel, les tonnerres cesseront et il n''y aura plus de grêle, afin que tu saches que la terre est à l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሙሴም። ከከተማ በወጣሁ ጊዜ እጄን ወደ እግዚአብሔር እዘረጋለሁ፤ ምድሪቱ ለእግዚአብሔር እንደሆነች ታውቅ ዘንድ ነጎድጓዱ ይቀራል፥ በረዶውም ደግሞ አይወርድም።

verses.en: But as for thee and thy servants, I know that ye will not yet fear the Lord God.
verses.fr: Mais je sais que toi et tes serviteurs, vous ne craindrez pas encore l''Eternel Dieu.
verses.am: ነገር ግን አንተና ባሪያዎችህ አምላክን እግዚአብሔርን ገና እንደማትፈሩ አውቃለሁ አለው።

verses.en: And the flax and the barley was smitten: for the barley was in the ear, and the flax was bolled.
verses.fr: Le lin et l''orge avaient été frappés, parce que l''orge était en épis et que c''était la floraison du lin;
verses.am: ገብሱ እሸቶ ተልባውም ኣፍርቶ ነበርና ተልባና ገብሱ ተመታ።

verses.en: But the wheat and the rie were not smitten: for they were not grown up.
verses.fr: le froment et l''épeautre n''avaient point été frappés, parce qu''ils sont tardifs.
verses.am: ስንዴውና አጃው ግን ጊዜው ገና ነበርና አልተመታም።

verses.en: And Moses went out of the city from Pharaoh, and spread abroad his hands unto the Lord: and the thunders and hail ceased, and the rain was not poured upon the earth.
verses.fr: Moïse sortit de chez Pharaon, pour aller hors de la ville; il leva ses mains vers l''Eternel, les tonnerres et la grêle cessèrent, et la pluie ne tomba plus sur la terre.
verses.am: ሙሴም ከፈርዖን ዘንድ ከከተማ ወጣ፥ እጁንም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ዘረጋ፤ ነጎድጓዱም በረዶውም ተቋረጠ፥ ዝናቡም በምድር ላይ አልፈሰሰም።

verses.en: And when Pharaoh saw that the rain and the hail and the thunders were ceased, he sinned yet more, and hardened his heart, he and his servants.
verses.fr: Pharaon, voyant que la pluie, la grêle et les tonnerres avaient cessé, continua de pécher, et il endurcit son coeur, lui et ses serviteurs.
verses.am: ፈርዖንም ዝናቡ በረዶውም ነጎድጓዱም እንደ ተቋረጠ ባየ ጊዜ ኃጢያትን ጨመረ፥ እርሱና ባሪያዎቹም ልባቸውን አደነደኑ።

verses.en: And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened, neither would he let the children of Israel go; as the Lord had spoken by Moses.
verses.fr: Le coeur de Pharaon s''endurcit, et il ne laissa point aller les enfants d''Israël, selon ce que l''Eternel avait dit par l''intermédiaire de Moïse.
verses.am: የፈርዖንም ልብ ጸና፤ እግዚአብሔርም በሙሴ አፍ እንደተናገር የእስራኤልን ልጆች አልለቀቀም።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Go in unto Pharaoh: for I have hardened his heart, and the heart of his servants, that I might shew these my signs before him:
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse: Va vers Pharaon, car j''ai endurci son coeur et le coeur de ses serviteurs, pour faire éclater mes signes au milieu d''eux.
verses.am: [see v2]

verses.en: And that thou mayest tell in the ears of thy son, and of thy son's son, what things I have wrought in Egypt, and my signs which I have done among them; that ye may know how that I am the Lord.
verses.fr: C''est aussi pour que tu racontes à ton fils et au fils de ton fils comment j''ai traité les Egyptiens, et quels signes j''ai fait éclater au milieu d''eux. Et vous saurez que je suis l''Eternel.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። እኔ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቁ ዘንድ በግብፃውያን ያደረግሁትን ነገር ያደረግሁባቸውንም ተአምራቴን በልጅህ በልጅ ልጅህም ጆሮች ትነግር ዘንድ፥ ይህችንም ተአምራቴን በመካከላቸው አደረግ ዘንድ የእርሱን የባሪያዎቹንም ልብ አደንድኜአለሁና ወደ ፈርዖን ግባ አለው።

verses.en: And Moses and Aaron came in unto Pharaoh, and said unto him, Thus saith the Lord God of the Hebrews, How long wilt thou refuse to humble thyself before me? let my people go, that they may serve me.
verses.fr: Moïse et Aaron allèrent vers Pharaon, et lui dirent: Ainsi parle l''Eternel, le Dieu des Hébreux: Jusqu''à quand refuseras-tu de t''humilier devant moi? Laisse aller mon peuple, afin qu''il me serve.
verses.am: ሙሴም አሮንም ወደ ፈርዖን ገቡ፥ አሉትም። የዕብራውያን አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በፊቴ ለመዋረድ እስከ መቼ እንቢ ትላለህ? ያገለግሉኝ ዘንድ ሕዝቤን ልቀቅ።

verses.en: Else, if thou refuse to let my people go, behold, to morrow will I bring the locusts into thy coast:
verses.fr: Si tu refuses de laisser aller mon peuple, voici, je ferai venir demain des sauterelles dans toute l''étendue de ton pays.
verses.am: ሕዝቤን ለመልቀቅ እንቢ ብትል ግን፥ እነሆ ነገ በአገርህ አንበጣዎችን አመጣለሁ፤

verses.en: And they shall cover the face of the earth, that one cannot be able to see the earth: and they shall eat the residue of that which is escaped, which remaineth unto you from the hail, and shall eat every tree which groweth for you out of the field:
verses.fr: Elles couvriront la surface de la terre, et l''on ne pourra plus voir la terre; elles dévoreront le reste de ce qui est échappé, ce que vous a laissé la grêle, elles dévoreront tous les arbres qui croissent dans vos champs;
verses.am: የምድሩንም ፊት ይሸፍኑታልና ምድሩን ለማየት አይቻልም፤ ከበረዶውም አምልጦ የተረፈላችሁን ትርፍ ይበሉታል፥ ያደገላችሁንም የእርሻውን ዛፍ ሁሉ ይበሉታል፤

verses.en: And they shall fill thy houses, and the houses of all thy servants, and the houses of all the Egyptians; which neither thy fathers, nor thy fathers' fathers have seen, since the day that they were upon the earth unto this day. And he turned himself, and went out from Pharaoh.
verses.fr: elles rempliront tes maisons, les maisons de tous tes serviteurs et les maisons de tous les Egyptiens. Tes pères et les pères de tes pères n''auront rien vu de pareil depuis qu''ils existent sur la terre jusqu''à ce jour. Moïse se retira, et sortit de chez Pharaon.
verses.am: ቤቶችህም የባሪያዎችህም ሁሉ ቤቶች የግብፃውያንም ሁሉ ቤቶች በእነርሱ ይሞላል፤ አባቶችህ የአባቶችህም አባቶች በምድር ላይ ከተቀመጡበት ቀን ጀምሮ እስከዚህ ቀን ድረስ እንደ እርሱ ያለ ያላዩት ነው። ተመልሶም ከፈርዖን ዘንድ ወጣ።

verses.en: And Pharaoh's servants said unto him, How long shall this man be a snare unto us? let the men go, that they may serve the Lord their God: knowest thou not yet that Egypt is destroyed?
verses.fr: Les serviteurs de Pharaon lui dirent: Jusqu''à quand cet homme sera-t-il pour nous un piège? Laisse aller ces gens, et qu''ils servent l''Eternel, leur Dieu. Ne vois-tu pas encore que l''Egypte périt?
verses.am: የፈርዖንም ባሪያዎች። ይህ ሰው እስከ መቼ ዕንቅፋት ይሆንብናል? አምላካቸውን እግዚአብሔርን ያገለግሉት ዘንድ ሰዎችን ልቀቅ ግብፅስ እንደ ጠፋች ገና አታውቅምን? አሉት።

verses.en: And Moses and Aaron were brought again unto Pharaoh: and he said unto them, Go, serve the Lord your God: but who are they that shall go?
verses.fr: On fit revenir vers Pharaon Moïse et Aaron: Allez, leur dit-il, servez l''Eternel, votre Dieu. Qui sont ceux qui iront?
verses.am: ፈርዖንም ሙሴንና አሮንን መልሶ አስመጣቸው። ሂዱ፥ አምላካችሁን እግዚአብሔርን አገልግሉ፤ ነገር ግን የሚሄዱት እነማን ናቸው? አላቸው።

verses.en: And Moses said, We will go with our young and with our old, with our sons and with our daughters, with our flocks and with our herds will we go; for we must hold a feast unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Moïse répondit: Nous irons avec nos enfants et nos vieillards, avec nos fils et nos filles, avec nos brebis et nos boeufs; car c''est pour nous une fête en l''honneur de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሙሴም። እኛ እንሄዳለን፥ የእግዚአብሔር በዓል ሆኖልናልና ታናናሾቻችንና ሽማግሌዎቻችን ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻችንም በጎቻችንና ከብቶቻችንም ከእኛ ጋር ይሄዳሉ አለ።

verses.en: And he said unto them, Let the Lord be so with you, as I will let you go, and your little ones: look to it; for evil is before you.
verses.fr: Pharaon leur dit: Que l''Eternel soit avec vous, tout comme je vais vous laisser aller, vous et vos enfants! Prenez garde, car le malheur est devant vous!
verses.am: ፈርዖንም። እናንተን ከልጆቻችሁ ጋር ስለቅቅ እግዚአብሔር ከእናንተ ጋር ይሁን፤ ነገር ግን ክፉ ነገር በፊታችሁ እንደሚሆን ተመልከቱ።

verses.en: Not so: go now ye that are men, and serve the Lord; for that ye did desire. And they were driven out from Pharaoh's presence.
verses.fr: Non, non: allez, vous les hommes, et servez l''Eternel, car c''est là ce que vous avez demandé. Et on les chassa de la présence de Pharaon.
verses.am: እንዲህም አይይደለም፤ እናንተ ወንዶቹ ሂዱ፥ ይህን ፈልጋችኋልና እግዚአብሔርን አገልግሉ አላቸው። ከፈርዖንም ፊት አባረሩአቸው።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Stretch out thine hand over the land of Egypt for the locusts, that they may come up upon the land of Egypt, and eat every herb of the land, even all that the hail hath left.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse: Etends ta main sur le pays d''Egypte, et que les sauterelles montent sur le pays d''Egypte; qu''elles dévorent toute l''herbe de la terre, tout ce que la grêle a laissé.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። በግብፅ አገር ላይ እንዲወጡ፥ ከበረዶውም የተረፈውን የምድርን ቡቃያ ሁሉ እንዲበሉ፥ ስለ አንበጣዎች በግብፅ አገር ላይ እጅህን ዘርጋ አለው።

verses.en: And Moses stretched forth his rod over the land of Egypt, and the Lord brought an east wind upon the land all that day, and all that night; and when it was morning, the east wind brought the locusts.
verses.fr: Moïse étendit sa verge sur le pays d''Egypte; et l''Eternel fit souffler un vent d''orient sur le pays toute cette journée et toute la nuit. Quand ce fut le matin, le vent d''orient avait apporté les sauterelles.
verses.am: ሙሴም በግብፅ አገር ላይ በትሩን ዘረጋ፥ እግዚአብሔርም የምሥራቅን ነፋስ ያን ቀን ሁሉ ሌሊቱን ሁሉ አመጣ፤ ማለዳም በሆነ ጊዜ የምሥራቁ ነፋስ አንበጣዎቹን አመጣ።

verses.en: And the locust went up over all the land of Egypt, and rested in all the coasts of Egypt: very grievous were they; before them there were no such locusts as they, neither after them shall be such.
verses.fr: Les sauterelles montèrent sur le pays d''Egypte, et se posèrent dans toute l''étendue de l''Egypte; elles étaient en si grande quantité qu''il n''y avait jamais eu et qu''il n''y aura jamais rien de semblable.
verses.am: አንበጣዎችም በግብፅ አገር ሁሉ ላይ ወጡ፥ በግብፅም ዳርቻ ሁሉ ላይ ተቀመጡ፤ እጅግም ብዙ ነበሩ፤ ይህንም የሚያህል አንበጣ በፊት አልነበረም፥ ወደ ፊትም ደግሞ እንደ እርሱ አይሆንም።

verses.en: For they covered the face of the whole earth, so that the land was darkened; and they did eat every herb of the land, and all the fruit of the trees which the hail had left: and there remained not any green thing in the trees, or in the herbs of the field, through all the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: Elles couvrirent la surface de toute la terre, et la terre fut dans l''obscurité; elles dévorèrent toute l''herbe de la terre et tout le fruit des arbres, tout ce que la grêle avait laissé; et il ne resta aucune verdure aux arbres ni à l''herbe des champs, dans tout le pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: የምድሩንም ፊት ፈጽመው ሸፈኑት አገሪቱም ጨለመች፤ የአገሪቱን ቡቃያ ሁሉ በረዶውም የተወውን በዛፉ የነበረውን ፍሬ ሁሉ በሉ፤ ለምለም ነገር ዛፍም የምድር ሣርም በግብፅ አገር ሁሉ አልቀረም።

verses.en: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron in haste; and he said, I have sinned against the Lord your God, and against you.
verses.fr: Aussitôt Pharaon appela Moïse et Aaron, et dit: J''ai péché contre l''Eternel, votre Dieu, et contre vous.
verses.am: ፈርዖንም ሙሴንና አሮንን በፍጥነት ጠራ። አምላካችሁን እግዚአብሔርን እናንተንም በደልሁ፤

verses.en: Now therefore forgive, I pray thee, my sin only this once, and intreat the Lord your God, that he may take away from me this death only.
verses.fr: Mais pardonne mon péché pour cette fois seulement; et priez l''Eternel, votre Dieu, afin qu''il éloigne de moi encore cette plaie mortelle.
verses.am: አሁን እንግዲህ በዚህ ጊዜ ብቻ ኃጢአቴን ይቅር በሉኝ፥ ይህንም ሞት ብቻ ከእኔ ያነሣልኝ ዘንድ አምላካችሁን እግዚአብሔርን ለምኑ አላቸው።

verses.en: And he went out from Pharaoh, and intreated the Lord.
verses.fr: Moïse sortit de chez Pharaon, et il pria l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሙሴም ከፈርዖን ፊት ወጣ፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ለመነ።

verses.en: And the Lord turned a mighty strong west wind, which took away the locusts, and cast them into the Red sea; there remained not one locust in all the coasts of Egypt.
verses.fr: L''Eternel fit souffler un vent d''occident très fort, qui emporta les sauterelles, et les précipita dans la mer Rouge; il ne resta pas une seule sauterelle dans toute l''étendue de l''Egypte.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ከምዕራብ ዐውሎ ነፋሱን አስወገደ፥ አንበጣዎችንም ወስዶ በኤርትራ ባሕር ውስጥ ጣላቸው፤ አንድ አንበጣም በግብፅ ዳርቻ ሁሉ አልቀረም።

verses.en: But the Lord hardened Pharaoh's heart, so that he would not let the children of Israel go.
verses.fr: L''Eternel endurcit le coeur de Pharaon, et Pharaon ne laissa point aller les enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የፈርዖንን ልብ አጸና የእስራኤልንም ልጆች አልለቀቀም።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Stretch out thine hand toward heaven, that there may be darkness over the land of Egypt, even darkness which may be felt.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse: Etends ta main vers le ciel, et qu''il y ait des ténèbres sur le pays d''Egypte, et que l''on puisse les toucher.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። እጅህን ወደ ሰማይ ዘርጋ፥ በግብፅም አገር ላይ ሰው የሚዳስሰው ፅኑ ጨለማ ይሁን አለው።

verses.en: And Moses stretched forth his hand toward heaven; and there was a thick darkness in all the land of Egypt three days:
verses.fr: Moïse étendit sa main vers le ciel; et il y eut d''épaisses ténèbres dans tout le pays d''Egypte, pendant trois jours.
verses.am: ሙሴም እጁን ወደ ሰማይ ዘረጋ፥ በግብፅም አገር ሁሉ ላይ ፅኑ ጨለማ ሦስት ቀን ሆነ፤

verses.en: They saw not one another, neither rose any from his place for three days: but all the children of Israel had light in their dwellings.
verses.fr: On ne se voyait pas les uns les autres, et personne ne se leva de sa place pendant trois jours. Mais il y avait de la lumière dans les lieux où habitaient tous les enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: ማንም ወንድሙን አላየም፥ ሦስት ቀንም ሙሉ ከስፍራው ማንም አልተነሣም፤ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ሁሉ ግን በተቀመጡበት ስፍራ ብርሃን ነበራቸው።

verses.en: And Pharaoh called unto Moses, and said, Go ye, serve the Lord; only let your flocks and your herds be stayed: let your little ones also go with you.
verses.fr: Pharaon appela Moïse, et dit: Allez, servez l''Eternel. Il n''y aura que vos brebis et vos boeufs qui resteront, et vos enfants pourront aller avec vous.
verses.am: ፈርዖንም ሙሴን ጠርቶ። ሂዱ፥ እግዚአብሔርን አገልግሉ፤ ነገር ግን በጎቻችሁንና ከብቶቻችሁን ተዉ፤ ልጆቻችሁ ደግሞ ከእናንተ ጋር ይሂዱ አለው።

verses.en: And Moses said, Thou must give us also sacrifices and burnt offerings, that we may sacrifice unto the Lord our God.
verses.fr: Moïse répondit: Tu mettras toi-même entre nos mains de quoi faire les sacrifices et les holocaustes que nous offrirons à l''Eternel, notre Dieu.
verses.am: ሙሴም። አንተ ደግሞ ለአምላካችን ለእግዚአብሔር የምንሠዋው መሥዋዕትንና የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትን ትሰጠናለህ።

verses.en: Our cattle also shall go with us; there shall not an hoof be left behind; for thereof must we take to serve the Lord our God; and we know not with what we must serve the Lord, until we come thither.
verses.fr: Nos troupeaux iront avec nous, et il ne restera pas un ongle; car c''est là que nous prendrons pour servir l''Eternel, notre Dieu; et jusqu''à ce que nous soyons arrivés, nous ne savons pas ce que nous choisirons pour offrir à l''Eternel.
verses.am: አምላካችንን እግዚአብሔርን ለማገልገል ከእነርሱ እንወስዳለንና ከብቶቻችን ከእኛ ጋር ይሄዳሉ፥ አንድ ሰኮናም አይቀርም፤ አምላካችን የምናገለግለው ምን እንደሆነ ከዚያ እስክንደርስ አናውቅም አለ።

verses.en: But the Lord hardened Pharaoh's heart, and he would not let them go.
verses.fr: L''Eternel endurcit le coeur de Pharaon, et Pharaon ne voulut point les laisser aller.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የፈርዖንን ልብ አጸና፥ ሊለቅቃቸውም አልወደደም።

verses.en: And Pharaoh said unto him, Get thee from me, take heed to thyself, see my face no more; for in that day thou seest my face thou shalt die.
verses.fr: Pharaon dit à Moïse: Sors de chez moi! Garde-toi de paraître encore en ma présence, car le jour où tu paraîtras en ma présence, tu mourras.
verses.am: ፈርዖንም። ከእኔ ዘንድ ሂድ፤ ፊቴን ባየህበት ቀን ትሞታለህና ፊቴን እንዳታይ ተጠንቀቅ አለው።

verses.en: And Moses said, Thou hast spoken well, I will see thy face again no more.
verses.fr: Tu l''as dit! répliqua Moïse, je ne paraîtrai plus en ta présence.
verses.am: ሙሴም። እንደ ተናገርህ ይሁን፤ ፊትህን እንደ ገና አላይም አለ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Yet will I bring one plague more upon Pharaoh, and upon Egypt; afterwards he will let you go hence: when he shall let you go, he shall surely thrust you out hence altogether.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse: Je ferai venir encore une plaie sur Pharaon et sur l''Egypte. Après cela, il vous laissera partir d''ici. Lorsqu''il vous laissera tout à fait aller, il vous chassera même d''ici.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። በፈርዖንና በግብፅ ላይ ገና አንዲት መቅሰፍት አመጣለሁ፥ ከዚያ ወዲያም ይለቅቃችኋል፤ ሲለቅቃችሁም አባርሮ ይሰድዳችኋል።

verses.en: Speak now in the ears of the people, and let every man borrow of his neighbour, and every woman of her neighbour, jewels of silver and jewels of gold.
verses.fr: Parle au peuple, pour que chacun demande à son voisin et chacune à sa voisine des vases d''argent et des vases d''or.
verses.am: ወንዱ ከወዳጁ ሴቲቱም ከወዳጅዋ የብርና የወርቅ ዕቃ ይሹ ዘንድ በሕዝቡ ጆሮ ተናገር አለው።

verses.en: And the Lord gave the people favour in the sight of the Egyptians. Moreover the man Moses was very great in the land of Egypt, in the sight of Pharaoh's servants, and in the sight of the people.
verses.fr: L''Eternel fit trouver grâce au peuple aux yeux des Egyptiens; Moïse lui-même était très considéré dans le pays d''Egypte, aux yeux des serviteurs de Pharaon et aux yeux du peuple.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በግብፃውያን ፊት ለሕዝቡ ሞገስን ሰጠው። ሙሴም በፈርዖን ባሪያዎችና በሕዝቡ ፊት በግብፅ አገር እጅግ የከበረ ሰው ነበረ።

verses.en: And Moses said, Thus saith the Lord, About midnight will I go out into the midst of Egypt:
verses.fr: Moïse dit: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Vers le milieu de la nuit, je passerai au travers de l''Egypte;
verses.am: ሙሴም አለ። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በእኩል ሌሊት እኔ በግብፅ መካከል እወጣለሁ፤

verses.en: And all the firstborn in the land of Egypt shall die, from the first born of Pharaoh that sitteth upon his throne, even unto the firstborn of the maidservant that is behind the mill; and all the firstborn of beasts.
verses.fr: et tous les premiers-nés mourront dans le pays d''Egypte, depuis le premier-né de Pharaon assis sur son trône, jusqu''au premier-né de la servante qui est derrière la meule, et jusqu''à tous les premiers-nés des animaux.
verses.am: በግብፅም አገር ያለ በኵር ሁሉ፥ በዙፋኑ ከሚቀመጠው ከፈርዖን በኵር ጀምሮ በወፍጮ እግር እስካለችው እስከ ባሪያይቱ በኵር ድረስ፥ የከብቱም በኵር ሁሉ ይሞታል።

verses.en: And there shall be a great cry throughout all the land of Egypt, such as there was none like it, nor shall be like it any more.
verses.fr: Il y aura dans tout le pays d''Egypte de grands cris, tels qu''il n''y en a point eu et qu''il n''y en aura plus de semblables.
verses.am: በግብፅም አገር ሁሉ አስቀድሞ እንደ እርሱ ያልሆነ ኋላም ደግሞ የማይሆን ታላቅ ጩኸት ይሆናል።

verses.en: But against any of the children of Israel shall not a dog move his tongue, against man or beast: that ye may know how that the Lord doth put a difference between the Egyptians and Israel.
verses.fr: Mais parmi tous les enfants d''Israël, depuis les hommes jusqu''aux animaux, pas même un chien ne remuera sa langue, afin que vous sachiez quelle différence l''Eternel fait entre l''Egypte et Israël.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ግን በግብፃውያንና በእስራኤል መካከል እንዲለይ እንድታውቁ በእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል ከሰው ጀምሮ እስከ እንስሳ ድረስ ውሻ ምላሱን አያንቀሳቅስባቸውም።

verses.en: And all these thy servants shall come down unto me, and bow down themselves unto me, saying, Get thee out, and all the people that follow thee: and after that I will go out. And he went out from Pharaoh in a great anger.
verses.fr: Alors tous tes serviteurs que voici descendront vers moi et se prosterneront devant moi, en disant: Sors, toi et tout le peuple qui s''attache à tes pas! Après cela, je sortirai. Moïse sortit de chez Pharaon, dans une ardente colère.
verses.am: እነዚህም ባሪያዎችህ ሁሉ። አንተ ውጣ የሚከተሉህም ሕዝብ ሁሉ ይውጡ እያሉ ወደ እኔ ይወርዳሉ፥ ለእኔም ይሰግዳሉ፤ ከዚያም በኋላ እወጣለሁ። ሙሴም በጽኑ ቁጣ ከፈርዖን ዘንድ ወጣ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Pharaoh shall not hearken unto you; that my wonders may be multiplied in the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse: Pharaon ne vous écoutera point, afin que mes miracles se multiplient dans le pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። ተአምራቴ በግብፅ አገር ብዙ እንዲሆን ፈርዖን አይሰማችሁም አለው።

verses.en: And Moses and Aaron did all these wonders before Pharaoh: and the Lord hardened Pharaoh's heart, so that he would not let the children of Israel go out of his land.
verses.fr: Moïse et Aaron firent tous ces miracles devant Pharaon, et Pharaon ne laissa point aller les enfants d''Israël hors de son pays. Exode
verses.am: ሙሴና አሮንም እነዚህን ተአምራቶች ሁሉ በፈርዖን ፊት አደረጉ፤ እግዚአብሔር የፈርዖንን ልብ አጸና፥ የእስራኤልንም ልጆች ከአገሩ አልለቀቀም።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse et à Aaron dans le pays d''Egypte:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በግብፅ አገር ሙሴንና አሮንን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.en: This month shall be unto you the beginning of months: it shall be the first month of the year to you.
verses.fr: Ce mois-ci sera pour vous le premier des mois; il sera pour vous le premier des mois de l''année.
verses.am: ይህ ወር የወሮች መጀመሪያ ይሁናችሁ፤ የዓመቱም መጀመሪያ ወር ይሁናችሁ።

verses.en: Speak ye unto all the congregation of Israel, saying, In the tenth day of this month they shall take to them every man a lamb, according to the house of their fathers, a lamb for an house:
verses.fr: Parlez à toute l''assemblée d''Israël, et dites: Le dixième jour de ce mois, on prendra un agneau pour chaque famille, un agneau pour chaque maison.
verses.am: ለእስራኤል ልጆች ሁሉ ተናገሩ፥ በሉአቸውም። በዚህ ወር በአሥረኛው ቀን ሰው ሁሉ ለአባቱ ቤት አንድ ጠቦት፥ ለአንድ ቤትም አንድ ጠቦት ይውሰድ።

verses.en: And if the household be too little for the lamb, let him and his neighbour next unto his house take it according to the number of the souls; every man according to his eating shall make your count for the lamb.
verses.fr: Si la maison est trop peu nombreuse pour un agneau, on le prendra avec son plus proche voisin, selon le nombre des personnes; vous compterez pour cet agneau d''après ce que chacun peut manger.
verses.am: የቤቱ ሰዎች ቍጥርም ለጠቦቱ የማይበቃ ቢሆን እርሱና ለቤቱ የቀረበው ጎረቤቱ እንደ ነፍሶቻቸው ቍጥር አንድ ጠቦት ይውሰድ፤ እያንዳንዱም እንደሚበላው መጠን ከጠቦቱ ይካፈሉ።

verses.en: Your lamb shall be without blemish, a male of the first year: ye shall take it out from the sheep, or from the goats:
verses.fr: Ce sera un agneau sans défaut, mâle, âgé d''un an; vous pourrez prendre un agneau ou un chevreau.
verses.am: የእናንተ ጠቦት ነውር የሌለበት የአንድ ዓመት ተባት ይሁን፤ ከበጎች ወይም ከፍየሎች ውሰድ።

verses.en: And ye shall keep it up until the fourteenth day of the same month: and the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel shall kill it in the evening.
verses.fr: Vous le garderez jusqu''au quatorzième jour de ce mois; et toute l''assemblée d''Israël l''immolera entre les deux soirs.
verses.am: በዚህም ወር እስከ አሥራ አራተኛው ቀን ድረስ ጠብቁት፤ የእስራኤልም ማኅበር ጉባኤ ሁሉ ሲመሽ ይረዱት።

verses.en: And they shall take of the blood, and strike it on the two side posts and on the upper door post of the houses, wherein they shall eat it.
verses.fr: On prendra de son sang, et on en mettra sur les deux poteaux et sur le linteau de la porte des maisons où on le mangera.
verses.am: ከደሙም ወስደው በሚበሉበት ቤት ሁለቱን መቃንና ጉበኑን ይቅቡት።

verses.en: And they shall eat the flesh in that night, roast with fire, and unleavened bread; and with bitter herbs they shall eat it.
verses.fr: Cette même nuit, on en mangera la chair, rôtie au feu; on la mangera avec des pains sans levain et des herbes amères.
verses.am: በእሳት የተጠበሰውን ሥጋውንና ቂጣውን እንጀራ በዚያች ሌሊት ይብሉ፤ ከመራራ ቅጠል ጋር ይበሉታል።

verses.en: Eat not of it raw, nor sodden at all with water, but roast with fire; his head with his legs, and with the purtenance thereof.
verses.fr: Vous ne le mangerez point à demi cuit et bouilli dans l''eau; mais il sera rôti au feu, avec la tête, les jambes et l''intérieur.
verses.am: ጥሬውን በውኃም የበሰለውን አትብሉ፥ ነገር ግን ከራሱ ከጭኑ ከሆድ ዕቃው ጋር በእሳት የተጠበሰውን ብሉት።

verses.en: And ye shall let nothing of it remain until the morning; and that which remaineth of it until the morning ye shall burn with fire.
verses.fr: Vous n''en laisserez rien jusqu''au matin; et, s''il en reste quelque chose le matin, vous le brûlerez au feu.
verses.am: ከእርሱም እስከ ጥዋት አንዳች አታስቀሩ፤ እስከ ጥዋትም የቀረውን በእሳት አቃጥሉት።

verses.en: And thus shall ye eat it; with your loins girded, your shoes on your feet, and your staff in your hand; and ye shall eat it in haste: it is the Lord's passover.
verses.fr: Quand vous le mangerez, vous aurez vos reins ceints, vos souliers aux pieds, et votre bâton à la main; et vous le mangerez à la hâte. C''est la Pâque de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ወገቦቻችሁን ታጥቃችሁ፥ ጫማችሁን በእግራችሁ፥ በትራችሁንም በእጃችሁ አድርጋችሁ እንዲህ ብሉት፥ ፈጥናችሁም ትበሉታላችህ፤ እርሱ የእግዚአብሔር ፋሲካ ነው።

verses.en: For I will pass through the land of Egypt this night, and will smite all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both man and beast; and against all the gods of Egypt I will execute judgment: I am the Lord.
verses.fr: Cette nuit-là, je passerai dans le pays d''Egypte, et je frapperai tous les premiers-nés du pays d''Egypte, depuis les hommes jusqu''aux animaux, et j''exercerai des jugements contre tous les dieux de l''Egypte. Je suis l''Eternel.
verses.am: እኔም በዚያች ሌሊት በግብፅ አገር አልፋለሁ፥ በግብፅም አገር ከሰው እስከ እንስሳ ድረስ በኵርን ሁሉ እገድላለሁ፤ በግብፅም አማልክት ሁሉ ላይ እፈርድባቸዋለሁ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ።

verses.en: And the blood shall be to you for a token upon the houses where ye are: and when I see the blood, I will pass over you, and the plague shall not be upon you to destroy you, when I smite the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: Le sang vous servira de signe sur les maisons où vous serez; je verrai le sang, et je passerai par-dessus vous, et il n''y aura point de plaie qui vous détruise, quand je frapperai le pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: ደሙም ባላችሁበት ቤቶች ምልክት ይሆንላችኋል፤ ደሙንም ባየሁ ጊዜ ከእናንተ አልፋለሁ፤ እኔም የግብፅን አገር በመታሁ ጊዜ መቅሰፍቱ ለጥፋት አይመጣባችሁም።

verses.en: And this day shall be unto you for a memorial; and ye shall keep it a feast to the Lord throughout your generations; ye shall keep it a feast by an ordinance for ever.
verses.fr: Vous conserverez le souvenir de ce jour, et vous le célébrerez par une fête en l''honneur de l''Eternel; vous le célébrerez comme une loi perpétuelle pour vos descendants.
verses.am: ይህም ቀን መታሰቢያ ይሁናችሁ፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም በዓል ታደርጉታላችሁ፤ ለልጅ ልጃችሁ ሥርዓት ሆኖ ለዘላለም ታደርጉታላችሁ።

verses.en: Seven days shall ye eat unleavened bread; even the first day ye shall put away leaven out of your houses: for whosoever eateth leavened bread from the first day until the seventh day, that soul shall be cut off from Israel.
verses.fr: Pendant sept jours, vous mangerez des pains sans levain. Dès le premier jour, il n''y aura plus de levain dans vos maisons; car toute personne qui mangera du pain levé, du premier jour au septième jour, sera retranchée d''Israël.
verses.am: ሰባት ቀን ቂጣ እንጀራ ትበላላችሁ፤ በመጀመሪያም ቀን እርሾውን ከቤታችሁ ታወጣላችሁ፤ ከመጀመሪያውም ቀን አንሥቶ እስከ ሰባተኛው ቀን እርሾ ያለበትን እንጀራ የሚበላ ነፍስ ከእስራኤል ተለይቶ ይጥፋ።

verses.en: And in the first day there shall be an holy convocation, and in the seventh day there shall be an holy convocation to you; no manner of work shall be done in them, save that which every man must eat, that only may be done of you.
verses.fr: Le premier jour, vous aurez une sainte convocation; et le septième jour, vous aurez une sainte convocation. On ne fera aucun travail ces jours-là; vous pourrez seulement préparer la nourriture de chaque personne.
verses.am: በመጀመሪያውም ቀን የተቀደሰ ጉባኤ እንዲሁም በሰባተኛውም ቀን የተቀደሰ ጉባኤ ይሆንላችኋል። ከሚበላው በቀር በእነርሱም ምንም አትሠሩም፥ ይህንም ብቻ ታደርጉታላችሁ።

verses.en: And ye shall observe the feast of unleavened bread; for in this selfsame day have I brought your armies out of the land of Egypt: therefore shall ye observe this day in your generations by an ordinance for ever.
verses.fr: Vous observerez la fête des pains sans levain, car c''est en ce jour même que j''aurai fait sortir vos armées du pays d''Egypte; vous observerez ce jour comme une loi perpétuelle pour vos descendants.
verses.am: በዚህም ቀን ሠራዊታችሁን ከግብፅ አገር አውጥቼአለሁና የቂጣውንም በዓል ጠብቁት፤ እንግዲህ ይህን ቀን ለልጅ ልጃችሁ ለዘላለም ሥርዓት ትጠብቃላችሁ።

verses.en: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at even, ye shall eat unleavened bread, until the one and twentieth day of the month at even.
verses.fr: Le premier mois, le quatorzième jour du mois, au soir, vous mangerez des pains sans levain jusqu''au soir du vingt et unième jour.
verses.am: በመጀመሪያውም ወር በአሥራ አራተኛው ቀን በመሸ ጊዜ ከወሩም እስከ ሀያ አንድ ቀን በመሸ ጊዜ የቂጣ እንጀራ ትበላላችሁ።

verses.en: Seven days shall there be no leaven found in your houses: for whosoever eateth that which is leavened, even that soul shall be cut off from the congregation of Israel, whether he be a stranger, or born in the land.
verses.fr: Pendant sept jours, il ne se trouvera point de levain dans vos maisons; car toute personne qui mangera du pain levé sera retranchée de l''assemblée d''Israël, que ce soit un étranger ou un indigène.
verses.am: ሰባት ቀን በቤታችሁ እርሾ አይገኝ፤ እርሾ ያለበትንም እንጀራ የሚበላ ነፍስ፥ ከመጻተኛው ጀምሮ እስከ አገር ልጁ ድረስ፥ ከእስራኤል ማኅበር ተለይቶ ይጥፋ።

verses.en: Ye shall eat nothing leavened; in all your habitations shall ye eat unleavened bread.
verses.fr: Vous ne mangerez point de pain levé; dans toutes vos demeures, vous mangerez des pains sans levain.
verses.am: እርሾ ያለበትን ምንም አትብሉ፥ በቤቶቻችሁም ሁሉ ውስጥ ቂጣ እንጀራ ብሉ።

verses.en: Then Moses called for all the elders of Israel, and said unto them, Draw out and take you a lamb according to your families, and kill the passover.
verses.fr: Moïse appela tous les anciens d''Israël, et leur dit: Allez prendre du bétail pour vos familles, et immolez la Pâque.
verses.am: ሙሴም የእስራኤልን ሽማግሌዎች ጠርቶ አላቸው። በየቤታችሁ ጠቦት ምረጡ፥ ወስዳችሁም ለፋሲካ እረዱት።

verses.en: And ye shall take a bunch of hyssop, and dip it in the blood that is in the bason, and strike the lintel and the two side posts with the blood that is in the bason; and none of you shall go out at the door of his house until the morning.
verses.fr: Vous prendrez ensuite un bouquet d''hysope, vous le tremperez dans le sang qui sera dans le bassin, et vous toucherez le linteau et les deux poteaux de la porte avec le sang qui sera dans le bassin. Nul de vous ne sortira de sa maison jusqu''au matin.
verses.am: ከሂሶጵ ቅጠልም ጭብጥ ውሰዱ፥ በዕቃ ውስጥ ባለውም ደም ንከሩት፥ በዕቃውም ውስጥ ካለው ደም ሁለቱን መቃኖችና ጉበኑን እርጩ፤ ከእናንተም አንድ ሰው ከቤቱ ደጅ እስኪነጋ ድረስ አይውጣ።

verses.en: For the Lord will pass through to smite the Egyptians; and when he seeth the blood upon the lintel, and on the two side posts, the Lord will pass over the door, and will not suffer the destroyer to come in unto your houses to smite you.
verses.fr: Quand l''Eternel passera pour frapper l''Egypte, et verra le sang sur le linteau et sur les deux poteaux, l''Eternel passera par-dessus la porte, et il ne permettra pas au destructeur d''entrer dans vos maisons pour frapper.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ግብፃውያንን ይመታ ዘንድ ያልፋልና፤ ደሙንም በጉበኑና በሁለቱ መቃኖች ላይ ባየ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር በደጁ ላይ ያልፋል፥ አጥፊውም ይመታችሁ ዘንድ ወደ ቤታችሁ እንዲገባ አይተውም።

verses.en: And ye shall observe this thing for an ordinance to thee and to thy sons for ever.
verses.fr: Vous observerez cela comme une loi pour vous et pour vos enfants à perpétuité.
verses.am: ለእናንተ ለልጆቻችሁም ለዘላለም ሥርዓት አድርጋችሁ ይህችን ነገር ጠብቁ።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, when ye be come to the land which the Lord will give you, according as he hath promised, that ye shall keep this service.
verses.fr: Quand vous serez entrés dans le pays que l''Eternel vous donnera, selon sa promesse, vous observerez cet usage sacré.
verses.am: እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ተናገረ ወደ ሚሰጣችሁ አገር በገባችሁ ጊዜ ይህን አምልኮ ጠብቁት።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, when your children shall say unto you, What mean ye by this service?
verses.fr: Et lorsque vos enfants vous diront: Que signifie pour vous cet usage?
verses.am: እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ ልጆቻችሁ። ይህ አምልኮ ለእናንተ ምንድር ነው?

verses.en: That ye shall say, It is the sacrifice of the Lord's passover, who passed over the houses of the children of Israel in Egypt, when he smote the Egyptians, and delivered our houses. And the people bowed the head and worshipped.
verses.fr: vous répondrez: C''est le sacrifice de Pâque en l''honneur de l''Eternel, qui a passé par-dessus les maisons des enfants d''Israël en Egypte, lorsqu''il frappa l''Egypte et qu''il sauva nos maisons. Le peuple s''inclina et se prosterna.
verses.am: ባሉአችሁ ጊዜ፥ እናንተ። በግብፅ አገር በእስራኤል ልጆች ቤቶች ላይ አልፎ ግብፃዊያንን በመታ ጊዜ፥ ቤቶቻችንን ያዳነ የእግዚአብሔር የማለፉ መሥዋዕት ይህች ናት ትሉአቸዋላችሁ።

verses.en: And the children of Israel went away, and did as the Lord had commanded Moses and Aaron, so did they.
verses.fr: Et les enfants d''Israël s''en allèrent, et firent ce que l''Eternel avait ordonné à Moïse et à Aaron; ils firent ainsi.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ተጎነበሰ ሰገደም። የእስራኤልም ልጆች ሄዱ፥ እንዲሁም አደረጉ፤ እግዚአብሔር ሙሴንና አሮንን እንዳዘዘ እንዲሁ አደረጉ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that at midnight the Lord smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh that sat on his throne unto the firstborn of the captive that was in the dungeon; and all the firstborn of cattle.
verses.fr: Au milieu de la nuit, l''Eternel frappa tous les premiers-nés dans le pays d''Egypte, depuis le premier-né de Pharaon assis sur son trône, jusqu''au premier-né du captif dans sa prison, et jusqu''à tous les premiers-nés des animaux.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ እኩል ሌሊት በሆነ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር፥ በዙፋን ከተቀመጠው ከፈርዖን በኵር ጀምሮ በግዞት እስካሉት እስከ ምርኮኞቹ በኵር ድረስ፥ የግብፃውያንን በግብፅ ምድር የተገኘውን በኵር ሁሉ፥ የእንስሳውንም በኵሮች ሁሉ መታ።

verses.en: And Pharaoh rose up in the night, he, and all his servants, and all the Egyptians; and there was a great cry in Egypt; for there was not a house where there was not one dead.
verses.fr: Pharaon se leva de nuit, lui et tous ses serviteurs, et tous les Egyptiens; et il y eut de grands cris en Egypte, car il n''y avait point de maison où il n''y eût un mort.
verses.am: ፈርዖንም ባሪያዎቹም ሁሉ ግብፃውያንም ሁሉ በሌሊት ተነሡ፤ የሞተ የሌለበት ቤት አልነበረምና በግብፅ ምድር ታላቅ ልቅሶ ሆነ።

verses.en: And he called for Moses and Aaron by night, and said, Rise up, and get you forth from among my people, both ye and the children of Israel; and go, serve the Lord, as ye have said.
verses.fr: Dans la nuit même, Pharaon appela Moïse et Aaron, et leur dit: Levez-vous, sortez du milieu de mon peuple, vous et les enfants d''Israël. Allez, servez l''Eternel, comme vous l''avez dit.
verses.am: ፈርዖንም ሙሴንና አሮንን በሌሊት ጠርቶ። እናንተ የእስራኤልም ልጆች ተነሡ፥ ከሕዝቤ መካከል ውጡ፤ ሂዱም፥ እንዳላችሁም እግዚአብሔርን አገልግሉ፤

verses.en: Also take your flocks and your herds, as ye have said, and be gone; and bless me also.
verses.fr: Prenez vos brebis et vos boeufs, comme vous l''avez dit; allez, et bénissez-moi.
verses.am: እንዳላችሁም መንጎቻችሁንና ከብቶቻችሁን ውሰዱ፥ ሂዱም፥ እኔንም ደግሞ ባርኩኝ አለ።

verses.en: And the Egyptians were urgent upon the people, that they might send them out of the land in haste; for they said, We be all dead men.
verses.fr: Les Egyptiens pressaient le peuple, et avaient hâte de le renvoyer du pays, car ils disaient: Nous périrons tous.
verses.am: ግብፃውያንም ፈጥነው ከምድሩ ይወጡ ዘንድ ሕዝቡን ያስቸኵሉአቸው ነበር። ሁላችን እንሞታለን ብለዋልና።

verses.en: And the people took their dough before it was leavened, their kneadingtroughs being bound up in their clothes upon their shoulders.
verses.fr: Le peuple emporta sa pâte avant qu''elle fût levée. Ils enveloppèrent les pétrins dans leurs vêtements, et les mirent sur leurs épaules.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ሊጡን ሳይቦካ ተሸከሙ፥ ቡሃቃውንም በልብሳቸው ጠቅልለው በትከሻቸው ተሸከሙት።

verses.en: And the children of Israel did according to the word of Moses; and they borrowed of the Egyptians jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment:
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël firent ce que Moïse avait dit, et ils demandèrent aux Egyptiens des vases d''argent, des vases d''or et des vêtements.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ሙሴ እንዳዘዘ አደረጉ፥ ከግብፃውያንም የብርንና የወርቅን ዕቃ ልብስንም ለመኑ።

verses.en: And the Lord gave the people favour in the sight of the Egyptians, so that they lent unto them such things as they required. And they spoiled the Egyptians.
verses.fr: L''Eternel fit trouver grâce au peuple aux yeux des Egyptiens, qui se rendirent à leur demande. Et ils dépouillèrent les Egyptiens.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ለሕዝቡ በግብፃውያን ፊት የፈለጉትን እንዲሰጡአቸው ሞገስን ሰጠ። እነርሱም ግብፃውያንን በዘበዙ።

verses.en: And the children of Israel journeyed from Rameses to Succoth, about six hundred thousand on foot that were men, beside children.
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël partirent de Ramsès pour Succoth au nombre d''environ six cent mille hommes de pied, sans les enfants.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ከራምሴ ተነሥተው ወደ ሱኮት ሄዱ፤ ከሕፃናቱም ሌላ ስድስት መቶ ሺህ ሰው የሚያህል እግረኛ ነበረ።

verses.en: And a mixed multitude went up also with them; and flocks, and herds, even very much cattle.
verses.fr: Une multitude de gens de toute espèce montèrent avec eux; ils avaient aussi des troupeaux considérables de brebis et de boeufs.
verses.am: ደግሞም ሌላ ብዙ ድብልቅ ሕዝብ መንጎችና ላሞችም እጅግ ብዙም ከብቶች ከእነርሱ ጋር ወጡ።

verses.en: And they baked unleavened cakes of the dough which they brought forth out of Egypt, for it was not leavened; because they were thrust out of Egypt, and could not tarry, neither had they prepared for themselves any victual.
verses.fr: Ils firent des gâteaux cuits sans levain avec la pâte qu''ils avaient emportée d''Egypte, et qui n''était pas levée; car ils avaient été chassés d''Egypte, sans pouvoir tarder, et sans prendre des provisions avec eux.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ አራት መቶ ሠላሳ ዓመት ከተፈጸመ በኋላ በዚያ ቀን የእግዚአብሔር ሠራዊት ሁሉ ከግብፅ ምድር ወጣ።

verses.en: Now the sojourning of the children of Israel, who dwelt in Egypt, was four hundred and thirty years.
verses.fr: Le séjour des enfants d''Israël en Egypte fut de quatre cent trente ans.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ አራት መቶ ሠላሳ ዓመት ከተፈጸመ በኋላ በዚያ ቀን የእግዚአብሔር ሠራዊት ሁሉ ከግብፅ ምድር ወጣ።

verses.en: And it came to pass at the end of the four hundred and thirty years, even the selfsame day it came to pass, that all the hosts of the Lord went out from the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: Et au bout de quatre cent trente ans, le jour même, toutes les armées de l''Eternel sortirent du pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: ይህች ሌሊት ከግብፅ ምድር ስላወጣቸው ለእግዚአብሔር የተጠበቀች ናት፤ ይህች ሌሊት በእስራኤል ልጆች ሁሉ ዘንድ እስከ ልጅ ልጃቸው ድረስ ለእግዚአብሔር የተጠበቀች ናት።

verses.en: It is a night to be much observed unto the Lord for bringing them out from the land of Egypt: this is that night of the Lord to be observed of all the children of Israel in their generations.
verses.fr: Cette nuit sera célébrée en l''honneur de l''Eternel, parce qu''il les fit sortir du pays d''Egypte; cette nuit sera célébrée en l''honneur de l''Eternel par tous les enfants d''Israël et par leurs descendants.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴንና አሮንን አለ። ይህ የፋሲካ ሕግ ነው፤ ከእርሱ እንግዳ ሰው አይብላ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses and Aaron, This is the ordinance of the passover: There shall no stranger eat thereof:
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse et à Aaron: Voici une ordonnance au sujet de la Pâque: Aucun étranger n''en mangera.
verses.am: በብር የተገዛ ባሪያ ቢኖር ከተገረዘ በኋላ ከእርሱ ይብላ።

verses.en: But every man's servant that is bought for money, when thou hast circumcised him, then shall he eat thereof.
verses.fr: Tu circonciras tout esclave acquis à prix d''argent; alors il en mangera.
verses.am: መጻተኛና ሞያተኛ ግን ከእርሱ አይብሉ።

verses.en: A foreigner and an hired servant shall not eat thereof.
verses.fr: L''habitant et le mercenaire n''en mangeront point.
verses.am: በአንድ ቤትም ይበላ፤ ከሥጋውም አንዳች ከቤት ወደ ሜዳ አታውጡ፤ አጥንትም አትስበሩበት።

verses.en: In one house shall it be eaten; thou shalt not carry forth ought of the flesh abroad out of the house; neither shall ye break a bone thereof.
verses.fr: On ne la mangera que dans la maison; vous n''emporterez point de chair hors de la maison, et vous ne briserez aucun os.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ጉባኤ ሁሉ ያድርጉት።

verses.en: All the congregation of Israel shall keep it.
verses.fr: Toute l''assemblée d''Israël fera la Pâque.
verses.am: እንግዳ ሰውም በመካከላችሁ ቢቀመጥ ለእግዚአብሔርም ፋሲካን ሊያደርግ ቢወድድ፥ አስቀድሞ ወንድ ሁሉ ይገረዝ፥ ከዚያም ወዲያ ይቅረብ ያድርግም፤ እንደ አገር ልጅም ይሆናል፤ ያልተገረዘ ሁሉ ግን ከእርሱ አይብላ።

verses.en: And when a stranger shall sojourn with thee, and will keep the passover to the Lord, let all his males be circumcised, and then let him come near and keep it; and he shall be as one that is born in the land: for no uncircumcised person shall eat thereof.
verses.fr: Si un étranger en séjour chez toi veut faire la Pâque de l''Eternel, tout mâle de sa maison devra être circoncis; alors il s''approchera pour la faire, et il sera comme l''indigène; mais aucun incirconcis n''en mangera.
verses.am: ለአገር ልጅ በእናንተ መካከልም ለሚቀመጡ እንግዶች አንድ ሥርዓት ይሆናል።

verses.en: One law shall be to him that is homeborn, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among you.
verses.fr: La même loi existera pour l''indigène comme pour l''étranger en séjour au milieu de vous.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ሁሉ እንዲህ አደረጉ፤ እግዚአብሔር ሙሴንና አሮንን እንዳዘዘ እንዲሁ አደረጉ።

verses.en: Thus did all the children of Israel; as the Lord commanded Moses and Aaron, so did they.
verses.fr: Tous les enfants d''Israël firent ce que l''Eternel avait ordonné à Moïse et à Aaron; ils firent ainsi.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን እግዚአብሔር የእስራኤልን ልጆች ከሠራዊታቸው ጋር ከግብፅ ምድር አወጣ።

verses.en: And it came to pass the selfsame day, that the Lord did bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt by their armies.
verses.fr: Et ce même jour l''Eternel fit sortir du pays d''Egypte les enfants d''Israël, selon leurs armées.
verses.am: ፤ በዚያም ቀን እግዚአብሔር የእስራኤልን ልጆች ከሠራዊታቸው ጋር ከግብፅ ምድር አወጣ።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገርው።

verses.en: Sanctify unto me all the firstborn, whatsoever openeth the womb among the children of Israel, both of man and of beast: it is mine.
verses.fr: Consacre-moi tout premier-né, tout premier-né parmi les enfants d''Israël, tant des hommes que des animaux: il m''appartient.
verses.am: በእስራኤል ልጆች ዘንድ ከሰውም ከእንስሳም ማሕፀንን የሚከፈት በኵር ሁሉ ለእኔ ቀድስልኝ፤ የእኔ ነው።

verses.en: And Moses said unto the people, Remember this day, in which ye came out from Egypt, out of the house of bondage; for by strength of hand the Lord brought you out from this place: there shall no leavened bread be eaten.
verses.fr: Moïse dit au peuple: Souvenez-vous de ce jour, où vous êtes sortis d''Egypte, de la maison de servitude; car c''est par sa main puissante que l''Eternel vous en a fait sortir. On ne mangera point de pain levé.
verses.am: ሙሴም ሕዝቡን አለ። ከባርነት ቤት ከግብፅ የወጣችሁበትን ይህን ቀን አስቡ፥ እግዚአብሔር ከዚህ ቦታ በብርቱ እጅ አውጥቶአችኋልና፤ ስለዚህ የቦካ እንጀራ አትብሉ።

verses.en: This day came ye out in the month Abib.
verses.fr: Vous sortez aujourd''hui, dans le mois des épis.
verses.am: እናንተ ዛሬ በአቢብ ወር ወጥታችኋል።

verses.en: And it shall be when the Lord shall bring thee into the land of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee, a land flowing with milk and honey, that thou shalt keep this service in this month.
verses.fr: Quand l''Eternel t''aura fait entrer dans le pays des Cananéens, des Héthiens, des Amoréens, des Héviens et des Jébusiens, qu''il a juré à tes pères de te donner, pays où coulent le lait et le miel, tu rendras ce culte à l''Eternel dans ce même mois.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ለአንተ ይሰጣት ዘንድ ለአባቶችህ ወደ ማለላቸው፥ ወተትና ማር ወደምታፈስስ ምድር፥ ወደ ከነዓናውያን ወደ ኬጢያውያንም ወደ አሞራውያንም ወደ ኤዊያውያንም ወደ ኢያቡሳውያንም ምድር ባገባህ ጊዜ ይህችን አምልኮ በዚህ ወር ታደርጋለህ።

verses.en: Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread, and in the seventh day shall be a feast to the Lord.
verses.fr: Pendant sept jours, tu mangeras des pains sans levain; et le septième jour, il y aura une fête en l''honneur de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሰባት ቀን ቂጣ እንጀራ ትበላለህ፥ በሰባተኛውም ቀን ለእግዚአብሔር በዓል ይሆናል።

verses.en: Unleavened bread shall be eaten seven days; and there shall no leavened bread be seen with thee, neither shall there be leaven seen with thee in all thy quarters.
verses.fr: On mangera des pains sans levain pendant les sept jours; on ne verra point chez toi de pain levé, et l''on ne verra point chez toi de levain, dans toute l''étendue de ton pays.
verses.am: ሰባት ቀንም ሙሉ ቂጣ እንጀራ ትበላለህ፥ በአንተም ዘንድ እርሾ ያለበት እንጀራ አይታይ፥ በድንበርህም ሁሉ እርሾ አይታይ።

verses.en: And thou shalt shew thy son in that day, saying, This is done because of that which the Lord did unto me when I came forth out of Egypt.
verses.fr: Tu diras alors à ton fils: C''est en mémoire de ce que l''Eternel a fait pour moi, lorsque je suis sorti d''Egypte.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን። ከግብፅ በወጣሁ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር ስላደረገልኝ ነው ስትል ለልጅህ ትነግረዋለህ።

verses.en: And it shall be for a sign unto thee upon thine hand, and for a memorial between thine eyes, that the Lord's law may be in thy mouth: for with a strong hand hath the Lord brought thee out of Egypt.
verses.fr: Ce sera pour toi comme un signe sur ta main et comme un souvenir entre tes yeux, afin que la loi de l''Eternel soit dans ta bouche; car c''est par sa main puissante que l''Eternel t''a fait sortir d''Egypte.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በብርቱ እጅ ከግብፅ አውጥቶሃልና የእግዚአብሔር ሕግ በአፍህ ይሆን ዘንድ በእጅህ እንደ ምልክት በዓይኖችህም መካከል እንደ መታሰቢያ ይሁንልህ።

verses.en: Thou shalt therefore keep this ordinance in his season from year to year.
verses.fr: Tu observeras cette ordonnance au temps fixé d''année en année.
verses.am: በዓመት በዓመት በወራቱ ይህችን ሥርዓት ጠብቃት።

verses.en: And it shall be when the Lord shall bring thee into the land of the Canaanites, as he sware unto thee and to thy fathers, and shall give it thee,
verses.fr: Quand l''Eternel t''aura fait entrer dans le pays des Cananéens, comme il l''a juré à toi et à tes pères, et qu''il te l''aura donné,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ለአንተ ለአባቶችህም እንደ ማለ ወደ ከነዓናውያን ምድር ባገባህ ጊዜ፥ እርስዋንም በሰጠህ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: That thou shalt set apart unto the Lord all that openeth the matrix, and every firstling that cometh of a beast which thou hast; the males shall be the Lord's.
verses.fr: tu consacreras à l''Eternel tout premier-né, même tout premier-né des animaux que tu auras: les mâles appartiennent à l''Eternel.
verses.am: ማሕፀንን የሚከፍተውን ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር ለይ፤ ከሚሆንልህ ከብት ሁሉ ተባት ሆኖ አስቀድሞ የተወለደው ለእግዚአብሔር ይሆናል።

verses.en: And every firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb; and if thou wilt not redeem it, then thou shalt break his neck: and all the firstborn of man among thy children shalt thou redeem.
verses.fr: Tu rachèteras avec un agneau tout premier-né de l''âne; et, si tu ne le rachètes pas, tu lui briseras la nuque. Tu rachèteras aussi tout premier-né de l''homme parmi tes fils.
verses.am: የአህያውን በኵር በጠቦት ትዋጀዋለህ፥ ባትዋጀውም አንገቱን ትሰብረዋለህ፤ የሰውንም በኵር ሁሉ ከልጆችህ መካከል ትዋጀዋለህ።

verses.en: And it shall be when thy son asketh thee in time to come, saying, What is this? that thou shalt say unto him, By strength of hand the Lord brought us out from Egypt, from the house of bondage:
verses.fr: Et lorsque ton fils te demandera un jour: Que signifie cela? tu lui répondras: Par sa main puissante, l''Eternel nous a fait sortir d''Egypte, de la maison de servitude;
verses.am: እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ በሚመጣው ጊዜ ልጅህ። ይህ ምንድር ነው? ብሎ በጠየቀህ ጊዜ እንዲህ ትለዋለህ። እግዚአብሔር በብርቱ እጅ ከባርነት ቤት ከግብፅ ምድር አወጣን፤

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Pharaoh would hardly let us go, that the Lord slew all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both the firstborn of man, and the firstborn of beast: therefore I sacrifice to the Lord all that openeth the matrix, being males; but all the firstborn of my children I redeem.
verses.fr: et, comme Pharaon s''obstinait à ne point nous laisser aller, l''Eternel fit mourir tous les premiers-nés dans le pays d''Egypte, depuis les premiers-nés des hommes jusqu''aux premiers-nés des animaux. Voilà pourquoi j''offre en sacrifice à l''Eternel tout premier-né des mâles, et je rachète tout premier-né de mes fils.
verses.am: ፈርዖንም እንዳይሰድደን ልቡን ባጸና ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር ከሰው በኵር ጀምሮ እስከ እንስሳ በኵር ድረስ በግብፅ ምድር ያለውን በኵር ሁሉ ገደለ፤ ስለዚህ ወንድ ሆኖ ማሕፀንን የከፈተውን ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር እሠዋለሁ፥ ነገር ግን የልጆቼን በኵር ሁሉ እዋጃለሁ።

verses.en: And it shall be for a token upon thine hand, and for frontlets between thine eyes: for by strength of hand the Lord brought us forth out of Egypt.
verses.fr: Ce sera comme un signe sur ta main et comme des fronteaux entre tes yeux; car c''est par sa main puissante que l''Eternel nous a fait sortir d''Egypte.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በብርቱ እጅ ከግብፅ አውጥቶናልና በእጅህ እንደ ምልክት፥ በዓይኖችህም መካከል እንደ ተንጠለጠለ ነገር ይሁንልህ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Pharaoh had let the people go, that God led them not through the way of the land of the Philistines, although that was near; for God said, Lest peradventure the people repent when they see war, and they return to Egypt:
verses.fr: Lorsque Pharaon laissa aller le peuple, Dieu ne le conduisit point par le chemin du pays des Philistins, quoique le plus proche; car Dieu dit: Le peuple pourrait se repentir en voyant la guerre, et retourner en Egypte.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ፈርዖን ሕዝቡን በለቀቀ ጊዜ፥ ምንም ቅርብ ቢሆን እግዚአብሔር በፍልስጥኤማውያን ምድር መንገድ አልመራቸውም፤ እግዚአብሔር። ሕዝቡ ሰልፉን ባየ ጊዜ እንዳይጸጽተው ወደ ግብፅም እንዳይመለስ ብሎአልና።

verses.en: But God led the people about, through the way of the wilderness of the Red sea: and the children of Israel went up harnessed out of the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: Mais Dieu fit faire au peuple un détour par le chemin du désert, vers la mer Rouge. Les enfants d''Israël montèrent en armes hors du pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቡን በዙሪያ መንገድ በኤርትራ ባሕር ባለችው ምድረ በዳ መራቸው። የእስራኤልም ልጆች ከግብፅ ምድር ተሰልፈው ወጡ።

verses.en: And Moses took the bones of Joseph with him: for he had straitly sworn the children of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you; and ye shall carry up my bones away hence with you.
verses.fr: Moïse prit avec lui les os de Joseph; car Joseph avait fait jurer les fils d''Israël, en disant: Dieu vous visitera, et vous ferez remonter avec vous mes os loin d''ici.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም። እግዚአብሔር ሳይጎበኛችሁ አይቀርም፥ አጥንቶቼንም ከዚህ ከእናንተ ጋር ታወጣላችሁ ብሎ የእስራኤልን ልጆች አምሎአቸው ነበርና ሙሴ የእርሱን አጥንቶች ከእርሱ ጋር ወሰደ።

verses.en: And they took their journey from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, in the edge of the wilderness.
verses.fr: Ils partirent de Succoth, et ils campèrent à Etham, à l''extrémité du désert.
verses.am: ከሱኮትም ተጓዙ፥ በምድረ በዳውም ዳር በኤታም ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And the Lord went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud, to lead them the way; and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light; to go by day and night:
verses.fr: L''Eternel allait devant eux, le jour dans une colonne de nuée pour les guider dans leur chemin, et la nuit dans une colonne de feu pour les éclairer, afin qu''ils marchassent jour et nuit.
verses.am: በቀንና በሌሊትም ይሄዱ ዘንድ፥ መንገድ ሊያሳያቸው ቀን በደመና ዓምድ፥ ሊያበራላቸውም ሌሊት በእሳት ዓምድ እግዚአብሔር በፊታቸው ሄደ።

verses.en: He took not away the pillar of the cloud by day, nor the pillar of fire by night, from before the people.
verses.fr: La colonne de nuée ne se retirait point de devant le peuple pendant le jour, ni la colonne de feu pendant la nuit.
verses.am: የደመና ዓምድ በቀን፥ የእሳት ዓምድ በሌሊት ከሕዝቡ ፊት ከቶ ፈቀቅ አላለም።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they turn and encamp before Pihahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, over against Baalzephon: before it shall ye encamp by the sea.
verses.fr: Parle aux enfants d''Israël; qu''ils se détournent, et qu''ils campent devant Pi-Hahiroth, entre Migdol et la mer, vis-à-vis de Baal-Tsephon; c''est en face de ce lieu que vous camperez, près de la mer.
verses.am: ተመልሰው በሚግዶልና በባሕር መካከል፥ በበኣልዛፎንም ፊት ለፊት ባለው በፊሀሒሮት ፊት እንዲሰፍሩ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ተናገር፤ ከእርሱም አጠገብ በባሕር ዳር ትሰፍራላችሁ።

verses.en: For Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel, They are entangled in the land, the wilderness hath shut them in.
verses.fr: Pharaon dira des enfants d''Israël: Ils sont égarés dans le pays; le désert les enferme.
verses.am: ፈርዖንም ስለ እስራኤል ልጆች። በምድር ይቅበዘበዛሉ፥ ምድረ በዳም ዘጋቻቸው ይላል።

verses.en: And I will harden Pharaoh's heart, that he shall follow after them; and I will be honoured upon Pharaoh, and upon all his host; that the Egyptians may know that I am the Lord. And they did so.
verses.fr: J''endurcirai le coeur de Pharaon, et il les poursuivra; mais Pharaon et toute son armée serviront à faire éclater ma gloire, et les Egyptiens sauront que je suis l''Eternel. Et les enfants d''Israël firent ainsi.
verses.am: እኔም የፈርዖንን ልብ አጸናለሁ፥ እርሱም ያባርራቸዋል፤ በፈርዖንና በሠራዊቱም ሁሉ ላይ ክብር አገኛለሁ፤ ግብፃውያንም እኔ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ። እነርሱም እንዲሁ አደረጉ።

verses.en: And it was told the king of Egypt that the people fled: and the heart of Pharaoh and of his servants was turned against the people, and they said, Why have we done this, that we have let Israel go from serving us?
verses.fr: On annonça au roi d''Egypte que le peuple avait pris la fuite. Alors le coeur de Pharaon et celui de ses serviteurs furent changés à l''égard du peuple. Ils dirent: Qu''avons-nous fait, en laissant aller Israël, dont nous n''aurons plus les services?
verses.am: ሕዝቡም እንደ ኰበለሉ ለግብፅ ንጉሥ ነገሩት፤ የፈርዖንና የባሪያዎቹም ልብ በሕዝቡ ላይ ተለወጠና። እንዳይገዛልን እስራኤልን የለቀቅነው ምን አድርገናል? አሉ።

verses.en: And he made ready his chariot, and took his people with him:
verses.fr: Et Pharaon attela son char, et il prit son peuple avec lui.
verses.am: ሰረገላውንም አሰናዳ፥ ሕዝቡንም ከእርሱ ጋር ወሰደ፤

verses.en: And he took six hundred chosen chariots, and all the chariots of Egypt, and captains over every one of them.
verses.fr: Il prit six cents chars d''élite, et tous les chars de l''Egypte; il y avait sur tous des combattants.
verses.am: ስድስት መቶ የተመረጡ ሰረገሎችንም፥ የግብፅንም ፈረሶች ሁሉ፥ በእያንዳንዱም ሰረገላ ሁሉ ላይ ሦስተኞችን ወሰደ።

verses.en: And the Lord hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and he pursued after the children of Israel: and the children of Israel went out with an high hand.
verses.fr: L''Eternel endurcit le coeur de Pharaon, roi d''Egypte, et Pharaon poursuivit les enfants d''Israël. Les enfants d''Israël étaient sortis la main levée.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም የግብፅን ንጉሥ የፈርዖንን ልብ አጸና፥ እርሱም የእስራኤልን ልጆች አሳደደ፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች ከፍ ባለች እጅ ወጡ።

verses.en: But the Egyptians pursued after them, all the horses and chariots of Pharaoh, and his horsemen, and his army, and overtook them encamping by the sea, beside Pihahiroth, before Baalzephon.
verses.fr: Les Egyptiens les poursuivirent; et tous les chevaux, les chars de Pharaon, ses cavaliers et son armée, les atteignirent campés près de la mer, vers Pi-Hahiroth, vis-à-vis de Baal-Tsephon.
verses.am: ግብፃውያንም የፈርዖን ፈረሶች ሰረገሎቹም ፈረሰኞቹም ሠራዊቱም ሁሉ፥ አሳደዱአቸው፤ በባሕሩ ዳር በበኣልዛፎን ፊት ለፊት ባለው በፊሀሒሮት አጠገብ ሰፍረው አገኙአቸው።

verses.en: And when Pharaoh drew nigh, the children of Israel lifted up their eyes, and, behold, the Egyptians marched after them; and they were sore afraid: and the children of Israel cried out unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Pharaon approchait. Les enfants d''Israël levèrent les yeux, et voici, les Egyptiens étaient en marche derrière eux. Et les enfants d''Israël eurent une grande frayeur, et crièrent à l''Eternel.
verses.am: ፈርዖንም በቀረበ ጊዜ የእስራኤል ልጆች ዓይናቸውን አነሡ፥ እነሆም ግብፃውያን በኋላቸው ገሥግስው ነበር፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች እጅግ ፈሩ፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ጮኹ።

verses.en: And they said unto Moses, Because there were no graves in Egypt, hast thou taken us away to die in the wilderness? wherefore hast thou dealt thus with us, to carry us forth out of Egypt?
verses.fr: Ils dirent à Moïse: N''y avait-il pas des sépulcres en Egypte, sans qu''il fût besoin de nous mener mourir au désert? Que nous as-tu fait en nous faisant sortir d''Egypte?
verses.am: ሙሴንም። በግብፅ መቃብር ስላልኖረ በምድረ በዳ እንሞት ዘንድ አወጣኸንን? ከግብፅ ታወጣን ዘንድ ይህ ያደረግህብን ምንድር ነው?

verses.en: Is not this the word that we did tell thee in Egypt, saying, Let us alone, that we may serve the Egyptians? For it had been better for us to serve the Egyptians, than that we should die in the wilderness.
verses.fr: N''est-ce pas là ce que nous te disions en Egypte: Laisse-nous servir les Egyptiens, car nous aimons mieux servir les Egyptiens que de mourir au désert?
verses.am: በምድረ በዳ ከምንሞት ብንገዛላቸው ይሻላልና። ተወን፥ ለግብፃውያን እንገዛ ብለን በግብፅ ሳለን ያልንህ ቃል ይህ አይደለምን? አሉት።

verses.en: And Moses said unto the people, Fear ye not, stand still, and see the salvation of the Lord, which he will shew to you to day: for the Egyptians whom ye have seen to day, ye shall see them again no more for ever.
verses.fr: Moïse répondit au peuple: Ne craignez rien, restez en place, et regardez la délivrance que l''Eternel va vous accorder en ce jour; car les Egyptiens que vous voyez aujourd''hui, vous ne les verrez plus jamais.
verses.am: ሙሴም ለሕዝቡ። አትፍሩ፥ ዛሬ የምታዩአቸውን ግብፃውያንን ለዘላለም አታዩአቸውምና ቁሙ፥ ዛሬ ለእናንተ የሚያደርጋትን የእግዚአብሔርን ማዳን እዩ።

verses.en: The Lord shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace.
verses.fr: L''Eternel combattra pour vous; et vous, gardez le silence.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ስለ እናንተ ይዋጋል፥ እናንተም ዝም ትላላችሁ አላቸው።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Wherefore criest thou unto me? speak unto the children of Israel, that they go forward:
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse: Pourquoi ces cris? Parle aux enfants d''Israël, et qu''ils marchent.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን አለው። ለምን ትጮኽብኛለህ? እንዲጓዙ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ንገር።

verses.en: But lift thou up thy rod, and stretch out thine hand over the sea, and divide it: and the children of Israel shall go on dry ground through the midst of the sea.
verses.fr: Toi, lève ta verge, étends ta main sur la mer, et fends-la; et les enfants d''Israël entreront au milieu de la mer à sec.
verses.am: አንተም በትርህን አንሣ፥ እጅህንም በባሕሩ ላይ ዘርጋ፥ ክፈለውም፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች በባሕሩ ውስጥ በየብስ ያልፋሉ።

verses.en: And I, behold, I will harden the hearts of the Egyptians, and they shall follow them: and I will get me honour upon Pharaoh, and upon all his host, upon his chariots, and upon his horsemen.
verses.fr: Et moi, je vais endurcir le coeur des Egyptiens, pour qu''ils y entrent après eux: et Pharaon et toute son armée, ses chars et ses cavaliers, feront éclater ma gloire.
verses.am: እነሆም እኔ የግብፃውያንን ልብ አጸናለሁ፥ በኋላቸውም ይገባሉ፤ በፈርዖንና በሠራዊቱም ሁሉ በሰረገሎቹም በፈረሰኞቹም ላይ ክብር አገኛለሁ።

verses.en: And the Egyptians shall know that I am the Lord, when I have gotten me honour upon Pharaoh, upon his chariots, and upon his horsemen.
verses.fr: Et les Egyptiens sauront que je suis l''Eternel, quand Pharaon, ses chars et ses cavaliers, auront fait éclater ma gloire.
verses.am: ግብፃውያንም በፈርዖንና በሰረገሎቹ በፈረሰኞቹም ላይ ክብር ባገኘሁ ጊዜ እኔ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ።

verses.en: And the angel of God, which went before the camp of Israel, removed and went behind them; and the pillar of the cloud went from before their face, and stood behind them:
verses.fr: L''ange de Dieu, qui allait devant le camp d''Israël, partit et alla derrière eux; et la colonne de nuée qui les précédait, partit et se tint derrière eux.
verses.am: በእስራኤልም ሠራዊት ፊት ይሄድ የነበረው የእግዚአብሔር መልአክ ፈቀቅ ብሎ በኋላቸው ሄደ፤ የደመናውም ዓምድ ከፊታቸው ፈቀቅ ብሎ በኋላቸው ቆመ፥

verses.en: And it came between the camp of the Egyptians and the camp of Israel; and it was a cloud and darkness to them, but it gave light by night to these: so that the one came not near the other all the night.
verses.fr: Elle se plaça entre le camp des Egyptiens et le camp d''Israël. Cette nuée était ténébreuse d''un côté, et de l''autre elle éclairait la nuit. Et les deux camps n''approchèrent point l''un de l''autre pendant toute la nuit.
verses.am: በግብፃውያን ሰፈርና በእስራኤል ሰፈር መካከልም ገባ፤ በዚያም ደመናና ጨለማ ነበረ፥ በዚህ በኩል ግን ሌሊቱን አበራ፤ ሌሊቱንም ሁሉ እርስ በእርሳቸው አልተቃረቡም።

verses.en: And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea; and the Lord caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all that night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.
verses.fr: Moïse étendit sa main sur la mer. Et l''Eternel refoula la mer par un vent d''orient, qui souffla avec impétuosité toute la nuit; il mit la mer à sec, et les eaux se fendirent.
verses.am: ሙሴም በባሕሩ ላይ እጁን ዘረጋ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ሌሊቱን ሁሉ ጽኑ የምሥራቅ ነፋስ አምጥቶ ባሕሩን አስወገደው፥ ባሕሩንም አደረቀው፥ ውኃውም ተከፈለ።

verses.en: And the children of Israel went into the midst of the sea upon the dry ground: and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël entrèrent au milieu de la mer à sec, et les eaux formaient comme une muraille à leur droite et à leur gauche.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች በባሕሩ መካከል በየብስ ገቡ፤ ውኃውም በቀኛቸውና በግራቸው እንደ ግድግዳ ሆነላቸው።

verses.en: And the Egyptians pursued, and went in after them to the midst of the sea, even all Pharaoh's horses, his chariots, and his horsemen.
verses.fr: Les Egyptiens les poursuivirent; et tous les chevaux de Pharaon, ses chars et ses cavaliers, entrèrent après eux au milieu de la mer.
verses.am: ግብፃውያንም፥ የፈርዖን ፈረሶችና ሰረገሎች ፈረሰኞቹም ሁሉ፥ እያሳደዱ በኋላቸው ወደ ባሕር መካከል ገቡ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that in the morning watch the Lord looked unto the host of the Egyptians through the pillar of fire and of the cloud, and troubled the host of the Egyptians,
verses.fr: A la veille du matin, l''Eternel, de la colonne de feu et de nuée, regarda le camp des Egyptiens, et mit en désordre le camp des Egyptiens.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። እጅህን በባሕሩ ላይ ዘርጋ፥ ውኃውም በግብፃውያን በሰረገሎቻቸውም በፈረሰኞቻቸውም ላይ ይመለስ አለው።

verses.en: And took off their chariot wheels, that they drave them heavily: so that the Egyptians said, Let us flee from the face of Israel; for the Lord fighteth for them against the Egyptians.
verses.fr: Il ôta les roues de leurs chars et en rendit la marche difficile. Les Egyptiens dirent alors: Fuyons devant Israël, car l''Eternel combat pour lui contre les Egyptiens.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። እጅህን በባሕሩ ላይ ዘርጋ፥ ውኃውም በግብፃውያን በሰረገሎቻቸውም በፈረሰኞቻቸውም ላይ ይመለስ አለው።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Stretch out thine hand over the sea, that the waters may come again upon the Egyptians, upon their chariots, and upon their horsemen.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse: Etends ta main sur la mer; et les eaux reviendront sur les Egyptiens, sur leurs chars et sur leurs cavaliers.
verses.am: ሙሴም እጁን በባሕሩ ላይ ዘረጋ፥ ባሕሩም ማለዳ ወደ መፍሰሱ ተመለሰ፤ ግብፃውያንም ከእርሱ ሸሹ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ግብፃውያንን በባሕሩ መካከል ጣላቸው።

verses.en: And Moses stretched forth his hand over the sea, and the sea returned to his strength when the morning appeared; and the Egyptians fled against it; and the Lord overthrew the Egyptians in the midst of the sea.
verses.fr: Moïse étendit sa main sur la mer. Et vers le matin, la mer reprit son impétuosité, et les Egyptiens s''enfuirent à son approche; mais l''Eternel précipita les Egyptiens au milieu de la mer.
verses.am: ውኃውም ተመልሶ በኋላቸው ወደ ባሕር የገቡትን ሰረገሎችን ፈረሰኞችንም የፈርዖንንም ሠራዊት ሁሉ ከደነ፤ ከእነርሱም አንድ ስንኳ አልቀረም።

verses.en: And the waters returned, and covered the chariots, and the horsemen, and all the host of Pharaoh that came into the sea after them; there remained not so much as one of them.
verses.fr: Les eaux revinrent, et couvrirent les chars, les cavaliers et toute l''armée de Pharaon, qui étaient entrés dans la mer après les enfants d''Israël; et il n''en échappa pas un seul.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ልጆች ግን በባሕሩ ውስጥ በየብስ ሄዱ፤ ውኆችም በቀኛቸውና በግራቸው እንደ ግድግዳ ሆኑላችው።

verses.en: But the children of Israel walked upon dry land in the midst of the sea; and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.
verses.fr: Mais les enfants d''Israël marchèrent à sec au milieu de la mer, et les eaux formaient comme une muraille à leur droite et à leur gauche.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በዚያን ቀን እስራኤልን እንደዚህ ከግብፃውያን እጅ አዳነ፤ እስራኤልም የግብፃውያንን ሬሳ በባሕር ዳር አዩ።

verses.en: Thus the Lord saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead upon the sea shore.
verses.fr: En ce jour, l''Eternel délivra Israël de la main des Egyptiens; et Israël vit sur le rivage de la mer les Egyptiens qui étaient morts.
verses.am: እስራኤልም እግዚአብሔር በግብፃውያን ላይ ያደረጋትን ታላቂቱን እጅ አዩ፥ ሕዝቡም እግዚአብሔርን ፈሩ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም በባሪያውም በሙሴ አመኑ።

verses.en: And Israel saw that great work which the Lord did upon the Egyptians: and the people feared the Lord, and believed the Lord, and his servant Moses.
verses.fr: Israël vit la main puissante que l''Eternel avait dirigée contre les Egyptiens. Et le peuple craignit l''Eternel, et il crut en l''Eternel et en Moïse, son serviteur.
verses.am: ፤ እስራኤልም እግዚአብሔር በግብፃውያን ላይ ያደረጋትን ታላቂቱን እጅ አዩ፥ ሕዝቡም እግዚአብሔርን ፈሩ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም በባሪያውም በሙሴ አመኑ።

verses.en: Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song unto the Lord, and spake, saying, I will sing unto the Lord, for he hath triumphed gloriously: the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.
verses.fr: Alors Moïse et les enfants d''Israël chantèrent ce cantique à l''Eternel. Ils dirent: Je chanterai à l''Eternel, car il a fait éclater sa gloire; Il a précipité dans la mer le cheval et son cavalier.
verses.am: በዚያም ጊዜ ሙሴና የእስራኤል ልጆች ይህንን መዝሙር ለእግዚአብሔር ዘመሩ፥ እንዲህም ብለው ተናገሩ። በክብር ከፍ ከፍ ብሎአልና ለእግዚአብሔር እዘምራለሁ፤ ፈረሱንና ፈረሰኛውን በባሕር ጣለ።

verses.en: The Lord is my strength and song, and he is become my salvation: he is my God, and I will prepare him an habitation; my father's God, and I will exalt him.
verses.fr: L''Eternel est ma force et le sujet de mes louanges; C''est lui qui m''a sauvé. Il est mon Dieu: je le célèbrerai; Il est le Dieu de mon père: je l''exalterai.
verses.am: ጕልበቴ ዝማሬዬም እግዚአብሔር ነው፥  መድኃኒቴም ሆነልኝ፤  ይህ አምላኬ ነው አመሰግነውማለሁ፥ የአባቴ አምላክ ነው ከፍ ከፍም አደርገዋለሁ።

verses.en: The Lord is a man of war: the Lord is his name.
verses.fr: L''Eternel est un vaillant guerrier; L''Eternel est son nom.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ተዋጊ ነው፥ ስሙም እግዚአብሔር ነው፥

verses.en: Pharaoh's chariots and his host hath he cast into the sea: his chosen captains also are drowned in the Red sea.
verses.fr: Il a lancé dans la mer les chars de Pharaon et son armée; Ses combattants d''élite ont été engloutis dans la mer Rouge.
verses.am: የፈርዖንን ሰረገሎች ሠራዊቱንም በባሕር ጣላቸው፤  የተመረጡት ሦስተኞች በኤርትራ ባሕር ሰጠሙ።

verses.en: The depths have covered them: they sank into the bottom as a stone.
verses.fr: Les flots les ont couverts: Ils sont descendus au fond des eaux, comme une pierre.
verses.am: ቀላያትም ከደኑአቸው፤  ወደ ባሕር ጥልቀት እንደ ድንጋይ ሰጠሙ።

verses.en: Thy right hand, O Lord, is become glorious in power: thy right hand, O Lord, hath dashed in pieces the enemy.
verses.fr: Ta droite, ô Eternel! a signalé sa force; Ta droite, ô Eternel! a écrasé l''ennemi.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ቀኝህ በኃይል ከበረ፤  አቤቱ፥ ቀኝህ ጠላቱን አደቀቀ።

verses.en: And in the greatness of thine excellency thou hast overthrown them that rose up against thee: thou sentest forth thy wrath, which consumed them as stubble.
verses.fr: Par la grandeur de ta majesté Tu renverses tes adversaires; Tu déchaînes ta colère: Elle les consume comme du chaume.
verses.am: በክብርህም ብዛት የተነሡብህን አጠፋህ፤  ቍጣህን ሰድደህ፥ እንደ ገለባም በላቸው።

verses.en: And with the blast of thy nostrils the waters were gathered together, the floods stood upright as an heap, and the depths were congealed in the heart of the sea.
verses.fr: Au souffle de tes narines, les eaux se sont amoncelées, Les courants se sont dressés comme une muraille, Les flots se sont durcis au milieu de la mer.
verses.am: በአፍንጫህ እስትንፋስ ውኆች ተከመሩ፥  ፈሳሾቹም እንደ ክምር ቆሙ፤  ሞገዱም በባሕር ውስጥ ረጋ።

verses.en: The enemy said, I will pursue, I will overtake, I will divide the spoil; my lust shall be satisfied upon them; I will draw my sword, my hand shall destroy them.
verses.fr: L''ennemi disait: Je poursuivrai, j''atteindrai, Je partagerai le butin; Ma vengeance sera assouvie, Je tirerai l''épée, ma main les détruira.
verses.am: ጠላትም። አሳድጄ እይዛቸዋለሁ፥  ምርኮም እካፈላለሁ፥ ነፍሴም ትጠግባቸዋለች፤ ሰይፌንም እመዝዛለሁ፥ እጄም ታጠፋቸዋለች አለ።

verses.en: Thou didst blow with thy wind, the sea covered them: they sank as lead in the mighty waters.
verses.fr: Tu as soufflé de ton haleine: La mer les a couverts; Ils se sont enfoncés comme du plomb, Dans la profondeur des eaux.
verses.am: ነፋስህን አነፈስህ፥ ባሕርም ከደናቸው፤  በኃይለኞች ውኆችም እንደ አረር ሰጠሙ።

verses.en: Who is like unto thee, O Lord, among the gods? who is like thee, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?
verses.fr: Qui est comme toi parmi les dieux, ô Eternel? Qui est comme toi magnifique en sainteté, Digne de louanges, Opérant des prodiges?
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በአማልክት መካከል እንደ አንተ ያለ ማን ነው?  በምስጋና የተፈራህ፥ ድንቅንም የምታደርግ፥  በቅድስና የከበረ እንደ አንተ ያለ ማን ነው?

verses.en: Thou stretchedst out thy right hand, the earth swallowed them.
verses.fr: Tu as étendu ta droite: La terre les a engloutis.
verses.am: ቀኝህን ዘረጋህ፥ ምድርም ዋጠቻቸው።

verses.en: Thou in thy mercy hast led forth the people which thou hast redeemed: thou hast guided them in thy strength unto thy holy habitation.
verses.fr: Par ta miséricorde tu as conduit, Tu as délivré ce peuple; Par ta puissance tu le diriges Vers la demeure de ta sainteté.
verses.am: በቸርነትህ የተቤዠሃቸውን ሕዝብህን መራህ፤  በኃይልህ ወደ ቅዱስ ማደሪያህ አገባሃቸው።

verses.en: The people shall hear, and be afraid: sorrow shall take hold on the inhabitants of Palestina.
verses.fr: Les peuples l''apprennent, et ils tremblent: La terreur s''empare des Philistins;
verses.am: አሕዛብ ሰሙ፥ ተንቀጠቀጡም፤  በፍልስጥኤም የሚኖሩትን ምጥ ያዛቸው።

verses.en: Then the dukes of Edom shall be amazed; the mighty men of Moab, trembling shall take hold upon them; all the inhabitants of Canaan shall melt away.
