verses.fr: Les chefs d''Edom s''épouvantent; Un tremblement saisit les guerriers de Moab; Tous les habitants de Canaan tombent en défaillance.
verses.am: የዚያን ጊዜ የኤዶም አለቆች ደነገጡ፤ የሞአብን ኃያላን መንቀጥቀጥ ያዛቸው፤ በከነዓን የሚኖሩ ሁሉ ቀለጡ።

verses.en: Fear and dread shall fall upon them; by the greatness of thine arm they shall be as still as a stone; till thy people pass over, O Lord, till the people pass over, which thou hast purchased.
verses.fr: La crainte et la frayeur les surprendront; Par la grandeur de ton bras Ils deviendront muets comme une pierre, Jusqu''à ce que ton peuple soit passé, ô Eternel! Jusqu''à ce qu''il soit passé, Le peuple que tu as acquis.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ሕዝብህ እስኪያልፍ ድረስ፥ የተቤዠኸው ሕዝብ እስኪያልፍ ድረስ፥ ፍርሃትና ድንጋጤ ወደቀባቸው፤ በክንድህ ብርታት እንደ ድንጋይ ዝም አሉ።

verses.en: Thou shalt bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of thine inheritance, in the place, O Lord, which thou hast made for thee to dwell in, in the Sanctuary, O Lord, which thy hands have established.
verses.fr: Tu les amèneras et tu les établiras sur la montagne de ton héritage, Au lieu que tu as préparé pour ta demeure, ô Eternel! Au sanctuaire, Seigneur! que tes mains ont fondé.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ታስገባቸዋለህ፥ በርስትህ ተራራም ትተክላቸዋለህ፥ አቤቱ፥ ለማደሪያህ ባደረግኸው ስፍራ፥ አቤቱ፥ እጆችህ ባዘጋጁት መቅደስ።

verses.en: The Lord shall reign for ever and ever.
verses.fr: L''Eternel régnera éternellement et à toujours.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለዘላለሙ እስከ ፍጻሜ ይነግሣል።

verses.en: For the horse of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea, and the Lord brought again the waters of the sea upon them; but the children of Israel went on dry land in the midst of the sea.
verses.fr: Car les chevaux de Pharaon, ses chars et ses cavaliers sont entrés dans la mer, Et l''Eternel a ramené sur eux les eaux de la mer; Mais les enfants d''Israël ont marché à sec au milieu de la mer.
verses.am: የፈርዖን ፈረሶች ከሰረገሎቹ ከፈረሰኞቹም ጋር ወደ ባሕር ገቡ፥ እግዚአብሔርም የባሕሩን ውኆች መለሰባቸው፤ የእስራኤል ልጆች ግን በባሕሩ መካከል በየብስ ሄዱ።

verses.en: And Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a timbrel in her hand; and all the women went out after her with timbrels and with dances.
verses.fr: Marie, la prophétesse, soeur d''Aaron, prit à sa main un tambourin, et toutes les femmes vinrent après elle, avec des tambourins et en dansant.
verses.am: የአሮን እኅት ነቢይቱ ማሪያምም ከበሮ በእጅዋ ወሰደች፤ ሴቶችም ሁሉ በከበሮና በዘፈን በኋላዋ ወጡ።

verses.en: And Miriam answered them, Sing ye to the Lord, for he hath triumphed gloriously; the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.
verses.fr: Marie répondait aux enfants d''Israël: Chantez à l''Eternel, car il a fait éclater sa gloire; Il a précipité dans la mer le cheval et son cavalier.
verses.am: ማርያምም እየዘመረች መለሰችላቸው። በክብር ከፍ ከፍ ብሎአልና ለእግዚአብሔር ዘምሩ፤ ፈረሱንና ፈረሰኛውን በባሕር ጣለ።

verses.en: So Moses brought Israel from the Red sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water.
verses.fr: Moïse fit partir Israël de la mer Rouge. Ils prirent la direction du désert de Schur; et, après trois journées de marche dans le désert, ils ne trouvèrent point d''eau.
verses.am: ሙሴም እስራኤልን ከኤርትራ ባሕር አስጓዘ፥ ወደ ሱርም ምድረ በዳ ወጡ፤ በምድረ በዳም ሦስት ቀን ሄዱ፥ ውኃም አላገኙም።

verses.en: And when they came to Marah, they could not drink of the waters of Marah, for they were bitter: therefore the name of it was called Marah.
verses.fr: Ils arrivèrent à Mara; mais ils ne purent pas boire l''eau de Mara parce qu''elle était amère. C''est pourquoi ce lieu fut appelé Mara.
verses.am: ወደ ማራም በመጡ ጊዜ የማራ ውኃ መራራ ነበረና ሊጠጡ አልቻሉም፤ ስለዚህ የዚያ ስፍራ ስም ማራ ተብሎ ተጠራ።

verses.en: And the people murmured against Moses, saying, What shall we drink?
verses.fr: Le peuple murmura contre Moïse, en disant: Que boirons-nous?
verses.am: ሕዝቡም። ምን እንጠጣለን? ብለው በሙሴ ላይ አንጐራጐሩ።

verses.en: And he cried unto the Lord; and the Lord shewed him a tree, which when he had cast into the waters, the waters were made sweet: there he made for them a statute and an ordinance, and there he proved them,
verses.fr: Moïse cria à l''Eternel; et l''Eternel lui indiqua un bois, qu''il jeta dans l''eau. Et l''eau devint douce. Ce fut là que l''Eternel donna au peuple des lois et des ordonnances, et ce fut là qu''il le mit à l''épreuve.
verses.am: ሙሴም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኸ፤ እግዚአብሔርም እንጨትን አሳየው፥ በውኃውም ላይ ጣለው፥ ውኃውም ጣፈጠ። በዚያም ሥርዓትንና ፍርድን አደረገላቸው፥ በዚያም ፈተናቸው፤

verses.en: And said, If thou wilt diligently hearken to the voice of the Lord thy God, and wilt do that which is right in his sight, and wilt give ear to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of these diseases upon thee, which I have brought upon the Egyptians: for I am the Lord that healeth thee.
verses.fr: Il dit: Si tu écoutes attentivement la voix de l''Eternel, ton Dieu, si tu fais ce qui est droit à ses yeux, si tu prêtes l''oreille à ses commandements, et si tu observes toutes ses lois, je ne te frapperai d''aucune des maladies dont j''ai frappé les Egyptiens; car je suis l''Eternel, qui te guérit.
verses.am: እርሱም። አንተ የአምላክህን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል አጥብቀህ ብትሰማ፥ በፊቱም የሚበጀውን ብታደርግ፥ ትእዛዙንም ብታደምጥ፥ ሥርዓቱንም ሁሉ ብትጠብቅ፥ በግብፃውያን ላይ ያመጣሁትን በሽታ አላደርስብህም፤ እኔ ፈዋሽህ እግዚአብሔር ነኝና አለ።

verses.en: And they came to Elim, where were twelve wells of water, and threescore and ten palm trees: and they encamped there by the waters.
verses.fr: Ils arrivèrent à Elim, où il y avait douze sources d''eau et soixante-dix palmiers. Ils campèrent là, près de l''eau.
verses.am: እነርሱም ወደ ኤሊም መጡ፥ በዚያም አሥራ ሁለት የውኃ ምንጮችና ሰባ የዘንባባ ዛፎች ነበሩባት፤ በዚያም በውኃው አጠገብ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they took their journey from Elim, and all the congregation of the children of Israel came unto the wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departing out of the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: Toute l''assemblée des enfants d''Israël partit d''Elim, et ils arrivèrent au désert de Sin, qui est entre Elim et Sinaï, le quinzième jour du second mois après leur sortie du pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: ከኤሊምም ተጓዙ፥ የእስራኤልም ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ ከግብፅ አገር ከወጡ በኋላ በሁለተኛው ወር ከወሩም በአሥራ አምስተኛው ቀን በኤሊምና በሲና መካከል ወዳለችው ወደ ሲን ምድረ በዳ መጡ።

verses.en: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness:
verses.fr: Et toute l''assemblée des enfants d''Israël murmura dans le désert contre Moïse et Aaron.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ በምድረ በዳ በሙሴና በአሮን ላይ አንጐራጐሩ።

verses.en: And the children of Israel said unto them, Would to God we had died by the hand of the Lord in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the flesh pots, and when we did eat bread to the full; for ye have brought us forth into this wilderness, to kill this whole assembly with hunger.
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël leur dirent: Que ne sommes-nous morts par la main de l''Eternel dans le pays d''Egypte, quand nous étions assis près des pots de viande, quand nous mangions du pain à satiété? car vous nous avez menés dans ce désert pour faire mourir de faim toute cette multitude.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች። ይህን ጉባኤ ሁሉ በራብ ልትገድሉ እኛን ወደዚች ምድረ በዳ አውጥታችኋል፤ በሥጋው ምንቸት አጠገብ ተቀምጠን እንጀራ ስንበላ ስንጠግብ ሳለን በግብፅ ምድር በእግዚአብሔር እጅ ምነው በሞትን! አሉአቸው።

verses.en: Then said the Lord unto Moses, Behold, I will rain bread from heaven for you; and the people shall go out and gather a certain rate every day, that I may prove them, whether they will walk in my law, or no.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse: Voici, je ferai pleuvoir pour vous du pain, du haut des cieux. Le peuple sortira, et en ramassera, jour par jour, la quantité nécessaire, afin que je le mette à l''épreuve, et que je voie s''il marchera, ou non, selon ma loi.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። በሕጌ ይሄዱ ወይም አይሄዱ እንደሆነ እኔ እንድፈትናቸው፥ እነሆ ከሰማይ እንጀራን አዘንብላችኋለሁ፤ ሕዝቡም ወጥተው ለዕለት ለዕለት የሚበቃቸውን ይልቀሙ።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that on the sixth day they shall prepare that which they bring in; and it shall be twice as much as they gather daily.
verses.fr: Le sixième jour, lorsqu''ils prépareront ce qu''ils auront apporté, il s''en trouvera le double de ce qu''ils ramasseront jour par jour.
verses.am: እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ በስድስተኛው ቀን ያመጡትን ያዘጋጁ፥ ዕለት ዕለትም ከሚለቅሙት ይልቅ ሁለት እጥፍ ይሁን አለው።

verses.en: And Moses and Aaron said unto all the children of Israel, At even, then ye shall know that the Lord hath brought you out from the land of Egypt:
verses.fr: Moïse et Aaron dirent à tous les enfants d''Israël: Ce soir, vous comprendrez que c''est l''Eternel qui vous a fait sortir du pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: ሙሴና አሮንም ለእስራኤል ልጆች ሁሉ። እግዚአብሔር ከግብፅ ምድር እንዳወጣችሁ ማታ ታውቃላችሁ፥

verses.en: And in the morning, then ye shall see the glory of the Lord; for that he heareth your murmurings against the Lord: and what are we, that ye murmur against us?
verses.fr: Et, au matin, vous verrez la gloire de l''Eternel, parce qu''il a entendu vos murmures contre l''Eternel; car que sommes-nous, pour que vous murmuriez contre nous?
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርንም ክብር ጥዋት ታያላችሁ፤ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ያንጐራጐራችሁትን ሰምቶአልና በእኛም ላይ የምታንጐራጕሩ እኛ ምንድር ነን? አሉ።

verses.en: And Moses said, This shall be, when the Lord shall give you in the evening flesh to eat, and in the morning bread to the full; for that the Lord heareth your murmurings which ye murmur against him: and what are we? your murmurings are not against us, but against the Lord.
verses.fr: Moïse dit: L''Eternel vous donnera ce soir de la viande à manger, et au matin du pain à satiété, parce que l''Eternel a entendu les murmures que vous avez proférés contre lui; car que sommes-nous? Ce n''est pas contre nous que sont vos murmures, c''est contre l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሙሴም። እግዚአብሔር ያንጐራጐራችሁበትን ማንጐራጐራችሁን ሰምቶአልና በመሸ ጊዜ ትበሉ ዘንድ ሥጋን፥ ማልዶም ትጠግቡ ዘንድ እንጀራን እግዚአብሔር ይሰጣችኋል፤ እኛም ምንድር ነን? ማንጐራጐራችሁ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ነው እንጂ በእኛ አይደለም አለ።

verses.en: And Moses spake unto Aaron, Say unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, Come near before the Lord: for he hath heard your murmurings.
verses.fr: Moïse dit à Aaron: Dis à toute l''assemblée des enfants d''Israël: Approchez-vous devant l''Eternel, car il a entendu vos murmures.
verses.am: ሙሴም አሮንን። ለእስራኤል ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ። ማንጐራጐራችሁን ሰምቶአልና ወደ እግዚአብሔር ፊት ቅረቡ በል አለው።

verses.en: And it came to pass, as Aaron spake unto the whole congregation of the children of Israel, that they looked toward the wilderness, and, behold, the glory of the Lord appeared in the cloud.
verses.fr: Et tandis qu''Aaron parlait à toute l''assemblée des enfants d''Israël, ils se tournèrent du côté du désert, et voici, la gloire de l''Eternel parut dans la nuée.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ አሮን ለእስራኤል ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ በተናገረ ጊዜ ወደ ምድረ በዳ ፊታቸውን አቀኑ፤ እነሆም የእግዚአብሔር ክብር በደመናው ታየ።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel, s''adressant à Moïse, dit:
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በመሸ ጊዜ ድርጭቶች መጡ፥ ሰፈሩንም ከደኑት፤ ማለዳም በሰፈሩ ዙሪያ ጠል ወድቆ ነበር።

verses.en: I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel: speak unto them, saying, At even ye shall eat flesh, and in the morning ye shall be filled with bread; and ye shall know that I am the Lord your God.
verses.fr: J''ai entendu les murmures des enfants d''Israël. Dis-leur: Entre les deux soirs vous mangerez de la viande, et au matin vous vous rassasierez de pain; et vous saurez que je suis l''Eternel, votre Dieu.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በመሸ ጊዜ ድርጭቶች መጡ፥ ሰፈሩንም ከደኑት፤ ማለዳም በሰፈሩ ዙሪያ ጠል ወድቆ ነበር።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that at even the quails came up, and covered the camp: and in the morning the dew lay round about the host.
verses.fr: Le soir, il survint des cailles qui couvrirent le camp; et, au matin, il y eut une couche de rosée autour du camp.
verses.am: የወደቀውም ጠል ባለፈ ጊዜ፥ እነሆ በመሬት ላይ እንደ ደቃቅ ውርጭ ሆኖ ቅርፊት የሚመስል ደቃቅ ነገር በምድረ በዳ ታየ።

verses.en: And when the dew that lay was gone up, behold, upon the face of the wilderness there lay a small round thing, as small as the hoar frost on the ground.
verses.fr: Quand cette rosée fut dissipée, il y avait à la surface du désert quelque chose de menu comme des grains, quelque chose de menu comme la gelée blanche sur la terre.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ባዩት ጊዜ ያ ምን እንደ ሆነ አላወቁምና እርስ በእርሳቸው። ይህ ምንድር ነው? ተባባሉ። ሙሴም። ትበሉት ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር የሰጣችሁ እንጀራ ነው።

verses.en: And when the children of Israel saw it, they said one to another, It is manna: for they wist not what it was. And Moses said unto them, This is the bread which the Lord hath given you to eat.
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël regardèrent et ils se dirent l''un à l''autre: Qu''est-ce que cela? car ils ne savaient pas ce que c''était. Moïse leur dit: C''est le pain que L''Eternel vous donne pour nourriture.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ያዘዘው ነገር ይህ ነው። እያንዳንዱ የሚበላውን ያህል ይልቀም፤ በድኳኑ ባሉት ነፍሶች ቍጥር ለአንድ ሰው አንድ ጎሞር ውሰዱ አላቸው።

verses.en: This is the thing which the Lord hath commanded, Gather of it every man according to his eating, an omer for every man, according to the number of your persons; take ye every man for them which are in his tents.
verses.fr: Voici ce que l''Eternel a ordonné: Que chacun de vous en ramasse ce qu''il faut pour sa nourriture, un omer par tête, suivant le nombre de vos personnes; chacun en prendra pour ceux qui sont dans sa tente.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች እንዲሁ አደረጉ፤ አንዱ አብዝቶ አንዱም አሳንሶ ለቀመ።

verses.en: And the children of Israel did so, and gathered, some more, some less.
verses.fr: Les Israélites firent ainsi; et ils en ramassèrent les uns plus, les autres moins.
verses.am: በጎሞርም በሰፈሩት ጊዜ እጅግ ለለቀመ አልተረፈውም ጥቂትም ለለቀመ አልጐደለበትም፤ ሁሉ እያንዳንዱ የሚበላውን ያህል ለቀመ።

verses.en: And when they did mete it with an omer, he that gathered much had nothing over, and he that gathered little had no lack; they gathered every man according to his eating.
verses.fr: On mesurait ensuite avec l''omer; celui qui avait ramassé plus n''avait rien de trop, et celui qui avait ramassé moins n''en manquait pas. Chacun ramassait ce qu''il fallait pour sa nourriture.
verses.am: ሙሴም። ማንም ከእርሱ አንዳች ለነገ አያስቀር አላቸው።

verses.en: And Moses said, Let no man leave of it till the morning.
verses.fr: Moïse leur dit: Que personne n''en laisse jusqu''au matin.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ሙሴን አልሰሙትም፤ አንዳንድ ሰዎችም ከእርሱ ለነገ አስቀሩ፥ እርሱም ተላ ሸተተም፤ ሙሴም ተቈጣቸው።

verses.en: Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto Moses; but some of them left of it until the morning, and it bred worms, and stank: and Moses was wroth with them.
verses.fr: Ils n''écoutèrent pas Moïse, et il y eut des gens qui en laissèrent jusqu''au matin; mais il s''y mit des vers, et cela devint infect. Moïse fut irrité contre ces gens.
verses.am: ሰውም ሁሉ ዕለት ዕለት የሚበላውን ያህል በጥዋት ለቀመ፤ ፀሐይም በተኰሰ ጊዜ ቀለጠ።

verses.en: And they gathered it every morning, every man according to his eating: and when the sun waxed hot, it melted.
verses.fr: Tous les matins, chacun ramassait ce qu''il fallait pour sa nourriture; et quand venait la chaleur du soleil, cela fondait.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በስድስተኛው ቀን ሁለት እጥፍ አድርገው እያንዳንዳቸው ሁለት ጎሞር እንጀራ ለቀሙ፤ የማኀበሩም አለቆች ሁሉ መጥተው ለሙሴ ነገሩት።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that on the sixth day they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for one man: and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses.
verses.fr: Le sixième jour, ils ramassèrent une quantité double de nourriture, deux omers pour chacun. Tous les principaux de l''assemblée vinrent le rapporter à Moïse.
verses.am: እርሱም። እግዚአብሔር የተናገረው ይህ ነው። ነገ ዕረፍት፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም የተቀደሰ ሰንበት ነው፤ የምትጋግሩትን ጋግሩ፥ የምትቀቅሉትንም ቀቅሉ፥ የተረፈውን ሁሉ ለነገ እንዲጠበቅ አኑሩት አላቸው።

verses.en: And he said unto them, This is that which the Lord hath said, To morrow is the rest of the holy sabbath unto the Lord: bake that which ye will bake to day, and seethe that ye will seethe; and that which remaineth over lay up for you to be kept until the morning.
verses.fr: Et Moïse leur dit: C''est ce que l''Eternel a ordonné. Demain est le jour du repos, le sabbat consacré à l''Eternel; faites cuire ce que vous avez à faire cuire, faites bouillir ce que vous avez à faire bouillir, et mettez en réserve jusqu''au matin tout ce qui restera.
verses.am: ሙሴም እንዳዘዘ ለነገ አኖሩት፤ አልሸተተም፥ ትልም አልሆነበትም።

verses.en: And they laid it up till the morning, as Moses bade: and it did not stink, neither was there any worm therein.
verses.fr: Ils le laissèrent jusqu''au matin, comme Moïse l''avait ordonné; et cela ne devint point infect, et il ne s''y mit point de vers.
verses.am: ሙሴም። የእግዚአብሔር ሰንበት ዛሬ ነውና ብሉት፤ ዛሬ በሜዳ አታገኙትም።

verses.en: And Moses said, Eat that to day; for to day is a sabbath unto the Lord: to day ye shall not find it in the field.
verses.fr: Moïse dit: Mangez-le aujourd''hui, car c''est le jour du sabbat; aujourd''hui vous n''en trouverez point dans la campagne.
verses.am: ስድስት ቀን ልቀሙት፤ ሰባተኛው ቀን ግን ሰንበት ነው፤ በእርሱ አይገኝም አለ።

verses.en: Six days ye shall gather it; but on the seventh day, which is the sabbath, in it there shall be none.
verses.fr: Pendant six jours vous en ramasserez; mais le septième jour, qui est le sabbat, il n''y en aura point.
verses.am: በሰባተኛውም ቀን እንዲህ ሆነ፤ ከሕዝቡ አንዳንድ ሰዎች ሊለቅሙ ወጡ፥ ምንምን አላገኙም።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that there went out some of the people on the seventh day for to gather, and they found none.
verses.fr: Le septième jour, quelques-uns du peuple sortirent pour en ramasser, et ils n''en trouvèrent point.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። ትእዛዞቼንና ሕጎቼን ለመጠበቅ እስከ መቼ እንቢ ትላላችሁ?

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, How long refuse ye to keep my commandments and my laws?
verses.fr: Alors l''Eternel dit à Moïse: Jusques à quand refuserez-vous d''observer mes commandements et mes lois?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ሰንበትን እንደ ሰጣችሁ እዩ፤ ስለዚህ በስድስተኛው ቀን የሁለት ቀን እንጀራ ሰጣችሁ፤ ሰው ሁሉ በስፍራው ይቀመጥ፥ በሰባተኛው ቀን ማንም ከስፍራው አይሂድ አለው።

verses.en: See, for that the Lord hath given you the sabbath, therefore he giveth you on the sixth day the bread of two days; abide ye every man in his place, let no man go out of his place on the seventh day.
verses.fr: Considérez que l''Eternel vous a donné le sabbat; c''est pourquoi il vous donne au sixième jour de la nourriture pour deux jours. Que chacun reste à sa place, et que personne ne sorte du lieu où il est au septième jour.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም በሰባተኛው ቀን ዐረፈ።

verses.en: So the people rested on the seventh day.
verses.fr: Et le peuple se reposa le septième jour.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ወገን ስሙን መና ብለው ጠሩት፤ እርሱም እንደ ድንብላል ዘር ነጭ ነው፤ ጣዕሙም እንደ ማር ቂጣ ነው።

verses.en: And the house of Israel called the name thereof Manna: and it was like coriander seed, white; and the taste of it was like wafers made with honey.
verses.fr: La maison d''Israël donna à cette nourriture le nom de manne. Elle ressemblait à de la graine de coriandre; elle était blanche, et avait le goût d''un gâteau au miel.
verses.am: ሙሴም። እግዚአብሔር ያዘዘው ነገር ይህ ነው። ከግብፅ ምድር ባወጣኋችሁ ጊዜ በምድረ በዳ ያበላኋችሁን እንጀራ ያዩ ዘንድ ከእርሱ አንድ ጎሞር ሙሉ ለልጅ ልጆቻችሁ ይጠበቅ አለ።

verses.en: And Moses said, This is the thing which the Lord commandeth, Fill an omer of it to be kept for your generations; that they may see the bread wherewith I have fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you forth from the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: Moïse dit: Voici ce que l''Eternel a ordonné: Qu''un omer rempli de manne soit conservé pour vos descendants, afin qu''ils voient le pain que je vous ai fait manger dans le désert, après vous avoir fait sortir du pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: ሙሴም አሮንን። አንድ ማድጋ ወስደህ ጎሞር ሙሉ መና አግባበት፥ ለልጅ ልጃችሁም ይጠበቅ ዘንድ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት አኑረው አለው።

verses.en: And Moses said unto Aaron, Take a pot, and put an omer full of manna therein, and lay it up before the Lord, to be kept for your generations.
verses.fr: Et Moïse dit à Aaron: Prends un vase, mets-y de la manne plein un omer, et dépose-le devant l''Eternel, afin qu''il soit conservé pour vos descendants.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው እንዲሁ ይጠበቅ ዘንድ አሮን በምስክሩ ፊት አኖረው።

verses.en: As the Lord commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.
verses.fr: Suivant l''ordre donné par l''Eternel à Moïse, Aaron le déposa devant le témoignage, afin qu''il fût conservé.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ወደሚኖሩባት ምድር እስኪመጡ ድረስ አርባ ዓመት መና በሉ፤ ወደ ከነዓን ምድር ድንበር እስኪመጡ ድረስ መና በሉ።

verses.en: And the children of Israel did eat manna forty years, until they came to a land inhabited; they did eat manna, until they came unto the borders of the land of Canaan.
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël mangèrent la manne pendant quarante ans, jusqu''à leur arrivée dans un pays habité; ils mangèrent la manne jusqu''à leur arrivée aux frontières du pays de Canaan.
verses.am: ጎሞርም የኢፍ መስፈሪያ አሥረኛ ክፍል ነው።

verses.en: Now an omer is the tenth part of an ephah.
verses.fr: L''omer est la dixième partie de l''épha.
verses.am: ፤ ጎሞርም የኢፍ መስፈሪያ አሥረኛ ክፍል ነው።

verses.en: And all the congregation of the children of Israel journeyed from the wilderness of Sin, after their journeys, according to the commandment of the Lord, and pitched in Rephidim: and there was no water for the people to drink.
verses.fr: Toute l''assemblée des enfants d''Israël partit du désert de Sin, selon les marches que l''Eternel leur avait ordonnées; et ils campèrent à Rephidim, où le peuple ne trouva point d''eau à boire.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዘ ከሲን ምድረ በዳ ሊጓዙ ተነሡ፥ በራፊዲምም ሰፈሩ፤ ሕዝቡም ይጠጡ ዘንድ ውኃ አልነበረም።

verses.en: Wherefore the people did chide with Moses, and said, Give us water that we may drink. And Moses said unto them, Why chide ye with me? wherefore do ye tempt the Lord?
verses.fr: Alors le peuple chercha querelle à Moïse. Ils dirent: Donnez-nous de l''eau à boire. Moïse leur répondit: Pourquoi me cherchez-vous querelle? Pourquoi tentez-vous l''Eternel?
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ሙሴን ተጣሉት። የምንጠጣውን ውኃ ስጠን አሉት። ሙሴም። ለምን ትጣሉኛላችሁ? እግዚአብሔርንስ ለምን ትፈታተናላችሁ? አላቸው።

verses.en: And the people thirsted there for water; and the people murmured against Moses, and said, Wherefore is this that thou hast brought us up out of Egypt, to kill us and our children and our cattle with thirst?
verses.fr: Le peuple était là, pressé par la soif, et murmurait contre Moïse. Il disait: Pourquoi nous as-tu fait monter hors d''Egypte, pour me faire mourir de soif avec mes enfants et mes troupeaux?
verses.am: ሕዝቡም በዚያ ስፍራ ውኃ ተጠሙ። እኛንና ልጆቻችንን ከብቶቻችንንም በጥማት ልትገድል ለምን ከግብፅ አወጣኸን? ሲሉ በሙሴ ላይ አንጐራጐሩ።

verses.en: And Moses cried unto the Lord, saying, What shall I do unto this people? they be almost ready to stone me.
verses.fr: Moïse cria à l''Eternel, en disant: Que ferai-je à ce peuple? Encore un peu, et ils me lapideront.
verses.am: ሙሴም። ሊወግሩኝ ቀርበዋልና በዚህ ሕዝብ ምን ላድርግ? ብሎ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኸ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Go on before the people, and take with thee of the elders of Israel; and thy rod, wherewith thou smotest the river, take in thine hand, and go.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse: Passe devant le peuple, et prends avec toi des anciens d''Israël; prends aussi dans ta main ta verge avec laquelle tu as frappé le fleuve, et marche!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። በሕዝቡ ፊት እለፍ፥ ከእስራኤልም ሽማግሌዎች ከአንተ ጋር ውሰድ፤ ወንዙንም የመታህባትን በትር በእጅህ ይዘሃት ሂድ።

verses.en: Behold, I will stand before thee there upon the rock in Horeb; and thou shalt smite the rock, and there shall come water out of it, that the people may drink. And Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel.
verses.fr: Voici, je me tiendrai devant toi sur le rocher d''Horeb; tu frapperas le rocher, et il en sortira de l''eau, et le peuple boira. Et Moïse fit ainsi, aux yeux des anciens d''Israël.
verses.am: እነሆ እኔ በዚያ በኮሬብ በዓለት ላይ በፊትህ እቆማለሁ፤ ዓለቱንም ትመታለህ፥ ሕዝቡም ይጠጣ ዘንድ ከእርሱ ውኃ ይወጣል አለው። ሙሴም በእስራኤል ሽማግሌዎች ፊት እንዲሁ አደረገ።

verses.en: And he called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because of the chiding of the children of Israel, and because they tempted the Lord, saying, Is the Lord among us, or not?
verses.fr: Il donna à ce lieu le nom de Massa et Meriba, parce que les enfants d''Israël avaient contesté, et parce qu''ils avaient tenté l''Eternel, en disant: L''Eternel est-il au milieu de nous, ou n''y est-il pas?
verses.am: ስለ እስራኤልም ልጆች ክርክር። እግዚአብሔር በመካከላችን ነውን ወይስ አይደለም? ሲሉ እግዚአብሔርን ስለተፈታተኑት የዚያን ስፍራ ስም ማሳህ፥ ደግሞም መሪባ ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.en: Then came Amalek, and fought with Israel in Rephidim.
verses.fr: Amalek vint combattre Israël à Rephidim.
verses.am: አማሌቅም መጥቶ ከእስራኤል ጋር በራፊድም ተዋጋ።

verses.en: And Moses said unto Joshua, Choose us out men, and go out, fight with Amalek: to morrow I will stand on the top of the hill with the rod of God in mine hand.
verses.fr: Alors Moïse dit à Josué: Choisis-nous des hommes, sors, et combats Amalek; demain je me tiendrai sur le sommet de la colline, la verge de Dieu dans ma main.
verses.am: ሙሴም ኢያሱን። ጕልማሶችን ምረጥልን፥ ወጥተህም ከአማሌቅ ጋር ተዋጋ፤ እኔ ነገ የእግዚአብሔርን በትር በእጄ ይዤ በኮረብታው ራስ ላይ እቆማለሁ አለው።

verses.en: So Joshua did as Moses had said to him, and fought with Amalek: and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.
verses.fr: Josué fit ce que lui avait dit Moïse, pour combattre Amalek. Et Moïse, Aaron et Hur montèrent au sommet de la colline.
verses.am: ኢያሱም ሙሴ እንዳለው አደረገ፥ ከአማሌቅም ጋር ተዋጋ፤ ሙሴና አሮንም ሖርም ወደ ኮረብታው ራስ ወጡ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Moses held up his hand, that Israel prevailed: and when he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.
verses.fr: Lorsque Moïse élevait sa main, Israël était le plus fort; et lorsqu''il baissait sa main, Amalek était le plus fort.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ሙሴ እጁን ባነሣ ጊዜ እስራኤል ድል ያደርግ ነበር፤ እጁንም ባወረደ ጊዜ አማሌቅ ድል ያደርግ ነበር።

verses.en: But Moses hands were heavy; and they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat thereon; and Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side; and his hands were steady until the going down of the sun.
verses.fr: Les mains de Moïse étant fatiguées, ils prirent une pierre qu''ils placèrent sous lui, et il s''assit dessus. Aaron et Hur soutenaient ses mains, l''un d''un côté, l''autre de l''autre; et ses mains restèrent fermes jusqu''au coucher du soleil.
verses.am: የሙሴ እጆች ግን ከብደው ነበር፤ ድንጋይም ወሰዱ፥ በበታቹም አኖሩ፥ እርሱም ተቀመጠበት፤ አሮንና ሖርም አንዱ በዚህ አንዱ በዚያ ሆነው እጆቹን ይደግፉ ነበር፤ ፀሐይም እስክትገባ ድረስ እጆቹ ጠነከሩ።

verses.en: And Joshua discomfited Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.
verses.fr: Et Josué vainquit Amalek et son peuple, au tranchant de l''épée.
verses.am: ኢያሱም አማሌቅንና ሕዝቡን በሰይፍ ስለት አሸነፈ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Write this for a memorial in a book, and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua: for I will utterly put out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse: Ecris cela dans le livre, pour que le souvenir s''en conserve, et déclare à Josué que j''effacerai la mémoire d''Amalek de dessous les cieux.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። የአማሌቅን ዝክር ከሰማይ በታች ጨርሼ እደመስሳለሁና ይህን ለመታሰቢያ በመጽሐፍ ጻፈው፥ በኢያሱም ጆሮ ተናገር አለው።

verses.en: And Moses built an altar, and called the name of it Jehovahnissi:
verses.fr: Moïse bâtit un autel, et lui donna pour nom: l''Eternel ma bannière.
verses.am: ሙሴም መሠዊያ ሠራ፥ ስሙንም ይህዌህ ንሲ ብሎ ጠራው፤

verses.en: For he said, Because the Lord hath sworn that the Lord will have war with Amalek from generation to generation.
verses.fr: Il dit: Parce que la main a été levée sur le trône de l''Eternel, il y aura guerre de l''Eternel contre Amalek, de génération en génération.
verses.am: እርሱም። እጁን በእግዚአብሔር ዙፋን ላይ ስለጫነ የእግዚአብሔር ሰልፍ በአማሌቅ ላይ ለልጅ ልጅ ይሁን አለ።

verses.en: When Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses' father in law, heard of all that God had done for Moses, and for Israel his people, and that the Lord had brought Israel out of Egypt;
verses.fr: Jéthro, sacrificateur de Madian, beau-père de Moïse, apprit tout ce que Dieu avait fait en faveur de Moïse et d''Israël, son peuple; il apprit que l''Eternel avait fait sortir Israël d''Egypte.
verses.am: የምድያምም ካህን የሙሴ አማት ዮቶር እግዚአብሔር ለሙሴና ለሕዝቡ ለእስራኤል ያደረገውን ሁሉ፥ እግዚአብሔርም እስራኤልን ከግብፅ እንዳወጣ ሰማ።

verses.en: Then Jethro, Moses' father in law, took Zipporah, Moses' wife, after he had sent her back,
verses.fr: Jéthro, beau-père de Moïse, prit Séphora, femme de Moïse, qui avait été renvoyée.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ የሙሴ አማት ዮቶር መልሶአት የነበረውን የሙሴን ሚስት ሲፓራን ሁለቱንም ልጆቿን ወሰደ።

verses.en: And her two sons; of which the name of the one was Gershom; for he said, I have been an alien in a strange land:
verses.fr: Il prit aussi les deux fils de Séphora; l''un se nommait Guerschom, car Moïse avait dit: J''habite un pays étranger;
verses.am: ከእነርሱ የአንደኛው ስም ጌርሳም ነበረ፤ አባቱ። በሌላ አገር ስደተኛ ነበርሁ ብሎአልና፤

verses.en: And the name of the other was Eliezer; for the God of my father, said he, was mine help, and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh:
verses.fr: l''autre se nommait Eliézer, car il avait dit: Le Dieu de mon père m''a secouru, et il m''a délivré de l''épée de Pharaon.
verses.am: የሁለተኛውም ስም አልዓዛር ነበረ። የአባቴ አምላክ ረዳኝ፥ ከፈርዖንም ሰይፍ አዳነኝ ብሎአልና።

verses.en: And Jethro, Moses' father in law, came with his sons and his wife unto Moses into the wilderness, where he encamped at the mount of God:
verses.fr: Jéthro, beau-père de Moïse, avec les fils et la femme de Moïse, vint au désert où il campait, à la montagne de Dieu.
verses.am: የሙሴ አማት ዮቶርም ከልጆቹና ከሚስቱ ጋር በእግዚአብሔር ተራራ አጠገብ በምድረ በዳ ወደ ሰፈረ ወደ ሙሴ መጣ።

verses.en: And he said unto Moses, I thy father in law Jethro am come unto thee, and thy wife, and her two sons with her.
verses.fr: Il fit dire à Moïse: Moi, ton beau-père Jéthro, je viens vers toi, avec ta femme et ses deux fils.
verses.am: ሙሴንም። እኔ አማትህ ዮቶር፥ ሚስትህም፥ ከእርስዋም ጋር ሁለቱ ልጆችዋ መጥተንልሃል አለው።

verses.en: And Moses went out to meet his father in law, and did obeisance, and kissed him; and they asked each other of their welfare; and they came into the tent.
verses.fr: Moïse sortit au-devant de son beau-père, il se prosterna, et il le baisa. Ils s''informèrent réciproquement de leur santé, et ils entrèrent dans la tente de Moïse.
verses.am: ሙሴም አማቱን ሊገናኝ ወጣ፥ ሰገደም፥ ሳመውም፤ እርስ በርሳቸውም ደኅንነታቸውን ተጠያየቁ፥ ወደ ድንኳኑም ገቡ።

verses.en: And Moses told his father in law all that the Lord had done unto Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel's sake, and all the travail that had come upon them by the way, and how the Lord delivered them.
verses.fr: Moïse raconta à son beau-père tout ce que l''Eternel avait fait à Pharaon et à l''Egypte à cause d''Israël, toutes les souffrances qui leur étaient survenues en chemin, et comment l''Eternel les avait délivrés.
verses.am: ሙሴም እግዚአብሔር በፈርዖንና በግብፃውያን ላይ ስለ እስራኤል ያደረገውን ሁሉ፥ በመንገድም ያገኛቸውን ድካም ሁሉ፥ እግዚአብሔርም እንዳዳናቸው ለአማቱ ነገረው።

verses.en: And Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which the Lord had done to Israel, whom he had delivered out of the hand of the Egyptians.
verses.fr: Jéthro se réjouit de tout le bien que l''Eternel avait fait à Israël, et de ce qu''il l''avait délivré de la main des Egyptiens.
verses.am: ዮቶርም እግዚአብሔር ለእስራኤል ስላደረገው ቸርነት ሁሉ፥ ከግብፃውያንም እጅ ስላዳናቸው ደስ አለው።

verses.en: And Jethro said, Blessed be the Lord, who hath delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of Pharaoh, who hath delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.
verses.fr: Et Jéthro dit: Béni soit l''Eternel, qui vous a délivrés de la main des Egyptiens et de la main de Pharaon; qui a délivré le peuple de la main des Egyptiens!
verses.am: ዮቶርም። ከግብፃውያንና ከፈርዖን እጅ ያዳናችሁ፥ ከግብፃውያንም እጅ ሕዝቡን ያዳነ እግዚአብሔር ይባረክ።

verses.en: Now I know that the Lord is greater than all gods: for in the thing wherein they dealt proudly he was above them.
verses.fr: Je reconnais maintenant que l''Eternel est plus grand que tous les dieux; car la méchanceté des Egyptiens est retombée sur eux.
verses.am: ትዕቢት ባደረጉባቸው ነገር እግዚአብሔር ከአማልክት ሁሉ እንዲበልጥ አሁን አወቅሁ አለ።

verses.en: And Jethro, Moses' father in law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God: and Aaron came, and all the elders of Israel, to eat bread with Moses' father in law before God.
verses.fr: Jéthro, beau-père de Moïse, offrit à Dieu un holocauste et des sacrifices. Aaron et tous les anciens d''Israël vinrent participer au repas avec le beau-père de Moïse, en présence de Dieu.
verses.am: የሙሴ አማት ዮቶርም የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትንና ሌላ መሥዋዕትን ለእግዚአብሔር ወሰደ፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ከሙሴ አማት ጋር እንጀራ ሊበሉ አሮን የእስራኤልም ሽማግሌዎች ሁሉ መጡ።

verses.en: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses sat to judge the people: and the people stood by Moses from the morning unto the evening.
verses.fr: Le lendemain, Moïse s''assit pour juger le peuple, et le peuple se tint devant lui depuis le matin jusqu''au soir.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በነጋው ሙሴ በሕዝቡ ሊፈርድ ተቀመጠ፤ ሕዝቡም በሙሴ ፊት ከጥዋት እስከ ማታ ድረስ ቆመው ነበር።

verses.en: And when Moses' father in law saw all that he did to the people, he said, What is this thing that thou doest to the people? why sittest thou thyself alone, and all the people stand by thee from morning unto even?
verses.fr: Le beau-père de Moïse vit tout ce qu''il faisait pour le peuple, et il dit: Que fais-tu là avec ce peuple? Pourquoi sièges-tu seul, et tout le peuple se tient-il devant toi, depuis le matin jusqu''au soir?
verses.am: የሙሴም አማት በሕዝቡ ያደረገውን ሁሉ ባየ ጊዜ። ይህ በሕዝቡ የምታደርገው ምንድር ነው? ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ከጥዋት ጀምሮ እስከ ማታ ድረስ በዙሪያህ ቆመው ሳሉ አንተ ብቻህን ስለ ምን ተቀምጠሃል? አለው።

verses.en: And Moses said unto his father in law, Because the people come unto me to enquire of God:
verses.fr: Moïse répondit à son beau-père: C''est que le peuple vient à moi pour consulter Dieu.
verses.am: ሙሴም አማቱን። ሕዝቡ እግዚአብሔርን ለመጠየቅ ወደ እኔ ይመጣሉ፤

verses.en: When they have a matter, they come unto me; and I judge between one and another, and I do make them know the statutes of God, and his laws.
verses.fr: Quand ils ont quelque affaire, ils viennent à moi; je prononce entre eux, et je fais connaître les ordonnances de Dieu et ses lois.
verses.am: ነገርም ቢኖራቸው ወደ እኔ ይመጣሉ፥ በዚህና በዚያ ሰውም መካከል እፈርዳለሁ፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ሥርዓትና ሕግ አስታውቃቸዋለሁ አለው።

verses.en: And Moses' father in law said unto him, The thing that thou doest is not good.
verses.fr: Le beau-père de Moïse lui dit: Ce que tu fais n''est pas bien.
verses.am: የሙሴም አማት አለው። አንተ የምታደርገው ይህ ነገር መልካም አይደለም።

verses.en: Thou wilt surely wear away, both thou, and this people that is with thee: for this thing is too heavy for thee; thou art not able to perform it thyself alone.
verses.fr: Tu t''épuiseras toi-même, et tu épuiseras ce peuple qui est avec toi; car la chose est au-dessus de tes forces, tu ne pourras pas y suffire seul.
verses.am: ይህ ነገር ይከብድብሃልና አንተ ከአንተም ጋር ያለው ሕዝብ ትደክማላችሁ፤ አንተ ብቻህን ልታደርገው አትችልም።

verses.en: Hearken now unto my voice, I will give thee counsel, and God shall be with thee: Be thou for the people to God-ward, that thou mayest bring the causes unto God:
verses.fr: Maintenant écoute ma voix; je vais te donner un conseil, et que Dieu soit avec toi! Sois l''interprète du peuple auprès de Dieu, et porte les affaires devant Dieu.
verses.am: አሁንም እመክርሃለሁና ቃሌን ስማ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ከአንተ ጋር ይሆናል፤ አንተ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለሕዝቡ ሁን፥ ነገራቸውንም ወደ እግዚአብሔር አድርስ፤

verses.en: And thou shalt teach them ordinances and laws, and shalt shew them the way wherein they must walk, and the work that they must do.
verses.fr: Enseigne-leur les ordonnances et les lois; et fais-leur connaître le chemin qu''ils doivent suivre, et ce qu''ils doivent faire.
verses.am: ሥርዓቱንም ሕጉንም አስተምራቸው፥ የሚሄዱበትን መንገድ የሚያደርጉትንም ሥራ ሁሉ አሳያቸው።

verses.en: Moreover thou shalt provide out of all the people able men, such as fear God, men of truth, hating covetousness; and place such over them, to be rulers of thousands, and rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens:
verses.fr: Choisis parmi tout le peuple des hommes capables, craignant Dieu, des hommes intègres, ennemis de la cupidité; établis-les sur eux comme chefs de mille, chefs de cent, chefs de cinquante et chefs de dix.
verses.am: አንተም ከሕዝቡ ሁሉ አዋቂዎችን፥ እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈሩትን፥ የታመኑ፥ የግፍንም ረብ የሚጠሉትን ሰዎች ምረጥ፤ ከእነርሱም የሺህ አለቆችን፥ የመቶ አለቆችን፥ የአምሳ አለቆችን፥ የአሥርም አለቆችን ሹምላቸው።

verses.en: And let them judge the people at all seasons: and it shall be, that every great matter they shall bring unto thee, but every small matter they shall judge: so shall it be easier for thyself, and they shall bear the burden with thee.
verses.fr: Qu''ils jugent le peuple en tout temps; qu''ils portent devant toi toutes les affaires importantes, et qu''ils prononcent eux-mêmes sur les petites causes. Allège ta charge, et qu''ils la portent avec toi.
verses.am: በሕዝቡ ላይ ሁልጊዜ ይፍረዱ፤ አውራውን ነገር ሁሉ ወደ አንተ ያምጡት፥ ታናሹንም ነገር ሁሉ እነርሱ ይፍረዱ፤ እነርሱም ከአንተ ጋር ሸክሙን ይሸከማሉ፥ ለአንተም ይቀልልልሃል።

verses.en: If thou shalt do this thing, and God command thee so, then thou shalt be able to endure, and all this people shall also go to their place in peace.
verses.fr: Si tu fais cela, et que Dieu te donne des ordres, tu pourras y suffire, et tout ce peuple parviendra heureusement à sa destination.
verses.am: ይህንም ብታደርግ፥ እግዚአብሔር እንዲሁ ቢያዝዝህ፥ መቆም ይቻልሃል፥ ደግሞም ይህ ሕዝብ ሁሉ በሰላም ወደ ስፍራው ይደርሳል።

verses.en: So Moses hearkened to the voice of his father in law, and did all that he had said.
verses.fr: Moïse écouta la voix de son beau-père, et fit tout ce qu''il avait dit.
verses.am: ሙሴም የአማቱን ቃል ሰማ፥ ያለውንም ሁሉ አደረገ።

verses.en: And Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.
verses.fr: Moïse choisit des hommes capables parmi tout Israël, et il les établit chefs du peuple, chefs de mille, chefs de cent, chefs de cinquante et chefs de dix.
verses.am: ሙሴም ከእስራኤል ሁሉ አዋቂዎችን መረጠ፥ በሕዝቡም ላይ የሺህ አለቆች፥ የመቶም አለቆች፥ የአምሳም አለቆች፥ የአሥርም አለቆች አድርጎ ሾማቸው።

verses.en: And they judged the people at all seasons: the hard causes they brought unto Moses, but every small matter they judged themselves.
verses.fr: Ils jugeaient le peuple en tout temps; ils portaient devant Moïse les affaires difficiles, et ils prononçaient eux-mêmes sur toutes les petites causes.
verses.am: በሕዝቡም ላይ ሁልጊዜ ፈረዱ፤ የከበደባቸውንም ነገር ወደ ሙሴ አመጡ፥ ታናሹን ነገር ሁሉ ግን እነርሱ ፈረዱ።

verses.en: And Moses let his father in law depart; and he went his way into his own land.
verses.fr: Moïse laissa partir son beau-père, et Jéthro s''en alla dans son pays.
verses.am: ሙሴም አማቱን ሰደደው፤ እርሱም ወደ አገሩ ተመለሰ።

verses.en: In the third month, when the children of Israel were gone forth out of the land of Egypt, the same day came they into the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.fr: Le troisième mois après leur sortie du pays d''Egypte, les enfants d''Israël arrivèrent ce jour-là au désert de Sinaï.
verses.am: በሦስተኛውም ወር የእስራኤል ልጆች ከግብፅ ምድር ከወጡ በኋላ በዚያ ቀን ወደ ሲና ምድረ በዳ መጡ።

verses.en: For they were departed from Rephidim, and were come to the desert of Sinai, and had pitched in the wilderness; and there Israel camped before the mount.
verses.fr: Etant partis de Rephidim, ils arrivèrent au désert de Sinaï, et ils campèrent dans le désert; Israël campa là, vis-à-vis de la montagne.
verses.am: ከራፊድም ተነሥተው ወደ ሲና ምድረ በዳ መጡ፥ በምድረ በዳም ሰፈሩ፤ በዚያም እስራኤል በተራራው ፊት ሰፈረ።

verses.en: And Moses went up unto God, and the Lord called unto him out of the mountain, saying, Thus shalt thou say to the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Israel;
verses.fr: Moïse monta vers Dieu: et l''Eternel l''appela du haut de la montagne, en disant: Tu parleras ainsi à la maison de Jacob, et tu diras aux enfants d''Israël:
verses.am: ሙሴም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወጣ፤ እግዚአብሔርም በተራራው ጠርቶ አለው። ለያዕቆብ ቤት እንዲህ በል፥ ለእስራኤልም ልጆች እንዲህ ንገር።

verses.en: Ye have seen what I did unto the Egyptians, and how I bare you on eagles' wings, and brought you unto myself.
verses.fr: Vous avez vu ce que j''ai fait à l''Egypte, et comment je vous ai portés sur des ailes d''aigle et amenés vers moi.
verses.am: በግብፃውያን ያደረግሁትን፥ በንስርም ክንፍ እንደተሸከምኋችሁ፥ ወደ እኔም እንዳመጣኋችሁ አይታችኋል።

verses.en: Now therefore, if ye will obey my voice indeed, and keep my covenant, then ye shall be a peculiar treasure unto me above all people: for all the earth is mine:
verses.fr: Maintenant, si vous écoutez ma voix, et si vous gardez mon alliance, vous m''appartiendrez entre tous les peuples, car toute la terre est à moi;
verses.am: አሁንም ቃሌን በእውነት ብትሰሙ ኪዳኔንም ብትጠብቁ፥ ምድር ሁሉ የእኔ ናትና ከአሕዛብ ሁሉ የተመረጠ ርስት ትሆኑልኛላችሁ፤

verses.en: And ye shall be unto me a kingdom of priests, and an holy nation. These are the words which thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel.
verses.fr: vous serez pour moi un royaume de sacrificateurs et une nation sainte. Voilà les paroles que tu diras aux enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: እናንተም የካህናት መንግሥት የተቀደሰም ሕዝብ ትሆኑልኛላችሁ። ለእስራኤል ልጆች የምትነግራቸው ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.en: And Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and laid before their faces all these words which the Lord commanded him.
verses.fr: Moïse vint appeler les anciens du peuple, et il mit devant eux toutes ces paroles, comme l''Eternel le lui avait ordonné.
verses.am: ሙሴም መጣ፥ የሕዝቡንም ሽማግሌዎች ጠርቶ እግዚአብሔር ያዘዘውን ይህን ቃል ሁሉ በፊታቸው ተናገረ።

verses.en: And all the people answered together, and said, All that the Lord hath spoken we will do. And Moses returned the words of the people unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Le peuple tout entier répondit: Nous ferons tout ce que l''Eternel a dit. Moïse rapporta les paroles du peuple à l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሕዝቡ ሁሉ አንድ አፍ ሆነው። እግዚአብሔር ያለውን ሁሉ እናደርጋለን ብለው መለሱ፤ ሙሴም የሕዝቡን ቃል ወደ እግዚአብሔር አደረሰ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Lo, I come unto thee in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with thee, and believe thee for ever. And Moses told the words of the people unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel dit à Moïse: Voici, je viendrai vers toi dans une épaisse nuée, afin que le peuple entende quand je te parlerai, et qu''il ait toujours confiance en toi. Moïse rapporta les paroles du peuple à l''Eternel.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። ከአንተ ጋር ስነጋገር ሕዝቡ እንዲሰሙ፥ ደግሞም ለዘላለም እንዲያምኑብህ፥ እነሆ በከባድ ደመና እመጣልሃለሁ አለው። ሙሴም የሕዝቡን ቃል ለእግዚአብሔር ነገረ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Go unto the people, and sanctify them to day and to morrow, and let them wash their clothes,
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel dit à Moïse: Va vers le peuple; sanctifie-les aujourd''hui et demain, qu''ils lavent leurs vêtements.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን አለው። ወደ ሕዝቡ ሂድ፥ ዛሬና ነገም ቀድሳቸው፥ ልብሳቸውንም ይጠቡ፤

verses.en: And be ready against the third day: for the third day the Lord will come down in the sight of all the people upon mount Sinai.
verses.fr: Qu''ils soient prêts pour le troisième jour; car le troisième jour l''Eternel descendra, aux yeux de tout le peuple, sur la montagne de Sinaï.
verses.am: በሦስተኛው ቀን ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ሲያዩ እግዚአብሔር በሲና ተራራ ላይ ይወርዳልና ለሦስተኛው ቀን ይዘጋጁ።

verses.en: And thou shalt set bounds unto the people round about, saying, Take heed to yourselves, that ye go not up into the mount, or touch the border of it: whosoever toucheth the mount shall be surely put to death:
verses.fr: Tu fixeras au peuple des limites tout à l''entour, et tu diras: Gardez-vous de monter sur la montagne, ou d''en toucher le bord. Quiconque touchera la montagne sera puni de mort.
verses.am: ወሰንም ለሕዝቡ በዙሪያው አድርግላቸው። ወደ ተራራው እንዳትወጡ ጫፉንም እንዳትነኩ ተጠንቀቁ፤ ተራራውንም የነካ ፈጽሞ ይሞታል፤

verses.en: There shall not an hand touch it, but he shall surely be stoned, or shot through; whether it be beast or man, it shall not live: when the trumpet soundeth long, they shall come up to the mount.
verses.fr: On ne mettra pas la main sur lui, mais on le lapidera, ou on le percera de flèches: animal ou homme, il ne vivra point. Quand la trompette sonnera, ils s''avanceront près de la montagne.
verses.am: የማንም እጅ አይንካ፤ ነገር ግን የሚነካው ሁሉ ይወገራል፥ ወይም በፍላጻ ይወጋል፤ እንስሳ ወይም ሰው ቢሆን አይድንም በላቸው። ሳያቋርጥ የመለከት ድምፅ ሲነፋ በዚያን ጊዜ ወደ ተራራው ይውጡ።

verses.en: And Moses went down from the mount unto the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their clothes.
verses.fr: Moïse descendit de la montagne vers le peuple; il sanctifia le peuple, et ils lavèrent leurs vêtements.
verses.am: ሙሴም ከተራራው ወደ ሕዝቡ ወረደ፥ ሕዝቡንም ቀደሰ፤ ልብሳቸውንም አጠቡ።

verses.en: And he said unto the people, Be ready against the third day: come not at your wives.
verses.fr: Et il dit au peuple: Soyez prêts dans trois jours; ne vous approchez d''aucune femme.
verses.am: ሕዝቡንም። ለሦስተኛው ቀን ተዘጋጁ፥ ወደ ሴቶቻችሁ አትቅረቡ አለ።

verses.en: And it came to pass on the third day in the morning, that there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud upon the mount, and the voice of the trumpet exceeding loud; so that all the people that was in the camp trembled.
verses.fr: Le troisième jour au matin, il y eut des tonnerres, des éclairs, et une épaisse nuée sur la montagne; le son de la trompette retentit fortement; et tout le peuple qui était dans le camp fut saisi d''épouvante.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በሦስተኛው ቀን በማለዳ ጊዜ ነጐድጓድና መብረቅ ከባድም ደመና እጅግም የበረታ የቀንደ መለከት ድምጽ በተራራው ላይ ሆነ፤ በሰፈሩም የነበሩት ሕዝብ ሁሉ ተንቀጠቀጡ።

verses.en: And Moses brought forth the people out of the camp to meet with God; and they stood at the nether part of the mount.
verses.fr: Moïse fit sortir le peuple du camp, à la rencontre de Dieu; et ils se placèrent au bas de la montagne.
verses.am: ሙሴም ሕዝቡን ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር ለማገናኘት ከሰፈር አወጣቸው፤ ከተራራውም እግርጌ ቆሙ።

verses.en: And mount Sinai was altogether on a smoke, because the Lord descended upon it in fire: and the smoke thereof ascended as the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mount quaked greatly.
verses.fr: La montagne de Sinaï était toute en fumée, parce que l''Eternel y était descendu au milieu du feu; cette fumée s''élevait comme la fumée d''une fournaise, et toute la montagne tremblait avec violence.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በእሳት ስለ ወረደበት የሲና ተራራ ሁሉ ይጤስ ነበር፤ ከእርሱም እንደ እቶን ጢስ ያለ ጢስ ይወጣ ነበር፥ ተራራውም ሁሉ እጅግ ይናወጥ ነበር።

verses.en: And when the voice of the trumpet sounded long, and waxed louder and louder, Moses spake, and God answered him by a voice.
verses.fr: Le son de la trompette retentissait de plus en plus fortement. Moïse parlait, et Dieu lui répondait à haute voix.
verses.am: የቀንደ መለከቱም ድምፅ እጅግ በበረታና በጸና ጊዜ ሙሴ ተናገረ እግዚአብሔርም በድምፅ መለሰለት።

verses.en: And the Lord came down upon mount Sinai, on the top of the mount: and the Lord called Moses up to the top of the mount; and Moses went up.
verses.fr: Ainsi l''Eternel descendit sur la montagne de Sinaï, sur le sommet de la montagne; l''Eternel appela Moïse sur le sommet de la montagne. Et Moïse monta.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በሲና ተራራ ላይ ወደ ተራራው ራስ ወረደ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን ወደ ተራራው ራስ ጠራው፤ ሙሴም ወጣ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Go down, charge the people, lest they break through unto the Lord to gaze, and many of them perish.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse: Descends, fais au peuple la défense expresse de se précipiter vers l''Eternel, pour regarder, de peur qu''un grand nombre d''entre eux ne périssent.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። ውረድ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ለማየት ዳርቻውን እንዳያልፉ ከእነርሱም ብዙ እንዳይጠፉ ለሕዝቡ አስጠንቅቃቸው፤

verses.en: And let the priests also, which come near to the Lord, sanctify themselves, lest the Lord break forth upon them.
verses.fr: Que les sacrificateurs, qui s''approchent de l''Eternel, se sanctifient aussi, de peur que l''Eternel ne les frappe de mort.
verses.am: ወደ እግዚአብሔርም የሚቀርቡት ካህናት ደግሞ እግዚአብሔር እንዳያጠፋቸው ራሳቸውን ይቀድሱ አለው።

verses.en: And Moses said unto the Lord, The people cannot come up to mount Sinai: for thou chargedst us, saying, Set bounds about the mount, and sanctify it.
verses.fr: Moïse dit à l''Eternel: Le peuple ne pourra pas monter sur la montagne de Sinaï, car tu nous en as fait la défense expresse, en disant: Fixe des limites autour de la montagne, et sanctifie-la.
verses.am: ሙሴም እግዚአብሔርን። አንተ። በተራራው ዙሪያ ወሰን አድርግ ቀድሰውም ብለህ አስጠንቅቀኸናልና ሕዝቡ ወደ ተራራ ይወጡ ዘንድ አይችሉም አለው።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto him, Away, get thee down, and thou shalt come up, thou, and Aaron with thee: but let not the priests and the people break through to come up unto the Lord, lest he break forth upon them.
verses.fr: L''Eternel lui dit: Va, descends; tu monteras ensuite avec Aaron; mais que les sacrificateurs et le peuple ne se précipitent point pour monter vers l''Eternel, de peur qu''il ne les frappe de mort.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። ሂድ፥ ውረድ፤ አንተ አሮንም ከአንተ ጋር ትወጣላችሁ፤ ካህናቱና ሕዝቡ ግን እግዚአብሔር እንዳያጠፋቸው ወደ እግዚአብሔር ይወጡ ዘንድ አይተላለፉ አለው።

verses.en: So Moses went down unto the people, and spake unto them.
verses.fr: Moïse descendit vers le peuple, et lui dit ces choses.
verses.am: ሙሴም ወደ ሕዝቡ ወረደ፥ ይህንንም ነገራቸው።

verses.en: And God spake all these words, saying,
verses.fr: Alors Dieu prononça toutes ces paroles, en disant:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ይህን ቃል ሁሉ እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረ።

verses.en: I am the Lord thy God, which have brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
verses.fr: Je suis l''Eternel, ton Dieu, qui t''ai fait sortir du pays d''Egypte, de la maison de servitude.
verses.am: ከግብፅ ምድር ከባርነት ቤት ያወጣሁህ እግዚአብሔር አምላክህ እኔ ነኝ።

verses.en: Thou shalt have no other gods before me.
verses.fr: Tu n''auras pas d''autres dieux devant ma face.
verses.am: ከእኔ በቀር ሌሎች አማልክት አይሁኑልህ።  ፕ

verses.en: Thou shalt not make unto thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth.
verses.fr: Tu ne te feras point d''image taillée, ni de représentation quelconque des choses qui sont en haut dans les cieux, qui sont en bas sur la terre, et qui sont dans les eaux plus bas que la terre.
verses.am: በላይ በሰማይ ካለው፥ በታችም በምድር ካለው፥ ከምድርም በታች በውኃ ካለው ነገር የማናቸውንም ምሳሌ፥ የተቀረጸውንም ምስል ለአንተ አታድርግ።

verses.en: Thou shalt not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them: for I the Lord thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me;
verses.fr: Tu ne te prosterneras point devant elles, et tu ne les serviras point; car moi, l''Eternel, ton Dieu, je suis un Dieu jaloux, qui punis l''iniquité des pères sur les enfants jusqu''à la troisième et la quatrième génération de ceux qui me haïssent,
verses.am: አትስገድላቸው፥ አታምልካቸውምም፤ በሚጠሉኝ እስከ ሦስተኛና እስከ አራተኛ ትውልድ ድረስ የአባቶችን ኃጢአት በልጆች ላይ የማመጣ፤

verses.en: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me, and keep my commandments.
verses.fr: et qui fais miséricorde jusqu''en mille générations à ceux qui m''aiment et qui gardent mes commandements.
verses.am: ለሚወድዱኝ፥ ትእዛዜንም ለሚጠብቁ እስከ ሺህ ትውልድ ድረስ ምሕረትን የማደርግ እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላክህ ቀናተኛ አምላክ ነኝና። ፕ

verses.en: Thou shalt not take the name of the Lord thy God in vain; for the Lord will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.
verses.fr: Tu ne prendras point le nom de l''Eternel, ton Dieu, en vain; car l''Eternel ne laissera point impuni celui qui prendra son nom en vain.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን የአምላክህን ስም በከንቱ አትጥራ፤ እግዚአብሔር ስሙን በከንቱ የሚጠራውን ከበደል አያነጻውምና።

verses.en: Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy.
verses.fr: Souviens-toi du jour du repos, pour le sanctifier.
verses.am: የሰንበትን ቀን ትቀድሰው ዘንድ አስብ።

verses.en: Six days shalt thou labour, and do all thy work:
verses.fr: Tu travailleras six jours, et tu feras tout ton ouvrage.
verses.am: ስድስት ቀን ሥራ ተግባርህንም ሁሉ አድርግ፤

verses.en: But the seventh day is the sabbath of the Lord thy God: in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates:
verses.fr: Mais le septième jour est le jour du repos de l''Eternel, ton Dieu: tu ne feras aucun ouvrage, ni toi, ni ton fils, ni ta fille, ni ton serviteur, ni ta servante, ni ton bétail, ni l''étranger qui est dans tes portes.
verses.am: ሰባተኛው ቀን ግን ለእግዚአብሔር ለአምላክህ ሰንበት ነው፤ አንተ፥ ወንድ ልጅህም፥ ሴት ልጅህም፥ ሎሌህም፥ ገረድህም፥ ከብትህም፥ በደጆችህም ውስጥ ያለ እንግዳ በእርሱ ምንም ሥራ አትሥሩ፤

verses.en: For in six days the Lord made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that in them is, and rested the seventh day: wherefore the Lord blessed the sabbath day, and hallowed it.
verses.fr: Car en six jours l''Eternel a fait les cieux, la terre et la mer, et tout ce qui y est contenu, et il s''est reposé le septième jour: c''est pourquoi l''Eternel a béni le jour du repos et l''a sanctifié.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በስድስት ቀን ሰማይንና ምድርን፥ ባሕርንም፥ ያለባቸውንም ሁሉ ፈጥሮ በሰባተኛው ቀን ዐርፎአልና፤ ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር የሰንበትን ቀን ባርኮታል ቀድሶታልም።

verses.en: Honour thy father and thy mother: that thy days may be long upon the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee.
verses.fr: Honore ton père et ta mère, afin que tes jours se prolongent dans le pays que l''Eternel, ton Dieu, te donne.
verses.am: አባትህንና እናትህን አክብር፤ እግዚአብሔር አምላክህ በሚሰጥህ ምድር ዕድሜህ እንዲረዝም።

verses.en: Thou shalt not kill.
verses.fr: Tu ne tueras point.
verses.am: አትግደል።

verses.en: Thou shalt not commit adultery.
verses.fr: Tu ne commettras point d''adultère.
verses.am: አታመንዝር።

verses.en: Thou shalt not steal.
verses.fr: Tu ne déroberas point.
verses.am: አትስረቅ።

verses.en: Thou shalt not bear false witness against thy neighbour.
verses.fr: Tu ne porteras point de faux témoignage contre ton prochain.
verses.am: በባልንጀራህ ላይ በሐሰት አትመስክር።

verses.en: Thou shalt not covet thy neighbour's house, thou shalt not covet thy neighbour's wife, nor his manservant, nor his maidservant, nor his ox, nor his ass, nor any thing that is thy neighbour's.
verses.fr: Tu ne convoiteras point la maison de ton prochain; tu ne convoiteras point la femme de ton prochain, ni son serviteur, ni sa servante, ni son boeuf, ni son âne, ni aucune chose qui appartienne à ton prochain.
verses.am: የባልንጀራህን ቤት አትመኝ፤ የባልንጀራህን ሚስት ሎሌውንም ገረዱንም በሬውንም አህያውንም ከባልንጀራህ ገንዘብ ሁሉ ማናቸውንም አትመኝ።

verses.en: And all the people saw the thunderings, and the lightnings, and the noise of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking: and when the people saw it, they removed, and stood afar off.
verses.fr: Tout le peuple entendait les tonnerres et le son de la trompette; il voyait les flammes de la montagne fumante. A ce spectacle, le peuple tremblait, et se tenait dans l''éloignement.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ነጐድጓዱንና መብረቁን፥ የቀንደ መለከቱን ድምፅ፥ ተራራውንም ሲጤስ አዩ፤ ሕዝቡም ባዩ ጊዜ ተርበደበዱ፥ ርቀውም ቆሙ።

verses.en: And they said unto Moses, Speak thou with us, and we will hear: but let not God speak with us, lest we die.
verses.fr: Ils dirent à Moïse: Parle-nous toi-même, et nous écouterons; mais que Dieu ne nous parle point, de peur que nous ne mourions.
verses.am: ሙሴንም። አንተ ተናገረን እኛም እንሰማለን፤ እንዳንሞት ግን እግዚአብሔር አይናገረን አሉት።

verses.en: And Moses said unto the people, Fear not: for God is come to prove you, and that his fear may be before your faces, that ye sin not.
verses.fr: Moïse dit au peuple: Ne vous effrayez pas; car c''est pour vous mettre à l''épreuve que Dieu est venu, et c''est pour que vous ayez sa crainte devant les yeux, afin que vous ne péchiez point.
verses.am: ሙሴም ለሕዝቡ። እግዚአብሔር ሊፈትናችሁ፥ ኃጢያትንም እንዳትሠሩ እርሱን መፍራት በልባችሁ ይሆን ዘንድ መጥቶአልና አትፍሩ አለ።

verses.en: And the people stood afar off, and Moses drew near unto the thick darkness where God was.
verses.fr: Le peuple restait dans l''éloignement; mais Moïse s''approcha de la nuée où était Dieu.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ርቀው ቆሙ፥ ሙሴም እግዚአብሔር ወዳለበት ወደ ጨለማው ቀረበ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Thus thou shalt say unto the children of Israel, Ye have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse: Tu parleras ainsi aux enfants d''Israël: Vous avez vu que je vous ai parlé depuis les cieux.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን አለው። ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ በል። እኔ ከሰማይ እንደ ተናገርኋችሁ እናንተ አይታችኋል።

verses.en: Ye shall not make with me gods of silver, neither shall ye make unto you gods of gold.
verses.fr: Vous ne ferez point des dieux d''argent et des dieux d''or, pour me les associer; vous ne vous en ferez point.
verses.am: በአጠገቤ ምንም አታድርጉ፤ የብር አማልክት የወርቅም አማልክት ለእናንተ አታድርጉ።

verses.en: An altar of earth thou shalt make unto me, and shalt sacrifice thereon thy burnt offerings, and thy peace offerings, thy sheep, and thine oxen: in all places where I record my name I will come unto thee, and I will bless thee.
verses.fr: Tu m''élèveras un autel de terre, sur lequel tu offriras tes holocaustes et tes sacrifices d''actions de grâces, tes brebis et tes boeufs. Partout où je rappellerai mon nom, je viendrai à toi, et je te bénirai.
verses.am: የጭቃ መሠዊያ ሥራልኝ፥ የሚቃጠለውንና የደኅንነት መሥዋዕትህን በጎችህንም በሬዎችህንም ሠዋበት፤ ስሜን በማሳስብበት ስፍራ ሁሉ ወደ አንተ መጥቼ እባርክሃለሁ።

verses.en: And if thou wilt make me an altar of stone, thou shalt not build it of hewn stone: for if thou lift up thy tool upon it, thou hast polluted it.
verses.fr: Si tu m''élèves un autel de pierre, tu ne le bâtiras point en pierres taillées; car en passant ton ciseau sur la pierre, tu la profanerais.
verses.am: የድንጋይም መሠዊያ ብታደርግልኝ ብረት በነካው ድንጋይ አትሥራው፤ በመሣሪያ ብትነካው ታረክሰዋለህና።

verses.en: Neither shalt thou go up by steps unto mine altar, that thy nakedness be not discovered thereon.
verses.fr: Tu ne monteras point à mon autel par des degrés, afin que ta nudité ne soit pas découverte.
verses.am: ኃፍረተ ሥጋህ በእርሱ እንዳይገለጥ ወደ መሠዊያዬ በደረጃ አትውጣ።

verses.en: Now these are the judgments which thou shalt set before them.
verses.fr: Voici les lois que tu leur présenteras.
verses.am: በፊታቸው የምታደርገው ሥርዓት ይህ ነው።

verses.en: If thou buy an Hebrew servant, six years he shall serve: and in the seventh he shall go out free for nothing.
verses.fr: Si tu achètes un esclave hébreu, il servira six années; mais la septième, il sortira libre, sans rien payer.
verses.am: ዕብራዊ ባሪያ የገዛህ እንደሆነ ስድስት ዓመት ያገልግልህ፥ በሰባተኛውም በከንቱ አርነት ይውጣ።

verses.en: If he came in by himself, he shall go out by himself: if he were married, then his wife shall go out with him.
verses.fr: S''il est entré seul, il sortira seul; s''il avait une femme, sa femme sortira avec lui.
verses.am: ብቻውን መጥቶ እንደሆነ ብቻውን ይውጣ፤ ከሚስቱ ጋር መጥቶ እንደሆነ ሚስቱ ከእርሱ ጋር ትውጣ።

verses.en: If his master have given him a wife, and she have born him sons or daughters; the wife and her children shall be her master's, and he shall go out by himself.
verses.fr: Si c''est son maître qui lui a donné une femme, et qu''il en ait eu des fils ou des filles, la femme et ses enfants seront à son maître, et il sortira seul.
verses.am: ጌታው ሚስት አጋብቶት እንደ ሆነ ወንዶች ወይም ሴቶች ልጆች ብትወልድለት፥ ሚስቱና ልጆችዋ ለጌታው ይሁኑ፥ እርሱም ብቻውን ይውጣ።

verses.en: And if the servant shall plainly say, I love my master, my wife, and my children; I will not go out free:
verses.fr: Si l''esclave dit: J''aime mon maître, ma femme et mes enfants, je ne veux pas sortir libre, -
verses.am: ባሪያውም። ጌታዬን ሚስቴን ልጅቼንም እወድዳለሁ፥ አርነት አልወጣም ብሎ ቢናገር፥ ጌታው ወደ ፈራጆች ይውሰደው፥

verses.en: Then his master shall bring him unto the judges; he shall also bring him to the door, or unto the door post; and his master shall bore his ear through with an aul; and he shall serve him for ever.
verses.fr: alors son maître le conduira devant Dieu, et le fera approcher de la porte ou du poteau, et son maître lui percera l''oreille avec un poinçon, et l''esclave sera pour toujours à son service.
verses.am: ወደ ደጁም ወደ መቃኑ አቅርቦ ጆሮውን በወስፌ ይብሳው፤ ለዘላለምም ባሪያው ይሁን።

verses.en: And if a man sell his daughter to be a maidservant, she shall not go out as the menservants do.
verses.fr: Si un homme vend sa fille pour être esclave, elle ne sortira point comme sortent les esclaves.
verses.am: ሰውም ሴት ልጁን ለባርነት ቢሸጥ ባሪያዎች እንደሚወጡ እርስዋ አትውጣ።

verses.en: If she please not her master, who hath betrothed her to himself, then shall he let her be redeemed: to sell her unto a strange nation he shall have no power, seeing he hath dealt deceitfully with her.
verses.fr: Si elle déplaît à son maître, qui s''était proposé de la prendre pour femme, il facilitera son rachat; mais il n''aura pas le pouvoir de la vendre à des étrangers, après lui avoir été infidèle.
verses.am: ጌታዋን ደስ ባታሰኘው በዎጆ ይስደዳት፤ ስለ ናቃት ለሌላ ወገን ሰዎች ይሸጣት ዘንድ አይገባውም።

verses.en: And if he have betrothed her unto his son, he shall deal with her after the manner of daughters.
verses.fr: S''il la destine à son fils, il agira envers elle selon le droit des filles.
verses.am: ለልጁም ብድራት፥ ለሴት ልጆች የሚገባውን ያድርግላት።

verses.en: If he take him another wife; her food, her raiment, and her duty of marriage, shall he not diminish.
verses.fr: S''il prend une autre femme, il ne retranchera rien pour la première à la nourriture, au vêtement, et au droit conjugal.
verses.am: ከእርስዋ ሌላም ቢያጋባው፥ መኖዋን ልብስዋንም ለምንጣፍዋም ተገቢውን አያጕድልባት።

verses.en: And if he do not these three unto her, then shall she go out free without money.
verses.fr: Et s''il ne fait pas pour elle ces trois choses, elle pourra sortir sans rien payer, sans donner de l''argent.
verses.am: ይህንም ሦስት ነገር ባያደርግላት ያለ ገንዘብ በከንቱ ትውጣ።

verses.en: He that smiteth a man, so that he die, shall be surely put to death.
verses.fr: Celui qui frappera un homme mortellement sera puni de mort.
verses.am: ሰው ሰውን ቢመታ ቢሞትም፥ እርሱ ፈጽሞ ይገደል።

verses.en: And if a man lie not in wait, but God deliver him into his hand; then I will appoint thee a place whither he shall flee.
verses.fr: S''il ne lui a point dressé d''embûches, et que Dieu l''ait fait tomber sous sa main, je t''établirai un lieu où il pourra se réfugier.
verses.am: ባይሸምቅበትም፥ ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔር ድንገት በእጁ ቢጥለው፥ የሚሸሽበት ስፍራ እኔ አደርግልሃለሁ።

verses.en: But if a man come presumptuously upon his neighbour, to slay him with guile; thou shalt take him from mine altar, that he may die.
verses.fr: Mais si quelqu''un agit méchamment contre son prochain, en employant la ruse pour le tuer, tu l''arracheras même de mon autel, pour le faire mourir.
verses.am: ሰው ግን ቢደፍር፥ ባልጀራውን በተንኰል ቢገድለው፥ እንዲሞት ከመሠዊያዬ አውጥተህ ውሰደው።

verses.en: And he that smiteth his father, or his mother, shall be surely put to death.
verses.fr: Celui qui frappera son père ou sa mère sera puni de mort.
verses.am: አባቱን ወይም እናቱን የሚመታ ፈጽሞ ይገደል።

verses.en: And he that stealeth a man, and selleth him, or if he be found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.
verses.fr: Celui qui dérobera un homme, et qui l''aura vendu ou retenu entre ses mains, sera puni de mort.
verses.am: ሰውን ሰርቆ ቢሸጥ፥ ወይም በእጁ ቢገኝ፥ እርሱ ፈጽሞ ይገደል።

verses.en: And he that curseth his father, or his mother, shall surely be put to death.
verses.fr: Celui qui maudira son père ou sa mère sera puni de mort.
verses.am: አባቱን ወይም እናቱን የሚሰድብ ፈጽሞ ይገደል።

verses.en: And if men strive together, and one smite another with a stone, or with his fist, and he die not, but keepeth his bed:
verses.fr: Si des hommes se querellent, et que l''un d''eux frappe l''autre avec une pierre ou avec le poing, sans causer sa mort, mais en l''obligeant à garder le lit,
verses.am: ሁለት ሰዎችም ቢጣሉ፥ አንዱም ሌላውን በድንጋይ ወይም በጡጫ ቢመታ፥ ያም ባይሞት ነገር ግን ታምሞ በአልጋው ላይ ቢተኛ፥

verses.en: If he rise again, and walk abroad upon his staff, then shall he that smote him be quit: only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall cause him to be thoroughly healed.
verses.fr: celui qui aura frappé ne sera point puni, dans le cas où l''autre viendrait à se lever et à se promener dehors avec son bâton. Seulement, il le dédommagera de son interruption de travail, et il le fera soigner jusqu''à sa guérison.
verses.am: ተነሥቶም በምርኩዝ ወደ ሜዳ ቢወጣ፥ የመታው ንጹሕ ነው፤ ነገር ግን ተግባሩን ስላስፈታው ገንዘብ ይከፍለው ዘንድ፥ ያስፈውሰውም ዘንድ ግዴታ አለበት።

verses.en: And if a man smite his servant, or his maid, with a rod, and he die under his hand; he shall be surely punished.
verses.fr: Si un homme frappe du bâton son esclave, homme ou femme, et que l''esclave meure sous sa main, le maître sera puni.
verses.am: ሰውም ወንድ ባሪያውን ወይም ሴት ባሪያውን በበትር ቢመታ፥ ቢሞትበትም፥ ፈጽሞ ይቀጣ።

verses.en: Notwithstanding, if he continue a day or two, he shall not be punished: for he is his money.
verses.fr: Mais s''il survit un jour ou deux, le maître ne sera point puni; car c''est son argent.
verses.am: የተመታው ግን አንድ ወይም ሁለት ቀን ቢቈይ ገንዘቡ ነውና አይቀጣ።

verses.en: If men strive, and hurt a woman with child, so that her fruit depart from her, and yet no mischief follow: he shall be surely punished, according as the woman's husband will lay upon him; and he shall pay as the judges determine.
verses.fr: Si des hommes se querellent, et qu''ils heurtent une femme enceinte, et la fassent accoucher, sans autre accident, ils seront punis d''une amende imposée par le mari de la femme, et qu''ils paieront devant les juges.
verses.am: ሁለት ሰዎች ቢጣሉ፥ ያረገዘችንም ሴት ልጁን እስክትጨነግፍ ቢገፉአት ባትጐዳ ግን፥ የሴቲቱ ባል የጫነበትን ያህል ካሳ ይስጥ፤ ፈራጆቹም እንደ ፈረዱበት ይክፈል።

verses.en: And if any mischief follow, then thou shalt give life for life,
verses.fr: Mais s''il y a un accident, tu donneras vie pour vie,
verses.am: ጕዳት ግን ቢያገኛት ሕይወት በሕይወት፥

verses.en: Eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
verses.fr: oeil pour oeil, dent pour dent, main pour main, pied pour pied,
verses.am: ዓይን በዓይን፥ ጥርስ በጥርስ፥ እጅ በእጅ፥

verses.en: Burning for burning, wound for wound, stripe for stripe.
verses.fr: brûlure pour brûlure, blessure pour blessure, meurtrissure pour meurtrissure.
verses.am: እግር በእግር፥ መቃጠል በመቃጠል፥ ቍስል በቍስል፥ ግርፋት በግርፋት ይከፈል።

verses.en: And if a man smite the eye of his servant, or the eye of his maid, that it perish; he shall let him go free for his eye's sake.
verses.fr: Si un homme frappe l''oeil de son esclave, homme ou femme, et qu''il lui fasse perdre l''oeil, il le mettra en liberté, pour prix de son oeil.
verses.am: ሰውም የባሪያውን ወይም የባሪይይቱን ዓይን ቢመታ ቢያጠፋውም፥ ስለ ዓይኑ አርነት ያውጣው።

verses.en: And if he smite out his manservant's tooth, or his maidservant's tooth; he shall let him go free for his tooth's sake.
verses.fr: Et s''il fait tomber une dent à son esclave, homme ou femme, il le mettra en liberté, pour prix de sa dent.
verses.am: የባሪያውን ወይም የባሪያይቱን ጥርስ ቢሰብር፥ ስለ ጥርሱ አርነት ያውጣው።

verses.en: If an ox gore a man or a woman, that they die: then the ox shall be surely stoned, and his flesh shall not be eaten; but the owner of the ox shall be quit.
verses.fr: Si un boeuf frappe de ses cornes un homme ou une femme, et que la mort en soit la suite, le boeuf sera lapidé, sa chair ne sera point mangée, et le maître du boeuf ne sera point puni.
verses.am: በሬም ወንድን ወይም ሴትን እስኪሞቱ ድረስ ቢወጋ፥ በሬው ይወገር፥ ሥጋውም አይበላ፤ የበሬው ባለቤት ግን ንጹሕ ነው።

verses.en: But if the ox were wont to push with his horn in time past, and it hath been testified to his owner, and he hath not kept him in, but that he hath killed a man or a woman; the ox shall be stoned, and his owner also shall be put to death.
verses.fr: Mais si le boeuf était auparavant sujet à frapper, et qu''on en ait averti le maître, qui ne l''a point surveillé, le boeuf sera lapidé, dans le cas où il tuerait un homme ou une femme, et son maître sera puni de mort.
verses.am: በሬው ግን አስቀድሞ ተዋጊ ቢሆን፥ ሰዎችም ለባለቤቱ ቢመሰክሩለት ባይጠብቀውም፥ ወንድንም ወይም ሴትን ቢገድል፥ በሬው ይወገር፥ ባለቤቱ ደግሞ ይገደል።

verses.en: If there be laid on him a sum of money, then he shall give for the ransom of his life whatsoever is laid upon him.
verses.fr: Si on impose au maître un prix pour le rachat de sa vie, il paiera tout ce qui lui sera imposé.
verses.am: ከእርሱ ግን ካሳ ቢፈልጉ፥ የሕይወቱን ዎጆ የጫኑበትን ያህል ይስጥ።

verses.en: Whether he have gored a son, or have gored a daughter, according to this judgment shall it be done unto him.
verses.fr: Lorsque le boeuf frappera un fils ou une fille, cette loi recevra son application;
verses.am: ደግሞ ወንድን ልጅ ቢወጋ ሴትንም ልጅ ቢወጋ፥ ይህንኑ ፍርድ ያድርጉበት።

verses.en: If the ox shall push a manservant or a maidservant; he shall give unto their master thirty shekels of silver, and the ox shall be stoned.
verses.fr: mais si le boeuf frappe un esclave, homme ou femme, on donnera trente sicles d''argent au maître de l''esclave, et le boeuf sera lapidé.
verses.am: በሬው ወንድ ባሪያ ወይም ሴት ባሪያ ቢወጋ፥ የበሬው ባለቤት ሠላሳ የብር ሰቅል ለጌታቸው ይስጥ፥ በሬውም ይወገር።

verses.en: And if a man shall open a pit, or if a man shall dig a pit, and not cover it, and an ox or an ass fall therein;
verses.fr: Si un homme met à découvert une citerne, ou si un homme en creuse une et ne la couvre pas, et qu''il y tombe un boeuf ou un âne,
verses.am: ሰውም ጕድጓድ ቢከፍት፥ ወይም ጕድጓድ ቢቈፍር ባይከድነውም፥ በሬም ወይም አህያ ቢወድቅበት፥

verses.en: The owner of the pit shall make it good, and give money unto the owner of them; and the dead beast shall be his.
verses.fr: le possesseur de la citerne paiera au maître la valeur de l''animal en argent, et aura pour lui l''animal mort.
verses.am: የጕድጓዱ ባለቤት ዋጋቸውን ለባለቤታቸው ይክፈል፤ የሞተውም ለእርሱ ይሁን።

verses.en: And if one man's ox hurt another's, that he die; then they shall sell the live ox, and divide the money of it; and the dead ox also they shall divide.
verses.fr: Si le boeuf d''un homme frappe de ses cornes le boeuf d''un autre homme, et que la mort en soit la suite, ils vendront le boeuf vivant et en partageront le prix; ils partageront aussi le boeuf mort.
verses.am: የሰው በሬ የሌላውን በሬ እስኪሞት ድረስ ቢወጋ፥ ደኅናውን በሬ ይሽጡ፥ ዋጋውንም በትክክል ይካፈሉ፤ የሞተውንም ደግሞ በትክክል ይካፈሉ።

verses.en: Or if it be known that the ox hath used to push in time past, and his owner hath not kept him in; he shall surely pay ox for ox; and the dead shall be his own.
verses.fr: Mais s''il est connu que le boeuf était auparavant sujet à frapper, et que son maître ne l''ait point surveillé, ce maître rendra boeuf pour boeuf, et aura pour lui le boeuf mort.
verses.am: በሬውም አስቀድሞ ተዋጊ መሆኑ ቢታወቅ፥ ባለቤቱም ባይጠብቀው፥ በሬውን በበሬው ፈንታ ይስጥ፥ የሞተውም ለእርሱ ይሁነው።

verses.en: If a man shall steal an ox, or a sheep, and kill it, or sell it; he shall restore five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.
verses.fr: Si un homme dérobe un boeuf ou un agneau, et qu''il l''égorge ou le vende, il restituera cinq boeufs pour le boeuf et quatre agneaux pour l''agneau.
verses.am: ሰው በሬ ወይም በግ ቢሰርቅ፥ ቢያርደው ወይም ቢሸጠው፥ በበሬው ፋንታ አምስት በሬዎች፥ በበጉም ፋንታ አራት በጎች ይክፈል።

verses.en: If a thief be found breaking up, and be smitten that he die, there shall no blood be shed for him.
verses.fr: Si le voleur est surpris dérobant avec effraction, et qu''il soit frappé et meure, on ne sera point coupable de meurtre envers lui;
verses.am: ሌባው ቤት ሲምስ ቢገኝ፥ እርሱም እስኪሞት ቢመታ፥ በመታው ሰው ላይ የደም ዕዳ አይሆንበትም።

verses.en: If the sun be risen upon him, there shall be blood shed for him; for he should make full restitution; if he have nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.
verses.fr: mais si le soleil est levé, on sera coupable de meurtre envers lui. Il fera restitution; s''il n''a rien, il sera vendu pour son vol;
verses.am: ፀሐይ ግን ከወጣችበት የደም ዕዳ አለበት፤ ሌባው የሰረቀውን ይመልስ፤ የሚከፍለውም ቢያጣ ስለ ሰረቀው ይሸጥ።

verses.en: If the theft be certainly found in his hand alive, whether it be ox, or ass, or sheep; he shall restore double.
verses.fr: si ce qu''il a dérobé, boeuf, âne, ou agneau, se trouve encore vivant entre ses mains, il fera une restitution au double.
verses.am: የሰረቀው ደኅና ሆኖ በእጁ ቢገኝ፥ በሬም ወይም አህያ ወይም በግ ቢሆን፥ የሰረቀውን ያህል ሁለት እጥፍ ይክፈል።

verses.en: If a man shall cause a field or vineyard to be eaten, and shall put in his beast, and shall feed in another man's field; of the best of his own field, and of the best of his own vineyard, shall he make restitution.
verses.fr: Si un homme fait du dégât dans un champ ou dans une vigne, et qu''il laisse son bétail paître dans le champ d''autrui, il donnera en dédommagement le meilleur produit de son champ et de sa vigne.
verses.am: ማንም ሰው ወደ እርሻ ወይም ወደ ወይን ስፍራ ከብቱን ቢነዳው፥ የሌላውንም እርሻ ቢያስበላ፥ ከተመረጠ እርሻው ከማለፊያውም ወይኑ ይካስ።

verses.en: If fire break out, and catch in thorns, so that the stacks of corn, or the standing corn, or the field, be consumed therewith; he that kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.
verses.fr: Si un feu éclate et rencontre des épines, et que du blé en gerbes ou sur pied, ou bien le champ, soit consumé, celui qui a causé l''incendie sera tenu à un dédommagement.
verses.am: እሳት ቢነሣ፥ እሾኽንም ቢይዝ፥ ክምሩንም ወይም ያልታጨደውን እህል ወይም እርሻውን ቢያቃጥል፥ እሳቱን ያነደደው ይካስ።

verses.en: If a man shall deliver unto his neighbour money or stuff to keep, and it be stolen out of the man's house; if the thief be found, let him pay double.
verses.fr: Si un homme donne à un autre de l''argent ou des objets à garder, et qu''on les vole dans la maison de ce dernier, le voleur fera une restitution au double, dans le cas où il serait trouvé.
verses.am: ሰው በባልንጀራው ዘንድ ብር ወይም ሌላ ነገር እንዲጠብቅለት አደራ ቢያኖር ከቤቱም ቢሰረቅ፥ ሌባው ቢገኝ ስለ አንድ ሁለት ይክፈል።

verses.en: If the thief be not found, then the master of the house shall be brought unto the judges, to see whether he have put his hand unto his neighbour's goods.
verses.fr: Si le voleur ne se trouve pas, le maître de la maison se présentera devant Dieu, pour déclarer qu''il n''a pas mis la main sur le bien de son prochain.
verses.am: ሌባውም ባይገኝ ባለቤቱ ወደ ፈራጆች ይቅረብ፥ እጁንም በባልንጀራው ከብት ላይ እንዳልዘረጋ ይማል።

verses.en: For all manner of trespass, whether it be for ox, for ass, for sheep, for raiment, or for any manner of lost thing which another challengeth to be his, the cause of both parties shall come before the judges; and whom the judges shall condemn, he shall pay double unto his neighbour.
verses.fr: Dans toute affaire frauduleuse concernant un boeuf, un âne, un agneau, un vêtement, ou un objet perdu, au sujet duquel on dira: C''est cela! -la cause des deux parties ira jusqu''à Dieu; celui que Dieu condamnera fera à son prochain une restitution au double.
verses.am: ሰዎች ስለ በሬ ወይም ስለ አህያ ወይም ስለ በግ ወይም ስለ ልብስ ወይም ስለ ሌላ ስለ ጠፋ ነገር ቢካሰሱ፥ አንዱም። ይህ የእኔ ነው ቢል፥ ክርክራቸው ወደ ፈራጆች ይድረስ፤ ፈራጆቹም የፈረዱበት እርሱ ለባልንጀራው በአንድ ሁለት ይክፈል።

verses.en: If a man deliver unto his neighbour an ass, or an ox, or a sheep, or any beast, to keep; and it die, or be hurt, or driven away, no man seeing it:
verses.fr: Si un homme donne à un autre un âne, un boeuf, un agneau, ou un animal quelconque à garder, et que l''animal meure, se casse un membre, ou soit enlevé, sans que personne l''ait vu,
verses.am: ሰው በባልንጀራው ዘንድ አህያ ወይም በሬ ወይም በግ ወይም ሌላ እንስሳ እንዲጠብቅለት አደራ ቢያኖር፥ ማንም ሳያይ ቢሞት ወይም ቢጎዳ ወይም ቢማረክ፥

verses.en: Then shall an oath of the Lord be between them both, that he hath not put his hand unto his neighbour's goods; and the owner of it shall accept thereof, and he shall not make it good.
verses.fr: le serment au nom de l''Eternel interviendra entre les deux parties, et celui qui a gardé l''animal déclarera qu''il n''a pas mis la main sur le bien de son prochain; le maître de l''animal acceptera ce serment, et l''autre ne sera point tenu à une restitution.
verses.am: በባልንጀራው ከብት ላይ እጁን እንዳልዘረጋ የእግዚአብሔር መሐላ በሁለታቸው መካከል ይሁን፤ የከብቱም ባለቤት መሐላውን ይቀበል፥ እርሱም ምንም አይክፈል።

verses.en: And if it be stolen from him, he shall make restitution unto the owner thereof.
verses.fr: Mais si l''animal a été dérobé chez lui, il sera tenu vis-à-vis de son maître à une restitution.
verses.am: ከእርሱም ዘንድ ቢሰረቅ የጠፋውን ያህል ለባለቤቱ ይመልስ።

verses.en: If it be torn in pieces, then let him bring it for witness, and he shall not make good that which was torn.
verses.fr: Si l''animal a été déchiré, il le produira en témoignage, et il ne sera point tenu à une restitution pour ce qui a été déchiré.
verses.am: ተቧጭሮም ቢገኝ ለምስክር ያምጣው፤ በመቧጨሩም ምክንያት አይክፈል።

verses.en: And if a man borrow ought of his neighbour, and it be hurt, or die, the owner thereof being not with it, he shall surely make it good.
verses.fr: Si un homme emprunte à un autre un animal, et que l''animal se casse un membre ou qu''il meure, en l''absence de son maître, il y aura lieu à restitution.
verses.am: ከባልንጀራው አንዳች ቢዋስ ባለቤቱ ከእርሱ ጋር ሳይኖር ቢጎዳ፥ ወይም ቢሞት፥ ፈጽሞ ይክፈለው።

verses.en: But if the owner thereof be with it, he shall not make it good: if it be an hired thing, it came for his hire.
verses.fr: Si le maître est présent, il n''y aura pas lieu à restitution. Si l''animal a été loué, le prix du louage suffira.
verses.am: ባለቤቱ ግን ከእርሱ ጋር ቢኖር አይክፈል፤ ቢከራየው በክራዩ ይግባ።

verses.en: And if a man entice a maid that is not betrothed, and lie with her, he shall surely endow her to be his wife.
verses.fr: Si un homme séduit une vierge qui n''est point fiancée, et qu''il couche avec elle, il paiera sa dot et la prendra pour femme.
verses.am: ሰው ያልታጨችውን ድንግል ቢያስታት፥ ከእርስዋም ጋር ቢተኛ፥ ማጫዋን ሰጥቶ ሚስት ያድርጋት።

verses.en: If her father utterly refuse to give her unto him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.
verses.fr: Si le père refuse de la lui accorder, il paiera en argent la valeur de la dot des vierges.
verses.am: አባትዋም እርስዋን እንዳይሰጠው ፈጽሞ እንቢ ቢል እንደ ደናግል ማጫ ያህል ብር ይክፈላት።

verses.en: Thou shalt not suffer a witch to live.
verses.fr: Tu ne laisseras point vivre la magicienne.
verses.am: መተተኛይቱን በሕይወት እንድትኖር አትፍቀድላት።

verses.en: Whosoever lieth with a beast shall surely be put to death.
verses.fr: Quiconque couche avec une bête sera puni de mort.
verses.am: ከእንስሳ ጋር የሚረክስ ፈጽሞ ይገደል።

verses.en: He that sacrificeth unto any god, save unto the Lord only, he shall be utterly destroyed.
verses.fr: Celui qui offre des sacrifices à d''autres dieux qu''à l''Eternel seul sera voué à l''extermination.
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔር በቀር ለአንዳች አምላክ የሚሠዋ ፈጽሞ ይጥፋ።

verses.en: Thou shalt neither vex a stranger, nor oppress him: for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: Tu ne maltraiteras point l''étranger, et tu ne l''opprimeras point; car vous avez été étrangers dans le pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: እናንተ በግብፅ ምድር ስደተኞች ነበራችሁና ስደተኛውን አትበድለው፥ ግፍም አታድርግበት።

verses.en: Ye shall not afflict any widow, or fatherless child.
verses.fr: Tu n''affligeras point la veuve, ni l''orphelin.
verses.am: መበለቲቱንና ድሀ አደጎቹን አታስጨንቁአቸው።

verses.en: If thou afflict them in any wise, and they cry at all unto me, I will surely hear their cry;
verses.fr: Si tu les affliges, et qu''ils viennent à moi, j''entendrai leurs cris;
verses.am: ብታስጨንቁአቸውና ወደ እኔ ቢጮኹ እኔ ጩኸታቸውን ፈጽሞ እሰማለሁ፤

verses.en: And my wrath shall wax hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.
verses.fr: ma colère s''enflammera, et je vous détruirai par l''épée; vos femmes deviendront veuves, et vos enfants orphelins.
verses.am: ቍጣዬም ይጸናባችኋል፥ በሰይፍም አስገድላችኋለሁ፤ ሚስቶቻችሁም መበለት፥ ልጆቻችሁም ድሀ አደጎች ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: If thou lend money to any of my people that is poor by thee, thou shalt not be to him as an usurer, neither shalt thou lay upon him usury.
verses.fr: Si tu prêtes de l''argent à mon peuple, au pauvre qui est avec toi, tu ne seras point à son égard comme un créancier, tu n''exigeras de lui point d''intérêt.
verses.am: ከአንተ ጋር ለተቀመጠው ለወገኔ ለድሀው ገንዘብ ብታበድረው፥ እንደ ባለ አራጣ አትሁን፥ አራጣም አትጫንበት።

verses.en: If thou at all take thy neighbour's raiment to pledge, thou shalt deliver it unto him by that the sun goeth down:
verses.fr: Si tu prends en gage le vêtement de ton prochain, tu le lui rendras avant le coucher du soleil;
verses.am: የባልንጀራህን ልብስ ለመያዣ ብትወስድ ፀሐይ ሳትገባ መልስለት፤

verses.en: For that is his covering only, it is his raiment for his skin: wherein shall he sleep? and it shall come to pass, when he crieth unto me, that I will hear; for I am gracious.
verses.fr: car c''est sa seule couverture, c''est le vêtement dont il s''enveloppe le corps: dans quoi coucherait-il? S''il crie à moi, je l''entendrai, car je suis miséricordieux.
verses.am: ሥጋውን የሚከድንበት እርሱ ብቻ ነውና፤ የሚተኛበትም ሌላ የለውምና፤ ወደ እኔም ቢጮኽ መሐሪ ነኝና እሰማዋለሁ።

verses.en: Thou shalt not revile the gods, nor curse the ruler of thy people.
verses.fr: Tu ne maudiras point Dieu, et tu ne maudiras point le prince de ton peuple.
verses.am: ፈራጆችን አትስደብ፥ የሕዝብህንም አለቃ አትርገመው።

verses.en: Thou shalt not delay to offer the first of thy ripe fruits, and of thy liquors: the firstborn of thy sons shalt thou give unto me.
verses.fr: Tu ne différeras point de m''offrir les prémices de ta moisson et de ta vendange. Tu me donneras le premier-né de tes fils.
verses.am: ነዶህንም የወይንህንም ጭማቂ ለማቅረብ አትዘግይ፤ የልጆችህንም በኵር ትሰጠኛለህ።

verses.en: Likewise shalt thou do with thine oxen, and with thy sheep: seven days it shall be with his dam; on the eighth day thou shalt give it me.
verses.fr: Tu me donneras aussi le premier-né de ta vache et de ta brebis; il restera sept jours avec sa mère; le huitième jour, tu me le donneras.
verses.am: እንዲህም በበሬዎችህና በበጎችህ ታደርገዋለህ፤ ሰባት ቀን ከእናቱ ጋር ይቀመጥ፥ በስምንተኛውም ቀን ለእኔ ትሰጠዋለህ።

verses.en: And ye shall be holy men unto me: neither shall ye eat any flesh that is torn of beasts in the field; ye shall cast it to the dogs.
verses.fr: Vous serez pour moi des hommes saints. Vous ne mangerez point de chair déchirée dans les champs: vous la jetterez aux chiens.
verses.am: ቅዱስ ወገን ትሆኑልኛላችሁ፤ ስለዚህ በምድረ በዳ አውሬ የቧጨረውን ሥጋ ለውሻ ጣሉት እንጂ አትብሉት።

verses.en: Thou shalt not raise a false report: put not thine hand with the wicked to be an unrighteous witness.
verses.fr: Tu ne répandras point de faux bruit. Tu ne te joindras point au méchant pour faire un faux témoignage.
verses.am: ሐሰተኛ ወሬ አትቀበል፤ ሐሰተኛ ምስክርም ትሆን ዘንድ ከኃጢአተኛ ጋር እጅህን አታንሣ።

verses.en: Thou shalt not follow a multitude to do evil; neither shalt thou speak in a cause to decline after many to wrest judgment:
verses.fr: Tu ne suivras point la multitude pour faire le mal; et tu ne déposeras point dans un procès en te mettant du côté du grand nombre, pour violer la justice.
verses.am: ክፉውን ለማድረግ ብዙ ሰዎችን አትከተል፤ ፍርድንም ለማጥመም ከብዙ ሰዎች ጋር ተስማምተህ አትመስክር።

verses.en: Neither shalt thou countenance a poor man in his cause.
verses.fr: Tu ne favoriseras point le pauvre dans son procès.
verses.am: በፍርድ ነገርም ለድሀው አታድላ።

verses.en: If thou meet thine enemy's ox or his ass going astray, thou shalt surely bring it back to him again.
verses.fr: Si tu rencontres le boeuf de ton ennemi ou son âne égaré, tu le lui ramèneras.
verses.am: የጠላትህን በሬ ወይም አህያውን ጠፍቶ ብታገኘው በፍጹም መልስለት።

verses.en: If thou see the ass of him that hateth thee lying under his burden, and wouldest forbear to help him, thou shalt surely help with him.
