verses.fr: Si tu vois l''âne de ton ennemi succombant sous sa charge, et que tu hésites à le décharger, tu l''aideras à le décharger.
verses.am: የሚጠላህን ሰው አህያ ከሸክሙ በታች ወድቆ ብታየው አትተወው፥ ነገር ግን ከእርሱ ጋር አንሣው።

verses.en: Thou shalt not wrest the judgment of thy poor in his cause.
verses.fr: Tu ne porteras point atteinte au droit du pauvre dans son procès.
verses.am: በሚምዋገትበት ጊዜ የድሀህን ፍርድ አታጥምም።

verses.en: Keep thee far from a false matter; and the innocent and righteous slay thou not: for I will not justify the wicked.
verses.fr: Tu ne prononceras point de sentence inique, et tu ne feras point mourir l''innocent et le juste; car je n''absoudrai point le coupable.
verses.am: ከሐሰት ነገር ራቅ፤ እኔ ኃጢአተኛውን አላጸድቅምና ንጹሕንና ጻድቅን አትግደል።

verses.en: And thou shalt take no gift: for the gift blindeth the wise, and perverteth the words of the righteous.
verses.fr: Tu ne recevras point de présent; car les présents aveuglent ceux qui ont les yeux ouverts et corrompent les paroles des justes.
verses.am: ማማለጃን አትቀበል፤ ማማለጃ የዓይናማዎችን ሰዎች ዓይን ያሳውራልና፥ የጻድቃንንም ቃል ያጣምማልና።

verses.en: Also thou shalt not oppress a stranger: for ye know the heart of a stranger, seeing ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: Tu n''opprimeras point l''étranger; vous savez ce qu''éprouve l''étranger, car vous avez été étrangers dans le pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: በስደተኛው ግፍ አታድርጉ፤ እናንተ በግብፅ ምድር ስደተኞች ስለ ነበራችሁ የስደተኛ ነፍስ እንዴት እንደ ሆነች አውቃችኋልና።

verses.en: And six years thou shalt sow thy land, and shalt gather in the fruits thereof:
verses.fr: Pendant six années, tu ensemenceras la terre, et tu en recueilleras le produit.
verses.am: ስድስት ዓመት ምድርህን ዝራ፥ ፍሬዋንም አግባ፤

verses.en: But the seventh year thou shalt let it rest and lie still; that the poor of thy people may eat: and what they leave the beasts of the field shall eat. In like manner thou shalt deal with thy vineyard, and with thy oliveyard.
verses.fr: Mais la septième, tu lui donneras du relâche et tu la laisseras en repos; les pauvres de ton peuple en jouiront, et les bêtes des champs mangeront ce qui restera. Tu feras de même pour ta vigne et pour tes oliviers.
verses.am: በሰባተኛው ዓመት ግን ተዋት አሳርፋትም፤ የሕዝብህም ድሆች ይበሉታል፤ ያስቀሩትንም የሜዳ እንስሳ ይብላው። እንዲሁም በወይንህና በወይራህ አድርግ።

verses.en: Six days thou shalt do thy work, and on the seventh day thou shalt rest: that thine ox and thine ass may rest, and the son of thy handmaid, and the stranger, may be refreshed.
verses.fr: Pendant six jours, tu feras ton ouvrage. Mais le septième jour, tu te reposeras, afin que ton boeuf et ton âne aient du repos, afin que le fils de ton esclave et l''étranger aient du relâche.
verses.am: ስድስት ቀን ሥራህን ሥራ፤ በሬህና አህያህ ያርፉ ዘንድ ለባሪያህም ልጅ ለመጻተኛውም ዕረፍት ይሆን ዘንድ በሰባተኛው ቀን ዕረፍ።

verses.en: And in all things that I have said unto you be circumspect: and make no mention of the name of other gods, neither let it be heard out of thy mouth.
verses.fr: Vous observerez tout ce que je vous ai dit, et vous ne prononcerez point le nom d''autres dieux: qu''on ne l''entende point sortir de votre bouche.
verses.am: ያልኋችሁንም ነገር ሁሉ ጠብቁ፤ የሌሎችንም አማልክት ስም አትጥሩ፥ ከአፋችሁም አይሰማ።

verses.en: Three times thou shalt keep a feast unto me in the year.
verses.fr: Trois fois par année, tu célébreras des fêtes en mon honneur.
verses.am: በዓመት ሦስት ጊዜ በዓል ታደርግልኛለህ።

verses.en: Thou shalt keep the feast of unleavened bread: (thou shalt eat unleavened bread seven days, as I commanded thee, in the time appointed of the month Abib; for in it thou camest out from Egypt: and none shall appear before me empty:)
verses.fr: Tu observeras la fête des pains sans levain; pendant sept jours, au temps fixé dans le mois des épis, tu mangeras des pains sans levain, comme je t''en ai donné l''ordre, car c''est dans ce mois que tu es sorti d''Egypte; et l''on ne se présentera point à vide devant ma face.
verses.am: የቂጣውን በዓል ጠብቅ፤ በአቢብ ወር ከግብፅ ምድር ወጥታችኋልና በዚህ ወር እንዳዘዝሁህ ሰባት ቀን ቂጣ እንጀራ ትበላለህ፤ በፊቴም ባዶ እጃችሁን አትታዩ።

verses.en: And the feast of harvest, the firstfruits of thy labours, which thou hast sown in the field: and the feast of ingathering, which is in the end of the year, when thou hast gathered in thy labours out of the field.
verses.fr: Tu observeras la fête de la moisson, des prémices de ton travail, de ce que tu auras semé dans les champs; et la fête de la récolte, à la fin de l''année, quand tu recueilleras des champs le fruit de ton travail.
verses.am: በእርሻም የምትዘራትን የፍሬህን በኵራት የመከር በዓል፥ ዓመቱም ሳያልቅ ፍሬህን ከእርሻ ባከማቸህ ጊዜ የመክተቻውን በዓል ጠብቅ።

verses.en: Three times in the year all thy males shall appear before the Lord God.
verses.fr: Trois fois par année, tous les mâles se présenteront devant le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: በዓመት ሦስት ጊዜ በአንተ ዘንድ ያለው ወንድ ሁሉ በጌታ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ይታይ።

verses.en: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread; neither shall the fat of my sacrifice remain until the morning.
verses.fr: Tu n''offriras point avec du pain levé le sang de la victime sacrifiée en mon honneur; et sa graisse ne sera point gardée pendant la nuit jusqu''au matin.
verses.am: የመሥዋዕቴን ደም ከቦካ እንጀራ ጋር አትሠዋ፤ የበዓሌም ስብ እስኪነጋ አይደር።

verses.en: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring into the house of the Lord thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother's milk.
verses.fr: Tu apporteras à la maison de l''Eternel, ton Dieu, les prémices des premiers fruits de la terre. Tu ne feras point cuire un chevreau dans le lait de sa mère.
verses.am: የተመረጠውን የምድርህን ፍሬ በኵራት ወደ አምላክህ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት አምጣ። ጠቦትን በእናቱ ወተት አትቀቅል።

verses.en: Behold, I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared.
verses.fr: Voici, j''envoie un ange devant toi, pour te protéger en chemin, et pour te faire arriver au lieu que j''ai préparé.
verses.am: በመንገድ ይጠብቅህ ዘንድ ወዳዘጋጀሁትም ስፍራ ያገባህ ዘንድ፥ እነሆ፥ እኔ መልአክን በፊትህ እሰድዳለሁ።

verses.en: Beware of him, and obey his voice, provoke him not; for he will not pardon your transgressions: for my name is in him.
verses.fr: Tiens-toi sur tes gardes en sa présence, et écoute sa voix; ne lui résiste point, parce qu''il ne pardonnera pas vos péchés, car mon nom est en lui.
verses.am: በፊቱ ተጠንቀቁ፥ ቃሉንም አድምጡ፤ ስሜም በእርሱ ስለ ሆነ ኃጢአት ብትሠሩ ይቅር አይልምና አታስመርሩት።

verses.en: But if thou shalt indeed obey his voice, and do all that I speak; then I will be an enemy unto thine enemies, and an adversary unto thine adversaries.
verses.fr: Mais si tu écoutes sa voix, et si tu fais tout ce que je te dirai, je serai l''ennemi de tes ennemis et l''adversaire de tes adversaires.
verses.am: አንተ ግን ቃሉን ብትሰማ፥ ያልሁህንም ሁሉ ብታደርግ፥ ጠላቶችህን እጣላቸዋለሁ፥ የሚያስጨንቁህንም አስጨንቃቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: For mine Angel shall go before thee, and bring thee in unto the Amorites, and the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites: and I will cut them off.
verses.fr: Mon ange marchera devant toi, et te conduira chez les Amoréens, les Héthiens, les Phéréziens, les Cananéens, les Héviens et les Jébusiens, et je les exterminerai.
verses.am: መልአኬ በፊትህ ይሄዳልና፥ ወደ አሞራውያንም ወደ ኬጢያውያንም ወደ ፌርዛውያንም ወደ ከነዓናውያንም ወደ ኤዊያውያንም ወደ ኢያቡሳውያንም ያገባሃል፤ እኔም አጠፋቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: Thou shalt not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor do after their works: but thou shalt utterly overthrow them, and quite break down their images.
verses.fr: Tu ne te prosterneras point devant leurs dieux, et tu ne les serviras point; tu n''imiteras point ces peuples dans leur conduite, mais tu les détruiras, et tu briseras leurs statues.
verses.am: ለአማልክቶቻቸው አትስገድ፥ አታምልካቸውም፤ እንደ ሥራቸውም አትሥራ፤ ነገር ግን ፈጽመህ አፍርሳቸው፥ ሐውልቶቻቸውንም ሰባብራቸው።

verses.en: And ye shall serve the Lord your God, and he shall bless thy bread, and thy water; and I will take sickness away from the midst of thee.
verses.fr: Vous servirez l''Eternel, votre Dieu, et il bénira votre pain et vos eaux, et j''éloignerai la maladie du milieu de toi.
verses.am: አምላካችሁንም እግዚአብሔርን ታመልኩታላችሁ፥ እርሱም እህልህንና ውኃህን ይባርካል፤ በሽታንም ከመካከልህ አርቃለሁ።

verses.en: There shall nothing cast their young, nor be barren, in thy land: the number of thy days I will fulfil.
verses.fr: Il n''y aura dans ton pays ni femme qui avorte, ni femme stérile. Je remplirai le nombre de tes jours.
verses.am: በምድርህም መካን ወይም የምትጨነግፍ አትሆንም፤ የዘመንህን ቍጥር እሞላለሁ።

verses.en: I will send my fear before thee, and will destroy all the people to whom thou shalt come, and I will make all thine enemies turn their backs unto thee.
verses.fr: J''enverrai ma terreur devant toi, je mettrai en déroute tous les peuples chez lesquels tu arriveras, et je ferai tourner le dos devant toi à tous tes ennemis.
verses.am: መፈራቴንም በፊትህ እሰድዳለሁ፥ የምትሄድበትንም ሕዝብ ሁሉ አስደነግጣቸዋለሁ፥ ጠላቶችህንም ሁሉ በፊትህ ጀርባቸውን እንዲያዞሩ አደርጋለሁ።

verses.en: And I will send hornets before thee, which shall drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before thee.
verses.fr: J''enverrai les frelons devant toi, et ils chasseront loin de ta face les Héviens, les Cananéens et les Héthiens.
verses.am: በፊትህም ተርብ እሰድዳለሁ፥ ኤዊያዊውንም ከነዓናዊውንም ኬጢያዊውንም ከፊትህ አባርራለሁ።

verses.en: I will not drive them out from before thee in one year; lest the land become desolate, and the beast of the field multiply against thee.
verses.fr: Je ne les chasserai pas en une seule année loin de ta face, de peur que le pays ne devienne un désert et que les bêtes des champs ne se multiplient contre toi.
verses.am: ምድር ባድማ እንዳትሆን፥ የምድር አራዊትም እንዳይበዙብህ፥ በአንድ ዓመት ከፊታችሁ አላባርራቸውም።

verses.en: By little and little I will drive them out from before thee, until thou be increased, and inherit the land.
verses.fr: Je les chasserai peu à peu loin de ta face, jusqu''à ce que tu augmentes en nombre et que tu puisses prendre possession du pays.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እስክትበዛ ምድርንም እስክትወርስ ድረስ በጥቂት በጥቂት አባርራቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: And I will set thy bounds from the Red sea even unto the sea of the Philistines, and from the desert unto the river: for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand; and thou shalt drive them out before thee.
verses.fr: J''établirai tes limites depuis la mer Rouge jusqu''à la mer des Philistins, et depuis le désert jusqu''au fleuve; car je livrerai entre vos mains les habitants du pays, et tu les chasseras devant toi.
verses.am: ድንበርህንም ከኤርትራ ባሕር እስከ ፍልስጥኤም ባሕር፥ ከምድረ በዳም እስከ ወንዙ ድረስ አደርጋለሁ፤ በምድር የሚኖሩትን በእጅህ እጥላለሁና፤ ከፊትህም ታባርራቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: Thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.
verses.fr: Tu ne feras point d''alliance avec eux, ni avec leurs dieux.
verses.am: ከእነርሱና ከአማልክቶቻቸው ጋር ቃል ኪዳን አታድርግ።

verses.en: They shall not dwell in thy land, lest they make thee sin against me: for if thou serve their gods, it will surely be a snare unto thee.
verses.fr: Ils n''habiteront point dans ton pays, de peur qu''ils ne te fassent pécher contre moi; car tu servirais leurs dieux, et ce serait un piège pour toi.
verses.am: አማልክቶቻቸውንም ብታመልክ ወጥመድ ይሆኑብሃልና እኔን እንድትበድል እንዳያደርጉህ በአገርህ አይቀመጡ።

verses.en: And he said unto Moses, Come up unto the Lord, thou, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship ye afar off.
verses.fr: Dieu dit à Moïse: Monte vers l''Eternel, toi et Aaron, Nadab et Abihu, et soixante-dix des anciens d''Israël, et vous vous prosternerez de loin.
verses.am: ሙሴንም። አንተ አሮንም ናዳብም አብዩድም ከእስራኤልም ሰባ ሽማግሌዎች ወደ እግዚአብሔር ውጡ፥ በሩቁም ስገዱ፤

verses.en: And Moses alone shall come near the Lord: but they shall not come nigh; neither shall the people go up with him.
verses.fr: Moïse s''approchera seul de l''Eternel; les autres ne s''approcheront pas, et le peuple ne montera point avec lui.
verses.am: ሙሴም ብቻውን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ይቅረብ፥ እነርሱ ግን አይቅረቡ፤ ሕዝቡም ከእርሱ ጋር አይውጡ አለው።

verses.en: And Moses came and told the people all the words of the Lord, and all the judgments: and all the people answered with one voice, and said, All the words which the Lord hath said will we do.
verses.fr: Moïse vint rapporter au peuple toutes les paroles de l''Eternel et toutes les lois. Le peuple entier répondit d''une même voix: Nous ferons tout ce que l''Eternel a dit.
verses.am: ሙሴም መጣ ለሕዝቡም የእግዚአብሔርን ቃሎች ሁሉ ሥርዓቱንም ሁሉ ነገረ፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ በአንድ ድምፅ። እግዚአብሔር የተናገራቸውን ቃሎች ሁሉ እናደርጋለን ብለው መለሱ።

verses.en: And Moses wrote all the words of the Lord, and rose up early in the morning, and builded an altar under the hill, and twelve pillars, according to the twelve tribes of Israel.
verses.fr: Moïse écrivit toutes les paroles de l''Eternel. Puis il se leva de bon matin; il bâtit un autel au pied de la montagne, et dressa douze pierres pour les douze tribus d''Israël.
verses.am: ሙሴም የእግዚአብሔርን ቃሎች ጻፈ፤ ማለዳም ተነሣ፥ ከተራራውም በታች መሠዊያን፥ አሥራ ሁለትም ሐውልቶች ለአሥራ ሁለቱ የእስራኤል ነገድ ሠራ።

verses.en: And he sent young men of the children of Israel, which offered burnt offerings, and sacrificed peace offerings of oxen unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Il envoya des jeunes hommes, enfants d''Israël, pour offrir à l''Eternel des holocaustes, et immoler des taureaux en sacrifices d''actions de grâces.
verses.am: የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት እንዲያቀርቡ፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም ስለ ደኅንነት መሥዋዕት በሬዎችን እንዲሠዉ የእስራኤልን ልጆች ጐበዛዝት ሰደደ።

verses.en: And Moses took half of the blood, and put it in basons; and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.
verses.fr: Moïse prit la moitié du sang, qu''il mit dans des bassins, et il répandit l''autre moitié sur l''autel.
verses.am: ሙሴም የደሙን እኵሌታ ወስዶ በቆሬ ውስጥ አደረገው፤ የደሙንም እኵሌታ በመሠዊያው ረጨው።

verses.en: And he took the book of the covenant, and read in the audience of the people: and they said, All that the Lord hath said will we do, and be obedient.
verses.fr: Il prit le livre de l''alliance, et le lut en présence du peuple; ils dirent: Nous ferons tout ce que l''Eternel a dit, et nous obéirons.
verses.am: የቃል ኪዳኑንም መጽሐፍ ወስዶ ለሕዝቡ አነበበላቸው፤ እነርሱም። እግዚአብሔር ያለውን ሁሉ እናደርጋለን እንታዘዛለንም አሉ።

verses.en: And Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, Behold the blood of the covenant, which the Lord hath made with you concerning all these words.
verses.fr: Moïse prit le sang, et il le répandit sur le peuple, en disant: Voici le sang de l''alliance que l''Eternel a faite avec vous selon toutes ces paroles.
verses.am: ሙሴም ደሙን ውስዶ በሕዝቡ ላይ ረጨው። በዚህ ቃል ሁሉ እግዚአብሔር ከእናንተ ጋር ያደረገው የቃል ኪዳኑ ደም እነሆ አለ።

verses.en: Then went up Moses, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel:
verses.fr: Moïse monta avec Aaron, Nadab et Abihu, et soixante-dix anciens d''Israël.
verses.am: ሙሴም አሮንም ናዳብም አብዩድም ከእስራኤልም ሰባ ሽማግሌዎች ወጡ፤

verses.en: And they saw the God of Israel: and there was under his feet as it were a paved work of a sapphire stone, and as it were the body of heaven in his clearness.
verses.fr: Ils virent le Dieu d''Israël; sous ses pieds, c''était comme un ouvrage de saphir transparent, comme le ciel lui-même dans sa pureté.
verses.am: የእስራኤልንም አምላክ አዩ፤ ከእግሩም በታች እንደ ሰማይ መልክ የሚያበራ እንደ ብሩህ ሰንፔር ድንጋይ የሚመስል ወለል ነበረ።

verses.en: And upon the nobles of the children of Israel he laid not his hand: also they saw God, and did eat and drink.
verses.fr: Il n''étendit point sa main sur l''élite des enfants d''Israël. Ils virent Dieu, et ils mangèrent et burent.
verses.am: እጁንም በእስራኤል አዛውንቶች ላይ አልዘረጋም፤ እነርሱም እግዚአብሔርን አዩ፥ በሉም ጠጡም።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Come up to me into the mount, and be there: and I will give thee tables of stone, and a law, and commandments which I have written; that thou mayest teach them.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse: Monte vers moi sur la montagne, et reste là; je te donnerai des tables de pierre, la loi et les ordonnances que j''ai écrites pour leur instruction.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። ወደ እኔ ወደ ተራራው ውጣ፥ በዚያም ሁን፤ እነርሱን ታስተምር ዘንድ እኔ የጻፍሁትን ሕግና ትእዛዝ የድንጋይም ጽላት እሰጥሃለሁ አለው።

verses.en: And Moses rose up, and his minister Joshua: and Moses went up into the mount of God.
verses.fr: Moïse se leva, avec Josué qui le servait, et Moïse monta sur la montagne de Dieu.
verses.am: ሙሴና ሎሌው ኢያሱ ተነሡ፤ ሙሴም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ተራራ ወጣ።

verses.en: And he said unto the elders, Tarry ye here for us, until we come again unto you: and, behold, Aaron and Hur are with you: if any man have any matters to do, let him come unto them.
verses.fr: Il dit aux anciens: Attendez-nous ici, jusqu''à ce que nous revenions auprès de vous. Voici, Aaron et Hur resteront avec vous; si quelqu''un a un différend, c''est à eux qu''il s''adressera.
verses.am: ሽማግሌዎችንም። ወደ እናንተ እስክንመለስ ድረስ በዚህ ቆዩን፤ አሮንና ሖርም እነሆ ከእናንተ ጋር ናቸው፥ ነገረተኛም ቢኖር ወደ እነርሱ ይምጣ አላቸው።

verses.en: And Moses went up into the mount, and a cloud covered the mount.
verses.fr: Moïse monta sur la montagne, et la nuée couvrit la montagne.
verses.am: ሙሴም ወደ ተራራ ወጣ፥ ደመናውም ተራራውን ሸፈነው።

verses.en: And the glory of the Lord abode upon mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days: and the seventh day he called unto Moses out of the midst of the cloud.
verses.fr: La gloire de l''Eternel reposa sur la montagne de Sinaï, et la nuée la couvrit pendant six jours. Le septième jour, l''Eternel appela Moïse du milieu de la nuée.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር በሲና ተራራ ላይ ተቀመጠ፥ ደመናውም ስድስት ቀን ሸፈነው፤ በሰባተኛውም ቀን ከደመናው ውስጥ ሙሴን ጠራው።

verses.en: And the sight of the glory of the Lord was like devouring fire on the top of the mount in the eyes of the children of Israel.
verses.fr: L''aspect de la gloire de l''Eternel était comme un feu dévorant sur le sommet de la montagne, aux yeux des enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: በተራራው ራስ ላይ በእስራኤል ልጆች ፊት የእግዚአብሔር ክብር መታየት እንደሚያቃጥል እሳት ነበረ።

verses.en: And Moses went into the midst of the cloud, and gat him up into the mount: and Moses was in the mount forty days and forty nights.
verses.fr: Moïse entra au milieu de la nuée, et il monta sur la montagne. Moïse demeura sur la montagne quarante jours et quarante nuits.
verses.am: ሙሴም ወደ ደመናው ውስጥ ገባ ወደ ተራራውም ወጣ፤ ሙሴም በተራራው ላይ አርባ ቀን አርባ ሌሊትም ቆየ።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ሲል ተናገረው።

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring me an offering: of every man that giveth it willingly with his heart ye shall take my offering.
verses.fr: Parle aux enfants d''Israël. Qu''ils m''apportent une offrande; vous la recevrez pour moi de tout homme qui la fera de bon coeur.
verses.am: ስጦታ ያመጡልኝ ዘንድ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ተናገር፤ በገዛ እጁ ሊሰጠኝ በልቡ ከሚያምረው ሰው ሁሉ መባ ተቀበሉ።

verses.en: And this is the offering which ye shall take of them; gold, and silver, and brass,
verses.fr: Voici ce que vous recevrez d''eux en offrande: de l''or, de l''argent et de l''airain;
verses.am: ከእነርሱም የምትቀበሉት መባ ይህ ነው፤

verses.en: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats' hair,
verses.fr: des étoffes teintes en bleu, en pourpre, en cramoisi, du fin lin et du poil de chèvre;
verses.am: ወርቅ፥ ብር፥ ናስም፥ ሰማያዊና ሐምራዊ ቀይም ግምጃ፥ ጥሩ በፍታም፥

verses.en: And rams' skins dyed red, and badgers' skins, and shittim wood,
verses.fr: des peaux de béliers teintes en rouge et des peaux de dauphins; du bois d''acacia;
verses.am: የፍየልም ጠጕር፥ ቀይ የአውራ በግ ቁርበት፥ የአቆስጣ ቁርበት፥ የግራርም እንጨት፥

verses.en: Oil for the light, spices for anointing oil, and for sweet incense,
verses.fr: de l''huile pour le chandelier, des aromates pour l''huile d''onction et pour le parfum odoriférant;
verses.am: የመብራትም ዘይት፥ ለቅብዓት ዘይትና ለጣፋጭ ዕጣን ቅመም፥

verses.en: Onyx stones, and stones to be set in the ephod, and in the breastplate.
verses.fr: des pierres d''onyx et d''autres pierres pour la garniture de l''éphod et du pectoral.
verses.am: መረግድም፥ ለኤፉድና ለደረት ኪስ የሚደረግ ፈርጥ።

verses.en: And let them make me a sanctuary; that I may dwell among them.
verses.fr: Ils me feront un sanctuaire, et j''habiterai au milieu d''eux.
verses.am: በመካከላቸውም አድር ዘንድ መቅደስ ይሥሩልኝ።

verses.en: According to all that I shew thee, after the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all the instruments thereof, even so shall ye make it.
verses.fr: Vous ferez le tabernacle et tous ses ustensiles d''après le modèle que je vais te montrer.
verses.am: እኔ እንደማሳይህ ሁሉ፥ እንደ ማደሪያው ምሳሌ እንደ ዕቃውም ሁሉ ምሳሌ፥ እንዲሁ ሥሩት።

verses.en: And they shall make an ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
verses.fr: Ils feront une arche de bois d''acacia, sa longueur sera de deux coudées et demie, sa largeur d''une coudée et demie, et sa hauteur d''une coudée et demie.
verses.am: ከግራር እንጨትም ታቦትን ይሥሩ፤ ርዝመቱ ሁለት ክንድ ተኩል፥ ወርዱም አንድ ክንድ ተኩል፥ ቁመቱም አንድ ክንድ ተኩል ይሁን።

verses.en: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, within and without shalt thou overlay it, and shalt make upon it a crown of gold round about.
verses.fr: Tu la couvriras d''or pur, tu la couvriras en dedans et en dehors, et tu y feras une bordure d''or tout autour.
verses.am: በውስጥና በውጭም በጥሩ ወርቅ ለብጠው፤ በእርሱም ላይ በዙሪያው የወርቅ አክሊል አድርግለት።

verses.en: And thou shalt cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in the four corners thereof; and two rings shall be in the one side of it, and two rings in the other side of it.
verses.fr: Tu fondras pour elle quatre anneaux d''or, et tu les mettras à ses quatre coins, deux anneaux d''un côté et deux anneaux de l''autre côté.
verses.am: አራት የወርቅ ቀለበቶችም አድርግለት፥ እነርሱንም በአራቱ እግሮቹ ላይ አኑር፤ በአንድ ወገን ሁለት ቀለበቶች፥ በሌላው ወገን ሁለት ቀለበቶች ይሁኑ።

verses.en: And thou shalt make staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.
verses.fr: Tu feras des barres de bois d''acacia, et tu les couvriras d''or.
verses.am: መሎጊያዎችንም ከግራር እንጨት ሥራ፥ በወርቅም ለብጣቸው።

verses.en: And thou shalt put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, that the ark may be borne with them.
verses.fr: Tu passeras les barres dans les anneaux sur les côtés de l''arche, pour qu''elles servent à porter l''arche;
verses.am: ለታቦቱ መሸከሚያ በታቦቱ ጐን ባሉት ቀለበቶች መሎጊያዎቹን አግባ።

verses.en: The staves shall be in the rings of the ark: they shall not be taken from it.
verses.fr: les barres resteront dans les anneaux de l''arche, et n''en seront point retirées.
verses.am: መሎጊያዎቹም በታቦቱ ቀለበቶች ውስጥ ይኑሩ፥ ከቶም አይውጡ።

verses.en: And thou shalt put into the ark the testimony which I shall give thee.
verses.fr: Tu mettras dans l''arche le témoignage, que je te donnerai.
verses.am: በታቦቱም ውስጥ እኔ የምሰጥህን ምስክር ታስቀምጣለህ።

verses.en: And thou shalt make a mercy seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof.
verses.fr: Tu feras un propitiatoire d''or pur; sa longueur sera de deux coudées et demie, et sa largeur d''une coudée et demie.
verses.am: ከጥሩ ወርቅም ርዝመቱ ሁለት ክንድ ተኩል፥ ወርዱም አንድ ክንድ ተኩል የሆነ የስርየት መክደኛ ሥራ።

verses.en: And thou shalt make two cherubims of gold, of beaten work shalt thou make them, in the two ends of the mercy seat.
verses.fr: Tu feras deux chérubins d''or, tu les feras d''or battu, aux deux extrémités du propitiatoire;
verses.am: ሁለት ኪሩቤል ከተቀጠቀጠ ወርቅ ሥራ፥ በስርየት መክደኛውም ላይ በሁለት ወገን ታደርጋቸዋለህ።

verses.en: And make one cherub on the one end, and the other cherub on the other end: even of the mercy seat shall ye make the cherubims on the two ends thereof.
verses.fr: fais un chérubin à l''une des extrémités et un chérubin à l''autre extrémité; vous ferez les chérubins sortant du propitiatoire à ses deux extrémités.
verses.am: ከስርየት መክደኛውም ጋር አንዱን ኪሩብ በአንድ ወገን፥ ሁለተኛውንም ኪሩብ በሌላው ወገን አድርገህ በአንድ ላይ ትሠራዋለህ።

verses.en: And the cherubims shall stretch forth their wings on high, covering the mercy seat with their wings, and their faces shall look one to another; toward the mercy seat shall the faces of the cherubims be.
verses.fr: Les chérubins étendront les ailes par-dessus, couvrant de leurs ailes le propitiatoire, et se faisant face l''un à l''autre; les chérubins auront la face tournée vers le propitiatoire.
verses.am: ኪሩቤልም ክንፎቻቸውን ወደ ላይ ይዘረጋሉ፥ የስርየት መክደኛውንም በክንፎቻቸው ይሸፍናሉ፥ ፊታቸውም እርስ በርሱ ይተያያል፤ የኪሩቤልም ፊቶቻቸው ወደ ስርየት መክደኛው ይመለከታሉ።

verses.en: And thou shalt put the mercy seat above upon the ark; and in the ark thou shalt put the testimony that I shall give thee.
verses.fr: Tu mettras le propitiatoire sur l''arche, et tu mettras dans l''arche le témoignage, que je te donnerai.
verses.am: የስርየት መክደኛውንም በታቦቱ ላይ ታደርገዋለህ፤ እኔም የምሰጥህን ምስክር በታቦቱ ውስጥ ታኖረዋለህ።

verses.en: And there I will meet with thee, and I will commune with thee from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubims which are upon the ark of the testimony, of all things which I will give thee in commandment unto the children of Israel.
verses.fr: C''est là que je me rencontrerai avec toi; du haut du propitiatoire, entre les deux chérubins placés sur l''arche du témoignage, je te donnerai tous mes ordres pour les enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: በዚያም ከአንተ ጋር እገናኛለሁ፤ የእስራኤልንም ልጆች ታዝዝ ዘንድ የምሰጥህን ነገር ሁሉ፥ በምስክሩ ታቦት ላይ ባለው በሁለት ኪሩቤል መካከል፥ በስርየት መክደኛውም ላይ ሆኜ እነጋገርሃለሁ።

verses.en: Thou shalt also make a table of shittim wood: two cubits shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
verses.fr: Tu feras une table de bois d''acacia; sa longueur sera de deux coudées, sa largeur d''une coudée, et sa hauteur d''une coudée et demie.
verses.am: ርዝመቱም ሁለት ክንድ፥ ወርዱም አንድ ክንድ፥ ቁመቱ አንድ ክንድ ተኩል የሆነ ገበታ ከግራር እንጨት ሥራ።

verses.en: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, and make thereto a crown of gold round about.
verses.fr: Tu la couvriras d''or pur, et tu y feras une bordure d''or tout autour.
verses.am: በጥሩም ወርቅ ትለብጠዋለህ፤ በዙሪያውም የወርቅ አክሊል አድርግለት፤

verses.en: And thou shalt make unto it a border of an hand breadth round about, and thou shalt make a golden crown to the border thereof round about.
verses.fr: Tu y feras à l''entour un rebord de quatre doigts, sur lequel tu mettras une bordure d''or tout autour.
verses.am: በዙሪያውም አንድ ጋት የሚያህል ክፈፍ አድርግለት፤ የወርቅም አክሊል በክፈፉ ዙሪያ አድርግለት።

verses.en: And thou shalt make for it four rings of gold, and put the rings in the four corners that are on the four feet thereof.
verses.fr: Tu feras pour la table quatre anneaux d''or, et tu mettras les anneaux aux quatre coins, qui seront à ses quatre pieds.
verses.am: አራትም የወርቅ ቀለበቶች አድርግለት፤ ቀለበቶቹንም አራቱ እግሮቹ ባሉበት በአራቱ ማዕዘኖች አድርግ።

verses.en: Over against the border shall the rings be for places of the staves to bear the table.
verses.fr: Les anneaux seront près du rebord, et recevront les barres pour porter la table.
verses.am: ገበታውንም ለመሸከም መሎጊያዎቹ እንዲሰኩባቸው ቀለበቶቹ በክፈፉ አቅራቢያ ይሁኑ።

verses.en: And thou shalt make the staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be borne with them.
verses.fr: Tu feras les barres de bois d''acacia, et tu les couvriras d''or; et elles serviront à porter la table.
verses.am: ገበታውን ይሸከሙባቸው ዘንድ መሎጊያዎቹን ከግራር እንጨት ሠርተህ በወርቅ ለብጣቸው።

verses.en: And thou shalt make the dishes thereof, and spoons thereof, and covers thereof, and bowls thereof, to cover withal: of pure gold shalt thou make them.
verses.fr: Tu feras ses plats, ses coupes, ses calices et ses tasses, pour servir aux libations; tu les feras d''or pur.
verses.am: ለማፍሰሻም ይሆኑ ዘንድ ወጭቶችዋን ጭልፋዎችዋንም መቅጃዎችዋንም ጽዋዎችዋንም አድርግ፤ እነርሱንም ከጥሩ ወርቅ አድርጋቸው።

verses.en: And thou shalt set upon the table shewbread before me alway.
verses.fr: Tu mettras sur la table les pains de proposition continuellement devant ma face.
verses.am: በገበታም ላይ የገጽ ኅብስት ሁልጊዜ በፊቴ ታደርጋለህ።

verses.en: And thou shalt make a candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work shall the candlestick be made: his shaft, and his branches, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, shall be of the same.
verses.fr: Tu feras un chandelier d''or pur; ce chandelier sera fait d''or battu; son pied, sa tige, ses calices, ses pommes et ses fleurs seront d''une même pièce.
verses.am: መቅረዝንም ከጥሩ ወርቅ አድርግ፤ መቅረዙ ከእግሩና ከአገዳው ጋር በተቀጠቀጠ ሥራ ይደረግ፤ ጽዋዎቹም ጕብጕቦቹም አበቦቹም አንድነት በእርሱ ይደረጉበት።

verses.en: And six branches shall come out of the sides of it; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side:
verses.fr: Six branches sortiront de ses côtés, trois branches du chandelier de l''un des côtés, et trois branches du chandelier de l''autre côté.
verses.am: በስተጎኑ ስድስት ቅርንጫፎች ይውጡለት፤ ሦስት የመቅረዙ ቅርንጫፎች በአንድ ወገን፥ ሦስትም የመቅረዙ ቅርንጫፎች በሌላ ወገን ይውጡ።

verses.en: Three bowls made like unto almonds, with a knop and a flower in one branch; and three bowls made like almonds in the other branch, with a knop and a flower: so in the six branches that come out of the candlestick.
verses.fr: Il y aura sur une branche trois calices en forme d''amande, avec pommes et fleurs, et sur une autre branche trois calices en forme d''amande, avec pommes et fleurs; il en sera de même pour les six branches sortant du chandelier.
verses.am: በአንደኛውም ቅርንጫፍ ጕብጕብና አበባ ሦስትም የለውዝ አበባ የሚመስሉትን ጽዋዎች፥ በሁለተኛውም ቅርንጫፍ ጕብጕብና አበባ ሦስትም የለውዝ አበባ የሚመስሉትን ጽዋዎች፤ እንዲሁም ከመቅረዙ ለሚወጡ ለስድስቱ ቅርንጫፎች አድርግ።

verses.en: And in the candlesticks shall be four bowls made like unto almonds, with their knops and their flowers.
verses.fr: A la tige du chandelier, il y aura quatre calices en forme d''amande, avec leurs pommes et leurs fleurs.
verses.am: በመቅረዙም ጕብጕቦቹንና አበቦቹን አራትም የለውዝ አበባ የሚመስሉትን ጽዋዎች አድርግ።

verses.en: And there shall be a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches that proceed out of the candlestick.
verses.fr: Il y aura une pomme sous deux des branches sortant de la tige du chandelier, une pomme sous deux autres branches, et une pomme sous deux autres branches; il en sera de même pour les six branches sortant du chandelier.
verses.am: ከመቅረዙ ለሚወጡ ለስድስቱ ቅርንጫፎች ከሁለት ቅርንጫፎች በታች አንድ ሆኖ የተሠራ አንድ ጕብጕብ፥ ከሁለትም ቅርንጫፎች በታች አንድ ሆኖ የተሠራ አንድ ጕብጕብ፥ ደግሞ ከሁለት ቅርንጫፎች በታች አንድ ሆኖ የተሠራ አንድ ጕብጕብ ይሁን።

verses.en: Their knops and their branches shall be of the same: all it shall be one beaten work of pure gold.
verses.fr: Les pommes et les branches du chandelier seront d''une même pièce: il sera tout entier d''or battu, d''or pur.
verses.am: ጕብጕቦቹና ቅርንጫፎቹ ሁሉ ከእርሱ ጋር አንድ ይሁኑ፤ ሁሉም አንድ ሆኖ ከተቀረጸ ከጥሩ ወርቅ ይደረግ።

verses.en: And thou shalt make the seven lamps thereof: and they shall light the lamps thereof, that they may give light over against it.
verses.fr: Tu feras ses sept lampes, qui seront placées dessus, de manière à éclairer en face.
verses.am: ሰባቱንም መብራቶች ሥራ፤ በፊቱ ያበሩ ዘንድ መብራቶቹን ያቀጣጥሉአቸዋል።

verses.en: And the tongs thereof, and the snuffdishes thereof, shall be of pure gold.
verses.fr: Ses mouchettes et ses vases à cendre seront d''or pur.
verses.am: መኰስተሪያዎችዋን የኵስታሪ ማድረጊያዎችዋንም ከጥሩ ወርቅ አድርግ።

verses.en: Of a talent of pure gold shall he make it, with all these vessels.
verses.fr: On emploiera un talent d''or pur pour faire le chandelier avec tous ses ustensiles.
verses.am: መቅረዙም ዕቃውም ሁሉ ከአንድ መክሊት ጥሩ ወርቅ ይሠሩ።

verses.en: And look that thou make them after their pattern, which was shewed thee in the mount.
verses.fr: Regarde, et fais d''après le modèle qui t''est montré sur la montagne.
verses.am: በተራራ ላይ እንዳሳየሁህ ምሳሌ እንድትሠራ ተጠንቀቅ።

verses.en: Moreover thou shalt make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: with cherubims of cunning work shalt thou make them.
verses.fr: Tu feras le tabernacle de dix tapis de fin lin retors, et d''étoffes teintes en bleu, en pourpre et en cramoisi; tu y représenteras des chérubins artistement travaillés.
verses.am: ደግሞም ከተፈተለ ከጥሩ በፍታ፥ ከሰማያዊ ከሐምራዊም ከቀይም ግምጃ የተሠሩ አሥር መጋረጆች ያሉበትን ማደሪያ ሥራ፤ ብልህ ሠራተኛ እንደሚሠራ ኪሩቤል በእነርሱ ላይ ይሁኑ።

verses.en: The length of one curtain shall be eight and twenty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and every one of the curtains shall have one measure.
verses.fr: La longueur d''un tapis sera de vingt-huit coudées, et la largeur d''un tapis sera de quatre coudées; la mesure sera la même pour tous les tapis.
verses.am: የእያንዳንዱ መጋረጃ ርዝመት ሀያ ስምንት ክንድ፥ ወርዱም አራት ክንድ ይሁን፤ የመጋረጆቹ ሁሉ መጠን ትክክል ይሁን።

verses.en: The five curtains shall be coupled together one to another; and other five curtains shall be coupled one to another.
verses.fr: Cinq de ces tapis seront joints ensemble; les cinq autres seront aussi joints ensemble.
verses.am: አምስቱ መጋረጆች እርስ በርሳቸው የተጋጠሙ ይሁኑ፤ አምስቱም መጋረጆች እንዲሁ እርስ በርሳቸው የተጋጠሙ ይሁኑ።

verses.en: And thou shalt make loops of blue upon the edge of the one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling; and likewise shalt thou make in the uttermost edge of another curtain, in the coupling of the second.
verses.fr: Tu feras des lacets bleus au bord du tapis terminant le premier assemblage; et tu feras de même au bord du tapis terminant le second assemblage.
verses.am: ከሚጋጠሙት መጋረጆች በአንደኛው መጋረጃ ዘርፍ ላይ የሰማያዊውን ግምጃ ቀለበቶች አድርግ፤ ደግሞ ከተጋጠሙት ከሌሎች በአንደኛው መጋረጃ ዘርፍ ላይ እንዲሁ አድርግ።

verses.en: Fifty loops shalt thou make in the one curtain, and fifty loops shalt thou make in the edge of the curtain that is in the coupling of the second; that the loops may take hold one of another.
verses.fr: Tu mettras cinquante lacets au premier tapis, et tu mettras cinquante lacets au bord du tapis terminant le second assemblage; ces lacets se correspondront les uns aux autres.
verses.am: አምሳ ቀለበቶችን በአንድ መጋረጃ አድርግ፥ አምሳውንም ቀለበቶች በሁለተኛው መጋረጃ ዘርፍ አድርግ፤ ቀለበቶቹ ሁሉ እርስ በርሳቸው ፊት ለፊት ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: And thou shalt make fifty taches of gold, and couple the curtains together with the taches: and it shall be one tabernacle.
verses.fr: Tu feras cinquante agrafes d''or, et tu joindras les tapis l''un à l''autre avec les agrafes. Et le tabernacle formera un tout.
verses.am: አምሳ የወርቅ መያዣዎች ሥራ፤ ማደሪያውንም አንድ እንዲሆን መጋረጆችን እርስ በርሳቸው በመያዣዎች አጋጥማቸው።

verses.en: And thou shalt make curtains of goats' hair to be a covering upon the tabernacle: eleven curtains shalt thou make.
verses.fr: Tu feras des tapis de poil de chèvre, pour servir de tente sur le tabernacle; tu feras onze de ces tapis.
verses.am: ከማደሪያውም በላይ ለድንኳን የሚሆኑ መጋረጆች ከፍየል ጠጕር አድርግ፤ አሥራ አንድ መጋረጆች ታደርጋለህ።

verses.en: The length of one curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and the eleven curtains shall be all of one measure.
verses.fr: La longueur d''un tapis sera de trente coudées, et la largeur d''un tapis sera de quatre coudées; la mesure sera la même pour les onze tapis.
verses.am: እያንዳንዱም መጋረጃ ርዝመቱ ሠላሳ ክንድ፥ እያንዳንዱም መጋረጃ ወርዱ አራት ክንድ ይሁን፤ የአሥራ አንዱም መጋረጆች መጠናቸው ትክክል ይሁን።

verses.en: And thou shalt couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shalt double the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tabernacle.
verses.fr: Tu joindras séparément cinq de ces tapis, et les six autres séparément, et tu redoubleras le sixième tapis sur le devant de la tente.
verses.am: አምስቱ መጋረጆች አንድ ሆነው ይጋጠሙ፥ ስድስቱም መጋረጆች እርስ በርሳቸው አንድ ሆነው ይጋጠሙ፤ ስድስተኛውም መጋረጃ በድንኳኑ ፊት ይደረብ።

verses.en: And thou shalt make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outmost in the coupling, and fifty loops in the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second.
verses.fr: Tu mettras cinquante lacets au bord du tapis terminant le premier assemblage, et cinquante lacets au bord du tapis du second assemblage.
verses.am: ከተጋጠሙት መጋረጆች በአንደኛው መጋረጃ ዘርፍ ላይ አምሳ ቀለበቶች አድርግ፤ ደግሞ ከተጋጠሙት ከሌሎቹ በአንድኛው መጋረጃ ዘርፍ ላይ እንዲሁ አምሳ ቀለበቶች አድርግ።

verses.en: And thou shalt make fifty taches of brass, and put the taches into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.
verses.fr: Tu feras cinquante agrafes d''airain, et tu feras entrer les agrafes dans les lacets. Tu assembleras ainsi la tente, qui fera un tout.
verses.am: አምሳም የናስ መያዣዎችን ሥራ፥ መያዣዎችንም ወደ ቀለበቶች አግባቸው፥ ድንኳኑም አንድ እንዲሆን አጋጥመው።

verses.en: And the remnant that remaineth of the curtains of the tent, the half curtain that remaineth, shall hang over the backside of the tabernacle.
verses.fr: Comme il y aura du surplus dans les tapis de la tente, la moitié du tapis de reste retombera sur le derrière du tabernacle;
verses.am: ከድንኳኑ መጋረጆች የቀረ ትርፍ ግማሽ መጋረጃ በማደሪያው ጀርባ ይንጠልጠል።

verses.en: And a cubit on the one side, and a cubit on the other side of that which remaineth in the length of the curtains of the tent, it shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.
verses.fr: la coudée d''une part, et la coudée d''autre part, qui seront de reste sur la longueur des tapis de la tente, retomberont sur les deux côtés du tabernacle, pour le couvrir.
verses.am: ማደሪያውን እንዲሸፍን ከርዝመቱ በአንድ ወገን አንድ ክንድ፥ በአንድ ወገንም አንድ ክንድ ከድንኳኑ መጋረጆች የቀረው ትርፍ በማደሪያው ውጭ በወዲህና በወዲያ ይንጠልጠል።

verses.en: And thou shalt make a covering for the tent of rams' skins dyed red, and a covering above of badgers' skins.
verses.fr: Tu feras pour la tente une couverture de peaux de béliers teintes en rouge, et une couverture de peaux de dauphins par-dessus.
verses.am: ለድንኳኑም መደረቢያ ከቀይ አውራ በግ ቁርበት፥ ከዚያም በላይ ሌላ መደረቢያ ከአቆስጣ ቁርበት አድርግ።

verses.en: And thou shalt make boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood standing up.
verses.fr: Tu feras des planches pour le tabernacle; elles seront de bois d''acacia, placées debout.
verses.am: ለማደሪያውም የሚቆሙትን ሳንቆች ከግራር እንጨት አድርግ።

verses.en: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and a cubit and a half shall be the breadth of one board.
verses.fr: La longueur d''une planche sera de dix coudées, et la largeur d''une planche sera d''une coudée et demie.
verses.am: የሳንቃው ሁሉ ርዝመቱ አሥር ክንድ፥ ወርዱም አንድ ክንድ ተኩል ይሁን።

verses.en: Two tenons shall there be in one board, set in order one against another: thus shalt thou make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
verses.fr: Il y aura à chaque planche deux tenons joints l''un à l''autre; tu feras de même pour toutes les planches du tabernacle.
verses.am: ለእያንዳንዱም ሳንቃ አንዱን በአንዱ ላይ የሚያያይዙ ሁለት ማጋጠሚያዎች ይሁኑለት፤ ለማደሪያው ሳንቆች ሁሉ እንዲሁ አድርግ።

verses.en: And thou shalt make the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards on the south side southward.
verses.fr: Tu feras vingt planches pour le tabernacle, du côté du midi.
verses.am: ለማደሪያውም በደቡብ ወገን ሀያ ሳንቆችን አድርግ።

verses.en: And thou shalt make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for his two tenons, and two sockets under another board for his two tenons.
verses.fr: Tu mettras quarante bases d''argent sous les vingt planches, deux bases sous chaque planche pour ses deux tenons.
verses.am: ከሀያውም ሳንቆች በታች አርባ የብር እግሮችን አድርግ፤ ከእያንዳንዱ ሳንቃ በታች ለሁለት ማጋጠሚያዎች ሁለት እግሮች ይሁኑ።

verses.en: And for the second side of the tabernacle on the north side there shall be twenty boards:
verses.fr: Tu feras vingt planches pour le second côté du tabernacle, le côté du nord,
verses.am: ለማደሪያው ለሁለተኛው ወገን በሰሜን በኩል ሀያ ሳንቆች፥

verses.en: And their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
verses.fr: et leurs quarante bases d''argent, deux bases sous chaque planche.
verses.am: ለእነርሱም አርባ የብር እግሮች ይሁኑ፤ ከእያንዳንዱም ሳንቃ በታች ሁለት እግሮች ይሁኑ።

verses.en: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward thou shalt make six boards.
verses.fr: Tu feras six planches pour le fond du tabernacle, du côté de l''occident.
verses.am: ለማደሪያውም በምዕራቡ ወገን በስተ ኋላ ስድስት ሳንቆችን አድርግ።

verses.en: And two boards shalt thou make for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.
verses.fr: Tu feras deux planches pour les angles du tabernacle, dans le fond;
verses.am: ለማደሪያውም ለሁለቱ ማዕዘን በስተ ኋላ ሁለት ሳንቆችን አድርግ።

verses.en: And they shall be coupled together beneath, and they shall be coupled together above the head of it unto one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.
verses.fr: elles seront doubles depuis le bas, et bien liées à leur sommet par un anneau; il en sera de même pour toutes les deux, placées aux deux angles.
verses.am: ከታችም እስከ ላይ እስከ አንደኛው ቀለበት ድረስ አንዱ ሳንቃ ድርብ ይሁን፤ እንዲሁም ለሁለቱ ይሁን፤ እነርሱም ለሁለቱ ማዕዘን ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: And they shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
verses.fr: Il y aura ainsi huit planches, avec leurs bases d''argent, soit seize bases, deux bases sous chaque planche.
verses.am: ስምንት ሳንቆችና አሥራ ስድስት የብር እግሮቻቸው ይሁኑ፤ ከእያንዳንዱም ሳንቃ በታች ሁለት እግሮች ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: And thou shalt make bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
verses.fr: Tu feras cinq barres de bois d''acacia pour les planches de l''un des côtés du tabernacle,
verses.am: ከግራርም እንጨት በማደሪያው በአንድ ወገን ላሉት ሳንቆች አምስት መወርወሪያዎች፥

verses.en: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the two sides westward.
verses.fr: cinq barres pour les planches du second côté du tabernacle, et cinq barres pour les planches du côté du tabernacle formant le fond vers l''occident.
verses.am: በማደሪያውም በሁለተኛው ወገን ላሉት ሳንቆች አምስት መወርወሪያዎች፥ በማደሪያውም በስተ ኋላ በምዕራብ ወገን ላሉት ሳንቆች አምስት መወርወሪያዎች አድርግ።

verses.en: And the middle bar in the midst of the boards shall reach from end to end.
verses.fr: La barre du milieu traversera les planches d''une extrémité à l''autre.
verses.am: መካከለኛውም መወርወሪያ በሳንቆች መካከል ከዳር እስከ ዳር ይለፍ።

verses.en: And thou shalt overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold for places for the bars: and thou shalt overlay the bars with gold.
verses.fr: Tu couvriras d''or les planches, et tu feras d''or leurs anneaux qui recevront les barres, et tu couvriras d''or les barres.
verses.am: ሳንቆቹንም በወርቅ ለብጣቸው፤ ቀለበቶቻቸውንም የመወርወሪያ ቤት እንዲሆኑላቸው ከወርቅ ሥራቸው፤ መወርወሪያዎችንም በወርቅ ለብጣቸው።

verses.en: And thou shalt rear up the tabernacle according to the fashion thereof which was shewed thee in the mount.
verses.fr: Tu dresseras le tabernacle d''après le modèle qui t''est montré sur la montagne.
verses.am: ማደሪያውንም በተራራ እንዳሳየሁህ ምሳሌ አቁም።

verses.en: And thou shalt make a vail of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen of cunning work: with cherubims shall it be made:
verses.fr: Tu feras un voile bleu, pourpre et cramoisi, et de fin lin retors; il sera artistement travaillé, et l''on y représentera des chérubins.
verses.am: መጋረጃውንም ከሰማያዊ ከሐምራዊም ከቀይም ግምጃ ከተፈተለ ከጥሩ በፍታም አድርግ፤ ብልህ ሠራተኛ እንደሚሠራ ኪሩቤል በእርሱ ላይ ይሁኑ።

verses.en: And thou shalt hang it upon four pillars of shittim wood overlaid with gold: their hooks shall be of gold, upon the four sockets of silver.
verses.fr: Tu le mettras sur quatre colonnes d''acacia, couvertes d''or; ces colonnes auront des crochets d''or, et poseront sur quatre bases d''argent.
verses.am: በወርቅ በተለበጡት ከግራር እንጨትም በተሠሩት በአራቱ ምሰሶች ላይ ስቀለው፤ ኩላቦቻቸውም ከወርቅ፥ አራቱም እግሮቻቸው ከብር የተሠሩ ይሁኑ።

verses.en: And thou shalt hang up the vail under the taches, that thou mayest bring in thither within the vail the ark of the testimony: and the vail shall divide unto you between the holy place and the most holy.
verses.fr: Tu mettras le voile au-dessous des agrafes, et c''est là, en dedans du voile, que tu feras entrer l''arche du témoignage; le voile vous servira de séparation entre le lieu saint et le lieu très saint.
verses.am: መጋረጃውንም ከመያዣዎቹ በታች ታንጠለጥለዋለህ፥ በመጋረጃውም ውስጥ የምስክርን ታቦት አግባው፤ መጋረጃውም በቅድስቱና በቅድስተ ቅዱሳኑ መካከል መለያ ይሁናችሁ።

verses.en: And thou shalt put the mercy seat upon the ark of the testimony in the most holy place.
verses.fr: Tu mettras le propitiatoire sur l''arche du témoignage dans le lieu très saint.
verses.am: በቅድስተ ቅዱሳኑም ውስጥ የስርየት መክደኛውን በምስክሩ ታቦት ላይ አድርግ።

verses.en: And thou shalt set the table without the vail, and the candlestick over against the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south: and thou shalt put the table on the north side.
verses.fr: Tu mettras la table en dehors du voile, et le chandelier en face de la table, au côté méridional du tabernacle; et tu mettras la table au côté septentrional.
verses.am: ገበታውንም በመጋረጃው ውጭ፥ መቅረዙንም በገበታው ፊት ለፊት በማደሪያው በደቡብ ወገን አድርግ፤ ገበታውንም በሰሜን ወገን አድርገው።

verses.en: And thou shalt make an hanging for the door of the tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, wrought with needlework.
verses.fr: Tu feras pour l''entrée de la tente un rideau bleu, pourpre et cramoisi, et de fin lin retors; ce sera un ouvrage de broderie.
verses.am: ለድንኳኑም ደጃፍ ከሰማያዊ ከሐምራዊም ከቀይም ግምጃ ከተፈተለ ከጥሩ በፍታም በጥልፍ አሠራር የተሠራ መጋረጃ አድርግለት።

verses.en: And thou shalt make for the hanging five pillars of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, and their hooks shall be of gold: and thou shalt cast five sockets of brass for them.
verses.fr: Tu feras pour le rideau cinq colonnes d''acacia, et tu les couvriras d''or; elles auront des crochets d''or, et tu fondras pour elles cinq bases d''airain.
verses.am: ለመጋረጃውም አምስት ምሰሶች ከግራር እንጨት አድርግ፥ በወርቅም ለብጣቸው፤ ኩላቦቻቸውም ከወርቅ የተሠሩ ይሁኑ፤ አምስትም እግሮች አድርግላቸው።

verses.en: And thou shalt make an altar of shittim wood, five cubits long, and five cubits broad; the altar shall be foursquare: and the height thereof shall be three cubits.
verses.fr: Tu feras l''autel de bois d''acacia; sa longueur sera de cinq coudées, et sa largeur de cinq coudées. L''autel sera carré, et sa hauteur sera de trois coudées.
verses.am: ርዝመቱ አምስት ክንድ፥ ወርዱም አምስት ክንድ መሠዊያ ከግራር እንጨት አድርግ፤ አራት ማዕዘንም ይሁን፤ ከፍታውም ሦስት ክንድ ይሁን።

verses.en: And thou shalt make the horns of it upon the four corners thereof: his horns shall be of the same: and thou shalt overlay it with brass.
verses.fr: Tu feras, aux quatre coins, des cornes qui sortiront de l''autel; et tu le couvriras d''airain.
verses.am: በአራቱም ማዕዘን ቀንዶችን ታደርጋለህ፥ ቀንዶቹም ከእርሱ ጋር በአንድ የተሠሩ ይሁኑ፤ በናስም ለብጠው።

verses.en: And thou shalt make his pans to receive his ashes, and his shovels, and his basons, and his fleshhooks, and his firepans: all the vessels thereof thou shalt make of brass.
verses.fr: Tu feras pour l''autel des cendriers, des pelles, des bassins, des fourchettes et des brasiers; tu feras d''airain tous ses ustensiles.
verses.am: አመድ የሚሆንባቸውን ምንቸቶች፥ መጫሪያዎቹንም፥ ድስቶቹንም፥ ሜንጦቹንም፥ ማንደጃዎቹንም አድርግ፤ ዕቃውንም ሁሉ ከናስ አድርግ።

verses.en: And thou shalt make for it a grate of network of brass; and upon the net shalt thou make four brasen rings in the four corners thereof.
verses.fr: Tu feras à l''autel une grille d''airain, en forme de treillis, et tu mettras quatre anneaux d''airain aux quatre coins du treillis.
verses.am: እንደ መረብ ሆኖ የተሠራ የናስ መከታ አድርግለት፤ ለመከታውም አራት የናስ ቀለበት በአራት ማዕዘኑ አድርግለት።

verses.en: And thou shalt put it under the compass of the altar beneath, that the net may be even to the midst of the altar.
verses.fr: Tu le placeras au-dessous du rebord de l''autel, à partir du bas, jusqu''à la moitié de la hauteur de l''autel.
verses.am: መከታውም እስከ መሠዊያው እኵሌታ ይደርስ ዘንድ በመሰዊያው በሚዞረው በእርከኑ ታች አድርገው።

verses.en: And thou shalt make staves for the altar, staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with brass.
verses.fr: Tu feras des barres pour l''autel, des barres de bois d''acacia, et tu les couvriras d''airain.
verses.am: ለመሠዊያውም ከግራር እንጨት መሎጊያዎችን ሠርተህ በናስ ለብጣቸው።

verses.en: And the staves shall be put into the rings, and the staves shall be upon the two sides of the altar, to bear it.
verses.fr: On passera les barres dans les anneaux; et les barres seront aux deux côtés de l''autel, quand on le portera.
verses.am: መሎጊያዎቹም በቀለበቶች ውስጥ ይግቡ፤ መሠዊያውንም ስትሸከሙ መሎጊያዎቹ በሁለቱ ወገኖች ይሁኑ።

verses.en: Hollow with boards shalt thou make it: as it was shewed thee in the mount, so shall they make it.
verses.fr: Tu le feras creux, avec des planches; il sera fait tel qu''il t''est montré sur la montagne.
verses.am: ከሳንቆች ሠርተህ ባዶ አድርገው፤ በተራራው እንዳሳየሁህ ምሳሌ እንዲሁ ያድርጉት።

verses.en: And thou shalt make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen of an hundred cubits long for one side:
verses.fr: Tu feras le parvis du tabernacle. Du côté du midi, il y aura, pour former le parvis, des toiles de fin lin retors, sur une longueur de cent coudées pour ce premier côté,
verses.am: የማደሪያውንም አደባባይ ሥራ፤ በደቡብ ወገን የጥሩ በፍታ መጋረጆች ይሁኑለት፥ የአንዱም ወገን ርዝመት መቶ ክንድ ይሁን፤

verses.en: And the twenty pillars thereof and their twenty sockets shall be of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.
verses.fr: avec vingt colonnes posant sur vingt bases d''airain; les crochets des colonnes et leurs tringles seront d''argent.
verses.am: ከናስ የተሠሩ ሀያ ምሰሶችና ሀያ እግሮች ይሁኑለት፤ የምሰሶቹም ኩላቦችና ዘንጎች የብር ይሁኑ።

verses.en: And likewise for the north side in length there shall be hangings of an hundred cubits long, and his twenty pillars and their twenty sockets of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.
verses.fr: Du côté du nord, il y aura également des toiles sur une longueur de cent coudées, avec vingt colonnes et leurs vingt bases d''airain; les crochets des colonnes et leurs tringles seront d''argent.
verses.am: እንዲሁም በሰሜን ወገን መቶ ክንድ ርዝመት ያላቸው መጋረጆች፥ ከናስ የተሠሩ ሀያ ምሶሶች ሀያም እግሮች ይሁኑ፤ ለምሰሶችም የብር ኩላቦችና ዘንጎች ይሁኑ።

verses.en: And for the breadth of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits: their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.
verses.fr: Du côté de l''occident, il y aura pour la largeur du parvis cinquante coudées de toiles, avec dix colonnes et leurs dix bases.
verses.am: በምዕራብም ወገን ለአደባባዩ ስፋት አምሳ ክንድ ርዝመት ያላቸው መጋረጆች፥ አሥርም ምሰሶች፥ አሥርም እግሮች ይሁኑለት።

verses.en: And the breadth of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.
verses.fr: Du côté de l''orient, sur les cinquante coudées de largeur du parvis,
verses.am: በምሥራቅም ወገን የአደባባዩ ስፋት አምሳ ክንድ ይሁን።

verses.en: The hangings of one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.
verses.fr: il y aura quinze coudées de toiles pour une aile, avec trois colonnes et leurs trois bases,
verses.am: በአንድ ወገን የመጋረጆቹ ርዝመት አሥራ አምስት ክንድ ይሁን፤ ምሰሶቹም ሦስት፥ እግሮቹም ሦስት ይሁኑ።

verses.en: And on the other side shall be hangings fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.
verses.fr: et quinze coudées de toiles pour la seconde aile, avec trois colonnes et leurs trois bases.
verses.am: በሌላውም ወገን የመጋረጆች ርዝመት አሥራ አምስት ክንድ ይሆናል፤ ምሰሶቹም ሦስት፥ እግሮቹም ሦስት ይሁኑ።

verses.en: And for the gate of the court shall be an hanging of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, wrought with needlework: and their pillars shall be four, and their sockets four.
verses.fr: Pour la porte du parvis il y aura un rideau de vingt coudées, bleu, pourpre et cramoisi, et de fin lin retors, en ouvrage de broderie, avec quatre colonnes et leurs quatre bases.
verses.am: ለአደባባዩም ደጅ ከሰማያዊ ከሐምራዊም ከቀይም ግምጃ ከጥሩ በፍታም በጥልፍ አሠራር የተሠራ ሀያ ክንድ መጋረጃ ይሆናል፤ ምሰሶቹም አራት፥ እግሮቹም አራት ይሁኑ።

verses.en: All the pillars round about the court shall be filleted with silver; their hooks shall be of silver, and their sockets of brass.
verses.fr: Toutes les colonnes formant l''enceinte du parvis auront des tringles d''argent, des crochets d''argent, et des bases d''airain.
verses.am: በአደባባዩም ዙሪያ ላሉት ምሰሶች ሁሉ የብር ዘንጎች፥ የብርም ኩላቦች፥ የናስም እግሮች ይሁኑላቸው።

verses.en: The length of the court shall be an hundred cubits, and the breadth fifty every where, and the height five cubits of fine twined linen, and their sockets of brass.
verses.fr: La longueur du parvis sera de cent coudées, sa largeur de cinquante de chaque côté, et sa hauteur de cinq coudées; les toiles seront de fin lin retors, et les bases d''airain.
verses.am: የአደባባዩ ርዝመት መቶ ክንድ ስፋቱም አምሳ ክንድ ይሁን፥ የመጋረጃውም ከፍታ አምስት ክንድ ይሁን፤ መጋረጃውም ከጥሩ በፍታ፥ እግሮቹም ከናስ የተሠሩ ይሁኑ።

verses.en: All the vessels of the tabernacle in all the service thereof, and all the pins thereof, and all the pins of the court, shall be of brass.
verses.fr: Tous les ustensiles destinés au service du tabernacle, tous ses pieux, et tous les pieux du parvis, seront d''airain.
verses.am: ለማገልገል ሁሉ የማደሪያው ዕቃ ሁሉ፥ ካስማዎቹም ሁሉ የአደባባዩም ካስማዎች ሁሉ፥ የናስ ይሁኑ።

verses.en: And thou shalt command the children of Israel, that they bring thee pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamp to burn always.
verses.fr: Tu ordonneras aux enfants d''Israël de t''apporter pour le chandelier de l''huile pure d''olives concassées, afin d''entretenir les lampes continuellement.
verses.am: አንተም መብራቱን ሁልጊዜ ያበሩት ዘንድ ለመብራት ተወቅጦ የተጠለለ ጥሩ የወይራ ዘይት እንዲያመጡልህ የእስራኤልን ልጆች እዘዛቸው።

verses.en: In the tabernacle of the congregation without the vail, which is before the testimony, Aaron and his sons shall order it from evening to morning before the Lord: it shall be a statute for ever unto their generations on the behalf of the children of Israel.
verses.fr: C''est dans la tente d''assignation, en dehors du voile qui est devant le témoignage, qu''Aaron et ses fils la prépareront, pour que les lampes brûlent du soir au matin en présence de l''Eternel. C''est une loi perpétuelle pour leurs descendants, et que devront observer les enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: በመገናኛው ድንኳን ውስጥ በምስክሩ ታቦት ፊት ባለው መጋረጃ ውጭ አሮንና ልጆቹ ከማታ እስከ ማለዳ ድረስ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እንዲበራ ያሰናዱት፤ በእስራኤል ልጆች ዘንድ ለልጅ ልጃቸው የዘላለም ሥርዓት ይሁን።

verses.en: And take thou unto thee Aaron thy brother, and his sons with him, from among the children of Israel, that he may minister unto me in the priest's office, even Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron's sons.
verses.fr: Fais approcher de toi Aaron, ton frère, et ses fils, et prends-les parmi les enfants d''Israël pour les consacrer à mon service dans le sacerdoce: Aaron et les fils d''Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, Eléazar et Ithamar.
verses.am: አንተም ወንድምህን አሮንን ከእርሱም ጋር ልጆቹን ከእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል ለይተህ ካህናት ይሆኑልኝ ዘንድ ወደ አንተ አቅርብ፤ አሮንን የአሮንንም ልጆች፥ ናዳብን አብዮድንም አልዓዛርንም ኢታምርንም፥ አቅርብ።

verses.en: And thou shalt make holy garments for Aaron thy brother for glory and for beauty.
verses.fr: Tu feras à Aaron, ton frère, des vêtements sacrés, pour marquer sa dignité et pour lui servir de parure.
verses.am: የተቀደሰውንም ልብስ ለክብርና ለጌጥ እንዲሆን ለወንድምህ ለአሮን ሥራለት።

verses.en: And thou shalt speak unto all that are wise hearted, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they may make Aaron's garments to consecrate him, that he may minister unto me in the priest's office.
verses.fr: Tu parleras à tous ceux qui sont habiles, à qui j''ai donné un esprit plein d''intelligence; et ils feront les vêtements d''Aaron, afin qu''il soit consacré et qu''il exerce mon sacerdoce.
verses.am: አንተም ካህን ሆኖ እንዲያገለግለኝ አሮን ቅዱስ ይሆን ዘንድ ልብስ እንዲሠሩለት የጥበብ መንፈስ ለሞላሁባቸው በልባቸው ጥበበኞች ለሆኑት ሁሉ ተናገር።

verses.en: And these are the garments which they shall make; a breastplate, and an ephod, and a robe, and a broidered coat, a mitre, and a girdle: and they shall make holy garments for Aaron thy brother, and his sons, that he may minister unto me in the priest's office.
verses.fr: Voici les vêtements qu''ils feront: un pectoral, un éphod, une robe, une tunique brodée, une tiare, et une ceinture. Ils feront des vêtements sacrés à Aaron, ton frère, et à ses fils, afin qu''ils exercent mon sacerdoce.
verses.am: የሚሠሩአቸውም ልብሶች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ የደረት ኪስ ኤፉድም ቀሚስም ዝንጕርጕር ሸሚዝም መጠምጠሚያም መታጠቂያም፤ እነዚህም ካህናት ይሆኑልኝ ዘንድ ለወንድምህ ለአሮን ለልጆቹም የተቀደሰ ልብስ ያድርጉ።

verses.en: And they shall take gold, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen.
verses.fr: Ils emploieront de l''or, des étoffes teintes en bleu, en pourpre, en cramoisi, et de fin lin.
verses.am: ወርቅንም፥ ሰማያዊና ሐምራዊ ቀይም ግምጃ፥ ጥሩ በፍታም ይውሰዱ።

verses.en: And they shall make the ephod of gold, of blue, and of purple, of scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cunning work.
verses.fr: Ils feront l''éphod d''or, de fil bleu, pourpre et cramoisi, et de fin lin retors; il sera artistement travaillé.
verses.am: ኤፉዱንም በብልሃት የተሠራ በወርቅና በሰማያዊ በሐምራዊም በቀይም ግምጃ ከተፈተለ ከጥሩ በፍታም ብልህ ሠራተኛ እንደሚሠራ ያድርጉ።

verses.en: It shall have the two shoulderpieces thereof joined at the two edges thereof; and so it shall be joined together.
verses.fr: On y fera deux épaulettes, qui le joindront par ses deux extrémités; et c''est ainsi qu''il sera joint.
verses.am: ሁለቱ ወገን አንድ እንዲሆን በሁለቱ ጫንቃ ላይ የሚጋጠም ጨርቅ ይሁን።

verses.en: And the curious girdle of the ephod, which is upon it, shall be of the same, according to the work thereof; even of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
verses.fr: La ceinture sera du même travail que l''éphod et fixée sur lui; elle sera d''or, de fil bleu, pourpre et cramoisi, et de fin lin retors.
verses.am: በላዩም መታጠቂያ ሆኖ በብልሃት የተጠለፈው የኤፉድ ቋድ እንደ እርሱ ከእርሱም ጋር አንድ ይሁን፤ ከወርቅና ከሰማያዊ ከሐምራዊ ከቀይ ግምጃም ከተፈተለ ከጥሩ በፍታም የተሠራ ይሁን።

verses.en: And thou shalt take two onyx stones, and grave on them the names of the children of Israel:
verses.fr: Tu prendras deux pierres d''onyx, et tu y graveras les noms des fils d''Israël,
verses.am: ሁለትም የመረግድ ድንጋይ ወስደህ የእስራኤልን ልጆች ስም ስማቸውን ቅረጽባቸው፤

verses.en: Six of their names on one stone, and the other six names of the rest on the other stone, according to their birth.
verses.fr: six de leurs noms sur une pierre, et les six autres sur la seconde pierre, d''après l''ordre des naissances.
verses.am: እንደ አወላለዳቸው ስድስት ስም በአንድ ድንጋይ፥ የቀረውንም ስድስቱን ስም በሌላው ቅረጽ።

verses.en: With the work of an engraver in stone, like the engravings of a signet, shalt thou engrave the two stones with the names of the children of Israel: thou shalt make them to be set in ouches of gold.
verses.fr: Tu graveras sur les deux pierres les noms des fils d''Israël, comme on grave les pierres et les cachets; tu les entoureras de montures d''or.
verses.am: በቅርጽ ሠራተኛ ሥራ እንደ ማኅተም ቅርጽ አድርገህ የእስራኤልን ልጆች ስም በሁለት ድንጋዮች ቅረጽ በወርቅም ፈርጥ አድርግ።

verses.en: And thou shalt put the two stones upon the shoulders of the ephod for stones of memorial unto the children of Israel: and Aaron shall bear their names before the Lord upon his two shoulders for a memorial.
verses.fr: Tu mettras les deux pierres sur les épaulettes de l''éphod, en souvenir des fils d''Israël; et c''est comme souvenir qu''Aaron portera leurs noms devant l''Eternel sur ses deux épaules.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ልጆችም የመታሰቢያ ድንጋዮች ይሆኑ ዘንድ ሁለቱን ዕንቍዎች በኤፉዱ ጫንቃዎች ላይ ታደርጋለህ፤ አሮንም በሁለቱ ጫንቃዎች ላይ ለመታሰቢያ ስማቸውን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ይሸከማል።

verses.en: And thou shalt make ouches of gold;
verses.fr: Tu feras des montures d''or,
verses.am: ብልህ ሠራተኛም እንደሚሠራ የፍርዱን የደረት ኪስ ሥራው እንደ ኤፉዱም አሠራር ሥራው፤ ከወርቅና ከሰማያዊ ከሐምራዊም ከቀይም ግምጃ ከጥሩ በፍታም ሥራው።

verses.en: And two chains of pure gold at the ends; of wreathen work shalt thou make them, and fasten the wreathen chains to the ouches.
verses.fr: et deux chaînettes d''or pur, que tu tresseras en forme de cordons; et tu fixeras aux montures les chaînettes ainsi tressées.
verses.am: ብልህ ሠራተኛም እንደሚሠራ የፍርዱን የደረት ኪስ ሥራው እንደ ኤፉዱም አሠራር ሥራው፤ ከወርቅና ከሰማያዊ ከሐምራዊም ከቀይም ግምጃ ከጥሩ በፍታም ሥራው።

verses.en: And thou shalt make the breastplate of judgment with cunning work; after the work of the ephod thou shalt make it; of gold, of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, and of fine twined linen, shalt thou make it.
verses.fr: Tu feras le pectoral du jugement, artistement travaillé; tu le feras du même travail que l''éphod, tu le feras d''or, de fil bleu, pourpre et cramoisi, et de fin lin retors.
verses.am: ርዝመቱ ስንዝር ስፋቱም ስንዝር ሆኖ ትክክልና ድርብ ይሆናል።

verses.en: Foursquare it shall be being doubled; a span shall be the length thereof, and a span shall be the breadth thereof.
verses.fr: Il sera carré et double; sa longueur sera d''un empan, et sa largeur d''un empan.
verses.am: በአራት ተራ የሆነ የዕንቍ ፈርጥ አድርግበት፤ በፊተኛው ተራ ሰርድዮን፥ ቶጳዝዮን፥ የሚያብረቀርቅ ዕንቍ፤

verses.en: And thou shalt set in it settings of stones, even four rows of stones: the first row shall be a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this shall be the first row.
verses.fr: Tu y enchâsseras une garniture de pierres, quatre rangées de pierres: première rangée, une sardoine, une topaze, une émeraude;
verses.am: በሁለተኛውም ተራ በሉር፥ ሰንፔር፥ አልማዝ፤

verses.en: And the second row shall be an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.
verses.fr: seconde rangée, une escarboucle, un saphir, un diamant;
verses.am: በሦስተኛውም ተራ ያክንት፥ ኬልቄዶን፥ አሜቴስጢኖስ፤

verses.en: And the third row a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.
verses.fr: troisième rangée, une opale, une agate, une améthyste;
verses.am: በአራተኛውም ተራ ቢረሌ፥ መረግድ፥ ኢያስጲድ በወርቅ ፈርጥ ይደረጋሉ።

verses.en: And the fourth row a beryl, and an onyx, and a jasper: they shall be set in gold in their inclosings.
verses.fr: quatrième rangée, une chrysolithe, un onyx, un jaspe. Ces pierres seront enchâssées dans leurs montures d''or.
verses.am: የዕንቈቹም ድንጋዮች እንደ እስራኤል ልጆች ስሞች አሥራ ሁለት ይሆናሉ፤ በየስማቸውም ማተሚያ እንደሚቀረጽ ይቀረጹ፤ ስለ አሥራ ሁለቱ ነገዶችም ይሁኑ።

verses.en: And the stones shall be with the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, like the engravings of a signet; every one with his name shall they be according to the twelve tribes.
verses.fr: Il y en aura douze, d''après les noms des fils d''Israël; elles seront gravées comme des cachets, chacune avec le nom de l''une des douze tribus. -
verses.am: ለደረቱ ኪስም የተጐነጐኑትን ድሪዎች እንደ ገመድ አድርገህ ከጥሩ ወርቅ ሥራቸው።

verses.en: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate chains at the ends of wreathen work of pure gold.
verses.fr: Tu feras sur le pectoral des chaînettes d''or pur, tressées en forme de cordons.
verses.am: ለደረቱ ኪስም ሁለት የወርቅ ቀለበቶች ሥራ፥ ሁለቱንም ቀለበቶች በደረቱ ኪስ በሁለቱ ወገን አድርጋቸው።

verses.en: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate two rings of gold, and shalt put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.
verses.fr: Tu feras sur le pectoral deux anneaux d''or, et tu mettras ces deux anneaux aux deux extrémités du pectoral.
verses.am: የተጐነጐኑትንም ሁለቱን የወርቅ ድሪዎች በደረቱ ኪስ ወገኖች ወዳሉት ወደ ሁለቱ ቀለበቶች ታገባቸዋለህ።

verses.en: And thou shalt put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings which are on the ends of the breastplate.
verses.fr: Tu passeras les deux cordons d''or dans les deux anneaux aux deux extrémités du pectoral;
verses.am: የሁለቱንም ድሪዎች ጫፎች በሁለቱ ፈርጦች ውስጥ አግብተህ በኤፉዱ ጫንቃዎች ላይ በፊታቸው ታደርጋቸዋለህ።

verses.en: And the other two ends of the two wreathen chains thou shalt fasten in the two ouches, and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod before it.
verses.fr: et tu arrêteras par devant les bouts des deux cordons aux deux montures placées sur les épaulettes de l''éphod.
verses.am: ሁለት የወርቅ ቀለበቶችም ሥራ፥ እነርሱንም በኤፉዱ ፊት ለፊት ባለው በደረቱ ኪስ በሁለቱ ጫፎች ላይ ታደርጋቸዋለህ።

verses.en: And thou shalt make two rings of gold, and thou shalt put them upon the two ends of the breastplate in the border thereof, which is in the side of the ephod inward.
verses.fr: Tu feras encore deux anneaux d''or, que tu mettras aux deux extrémités du pectoral, sur le bord intérieur appliqué contre l''éphod.
verses.am: ደግሞም ሁለት የወርቅ ቀለበቶች ሥራ፥ በኤፉዱም ፊት ከጫንቃዎች በታች በብልሃት ከተጠለፈ ከኤፉዱ ቋድ በላይ በመያዣው አጠገብ ታደርጋቸዋለህ።

verses.en: And two other rings of gold thou shalt make, and shalt put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart thereof, over against the other coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.
verses.fr: Et tu feras deux autres anneaux d''or, que tu mettras au bas des deux épaulettes de l''éphod, sur le devant, près de la jointure, au-dessus de la ceinture de l''éphod.
verses.am: የደረቱም ኪስ በብልሃት ከተጠለፈ ከኤፉዱ ቋድ በላይ እንዲሆን ከኤፉዱም እንዳይለይ፥ የደረቱን ኪስ ከቀለበቶቹ ወደ ኤፉዱ ቀለበቶች በሰማያዊ ፈትል ያስሩታል።

verses.en: And they shall bind the breastplate by the rings thereof unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it may be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate be not loosed from the ephod.
verses.fr: On attachera le pectoral par ses anneaux aux anneaux de l''éphod avec un cordon bleu, afin que le pectoral soit au-dessus de la ceinture de l''éphod et qu''il ne puisse pas se séparer de l''éphod.
verses.am: አሮንም ወደ መቅደስ በገባ ጊዜ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለዘላለም መታሰቢያ የእስራኤልን ልጆች ስሞች በፍርዱ በደረት ኪስ ውስጥ በልቡ ላይ ይሸከም።

verses.en: And Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment upon his heart, when he goeth in unto the holy place, for a memorial before the Lord continually.
verses.fr: Lorsque Aaron entrera dans le sanctuaire, il portera sur son coeur les noms des fils d''Israël, gravés sur le pectoral du jugement, pour en conserver à toujours le souvenir devant l''Eternel. -
verses.am: በፍርዱ በደረት ኪስም ውስጥ ኡሪምንና ቱሚምን ታደርጋለህ፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት በገባ ጊዜ በአሮን ልብ ላይ ይሆናሉ፤ አሮንም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ሁልጊዜ የእስራኤልን ልጆች ፍርድ በልቡ ላይ ይሸከማል።

verses.en: And thou shalt put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be upon Aaron's heart, when he goeth in before the Lord: and Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel upon his heart before the Lord continually.
verses.fr: Tu joindras au pectoral du jugement l''urim et le thummim, et ils seront sur le coeur d''Aaron, lorsqu''il se présentera devant l''Eternel. Ainsi, Aaron portera constamment sur son coeur le jugement des enfants d''Israël, lorsqu''il se présentera devant l''Eternel.
verses.am: የኤፉዱንም ቀሚስ ሁሉ ሰማያዊ አድርገው።

verses.en: And thou shalt make the robe of the ephod all of blue.
verses.fr: Tu feras la robe de l''éphod entièrement d''étoffe bleue.
verses.am: ከላይም በመካከል አንገትጌ ይሁንበት፤ እንዳይቀደድም እንደ ጥሩር የተሠራ ጥልፍ በአንገትጌው ዙሪያ ይሁንበት።

verses.en: And there shall be an hole in the top of it, in the midst thereof: it shall have a binding of woven work round about the hole of it, as it were the hole of an habergeon, that it be not rent.
verses.fr: Il y aura, au milieu, une ouverture pour la tête; et cette ouverture aura tout autour un bord tissé, comme l''ouverture d''une cotte de mailles, afin que la robe ne se déchire pas.
verses.am: በታችኛውም ዘርፍ ዙሪያ ከሰማያዊ ከሐምራዊም ከቀይም ግምጃ ሮማኖች አድርግ፤ በዚያም መካከል በዙሪያው የወርቅ ሻኵራዎች አድርግ፤

verses.en: And beneath upon the hem of it thou shalt make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, round about the hem thereof; and bells of gold between them round about:
verses.fr: Tu mettras autour de la bordure, en bas, des grenades de couleur bleue, pourpre et cramoisi, entremêlées de clochettes d''or:
verses.am: የወርቅ ሻኵራ ሮማንም፥ ሌላም የወርቅ ሻኵራ ሮማንም በቀሚሱ ዘርፍ ዙሪያውን ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: A golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, upon the hem of the robe round about.
verses.fr: une clochette d''or et une grenade, une clochette d''or et une grenade, sur tout le tour de la bordure de la robe.
verses.am: በማገልገል ጊዜም በአሮን ላይ ይሆናል፤ እርሱም እንዳይሞት ወደ መቅደሱ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ሲገባና ሲወጣ ድምፁ ይሰማል።

verses.en: And it shall be upon Aaron to minister: and his sound shall be heard when he goeth in unto the holy place before the Lord, and when he cometh out, that he die not.
verses.fr: Aaron s''en revêtira pour faire le service; quand il entrera dans le sanctuaire devant l''Eternel, et quand il en sortira, on entendra le son des clochettes, et il ne mourra point.
verses.am: ከጥሩ ወርቅም ቅጠል የሚመስል ምልክት ሥራ፥ በእርሱም እንደ ማኅተም ቅርጽ አድርገህ። ቅድስና ለእግዚአብሔር የሚል ትቀርጽበታለህ።

verses.en: And thou shalt make a plate of pure gold, and grave upon it, like the engravings of a signet, Holiness To The Lord.
verses.fr: Tu feras une lame d''or pur, et tu y graveras, comme on grave un cachet: Sainteté à l''Eternel.
verses.am: በሰማያዊም ፈትል በመጠምጠሚያው ፊት ላይ ታንጠለጥለዋለህ።

verses.en: And thou shalt put it on a blue lace, that it may be upon the mitre; upon the forefront of the mitre it shall be.
verses.fr: Tu l''attacheras avec un cordon bleu sur la tiare, sur le devant de la tiare.
verses.am: በአሮንም ግምባር ላይ ይሆናል፥ አሮንም የእስራኤል ልጆች በሚያቀርቡትና በሚቀድሱት በቅዱስ ስጦታቸው ሁሉ ላይ ያለውን ኃጢአት ይሸከም፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ሞገስ እንዲሆንላቸው ቅጠል የሚመስለው ምልክቱ ሁልጊዜ በግምባሩ ላይ ይሁን።

verses.en: And it shall be upon Aaron's forehead, that Aaron may bear the iniquity of the holy things, which the children of Israel shall hallow in all their holy gifts; and it shall be always upon his forehead, that they may be accepted before the Lord.
verses.fr: Elle sera sur le front d''Aaron; et Aaron sera chargé des iniquités commises par les enfants d''Israël en faisant toutes leurs saintes offrandes; elle sera constamment sur son front devant l''Eternel, pour qu''il leur soit favorable.
verses.am: ሸሚዙንም ከጥሩ በፍታ ዝንጕርጕር አድርገህ፥ መጠምጠሚያውን ከበፍታ ትሠራለህ፤ በጥልፍ አሠራር መታጠቂያም ትሠራለህ።

verses.en: And thou shalt embroider the coat of fine linen, and thou shalt make the mitre of fine linen, and thou shalt make the girdle of needlework.
verses.fr: Tu feras la tunique de fin lin; tu feras une tiare de fin lin, et tu feras une ceinture brodée.
verses.am: ለአሮንም ልጆች ሸሚዞችን መታጠቂያዎችንም ቆቦችንም ለክብርና ለጌጥ ታደርግላቸዋለህ።

verses.en: And for Aaron's sons thou shalt make coats, and thou shalt make for them girdles, and bonnets shalt thou make for them, for glory and for beauty.
verses.fr: Pour les fils d''Aaron tu feras des tuniques, tu leur feras des ceintures, et tu leur feras des bonnets, pour marquer leur dignité et pour leur servir de parure.
verses.am: ይህንም ሁሉ ወንድምህን አሮንን ከእርሱም ጋር ልጆቹን ታለብሳቸዋለህ፤ በክህነት እንዲያገለግሉኝ ትቀባቸዋለህ፥ ትክናቸዋለህ፥ ትቀድሳቸውማለህ።

verses.en: And thou shalt put them upon Aaron thy brother, and his sons with him; and shalt anoint them, and consecrate them, and sanctify them, that they may minister unto me in the priest's office.
verses.fr: Tu en revêtiras Aaron, ton frère, et ses fils avec lui. Tu les oindras, tu les consacreras, tu les sanctifieras, et ils seront à mon service dans le sacerdoce.
verses.am: ኀፍረተ ሥጋቸውንም ይከድኑበት ዘንድ የበፍታ ሱሪ ታደርግላቸዋለህ፤ ከወገባቸውም እስከ ጭናቸው ይደርሳል፤

verses.en: And thou shalt make them linen breeches to cover their nakedness; from the loins even unto the thighs they shall reach:
verses.fr: Fais-leur des caleçons de lin, pour couvrir leur nudité; ils iront depuis les reins jusqu''aux cuisses.
verses.am: ኃጢአትም እንዳይሆንባቸው እንዳይሞቱም፥ ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ሲገቡ በመቅደሱም ያገለግሉ ዘንድ ወደ መሠዊያው ሲቀርቡ በአሮንና በልጆቹ ላይ ይሆናል፤ ለእርሱ ከእርሱም በኋላ ለዘሩ ለዘላለም ሥርዓት ይሆናል።

verses.en: And they shall be upon Aaron, and upon his sons, when they come in unto the tabernacle of the congregation, or when they come near unto the altar to minister in the holy place; that they bear not iniquity, and die: it shall be a statute for ever unto him and his seed after him.
verses.fr: Aaron et ses fils les porteront, quand ils entreront dans la tente d''assignation, ou quand ils s''approcheront de l''autel, pour faire le service dans le sanctuaire; ainsi ils ne se rendront point coupables, et ne mourront point. C''est une loi perpétuelle pour Aaron et pour ses descendants après lui.
verses.am: ፤ ኃጢአትም እንዳይሆንባቸው እንዳይሞቱም፥ ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ሲገቡ በመቅደሱም ያገለግሉ ዘንድ ወደ መሠዊያው ሲቀርቡ በአሮንና በልጆቹ ላይ ይሆናል፤ ለእርሱ ከእርሱም በኋላ ለዘሩ ለዘላለም ሥርዓት ይሆናል።

verses.en: And this is the thing that thou shalt do unto them to hallow them, to minister unto me in the priest's office: Take one young bullock, and two rams without blemish,
verses.fr: Voici ce que tu feras pour les sanctifier, afin qu''ils soient à mon service dans le sacerdoce. Prends un jeune taureau et deux béliers sans défaut.
verses.am: እኔንም በክህነት እንዲያገለግሉኝ ትቀድሳቸው ዘንድ የምታደርግባቸው ነገር ይህ ነው፤ ነውር የሌለባቸውን አንድ ወይፈንና ሁለት አውራ በጎች ትወስዳለህ።

verses.en: And unleavened bread, and cakes unleavened tempered with oil, and wafers unleavened anointed with oil: of wheaten flour shalt thou make them.
verses.fr: Fais, avec de la fleur de farine de froment, des pains sans levain, des gâteaux sans levain pétris à l''huile, et des galettes sans levain arrosées d''huile.
verses.am: ቂጣ እንጀራ፥ በዘይትም የተለወሰ የቂጣ እንጐቻ፥ በዘይትም የተቀባ ስስ ቂጣ ከመልካም ስንዴ ታደርጋለህ።

verses.en: And thou shalt put them into one basket, and bring them in the basket, with the bullock and the two rams.
verses.fr: Tu les mettras dans une corbeille, en offrant le jeune taureau et les deux béliers.
verses.am: በአንድ ሌማትም ታደርጋቸዋለህ፤ ከወይፈኑና ከሁለቱ አውራ በጎች ጋር በሌማቱ ታቀርባቸዋለህ።

verses.en: And Aaron and his sons thou shalt bring unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shalt wash them with water.
verses.fr: Tu feras avancer Aaron et ses fils vers l''entrée de la tente d''assignation, et tu les laveras avec de l''eau.
verses.am: አሮንና ልጆቹንም ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ታቀርባቸዋለህ፥ በውኃም ታጥባቸዋለህ።

verses.en: And thou shalt take the garments, and put upon Aaron the coat, and the robe of the ephod, and the ephod, and the breastplate, and gird him with the curious girdle of the ephod:
verses.fr: Tu prendras les vêtements; tu revêtiras Aaron de la tunique, de la robe de l''éphod, de l''éphod et du pectoral, et tu mettras sur lui la ceinture de l''éphod.
verses.am: ልብሶችን ወስደህ ለአሮን ሸሚዝና የኤፉድ ቀሚስ ኤፉድም የደረት ኪስም ታለብሰዋለህ፥ በብልሃትም በተጠለፈ ቋድ ታስታጥቀዋለህ፤

verses.en: And thou shalt put the mitre upon his head, and put the holy crown upon the mitre.
verses.fr: Tu poseras la tiare sur sa tête, et tu placeras le diadème de sainteté sur la tiare.
verses.am: መጠምጠሚያውንም በራሱ ላይ ታደርጋለህ፥ የተቀደሰውንም አክሊል በመጠምጠሚያው ላይ ታኖራለህ።

verses.en: Then shalt thou take the anointing oil, and pour it upon his head, and anoint him.
verses.fr: Tu prendras l''huile d''onction, tu en répandras sur sa tête, et tu l''oindras.
verses.am: የቅብዓትንም ዘይት ወስደህ በራሱ ላይ ታፈስሰዋለህ፥ ትቀባውማለህ።

verses.en: And thou shalt bring his sons, and put coats upon them.
verses.fr: Tu feras approcher ses fils, et tu les revêtiras des tuniques.
verses.am: ልጆቹንም ታቀርባቸዋለህ፥ ሸሚዞቹንም ታለብሳቸዋለህ።

verses.en: And thou shalt gird them with girdles, Aaron and his sons, and put the bonnets on them: and the priest's office shall be theirs for a perpetual statute: and thou shalt consecrate Aaron and his sons.
verses.fr: Tu mettras une ceinture à Aaron et à ses fils, et tu attacheras des bonnets aux fils d''Aaron. Le sacerdoce leur appartiendra par une loi perpétuelle. Tu consacreras donc Aaron et ses fils.
verses.am: አሮንንና ልጆቹንም በመታጠቂያ ታስታጥቃቸዋለህ፥ ቆብንም ታለብሳቸዋለህ፤ ለዘላለም ሥርዓትም ክህነት ይሆንላቸዋል፤ እንዲሁም አሮንንና ልጆቹን ትክናቸዋለህ።

verses.en: And thou shalt cause a bullock to be brought before the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the bullock.
verses.fr: Tu amèneras le taureau devant la tente d''assignation, et Aaron et ses fils poseront leurs mains sur la tête du taureau.
verses.am: ወይፈኑንም ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን በር ፊት ታቀርበዋለህ፤ አሮንና ልጆቹም እጆቻቸውን በወይፈኑ ራስ ላይ ይጭናሉ።

verses.en: And thou shalt kill the bullock before the Lord, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.fr: Tu égorgeras le taureau devant l''Eternel, à l''entrée de la tente d''assignation.
verses.am: ወይፈኑንም በመገናኛው ድንኳን በር አጠገብ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ታርደዋለህ።

verses.en: And thou shalt take of the blood of the bullock, and put it upon the horns of the altar with thy finger, and pour all the blood beside the bottom of the altar.
verses.fr: Tu prendras du sang du taureau, tu en mettras avec ton doigt sur les cornes de l''autel, et tu répandras tout le sang au pied de l''autel.
verses.am: ከወይፈኑም ደም ወስደህ በመሠዊያው ቀንዶች ላይ በጣትህ ትረጨዋለህ፤ ደሙንም ሁሉ ከመሠዊያው በታች ታፈስሰዋለህ።

verses.en: And thou shalt take all the fat that covereth the inwards, and the caul that is above the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and burn them upon the altar.
verses.fr: Tu prendras toute la graisse qui couvre les entrailles, le grand lobe du foie, les deux rognons et la graisse qui les entoure, et tu brûleras cela sur l''autel.
verses.am: የሆድ ዕቃውንም የሚሸፍነውን ስብ ሁሉ በጉልበቱም ላይ ያለውን መረብ ሁለቱንም ኵላሊቶች በላያቸውም ያለውን ስብ ወስደህ በመሠዊያው ላይ ታቃጥላለህ።

verses.en: But the flesh of the bullock, and his skin, and his dung, shalt thou burn with fire without the camp: it is a sin offering.
verses.fr: Mais tu brûleras au feu hors du camp la chair du taureau, sa peau et ses excréments: c''est un sacrifice pour le péché.
verses.am: የወይፈኑን ሥጋ ግን፥ ቁርበቱንም፥ ፈርሱንም ከሰፈር ውጭ በእሳት ታቃጥለዋለህ፤ የኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ነው።

verses.en: Thou shalt also take one ram; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram.
verses.fr: Tu prendras l''un des béliers, et Aaron et ses fils poseront leurs mains sur la tête du bélier.
verses.am: አንደኛውንም አውራ በግ ትወስደዋለህ፤ አሮንና ልጆቹም በአውራው በግ ራስ ላይ እጆቻቸውን ይጭናሉ።

verses.en: And thou shalt slay the ram, and thou shalt take his blood, and sprinkle it round about upon the altar.
verses.fr: Tu égorgeras le bélier; tu en prendras le sang, et tu le répandras sur l''autel tout autour.
verses.am: አውራውንም በግ ታርደዋለህ፥ ደሙንም ወስደህ በመሠዊያው ላይ በዙሪያው ትረጨዋለህ።

verses.en: And thou shalt cut the ram in pieces, and wash the inwards of him, and his legs, and put them unto his pieces, and unto his head.
verses.fr: Tu couperas le bélier par morceaux, et tu laveras les entrailles et les jambes, que tu mettras sur les morceaux et sur sa tête.
verses.am: አውራውንም በግ በየብልቱ ትቈርጠዋለህ፥ የሆድ ዕቃውንና እግሮቹንም ታጥባለህ፥ ከብልቱና ከራሱም ጋር ታኖረዋለህ።

verses.en: And thou shalt burn the whole ram upon the altar: it is a burnt offering unto the Lord: it is a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Tu brûleras tout le bélier sur l''autel; c''est un holocauste à l''Eternel, c''est un sacrifice consumé par le feu, d''une agréable odeur à l''Eternel.
verses.am: አውራውንም በግ በሞላው በመሠዊያው ላይ ታቃጥላለህ፤ ለእግዚአብሔር የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ነው፤ ጣፋጭ ሽቱ ነው። ለእግዚአብሔር የቀረበ የእሳት ቍርባን ነው።

verses.en: And thou shalt take the other ram; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram.
verses.fr: Tu prendras l''autre bélier, et Aaron et ses fils poseront leurs mains sur la tête du bélier.
verses.am: ሁለተኛውንም አውራ በግ ትወስደዋለህ፤ አሮንና ልጆቹም እጆቻቸውን በአውራው በግ ራስ ላይ ይጭናሉ።

verses.en: Then shalt thou kill the ram, and take of his blood, and put it upon the tip of the right ear of Aaron, and upon the tip of the right ear of his sons, and upon the thumb of their right hand, and upon the great toe of their right foot, and sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.
verses.fr: Tu égorgeras le bélier; tu prendras de son sang, tu en mettras sur le lobe de l''oreille droite d''Aaron et sur le lobe de l''oreille droite de ses fils, sur le pouce de leur main droite et sur le gros orteil de leur pied droit, et tu répandras le sang sur l''autel tout autour.
verses.am: አውራውንም በግ ታርደዋለህ፥ ደሙንም ትወስዳለህ፥ የአሮንንም የቀኝ ጆሮ ጫፍ፥ የልጆቹንም የቀኝ ጆሮአቸውን ጫፍ፥ የቀኝ እጃቸውንና የቀኝ እግራቸውን አውራ ጣት ታስነካለህ፤ ደሙንም በመሠዊያው ላይ በዙሪያው ትረጨዋለህ።

verses.en: And thou shalt take of the blood that is upon the altar, and of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it upon Aaron, and upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon the garments of his sons with him: and he shall be hallowed, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons' garments with him.
verses.fr: Tu prendras du sang qui sera sur l''autel et de l''huile d''onction, et tu en feras l''aspersion sur Aaron et sur ses vêtements, sur ses fils et sur leurs vêtements. Ainsi seront consacrés Aaron et ses vêtements, ses fils et leurs vêtements.
verses.am: በመሠዊያውም ላይ ካለው ደም ከቅብዓት ዘይትም ወስደህ በአሮንና በልብሱ ላይ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ባሉት በልጆቹና በልብሶቻቸው ላይ ትረጨዋለህ፤ እርሱም ልብሶቹም፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ልጆቹ ልብሶቻቸውም ይቀደሳሉ።

verses.en: Also thou shalt take of the ram the fat and the rump, and the fat that covereth the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and the right shoulder; for it is a ram of consecration:
verses.fr: Tu prendras la graisse du bélier, la queue, la graisse qui couvre les entrailles, le grand lobe du foie, les deux rognons et la graisse qui les entoure, et l''épaule droite, car c''est un bélier de consécration;
verses.am: ደግሞም የሚካኑበት አውራ በግ ነውና የበጉን ስብ፥ ላቱንም፥ የሆድ ዕቃውንም የሚሸፍነውን ስብ፥ በጉበቱም ላይ ያለውን መረብ፥ ሁለቱንም ኵላሊቶች በላያቸውም ያለውን ስብ፥ የቀኙንም ወርች ትወስዳለህ።

verses.en: And one loaf of bread, and one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of the unleavened bread that is before the Lord:
verses.fr: tu prendras aussi dans la corbeille de pains sans levain, placée devant l''Eternel, un gâteau de pain, un gâteau à l''huile et une galette.
verses.am: አንድ እንጀራ፥ አንድም የዘይት እንጀራ፥ አንድም ስስ ቂጣ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በሌማት ካለው ቂጣ እንጀራ ትወስዳለህ፤

verses.en: And thou shalt put all in the hands of Aaron, and in the hands of his sons; and shalt wave them for a wave offering before the Lord.
verses.fr: Tu mettras toutes ces choses sur les mains d''Aaron et sur les mains de ses fils, et tu les agiteras de côté et d''autre devant l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሁሉንም በአሮን እጆችና በልጆቹ እጆች ታኖረዋለህ፤ ለሚወዘወዝ ቍርባን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ትወዘውዘዋለህ።

verses.en: And thou shalt receive them of their hands, and burn them upon the altar for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour before the Lord: it is an offering made by fire unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Tu les ôteras ensuite de leurs mains, et tu les brûleras sur l''autel, par-dessus l''holocauste; c''est un sacrifice consumé par le feu devant l''Eternel, d''une agréable odeur à l''Eternel.
verses.am: ከእጃቸውም ትቀበለዋለህ፥ በመሠዊያውም ላይ ከሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ጋር በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ጣፋጭ ሽቱ እንዲሆን ታቃጥለዋለህ፤ እርሱ ለእግዚአብሔር የእሳት ቍርባን ነው።

verses.en: And thou shalt take the breast of the ram of Aaron's consecration, and wave it for a wave offering before the Lord: and it shall be thy part.
verses.fr: Tu prendras la poitrine du bélier qui aura servi à la consécration d''Aaron, et tu l''agiteras de côté et d''autre devant l''Eternel: ce sera ta portion.
verses.am: ለአሮንም ክህነት የታረደውን በግ ፍርምባ ወስደህ ለሚወዘወዝ ቍርባን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ትወዘውዘዋለህ፤ እርሱም የአንተ ወግ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And thou shalt sanctify the breast of the wave offering, and the shoulder of the heave offering, which is waved, and which is heaved up, of the ram of the consecration, even of that which is for Aaron, and of that which is for his sons:
verses.fr: Tu sanctifieras la poitrine et l''épaule du bélier qui aura servi à la consécration d''Aaron et de ses fils, la poitrine en l''agitant de côté et d''autre, l''épaule en la présentant par élévation.
verses.am: ከሚካኑበትም አውራ በግ የተወሰደ ለአሮንና ለልጆቹ ወግ የሚሆን ለመሥዋዕት የተወዘወዘውን ፍርምባና የተነሣውን ወርች ትቀድሳለህ።
