verses.en: And it shall be Aaron's and his sons' by a statute for ever from the children of Israel: for it is an heave offering: and it shall be an heave offering from the children of Israel of the sacrifice of their peace offerings, even their heave offering unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Elles appartiendront à Aaron et à ses fils, par une loi perpétuelle qu''observeront les enfants d''Israël, car c''est une offrande par élévation; et, dans les sacrifices d''actions de grâces des enfants d''Israël, l''offrande par élévation sera pour l''Eternel.
verses.am: ያውም የማንሣት ቍርባን ነውና ከእስራኤል ልጆች ዘንድ ለዘላለም የአሮንና የልጆቹ ወግ ይሁን፤ የእስራኤል ልጆች የሚያቀርቡት የደኅንነት መሥዋዕታቸው የማንሣት ቍርባን ይሆናል፤ ለእግዚአብሔር የማንሣት ቍርባን ይሆናል።

verses.en: And the holy garments of Aaron shall be his sons' after him, to be anointed therein, and to be consecrated in them.
verses.fr: Les vêtements sacrés d''Aaron seront après lui pour ses fils, qui les mettront lorsqu''on les oindra et qu''on les consacrera.
verses.am: የተቀደሰውም የአሮን ልብስ ይቀቡበትና ይካኑበት ዘንድ ከእርሱ በኋላ ለልጆቹ ይሁን።

verses.en: And that son that is priest in his stead shall put them on seven days, when he cometh into the tabernacle of the congregation to minister in the holy place.
verses.fr: Ils seront portés pendant sept jours par celui de ses fils qui lui succédera dans le sacerdoce, et qui entrera dans la tente d''assignation, pour faire le service dans le sanctuaire.
verses.am: ከልጆቹም በእርሱ ፋንታ ካህን የሚሆነው በመቅደስ ለማገልገል ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ሲገባ ሰባት ቀን ይልበሰው።

verses.en: And thou shalt take the ram of the consecration, and seethe his flesh in the holy place.
verses.fr: Tu prendras le bélier de consécration, et tu en feras cuire la chair dans un lieu saint.
verses.am: የሚካንበትንም አውራ በግ ወስደህ ሥጋውን በተቀደሰ ስፍራ ትቀቅለዋለህ።

verses.en: And Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram, and the bread that is in the basket by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.fr: Aaron et ses fils mangeront, à l''entrée de la tente d''assignation, la chair du bélier et le pain qui sera dans la corbeille.
verses.am: አሮንና ልጆቹም የአውራውን በግ ሥጋ በሌማትም ያለውን እንጀራ በመገናኛው ድንኳን በር ይበሉታል።

verses.en: And they shall eat those things wherewith the atonement was made, to consecrate and to sanctify them: but a stranger shall not eat thereof, because they are holy.
verses.fr: Ils mangeront ainsi ce qui aura servi d''expiation afin qu''ils fussent consacrés et sanctifiés; nul étranger n''en mangera, car ce sont des choses saintes.
verses.am: የተካኑና የተቀደሱ ይሆኑ ዘንድ ማስተስረያ የሆነውን ነገር ይብሉት፤ ሌላ ሰው ግን አይብላው፤ የተቀደሰ ነውና።

verses.en: And if ought of the flesh of the consecrations, or of the bread, remain unto the morning, then thou shalt burn the remainder with fire: it shall not be eaten, because it is holy.
verses.fr: S''il reste de la chair de consécration et du pain jusqu''au matin, tu brûleras dans le feu ce qui restera; on ne le mangera point, car c''est une chose sainte.
verses.am: የተካኑበትም ሥጋ ወይም እንጀራ ተርፎ ቢያድር፥ የቀረውን በእሳት ታቃጥለዋለህ፤ የተቀደሰ ነውና አይበላም።

verses.en: And thus shalt thou do unto Aaron, and to his sons, according to all things which I have commanded thee: seven days shalt thou consecrate them.
verses.fr: Tu suivras à l''égard d''Aaron et de ses fils tous les ordres que je t''ai donnés. Tu emploieras sept jours à les consacrer.
verses.am: እንዳዘዝሁህም ሁሉ በአሮንና በልጆቹ እንዲህ አድርግ፤ ሰባት ቀን ትክናቸዋለህ።

verses.en: And thou shalt offer every day a bullock for a sin offering for atonement: and thou shalt cleanse the altar, when thou hast made an atonement for it, and thou shalt anoint it, to sanctify it.
verses.fr: Tu offriras chaque jour un taureau en sacrifice pour le péché, pour l''expiation; tu purifieras l''autel par cette expiation, et tu l''oindras pour le sanctifier.
verses.am: ዕለት ዕለትም ስለ ማስተስረይ ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ወይፈኑን ታቀርባለህ፤ ማስተስረያም ባደረግህ ጊዜ መሠዊያውን ታነጻዋለህ፤ ቅዱስም ይሆን ዘንድ ትቀባዋለህ።

verses.en: Seven days thou shalt make an atonement for the altar, and sanctify it; and it shall be an altar most holy: whatsoever toucheth the altar shall be holy.
verses.fr: Pendant sept jours, tu feras des expiations sur l''autel, et tu le sanctifieras; et l''autel sera très saint, et tout ce qui touchera l''autel sera sanctifié.
verses.am: ሰባት ቀን ለመሠዊያው ማስተስረያ ታደርጋለህ፥ ትቀድሰውማለህ፤ መሠዊያውም ቅድስተ ቅዱሳን ይሆናል፤ መሠዊያውንም የሚነካ ሁሉ ቅዱስ ይሆናል።

verses.en: Now this is that which thou shalt offer upon the altar; two lambs of the first year day by day continually.
verses.fr: Voici ce que tu offriras sur l''autel: deux agneaux d''un an, chaque jour, à perpétuité.
verses.am: በመሠዊያውም ላይ የምታቀርበው ይህ ነው፤ በቀን በቀን ዘወትር ሁለት የዓመት ጠቦቶች ታቀርባለህ።

verses.en: The one lamb thou shalt offer in the morning; and the other lamb thou shalt offer at even:
verses.fr: Tu offriras l''un des agneaux le matin, et l''autre agneau entre les deux soirs.
verses.am: አንዱን ጠቦት በማለዳ ቍርባን አድርገህ ታቀርበዋለህ፤ ሁለተኛውንም ጠቦት በማታ ቍርባን አድርገህ ታቀርበዋለህ።

verses.en: And with the one lamb a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil; and the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering.
verses.fr: Tu offriras, avec le premier agneau, un dixième d''épha de fleur de farine pétrie dans un quart de hin d''huile d''olives concassées, et une libation d''un quart de hin de vin.
verses.am: ከአንዱ ጠቦትም ጋር የኢን መስፈሪያ አራተኛ እጅ በሆነ ተወቅጦ በተጠለለ ዘይት የተለወሰ የኢፍ መስፈሪያ አሥረኛ እጅ መልካም ዱቄት፥ ደግሞ ለመጠጥ ቍርባን የኢን መስፈሪያ አራተኛ እጅ የወይን ጠጅ ታቀርባለህ።

verses.en: And the other lamb thou shalt offer at even, and shalt do thereto according to the meat offering of the morning, and according to the drink offering thereof, for a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Tu offriras le second agneau entre les deux soirs, avec une offrande et une libation semblables à celles du matin; c''est un sacrifice consumé par le feu, d''une agréable odeur à l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሁለተኛውንም ጠቦት በማታ ታቀርበዋለህ፥ እንደ ማለዳውም የእህልና የመጠጥ ቍርባን ታደርግበታለህ፤ ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽቱ እንዲሆን የእሳት ቍርባን ይሆናል።

verses.en: This shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the Lord: where I will meet you, to speak there unto thee.
verses.fr: Voilà l''holocauste perpétuel qui sera offert par vos descendants, à l''entrée de la tente d''assignation, devant l''Eternel: c''est là que je me rencontrerai avec vous, et que je te parlerai.
verses.am: ለአንተ እናገር ዘንድ ከእናንተ ጋር በምገናኝበት በመገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ይህ ዘወትር ለልጅ ልጃችሁ የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ይሆናል።

verses.en: And there I will meet with the children of Israel, and the tabernacle shall be sanctified by my glory.
verses.fr: Je me rencontrerai là avec les enfants d''Israël, et ce lieu sera sanctifié par ma gloire.
verses.am: ከእስራኤልም ልጆች ጋር በዚያ እገናኛለሁ፤ ድንኳኑም በክብሬ ይቀደሳል።

verses.en: And I will sanctify the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar: I will sanctify also both Aaron and his sons, to minister to me in the priest's office.
verses.fr: Je sanctifierai la tente d''assignation et l''autel; je sanctifierai Aaron et ses fils, pour qu''ils soient à mon service dans le sacerdoce.
verses.am: የመገናኛውንም ድንኳን መሠዊያውንም እቀድሳለሁ፤ በክህነትም ያገለግሉኝ ዘንድ አሮንንና ልጆቹን እቀድሳለሁ።

verses.en: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will be their God.
verses.fr: J''habiterai au milieu des enfants d''Israël, et je serai leur Dieu.
verses.am: በእስራኤልም ልጆች መካከል እኖራለሁ፥ አምላክም እሆናቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: And they shall know that I am the Lord their God, that brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, that I may dwell among them: I am the Lord their God.
verses.fr: Ils connaîtront que je suis l''Eternel, leur Dieu, qui les ai fait sortir du pays d''Egypte, pour habiter au milieu d''eux. Je suis l''Eternel, leur Dieu.
verses.am: በመካከላቸውም እኖር ዘንድ ከግብፅ ምድር ያወጣኋቸው አምላካቸው እግዚአብሔር እኔ እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ፤ እኔ አምላካቸው እግዚአብሔር ነኝ።

verses.en: And thou shalt make an altar to burn incense upon: of shittim wood shalt thou make it.
verses.fr: Tu feras un autel pour brûler des parfums, tu le feras de bois d''acacia;
verses.am: የዕጣን መሠዊያውን ሥራ፤ ከግራር እንጨት አድርገው።

verses.en: A cubit shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof; foursquare shall it be: and two cubits shall be the height thereof: the horns thereof shall be of the same.
verses.fr: sa longueur sera d''une coudée, et sa largeur d''une coudée; il sera carré, et sa hauteur sera de deux coudées. Tu feras des cornes qui sortiront de l''autel.
verses.am: ርዝመቱ አንድ ክንድ፥ ስፋቱም አንድ ክንድ፥ አራት ማዕዘን ይሁን፤ ከፍታውም ሁለት ክንድ ይሆናል፤ ቀንዶቹም ከእርሱ ጋር በአንድነት የተሠሩ ይሁኑ።

verses.en: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, the top thereof, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns thereof; and thou shalt make unto it a crown of gold round about.
verses.fr: Tu le couvriras d''or pur, le dessus, les côtés tout autour et les cornes, et tu y feras une bordure d''or tout autour.
verses.am: ላይኛውንና የግድግዳውንም ዙሪያ ቀንዶቹንም በጥሩ ወርቅ ትለብጠዋለህ፤ በዙሪያውም የወርቅ ክፈፍ ታደርግለታለህ።

verses.en: And two golden rings shalt thou make to it under the crown of it, by the two corners thereof, upon the two sides of it shalt thou make it; and they shall be for places for the staves to bear it withal.
verses.fr: Tu feras au-dessous de la bordure deux anneaux d''or aux deux côtés; tu en mettras aux deux côtés, pour recevoir les barres qui serviront à le porter.
verses.am: ከክፈፉም በታች ሁለት የወርቅ ቀለበቶች አድርግለት። በዚህና በዚያ በሁለቱ ጎን ታደርጋቸዋለህ፤ ለመሸከምም የመሎጊያዎች ስፍራ ይሁኑ።

verses.en: And thou shalt make the staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.
verses.fr: Tu feras les barres de bois d''acacia, et tu les couvriras d''or.
verses.am: መሎጊያዎቹንም ከግራር እንጨት አድርግ፥ በወርቅም ለብጣቸው።

verses.en: And thou shalt put it before the vail that is by the ark of the testimony, before the mercy seat that is over the testimony, where I will meet with thee.
verses.fr: Tu placeras l''autel en face du voile qui est devant l''arche du témoignage, en face du propitiatoire qui est sur le témoignage, et où je me rencontrerai avec toi.
verses.am: በምስክሩ ታቦት አጠገብም ካለው መጋረጃ በፊት ታኖረዋለህ ይህንም አንተን በምገናኝበት ከምስክሩ በላይ ባለው በስርየት መክደኛ ፊት ታኖረዋለህ።

verses.en: And Aaron shall burn thereon sweet incense every morning: when he dresseth the lamps, he shall burn incense upon it.
verses.fr: Aaron y fera brûler du parfum odoriférant; il en fera brûler chaque matin, lorsqu''il préparera les lampes;
verses.am: አሮንም የጣፋጭ ሽቱ እጣን ይጠንበት፤ በማለዳ በማለዳ መብራቶቹን ሲያዘጋጅ ይጠነው።

verses.en: And when Aaron lighteth the lamps at even, he shall burn incense upon it, a perpetual incense before the Lord throughout your generations.
verses.fr: il en fera brûler aussi entre les deux soirs, lorsqu''il arrangera les lampes. C''est ainsi que l''on brûlera à perpétuité du parfum devant l''Eternel parmi vos descendants.
verses.am: ይህን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለልጅ ልጃችሁ የዘወትር ዕጣን ይሆን ዘንድ አሮን በማታ ጊዜ መብራቶቹን ሲያበራ ያጥነዋል።

verses.en: Ye shall offer no strange incense thereon, nor burnt sacrifice, nor meat offering; neither shall ye pour drink offering thereon.
verses.fr: Vous n''offrirez sur l''autel ni parfum étranger, ni holocauste, ni offrande, et vous n''y répandrez aucune libation.
verses.am: ሌላም ዕጣን፥ የሚቃጠለውንም መስዋዕት፥ የእህሉንም ቍርባን አታቀርብበትም፤ የመጠጥም ቍርባን አታፈስስበትም።

verses.en: And Aaron shall make an atonement upon the horns of it once in a year with the blood of the sin offering of atonements: once in the year shall he make atonement upon it throughout your generations: it is most holy unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Une fois chaque année, Aaron fera des expiations sur les cornes de l''autel; avec le sang de la victime expiatoire, il y sera fait des expiations une fois chaque année parmi vos descendants. Ce sera une chose très sainte devant l''Eternel.
verses.am: አሮንም በአመት አንድ ጊዜ በቀንዶቹ ላይ ማስተስረያ ያደርጋል፤ በአመት አንድ ጊዜ ለልጅ ልጃችሁ ማስተስረያ በሚሆን በኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ደም ማስተስረያ ያደርግበታል። ለእግዚአብሔር ቅድስተ ቅዱሳን ናት።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: When thou takest the sum of the children of Israel after their number, then shall they give every man a ransom for his soul unto the Lord, when thou numberest them; that there be no plague among them, when thou numberest them.
verses.fr: Lorsque tu compteras les enfants d''Israël pour en faire le dénombrement, chacun d''eux paiera à l''Eternel le rachat de sa personne, afin qu''ils ne soient frappés d''aucune plaie lors de ce dénombrement.
verses.am: አንተ የእስራኤልን ልጆች ቍጥር ተቀብለህ፥ በቈጠርሃቸው ጊዜ መቅሰፍት እንዳይሆንባቸው፥ በቈጠርሃቸው ጊዜ ከእነርሱ ሰው ሁሉ እንደ ቍጥራቸው መጠን የነፍሱን ቤዛ ለእግዚአብሔር ይስጥ።

verses.en: This they shall give, every one that passeth among them that are numbered, half a shekel after the shekel of the sanctuary: (a shekel is twenty gerahs:) an half shekel shall be the offering of the Lord.
verses.fr: Voici ce que donneront tous ceux qui seront compris dans le dénombrement: un demi-sicle, selon le sicle du sanctuaire, qui est de vingt guéras; un demi-sicle sera le don prélevé pour l''Eternel.
verses.am: አልፎ የሚቈጠር ሁሉ ግማሽ ሰቅል እንደ መቅደሱ ሰቅል ሚዛን ይሰጣል፤ የሰቅል ግማሽ ለእግዚአብሔር ያነሣል።

verses.en: Every one that passeth among them that are numbered, from twenty years old and above, shall give an offering unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Tout homme compris dans le dénombrement, depuis l''âge de vingt ans et au-dessus, paiera le don prélevé pour l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሰቅሉ ሀያ ኦቦሊ ነው። አልፎ የተቈጠረ ሁሉ፥ ከሀያ ዓመት ጀምሮ ከዚያም ከፍ ያለ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ስጦታ ይሰጣል።

verses.en: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less than half a shekel, when they give an offering unto the Lord, to make an atonement for your souls.
verses.fr: Le riche ne paiera pas plus, et le pauvre ne paiera pas moins d''un demi-sicle, comme don prélevé pour l''Eternel, afin de racheter leurs personnes.
verses.am: ለነፍሳችሁ ማስተስረያ የእግዚአብሔርን ስጦታ ስትሰጡ ባለ ጠጋው ከሰቅል ግማሽ አይጨምር፥ ድሀውም አያጕድል።

verses.en: And thou shalt take the atonement money of the children of Israel, and shalt appoint it for the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; that it may be a memorial unto the children of Israel before the Lord, to make an atonement for your souls.
verses.fr: Tu recevras des enfants d''Israël l''argent du rachat, et tu l''appliqueras au travail de la tente d''assignation; ce sera pour les enfants d''Israël un souvenir devant l''Eternel pour le rachat de leurs personnes.
verses.am: የማስተስረያውንም ገንዘብ ከእስራኤል ልጆች ወስደህ ለመገናኛው ድንኳን ማገልገያ ታደርገዋለህ፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ለነፍሳችሁ ቤዛ እንዲሆን ለእስራኤል ልጆች መታሰቢያ ይሁን።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Thou shalt also make a laver of brass, and his foot also of brass, to wash withal: and thou shalt put it between the tabernacle of the congregation and the altar, and thou shalt put water therein.
verses.fr: Tu feras une cuve d''airain, avec sa base d''airain, pour les ablutions; tu la placeras entre la tente d''assignation et l''autel, et tu y mettras de l''eau,
verses.am: የመታጠቢያ ሰንና መቀመጫውን ከናስ ሥራ፤ በመገናኛው ድንኳንና በመሠዊያው መካከል እርሱን አድርገህ ውኃን ትጨምርበታለህ።

verses.en: For Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet thereat:
verses.fr: avec laquelle Aaron et ses fils se laveront les mains et les pieds.
verses.am: አሮንና ልጆቹም እጆቻቸውንና እግሮቻቸውን ይታጠቡበታል።

verses.en: When they go into the tabernacle of the congregation, they shall wash with water, that they die not; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn offering made by fire unto the Lord:
verses.fr: Lorsqu''ils entreront dans la tente d''assignation, ils se laveront avec cette eau, afin qu''ils ne meurent point; et aussi lorsqu''ils s''approcheront de l''autel, pour faire le service et pour offrir des sacrifices à l''Eternel.
verses.am: ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን በገቡ ጊዜ፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም የእሳት መስዋዕት ያቃጥሉ ዘንድ ወደ መሠዊያው ሊያገለግሉ በቀረቡ ጊዜ፥ እንዳይሞቱ ይታጠቡበታል።

verses.en: So they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they die not: and it shall be a statute for ever to them, even to him and to his seed throughout their generations.
verses.fr: Ils se laveront les mains et les pieds, afin qu''ils ne meurent point. Ce sera une loi perpétuelle pour Aaron, pour ses fils et pour leurs descendants.
verses.am: እንዳይሞቱም እጆቻቸውንና እግሮቻቸውን ይታጠቡ፤ ይህም ለእርሱ ከእርሱም በኋላ ለዘሩ የዘላለም ሥርዓት ይሆንላቸዋል።

verses.en: Moreover the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Take thou also unto thee principal spices, of pure myrrh five hundred shekels, and of sweet cinnamon half so much, even two hundred and fifty shekels, and of sweet calamus two hundred and fifty shekels,
verses.fr: Prends des meilleurs aromates, cinq cents sicles de myrrhe, de celle qui coule d''elle-même; la moitié, soit deux cent cinquante sicles, de cinnamome aromatique, deux cent cinquante sicles de roseau aromatique,
verses.am: አንተም ክቡሩን ሽቱ ውሰድ፤ የተመረጠ ከርቤ አምስት መቶ ሰቅል፥ ግማሽም ጣፋጭ ቀረፋ ሁለት መቶ አምሳ ሰቅል፥ የጠጅ ሣርም እንዲሁ ሁለት መቶ አምሳ ሰቅል፥

verses.en: And of cassia five hundred shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, and of oil olive an hin:
verses.fr: cinq cents sicles de casse, selon le sicle du sanctuaire, et un hin d''huile d''olive.
verses.am: ብርጕድም አምስት መቶ ሰቅል እንደ መቅደሱ ሰቅል ሚዛን፥ የወይራ ዘይትም አንድ የኢን መስፈሪያ ትወስዳለህ።

verses.en: And thou shalt make it an oil of holy ointment, an ointment compound after the art of the apothecary: it shall be an holy anointing oil.
verses.fr: Tu feras avec cela une huile pour l''onction sainte, composition de parfums selon l''art du parfumeur; ce sera l''huile pour l''onction sainte.
verses.am: በቀማሚም ብልሃት እንደ ተሠራ ቅመም፥ የተቀደሰ የቅብዓት ዘይት ታደርገዋለህ፤ የተቀደሰ የቅብዓት ዘይት ይሆናል።

verses.en: And thou shalt anoint the tabernacle of the congregation therewith, and the ark of the testimony,
verses.fr: Tu en oindras la tente d''assignation et l''arche du témoignage,
verses.am: የመገናኛውንም ድንኳን፥ የምስክሩንም ታቦት፥

verses.en: And the table and all his vessels, and the candlestick and his vessels, and the altar of incense,
verses.fr: la table et tous ses ustensiles, le chandelier et ses ustensiles, l''autel des parfums,
verses.am: ገበታውንም ዕቃውንም ሁሉ፥ መቅረዙንም ዕቃውንም፥ የዕጣን መሠዊያውንም፥

verses.en: And the altar of burnt offering with all his vessels, and the laver and his foot.
verses.fr: l''autel des holocaustes et tous ses ustensiles, la cuve avec sa base.
verses.am: ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት የሚሆነውን መሠዊያና ዕቃውንም ሁሉ፥ የመታጠቢያውን ሰንና መቀመጫውንም ትቀባበታለህ።

verses.en: And thou shalt sanctify them, that they may be most holy: whatsoever toucheth them shall be holy.
verses.fr: Tu sanctifieras ces choses, et elles seront très saintes, tout ce qui les touchera sera sanctifié.
verses.am: ሁሉንም ትቀድሳቸዋለህ፥ ቅድስተ ቅዱሳንም ይሆናሉ፤ የሚነካቸውም ሁሉ ቅዱስ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And thou shalt anoint Aaron and his sons, and consecrate them, that they may minister unto me in the priest's office.
verses.fr: Tu oindras Aaron et ses fils, et tu les sanctifieras, pour qu''ils soient à mon service dans le sacerdoce.
verses.am: በክህነትም ያገለግሉኝ ዘንድ አሮንንና ልጆቹን ቅባቸው፥ ቀድሳቸውም።

verses.en: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, This shall be an holy anointing oil unto me throughout your generations.
verses.fr: Tu parleras aux enfants d''Israël, et tu diras: Ce sera pour moi l''huile de l''onction sainte, parmi vos descendants.
verses.am: አንተም ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ተናገር። ይህ ለልጅ ልጃችሁ የተቀደሰ የቅብዓት ዘይት ይሁንልኝ።

verses.en: Upon man's flesh shall it not be poured, neither shall ye make any other like it, after the composition of it: it is holy, and it shall be holy unto you.
verses.fr: On n''en répandra point sur le corps d''un homme, et vous n''en ferez point de semblable, dans les mêmes proportions; elle est sainte, et vous la regarderez comme sainte.
verses.am: በሰው ሥጋ ላይ አይፍሰስ፤ እንደ እርሱም የተሰራ ሌላ ቅብዓት አታድርጉ፤ ቅዱስ ነው፥ ለእናንተም ቅዱስ ይሁን።

verses.en: Whosoever compoundeth any like it, or whosoever putteth any of it upon a stranger, shall even be cut off from his people.
verses.fr: Quiconque en composera de semblable, ou en mettra sur un étranger, sera retranché de son peuple.
verses.am: እንደ እርሱ ያለውን የሚያደርግ ሰው፥ በሌላም ሰው ላይ የሚያፈስሰው ከሕዝቡ ተለይቶ ይጥፋ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Take unto thee sweet spices, stacte, and onycha, and galbanum; these sweet spices with pure frankincense: of each shall there be a like weight:
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse: Prends des aromates, du stacté, de l''ongle odorant, du galbanum, et de l''encens pur, en parties égales.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን አለው። ጣፋጭ ሽቱ ውሰድ፤ የሚንጠባጠብ ሙጫ፥ በዛጎል ውስጥ የሚገኝ ሽቱ፥ የሚሸትትም ሙጫ፥ ጥሩም እጣን ውሰድ፤ የሁሉም መጠን ትክክል ይሁን።

verses.en: And thou shalt make it a perfume, a confection after the art of the apothecary, tempered together, pure and holy:
verses.fr: Tu feras avec cela un parfum composé selon l''art du parfumeur; il sera salé, pur et saint.
verses.am: በቀማሚ ብልሃት እንደ ተሠራ፥ በጨው የተቀመመ ንጹሕና ቅዱስ ዕጣን አድርገው።

verses.en: And thou shalt beat some of it very small, and put of it before the testimony in the tabernacle of the congregation, where I will meet with thee: it shall be unto you most holy.
verses.fr: Tu le réduiras en poudre, et tu le mettras devant le témoignage, dans la tente d''assignation, où je me rencontrerai avec toi. Ce sera pour vous une chose très sainte.
verses.am: ከእርሱም ጥቂት ትወቅጣለህ፥ ታልመውማለህ፤ ከዚያም ወስደህ አንተን በምገናኝበት በመገናኛው ድንኳን ውስጥ በምስክሩ ፊት ታኖረዋለህ። እርሱም የቅዱሳን ቅዱስ ይሁንላችሁ።

verses.en: And as for the perfume which thou shalt make, ye shall not make to yourselves according to the composition thereof: it shall be unto thee holy for the Lord.
verses.fr: Vous ne ferez point pour vous de parfum semblable, dans les mêmes proportions; vous le regarderez comme saint, et réservé pour l''Eternel.
verses.am: እንደ እርሱ የተሠራ ዕጣን ለእናንተ አታድርጉ፤ በእናንተ ዘንድም ለእግዚአብሔር የተቀደሰ ይሁን።

verses.en: Whosoever shall make like unto that, to smell thereto, shall even be cut off from his people.
verses.fr: Quiconque en fera de semblable, pour le sentir, sera retranché de son peuple.
verses.am: ሊያሸትተውም እንደ እርሱ የሚያደርግ ሰው ከሕዝቡ ተለይቶ ይጥፋ።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: See, I have called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah:
verses.fr: Sache que j''ai choisi Betsaleel, fils d''Uri, fils de Hur, de la tribu de Juda.
verses.am: እይ ከይሁዳ ነገድ የሚሆን የሆር የልጅ ልጅ፥ የኡሪ ልጅ ባስልኤልን በስሙ ጠርቼዋለሁ።

verses.en: And I have filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship,
verses.fr: Je l''ai rempli de l''Esprit de Dieu, de sagesse, d''intelligence, et de savoir pour toutes sortes d''ouvrages,
verses.am: በሥራ ሁሉ ብልሃት በጥበብም በማስተዋልም በእውቀትም የእዚአብሔርን መንፈስ ሞላሁበት፤

verses.en: To devise cunning works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,
verses.fr: je l''ai rendu capable de faire des inventions, de travailler l''or, l''argent et l''airain,
verses.am: የጥበብን ሥራ ያስተውል ዘንድ፥ በወርቅና በብር በናስም ይሰራ ዘንድ፥

verses.en: And in cutting of stones, to set them, and in carving of timber, to work in all manner of workmanship.
verses.fr: de graver les pierres à enchâsser, de travailler le bois, et d''exécuter toutes sortes d''ouvrages.
verses.am: ለፈርጥ የሚሆነውን የዕንቍ ድንጋይ ይቀርጽ ዘንድ፥ እንጨቱንም ይጠርብ ዘንድ፥ ሥራውንም ሁሉ ይሠራ ዘንድ።

verses.en: And I, behold, I have given with him Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan: and in the hearts of all that are wise hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded thee;
verses.fr: Et voici, je lui ai donné pour aide Oholiab, fils d''Ahisamac, de la tribu de Dan. J''ai mis de l''intelligence dans l''esprit de tous ceux qui sont habiles, pour qu''ils fassent tout ce que je t''ai ordonné:
verses.am: እኔም እነሆ ከእርሱ ጋር ከዳን ነገድ የሚሆን የአሂሳሚክን ልጅ ኤልያብን ሰጠሁ፤ ያዘዝሁህን ሁሉ ያደርጉ ዘንድ በልባቸው ጥበበኞች በሆኑት ሁሉ ጥበብን አኖርሁ።

verses.en: The tabernacle of the congregation, and the ark of the testimony, and the mercy seat that is thereupon, and all the furniture of the tabernacle,
verses.fr: la tente d''assignation, l''arche du témoignage, le propitiatoire qui sera dessus, et tous les ustensiles de la tente;
verses.am: የመገናኛውን ድንኳን፥ የምስክሩንም ታቦት፥ በእርሱም ላይ ያለውን የስርየት መክደኛውን፥ የድንኳኑንም ዕቃ ሁሉ፥

verses.en: And the table and his furniture, and the pure candlestick with all his furniture, and the altar of incense,
verses.fr: la table et ses ustensiles, le chandelier d''or pur et tous ses ustensiles, l''autel des parfums;
verses.am: ገበታውንም ዕቃውንም፥ ከዕቃው ሁሉ ጋር የነጻውን መቅረዝ፥ የዕጣን መሠዊያውን፥

verses.en: And the altar of burnt offering with all his furniture, and the laver and his foot,
verses.fr: l''autel des holocaustes et tous ses ustensiles, la cuve avec sa base;
verses.am: ለሚቃጠል መሥዋት የሚሆነውንም መሠዊያ ዕቃውንም ሁሉ፥ የመታጠቢያውን ሰንም መቀመጫውንም፥ በብልሃት የተሠራውንም ልብስ፥

verses.en: And the cloths of service, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest's office,
verses.fr: les vêtements d''office, les vêtements sacrés pour le sacrificateur Aaron, les vêtements de ses fils pour les fonctions du sacerdoce;
verses.am: በክህነት እኔን የሚያገለግሉበትን የካህኑን የአሮንን ልብሰ ተክህኖና የልጆቹን ልብስ፥

verses.en: And the anointing oil, and sweet incense for the holy place: according to all that I have commanded thee shall they do.
verses.fr: l''huile d''onction, et le parfum odoriférant pour le sanctuaire. Ils se conformeront à tous les ordres que j''ai donnés.
verses.am: የቅብዓቱንም ዘይት፥ ለመቅደሱ የሚሆን የጣፋጭ ሽቱውንም ዕጣን እንዳዘዝሁህ ሁሉ ያድርጉ።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ሲል ተናገረው።

verses.en: Speak thou also unto the children of Israel, saying, Verily my sabbaths ye shall keep: for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations; that ye may know that I am the Lord that doth sanctify you.
verses.fr: Parle aux enfants d''Israël, et dis-leur: Vous ne manquerez pas d''observer mes sabbats, car ce sera entre moi et vous, et parmi vos descendants, un signe auquel on connaîtra que je suis l''Eternel qui vous sanctifie.
verses.am: ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ንገራቸው። እኔ የምቀድሳችሁ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቁ ዘንድ በእኔና በእናንተ ዘንድ ለልጅ ልጃችሁ ምልክት ነውና ሰንበቶቼን ፈጽሞ ጠብቁ።

verses.en: Ye shall keep the sabbath therefore; for it is holy unto you: every one that defileth it shall surely be put to death: for whosoever doeth any work therein, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.fr: Vous observerez le sabbat, car il sera pour vous une chose sainte. Celui qui le profanera, sera puni de mort; celui qui fera quelque ouvrage ce jour-là, sera retranché du milieu de son peuple.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ለእናንተ ቅዱስ ነውና ሰንበትን ጠብቁ፤ የሚያረክሰውም ሰው ሁሉ ፈጽሞ ይገደል፥ ሥራንም በእርሱ የሠራ ሰው ሁሉ ከሕዝቡ መካከል ተለይቶ ይጥፋ።

verses.en: Six days may work be done; but in the seventh is the sabbath of rest, holy to the Lord: whosoever doeth any work in the sabbath day, he shall surely be put to death.
verses.fr: On travaillera six jours; mais le septième jour est le sabbat, le jour du repos, consacré à l''Eternel. Celui qui fera quelque ouvrage le jour du sabbat, sera puni de mort.
verses.am: ስድስት ቀን ሥራን ሥራ፤ ሰባተኛው ቀን ግን ለእግዚአብሔር የተቀደሰ የዕረፍት ሰንበት ነው፤ በሰንበት ቀን የሚሠራ ሁሉ ፈጽሞ ይገደል።

verses.en: Wherefore the children of Israel shall keep the sabbath, to observe the sabbath throughout their generations, for a perpetual covenant.
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël observeront le sabbat, en le célébrant, eux et leurs descendants, comme une alliance perpétuelle.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ለልጅ ልጃቸው ለዘላለም ቃል ኪዳን በሰንበት ያርፉ ዘንድ ሰንበትን ይጠብቁ።

verses.en: It is a sign between me and the children of Israel for ever: for in six days the Lord made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed.
verses.fr: Ce sera entre moi et les enfants d''Israël un signe qui devra durer à perpétuité; car en six jours l''Eternel a fait les cieux et la terre, et le septième jour il a cessé son oeuvre et il s''est reposé.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ሰማይንና ምድርን በስድስት ቀን ስለ ፈጠረ፥ በሰባተኛውም ቀን ከሥራው ስላረፈና ስለ ተነፈሰ፥ በእኔና በእስራኤል ልጆች ዘንድ የዘላለም ምልክት ነው።

verses.en: And he gave unto Moses, when he had made an end of communing with him upon mount Sinai, two tables of testimony, tables of stone, written with the finger of God.
verses.fr: Lorsque l''Eternel eut achevé de parler à Moïse sur la montagne de Sinaï, il lui donna les deux tables du témoignage, tables de pierre, écrites du doigt de Dieu.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ከሙሴ ጋር በሲና ተራራ የተናገረውን በፈጸመ ጊዜ በእግዚአብሔር ጣት የተጻፈባቸውን ከድንጋይ የሆኑ ሁለቱን የምስክር ጽላቶች ሰጠው።

verses.en: And when the people saw that Moses delayed to come down out of the mount, the people gathered themselves together unto Aaron, and said unto him, Up, make us gods, which shall go before us; for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.
verses.fr: Le peuple, voyant que Moïse tardait à descendre de la montagne, s''assembla autour d''Aaron, et lui dit: Allons! fais-nous un dieu qui marche devant nous, car ce Moïse, cet homme qui nous a fait sortir du pays d''Egypte, nous ne savons ce qu''il est devenu.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ሙሴ ከተራራው ሳይወርድ እንደ ዘገየ ባዩ ጊዜ፥ ወደ አሮን ተሰብስበው። ይህ ከግብፅ ምድር ያወጣን ሰው ሙሴ ምን እንደ ሆነ አናውቅምና ተነሥተህ በፊታችን የሚሄዱ አማልክት ሥራልን አሉት።

verses.en: And Aaron said unto them, Break off the golden earrings, which are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring them unto me.
verses.fr: Aaron leur dit: Otez les anneaux d''or qui sont aux oreilles de vos femmes, de vos fils et de vos filles, et apportez-les-moi.
verses.am: አሮንም። በሚስቶቻችሁ በወንዶችና በሴቶች ልጆቻችሁም ጆሮ ያሉትን የወርቅ ቀለበቶች ሰብራችሁ አምጡልኝ አላቸው።

verses.en: And all the people brake off the golden earrings which were in their ears, and brought them unto Aaron.
verses.fr: Et tous ôtèrent les anneaux d''or qui étaient à leurs oreilles, et ils les apportèrent à Aaron.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ በጆሮቻቸው ያሉትን የወርቅ ቀለበቶች ሰብረው ወደ አሮን አመጡለት።

verses.en: And he received them at their hand, and fashioned it with a graving tool, after he had made it a molten calf: and they said, These be thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: Il les reçut de leurs mains, jeta l''or dans un moule, et fit un veau en fonte. Et ils dirent: Israël! voici ton dieu, qui t''a fait sortir du pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: ከእጃቸውም ተቀብሎ በመቅረጫ ቀረጸው፥ ቀልጦ የተሠራ ጥጃም አደረገው፤ እርሱም። እስራኤል ሆይ፥ እነዚህ ከግብፅ ምድር ያወጡህ አማልክትህ ናቸው አላቸው።

verses.en: And when Aaron saw it, he built an altar before it; and Aaron made proclamation, and said, To morrow is a feast to the Lord.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''Aaron vit cela, il bâtit un autel devant lui, et il s''écria: Demain, il y aura fête en l''honneur de l''Eternel!
verses.am: አሮንም ባየው ጊዜ መሠዊያን በፊቱ ሠራ፤ አሮንም።ነገ የእግዚአብሔር በዓል ነው ሲል አወጀ።

verses.en: And they rose up early on the morrow, and offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.
verses.fr: Le lendemain, ils se levèrent de bon matin, et ils offrirent des holocaustes et des sacrifices d''actions de grâces. Le peuple s''assit pour manger et pour boire; puis ils se levèrent pour se divertir.
verses.am: በነጋውም ማልደው ተነሥተው የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ሠዉ፥ የደኅነትም መሥዋዕት አቀረቡ፤ ሕዝቡም ሊበሉና ሊጠጡ ተቀመጡ፥ ሊዘፍኑም ተነሡ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Go, get thee down; for thy people, which thou broughtest out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves:
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse: Va, descends; car ton peuple, que tu as fait sortir du pays d''Egypte, s''est corrompu.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። ከግብፅ ምድር ያወጣኸው ሕዝብህ ኃጢአት ሠርተዋልና ሂድ፥ ውረድ።

verses.en: They have turned aside quickly out of the way which I commanded them: they have made them a molten calf, and have worshipped it, and have sacrificed thereunto, and said, These be thy gods, O Israel, which have brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: Ils se sont promptement écartés de la voie que je leur avais prescrite; ils se sont fait un veau en fonte, ils se sont prosternés devant lui, ils lui ont offert des sacrifices, et ils ont dit: Israël! voici ton dieu, qui t''a fait sortir du pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: ካዘዝኋቸው መንገድ ፈጥነው ፈቀቅ አሉ፤ ቀልጦ የተሠራ የጥጃ ምስል ለራሳቸው አደረጉ፥ ሰገዱለትም፥ ሠዉለትም። እስራኤል ሆይ፥ እነዚህ ከግብፅ ምድር ያወጡህ አማልክትህ ናቸው አሉ ሲል ተናገረው።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people:
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse: Je vois que ce peuple est un peuple au cou roide.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። እኔ ይህን ሕዝብ አየሁት፥ እነሆም አንገተ ደንዳና ሕዝብ ነው።

verses.en: Now therefore let me alone, that my wrath may wax hot against them, and that I may consume them: and I will make of thee a great nation.
verses.fr: Maintenant laisse-moi; ma colère va s''enflammer contre eux, et je les consumerai; mais je ferai de toi une grande nation.
verses.am: አሁንም ቍጣዬ እንዲቃጠልባቸው እንዳጠፋቸውም ተወኝ፤ አንተንም ለታላቅ ሕዝብ አደርግሃለሁ አለው።

verses.en: And Moses besought the Lord his God, and said, Lord, why doth thy wrath wax hot against thy people, which thou hast brought forth out of the land of Egypt with great power, and with a mighty hand?
verses.fr: Moïse implora l''Eternel, son Dieu, et dit: Pourquoi, ô Eternel! ta colère s''enflammerait-elle contre ton peuple, que tu as fait sortir du pays d''Egypte par une grande puissance et par une main forte?
verses.am: ሙሴም በእግዚአብሔር በአምላኩ ፊት ጸለየ፥ አለም። አቤቱ፥ ቍጣህ በታላቅ ኃይልና በጽኑ እጅ ከግብፅ ምድር ባወጣኸው በሕዝብህ ላይ ስለ ምን ተቃጠለ?

verses.en: Wherefore should the Egyptians speak, and say, For mischief did he bring them out, to slay them in the mountains, and to consume them from the face of the earth? Turn from thy fierce wrath, and repent of this evil against thy people.
verses.fr: Pourquoi les Egyptiens diraient-ils: C''est pour leur malheur qu''il les a fait sortir, c''est pour les tuer dans les montagnes, et pour les exterminer de dessus la terre? Reviens de l''ardeur de ta colère, et repens-toi du mal que tu veux faire à ton peuple.
verses.am: ግብፃውያንስ። በተራራ መካከል ሊገድላቸው፥ ከምድርም ፊት ሊያጠፋቸው ለክፋት አወጣቸው ብለው ስለ ምን ይናገራሉ? ከመዓትህ ተመለስ፥ ለሕዝብህም በክፋታቸው ላይ ራራ።

verses.en: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, thy servants, to whom thou swarest by thine own self, and saidst unto them, I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven, and all this land that I have spoken of will I give unto your seed, and they shall inherit it for ever.
verses.fr: Souviens-toi d''Abraham, d''Isaac et d''Israël, tes serviteurs, auxquels tu as dit, en jurant par toi-même: Je multiplierai votre postérité comme les étoiles du ciel, je donnerai à vos descendants tout ce pays dont j''ai parlé, et ils le posséderont à jamais.
verses.am: ዘራችሁን እንደ ሰማይ ከዋክብት አበዛለሁ፥ ይህችንም የተናገርኋትን ምድር ሁሉ ለዘራችሁ እሰጣታለሁ፥ ለዘላለምም ይወርሱአታል ብለህ በራስህ የማልህላቸውን ባሪያዎችህን አብርሃምንና ይስሐቅን እስራኤልንም አስብ።

verses.en: And the Lord repented of the evil which he thought to do unto his people.
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel se repentit du mal qu''il avait déclaré vouloir faire à son peuple.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በሕዝቡ ላይ ሊያደርግ ስላሰበው ክፋት ራራ።

verses.en: And Moses turned, and went down from the mount, and the two tables of the testimony were in his hand: the tables were written on both their sides; on the one side and on the other were they written.
verses.fr: Moïse retourna et descendit de la montagne, les deux tables du témoignage dans sa main; les tables étaient écrites des deux côtés, elles étaient écrites de l''un et de l''autre côté.
verses.am: ሙሴም ተመለሰ፥ ሁለቱንም የምስክር ጽላቶች በእጁ ይዞ ከተራራው ወረደ፤ ጽላቶቹም በዚህና በዚያ በሁለት ወገን ተጽፎባቸው ነበር።

verses.en: And the tables were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, graven upon the tables.
verses.fr: Les tables étaient l''ouvrage de Dieu, et l''écriture était l''écriture de Dieu, gravée sur les tables.
verses.am: ጽላቶቹም የእግዚአብሔር ሥራ ነበሩ፤ ጽሕፈቱም በጽላቶች ላይ የተቀረጸባቸው የእግዚአብሔር ጽሕፈት ነበረ።

verses.en: And when Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said unto Moses, There is a noise of war in the camp.
verses.fr: Josué entendit la voix du peuple, qui poussait des cris, et il dit à Moïse: Il y a un cri de guerre dans le camp.
verses.am: ኢያሱም እልል ሲሉ የሕዝቡን ድምፅ ሰምቶ ሙሴን። የሰልፍ ድምፅ በሰፈሩ ውስጥ አለ አለው።

verses.en: And he said, It is not the voice of them that shout for mastery, neither is it the voice of them that cry for being overcome: but the noise of them that sing do I hear.
verses.fr: Moïse répondit: Ce n''est ni un cri de vainqueurs, ni un cri de vaincus; ce que j''entends, c''est la voix de gens qui chantent.
verses.am: እርሱም። ይህ የድል ነሺዎች ወይም የድል ተነሺዎች ድምፅ አይደለም፥ ነገር ግን የዘፈን ድምፅ እሰማለሁ አለው።

verses.en: And it came to pass, as soon as he came nigh unto the camp, that he saw the calf, and the dancing: and Moses' anger waxed hot, and he cast the tables out of his hands, and brake them beneath the mount.
verses.fr: Et, comme il approchait du camp, il vit le veau et les danses. La colère de Moïse s''enflamma; il jeta de ses mains les tables, et les brisa au pied de la montagne.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ወደ ሰፈሩ ሲቀርብ ጥጃውንም ዘፈኑንም አየ፤ የሙሴም ቍጣ ተቃጠለ፥ ጽላቶቹንም ከእጁ ጥሎ ከተራራው በታች ሰበራቸው።

verses.en: And he took the calf which they had made, and burnt it in the fire, and ground it to powder, and strawed it upon the water, and made the children of Israel drink of it.
verses.fr: Il prit le veau qu''ils avaient fait, et le brûla au feu; il le réduisit en poudre, répandit cette poudre à la surface de l''eau, et fit boire les enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: የሠሩትንም ጥጃ ወስዶ በእሳት አቀለጠው፥ እንደ ትቢያም እስኪሆን ድረስ ፈጨው፥ በውኃውም ላይ በተነው፥ ለእስራኤልም ልጆች አጠጣው።

verses.en: And Moses said unto Aaron, What did this people unto thee, that thou hast brought so great a sin upon them?
verses.fr: Moïse dit à Aaron: Que t''a fait ce peuple, pour que tu l''aies laissé commettre un si grand péché?
verses.am: ሙሴም አሮንን። ይህን ታላቅ ኃጢአት ታመጣበት ዘንድ ይህ ሕዝብ ምን አደረገህ? አለው።

verses.en: And Aaron said, Let not the anger of my lord wax hot: thou knowest the people, that they are set on mischief.
verses.fr: Aaron répondit: Que la colère de mon seigneur ne s''enflamme point! Tu sais toi-même que ce peuple est porté au mal.
verses.am: አሮንም እንዲህ አለ። ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ ቍጣህ አይቃጠል፤ ይህ ሕዝብ ክፋትን እንዲወድድ አንተ ታውቃለህ።

verses.en: For they said unto me, Make us gods, which shall go before us: for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.
verses.fr: Ils m''ont dit: Fais-nous un dieu qui marche devant nous; car ce Moïse, cet homme qui nous a fait sortir du pays d''Egypte, nous ne savons ce qu''il est devenu.
verses.am: እነርሱም። ይህ ከግብፅ ምድር ያወጣን ሰው ሙሴ ምን እንደ ሆነ አናውቅምና በፊታችን የሚሄዱ አማልክት ሥራልን አሉኝ።

verses.en: And I said unto them, Whosoever hath any gold, let them break it off. So they gave it me: then I cast it into the fire, and there came out this calf.
verses.fr: Je leur ai dit: Que ceux qui ont de l''or, s''en dépouillent! Et ils me l''ont donné; je l''ai jeté au feu, et il en est sorti ce veau.
verses.am: እኔም። ከእናንተ ወርቅ ያለው ሰው ከእርሱ ሰብሮ ያምጣልኝ አልኋቸው፤ ሰጡኝም፤ በእሳትም ላይ ጣልሁት፥ ይህም ጥጃ ወጣ።

verses.en: And when Moses saw that the people were naked; (for Aaron had made them naked unto their shame among their enemies:)
verses.fr: Moïse vit que le peuple était livré au désordre, et qu''Aaron l''avait laissé dans ce désordre, exposé à l''opprobre parmi ses ennemis.
verses.am: ሙሴም በጠላቶቻቸው ፊት እንዲነወሩ አሮን ስድ ለቅቋቸዋልና ሕዝቡ ስድ እንደ ተለቀቁ ባየ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: Then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, Who is on the Lord's side? let him come unto me. And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves together unto him.
verses.fr: Moïse se plaça à la porte du camp, et dit: A moi ceux qui sont pour l''Eternel! Et tous les enfants de Lévi s''assemblèrent auprès de lui.
verses.am: በሰፈሩ ደጅ ቆሞ። የእግዚአብሔር ወገን የሆነ ወደ እኔ ይምጣ! አለ፤ የሌዊም ልጆች ሁሉ ወደ እርሱ ተሰበሰቡ።

verses.en: And he said unto them, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Put every man his sword by his side, and go in and out from gate to gate throughout the camp, and slay every man his brother, and every man his companion, and every man his neighbour.
verses.fr: Il leur dit: Ainsi parle l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël: Que chacun de vous mette son épée au côté; traversez et parcourez le camp d''une porte à l''autre, et que chacun tue son frère, son parent.
verses.am: እርሱም። የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የእናንተ ሰው ሁሉ ሰይፉን በወገቡ ላይ ይታጠቅ፥ በሰፈሩም ውስጥ በዚህና በዚያ ከበር እስከ በር ተመላለሱ፥ የእናንተም ሰው ሁሉ ወንድሙን ወዳጁንም ጎረቤቱንም ይግደል አላቸው።

verses.en: And the children of Levi did according to the word of Moses: and there fell of the people that day about three thousand men.
verses.fr: Les enfants de Lévi firent ce qu''ordonnait Moïse; et environ trois mille hommes parmi le peuple périrent en cette journée.
verses.am: የሌዊም ልጆች ሙሴ እንዳለ አደረጉ፤ በዚያም ቀን ከሕዝቡ ሦስት ሺህ ሰዎች ሞቱ።

verses.en: For Moses had said, Consecrate yourselves today to the Lord, even every man upon his son, and upon his brother; that he may bestow upon you a blessing this day.
verses.fr: Moïse dit: Consacrez-vous aujourd''hui à l''Eternel, même en sacrifiant votre fils et votre frère, afin qu''il vous accorde aujourd''hui une bénédiction.
verses.am: ሙሴም። ዛሬ በረከትን እንዲያወርድላችሁ እያንዳንዳችሁ በልጃችሁና በወንድማችሁ ላይ ዛሬ እጃችሁን ለእግዚአብሔር ቅዱስ አድርጉ አለ።

verses.en: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses said unto the people, Ye have sinned a great sin: and now I will go up unto the Lord; peradventure I shall make an atonement for your sin.
verses.fr: Le lendemain, Moïse dit au peuple: Vous avez commis un grand péché. Je vais maintenant monter vers l''Eternel: j''obtiendrai peut-être le pardon de votre péché.
verses.am: በነጋውም ሙሴ ለሕዝቡ። እናንተ ታላቅ ኃጢአት ሠርታችኋል፤ አሁንም ወደ እግዚአብሔር እወጣለሁ፤ ምናልባት ኃጢአታችሁን አስተሰርይላችኋለሁ አላቸው።

verses.en: And Moses returned unto the Lord, and said, Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made them gods of gold.
verses.fr: Moïse retourna vers l''Eternel et dit: Ah! ce peuple a commis un grand péché. Ils se sont fait un dieu d''or.
verses.am: ሙሴም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ተመልሶ። ወዮ! እኒህ ሕዝብ ታላቅ ኃጢአት ሠርተዋል፥ ለራሳቸውም የወርቅ አማልክት አድርገዋል፤

verses.en: Yet now, if thou wilt forgive their sin--; and if not, blot me, I pray thee, out of thy book which thou hast written.
verses.fr: Pardonne maintenant leur péché! Sinon, efface-moi de ton livre que tu as écrit.
verses.am: አሁን ይህን ኃጢአታቸውን ይቅር በላቸው፤ ያለዚያ ግን ከጻፍኸው መጽሐፍህ እባክህ ደምስሰኝ አለ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Whosoever hath sinned against me, him will I blot out of my book.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse: C''est celui qui a péché contre moi que j''effacerai de mon livre.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። የበደለኝን እርሱን ከመጽሐፌ እደመስሰዋለሁ።

verses.en: Therefore now go, lead the people unto the place of which I have spoken unto thee: behold, mine Angel shall go before thee: nevertheless in the day when I visit I will visit their sin upon them.
verses.fr: Va donc, conduis le peuple où je t''ai dit. Voici, mon ange marchera devant toi, mais au jour de ma vengeance, je les punirai de leur péché.
verses.am: አሁንም ሂድ፥ ይህንም ሕዝብ ወደ ነገርሁህ ምራ፤ እነሆ መልአኬ በፊትህ ይሄዳል፤ ነገር ግን በምጐበኝበት ቀን ኃጢአታቸውን አመጣባቸዋለሁ አለው።

verses.en: And the Lord plagued the people, because they made the calf, which Aaron made.
verses.fr: L''Eternel frappa le peuple, parce qu''il avait fait le veau, fabriqué par Aaron.
verses.am: አሮን የሠራውን ጥጃ ስለ ሠሩ እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቡን ቀሠፈ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Depart, and go up hence, thou and the people which thou hast brought up out of the land of Egypt, unto the land which I sware unto Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, Unto thy seed will I give it:
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse: Va, pars d''ici, toi et le peuple que tu as fait sortir du pays d''Egypte; monte vers le pays que j''ai juré de donner à Abraham, à Isaac et à Jacob, en disant: Je le donnerai à ta postérité.
verses.am: [see v2]

verses.en: And I will send an angel before thee; and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:
verses.fr: J''enverrai devant toi un ange, et je chasserai les Cananéens, les Amoréens, les Héthiens, les Phéréziens, les Héviens et les Jébusiens.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው። ሂድ፥ ለአብርሃምና ለይስሐቅ ለያዕቆብም። ለዘርህ እሰጣታለሁ ብዬ ወደ ማልሁባት ምድር፥ ወተትና ማርም ወደምታፈስሰው ምድር አንተ ከግብፅ ምድር ካወጣኸው ሕዝብ ጋር ከዚህም ውጣ። አንገተ ደንዳና ሕዝብ ስለ ሆንህ በመንገድ ላይ እንዳላጠፋህ እኔ በአንተ መካከል አልወጣምና በፊትህ መልአክ እሰድዳለሁ፤ ከነዓናዊውን አሞራዊውንም ኬጢያዊውንም ፌርዛዊውንም ኤዊያዊውንም ኢያቡሳዊውንም አወጣልሃለሁ።

verses.en: Unto a land flowing with milk and honey: for I will not go up in the midst of thee; for thou art a stiffnecked people: lest I consume thee in the way.
verses.fr: Monte vers ce pays où coulent le lait et le miel. Mais je ne monterai point au milieu de toi, de peur que je ne te consume en chemin, car tu es un peuple au cou roide.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው። ሂድ፥ ለአብርሃምና ለይስሐቅ ለያዕቆብም። ለዘርህ እሰጣታለሁ ብዬ ወደ ማልሁባት ምድር፥ ወተትና ማርም ወደምታፈስሰው ምድር አንተ ከግብፅ ምድር ካወጣኸው ሕዝብ ጋር ከዚህም ውጣ። አንገተ ደንዳና ሕዝብ ስለ ሆንህ በመንገድ ላይ እንዳላጠፋህ እኔ በአንተ መካከል አልወጣምና በፊትህ መልአክ እሰድዳለሁ፤ ከነዓናዊውን አሞራዊውንም ኬጢያዊውንም ፌርዛዊውንም ኤዊያዊውንም ኢያቡሳዊውንም አወጣልሃለሁ።

verses.en: And when the people heard these evil tidings, they mourned: and no man did put on him his ornaments.
verses.fr: Lorsque le peuple eut entendu ces sinistres paroles, il fut dans la désolation, et personne ne mit ses ornements.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ይህን ክፉ ወሬ ሰምተው አዘኑ፤ ከእነርሱም ማንም ጌጡን አልለበሰም።

verses.en: For the Lord had said unto Moses, Say unto the children of Israel, Ye are a stiffnecked people: I will come up into the midst of thee in a moment, and consume thee: therefore now put off thy ornaments from thee, that I may know what to do unto thee.
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel dit à Moïse: Dis aux enfants d''Israël: Vous êtes un peuple au cou roide; si je montais un seul instant au milieu de toi, je te consumerais. Ote maintenant tes ornements de dessus toi, et je verrai ce que je te ferai.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። ለእስራኤል ልጆች። እናንተ አንገተ ደንዳና ሕዝብ ናችሁ፥ አንድ ጊዜ በእናንተ መካከል ብወጣ አጠፋችኋለሁ፤ አሁንም የማደርግባችሁን አውቅ ዘንድ ጌጣችሁን ከእናንተ አውጡ በላቸው አለው።

verses.en: And the children of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments by the mount Horeb.
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël se dépouillèrent de leurs ornements, en s''éloignant du mont Horeb.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ከኮሬብ ተራራ ጀምረው ጌጣቸውን አወጡ።

verses.en: And Moses took the tabernacle, and pitched it without the camp, afar off from the camp, and called it the Tabernacle of the congregation. And it came to pass, that every one which sought the Lord went out unto the tabernacle of the congregation, which was without the camp.
verses.fr: Moïse prit la tente et la dressa hors du camp, à quelque distance; il l''appela tente d''assignation; et tous ceux qui consultaient l''Eternel allaient vers la tente d''assignation, qui était hors du camp.
verses.am: ሙሴም ድንኳኑን እየወሰደ ከሰፈር ውጭ ይተክለው ነበር፤ ከሰፈሩም ራቅ ያደርገው ነበር፤ የመገናኛውም ድንኳን ብሎ ጠራው። እግዚአብሔርንም የፈለገ ሁሉ ከሰፈር ውጭ ወዳለው ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ይወጣ ነበር።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Moses went out unto the tabernacle, that all the people rose up, and stood every man at his tent door, and looked after Moses, until he was gone into the tabernacle.
verses.fr: Lorsque Moïse se rendait à la tente, tout le peuple se levait; chacun se tenait à l''entrée de sa tente, et suivait des yeux Moïse, jusqu''à ce qu''il fût entré dans la tente.
verses.am: ሙሴም ወደ ድንኳኑ በሄደ ጊዜ ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ይነሡ ነበር፥ እያንዳንዱም በድንኳኑ ደጃፍ ይቆም ነበር፥ ሙሴም ወደ ድንኳኑ እስኪገባ ድረስ ይመለከቱት ነበር።

verses.en: And it came to pass, as Moses entered into the tabernacle, the cloudy pillar descended, and stood at the door of the tabernacle, and the Lord talked with Moses.
verses.fr: Et lorsque Moïse était entré dans la tente, la colonne de nuée descendait et s''arrêtait à l''entrée de la tente, et l''Eternel parlait avec Moïse.
verses.am: ሙሴም ወደ ድንኳኑ በገባ ጊዜ የደመና ዓምድ ይወርድ ነበር፥ በድንኳኑም ደጃፍ ይቆም ነበር፤ እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን ይናገረው ነበር።

verses.en: And all the people saw the cloudy pillar stand at the tabernacle door: and all the people rose up and worshipped, every man in his tent door.
verses.fr: Tout le peuple voyait la colonne de nuée qui s''arrêtait à l''entrée de la tente, tout le peuple se levait et se prosternait à l''entrée de sa tente.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ የደመናው ዓምድ በድንኳኑ ደጃፍ ሲቆም ያየው ነበር፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ተነሥቶ እያንዳንዱ በድንኳኑ ደጃፍ ይሰግድ ነበር።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses face to face, as a man speaketh unto his friend. And he turned again into the camp: but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, departed not out of the tabernacle.
verses.fr: L''Eternel parlait avec Moïse face à face, comme un homme parle à son ami. Puis Moïse retournait au camp; mais son jeune serviteur, Josué, fils de Nun, ne sortait pas du milieu de la tente.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሰው ከባልንጀራው ጋር እንደሚነጋገር ፊት ለፊት ከሙሴ ጋር ይነጋገር ነበር። ሙሴም ወደ ሰፈሩ ይመለስ ነበር፤ ነገር ግን ሎሌው ብላቴና የነዌ ልጅ ኢያሱ ከድንኳኑ አይለይም ነበር።

verses.en: And Moses said unto the Lord, See, thou sayest unto me, Bring up this people: and thou hast not let me know whom thou wilt send with me. Yet thou hast said, I know thee by name, and thou hast also found grace in my sight.
verses.fr: Moïse dit à l''Eternel: Voici, tu me dis: Fais monter ce peuple! Et tu ne me fais pas connaître qui tu enverras avec moi. Cependant, tu as dit: Je te connais par ton nom, et tu as trouvé grâce à mes yeux.
verses.am: ሙሴም እግዚአብሔርን። እነሆ አንተ። ይህን ሕዝብ አውጣ ትለኛለህ፤ ከእኔም ጋር የምትልከውን አላስታወቅኸኝም። አንተም። በስምህ አወቅሁህ፥ ደግሞም በእኔ ፊት ሞገስን አገኘህ አልኸኝ።

verses.en: Now therefore, I pray thee, if I have found grace in thy sight, shew me now thy way, that I may know thee, that I may find grace in thy sight: and consider that this nation is thy people.
verses.fr: Maintenant, si j''ai trouvé grâce à tes yeux, fais-moi connaître tes voies; alors je te connaîtrai, et je trouverai encore grâce à tes yeux. Considère que cette nation est ton peuple.
verses.am: አሁንም በፊትህ ሞገስን አግኝቼ እንደ ሆነ፥ አውቅህ ዘንድ በፊትህም ሞገስን አገኝ ዘንድ መንገድህን እባክህ አሳየኝ፤ ይህም ሕዝብ ሕዝብህ እንደ ሆነ ተመልከት አለው።

verses.en: And he said, My presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee rest.
verses.fr: L''Eternel répondit: Je marcherai moi-même avec toi, et je te donnerai du repos.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። እኔ ከአንተ ጋር እሄዳለሁ፥ አሳርፍህማለሁ አለው።

verses.en: And he said unto him, If thy presence go not with me, carry us not up hence.
verses.fr: Moïse lui dit: Si tu ne marches pas toi-même avec nous, ne nous fais point partir d''ici.
verses.am: እርሱም። አንተ ከእኛ ጋር ካልወጣህስ፥ ከዚህ አታውጣን።

verses.en: For wherein shall it be known here that I and thy people have found grace in thy sight? is it not in that thou goest with us? so shall we be separated, I and thy people, from all the people that are upon the face of the earth.
verses.fr: Comment sera-t-il donc certain que j''ai trouvé grâce à tes yeux, moi et ton peuple? Ne sera-ce pas quand tu marcheras avec nous, et quand nous serons distingués, moi et ton peuple, de tous les peuples qui sont sur la face de la terre?
verses.am: በምድርም ፊት ካለው ሕዝብ ሁሉ እኔና ሕዝብህ የተለየን እንሆን ዘንድ አንተ ከእኛ ጋር ካልወጣህ፥ እኔና ሕዝብህ በአንተ ዘንድ ሞገስ ማግኘታችን በምን ይታወቃል? አለው።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, I will do this thing also that thou hast spoken: for thou hast found grace in my sight, and I know thee by name.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse: Je ferai ce que tu me demandes, car tu as trouvé grâce à mes yeux, et je te connais par ton nom.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። በፊቴ ሞገስ ስላገኘህ በስምህም ስላወቅሁህ ይህን ያልኸውን ነገር አደርጋለሁ አለው።

verses.en: And he said, I beseech thee, shew me thy glory.
verses.fr: Moïse dit: Fais-moi voir ta gloire!
verses.am: እርሱም። እባክህ ክብርህን አሳየኝ አለ።

verses.en: And he said, I will make all my goodness pass before thee, and I will proclaim the name of the Lord before thee; and will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will shew mercy on whom I will shew mercy.
verses.fr: L''Eternel répondit: Je ferai passer devant toi toute ma bonté, et je proclamerai devant toi le nom de l''Eternel; je fais grâce à qui je fais grâce, et miséricorde à qui je fais miséricorde.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። እኔ መልካምነቴን ሁሉ በፊትህ አሳልፋለሁ፤ የእግዚአብሔርንም ስም በፊትህ አውጃለሁ፤ ይቅርም የምለውን ይቅር እላለሁ፥ የምምረውንም እምራለሁ አለ።

verses.en: And he said, Thou canst not see my face: for there shall no man see me, and live.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit: Tu ne pourras pas voir ma face, car l''homme ne peut me voir et vivre.
verses.am: ደግሞም። ሰው አይቶኝ አይድንምና ፊቴን ማየት አይቻልህም አለ።

verses.en: And the Lord said, Behold, there is a place by me, and thou shalt stand upon a rock:
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit: Voici un lieu près de moi; tu te tiendras sur le rocher.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አለ። እነሆ ስፍራ በእኔ ዘንድ አለ፥ በዓለቱም ላይ ትቆማለህ፤

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, while my glory passeth by, that I will put thee in a clift of the rock, and will cover thee with my hand while I pass by:
verses.fr: Quand ma gloire passera, je te mettrai dans un creux du rocher, et je te couvrirai de ma main jusqu''à ce que j''aie passé.
verses.am: ክብሬም ባለፈ ጊዜ በሰንጣቃው ዓለት አኖርሃለሁ፥ እስካልፍ ድረስ እጄን በላይህ እጋርዳለሁ፤

verses.en: And I will take away mine hand, and thou shalt see my back parts: but my face shall not be seen.
verses.fr: Et lorsque je retournerai ma main, tu me verras par derrière, mais ma face ne pourra pas être vue.
verses.am: እጄንም ፈቀቅ አደርጋለሁ፥ ጀርባዬንም ታያለህ፤ ፊቴ ግን አይታይም።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first: and I will write upon these tables the words that were in the first tables, which thou brakest.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse: Taille deux tables de pierre comme les premières, et j''y écrirai les paroles qui étaient sur les premières tables que tu as brisées.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን አለው። ሁለት የድንጋይ ጽላቶች እንደ ፊተኞች አድርገህ ጥረብ፤ በሰበርኻቸው በፊተኞቹ ጽላቶች የነበሩትን ቃሎች እጽፍባቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: And be ready in the morning, and come up in the morning unto mount Sinai, and present thyself there to me in the top of the mount.
verses.fr: Sois prêt de bonne heure, et tu monteras dès le matin sur la montagne de Sinaï; tu te tiendras là devant moi, sur le sommet de la montagne.
verses.am: ነገም የተዘጋጀህ ሁን፥ በማለዳም ወደ ሲና ተራራ ወጥተህ በዚያ በተራራው ራስ ላይ በፊቴ ቁም።

verses.en: And no man shall come up with thee, neither let any man be seen throughout all the mount; neither let the flocks nor herds feed before that mount.
verses.fr: Que personne ne monte avec toi, et que personne ne paraisse sur toute la montagne; et même que ni brebis ni boeufs ne paissent près de cette montagne.
verses.am: ከአንተም ጋር ማንም ሰው አይውጣ፥ በተራራውም ሁሉ ማንም አይታይ፤ መንጎችና ከብቶችም በዚያ ተራራ ፊት አይሰማሩ።

verses.en: And he hewed two tables of stone like unto the first; and Moses rose up early in the morning, and went up unto mount Sinai, as the Lord had commanded him, and took in his hand the two tables of stone.
verses.fr: Moïse tailla deux tables de pierre comme les premières; il se leva de bon matin, et monta sur la montagne de Sinaï, selon l''ordre que l''Eternel lui avait donné, et il prit dans sa main les deux tables de pierre.
verses.am: ሙሴም እንደ ፊተኞቹ አድርጎ ሁለት የድንጋይ ጽላቶች ጠረበ፤ በነጋውም ማልዶ እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዘው ወደ ሲና ተራራ ወጣ፥ ሁለቱንም የድንጋይ ጽላቶች በእጁ ወሰደ፥

verses.en: And the Lord descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed the name of the Lord.
verses.fr: L''Eternel descendit dans une nuée, se tint là auprès de lui, et proclama le nom de l''Eternel.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በደመናው ውስጥ ወረደ፥ በዚያም ከእርሱ ጋር ቆመ፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ስም አወጀ።

verses.en: And the Lord passed by before him, and proclaimed, The Lord, The Lord God, merciful and gracious, longsuffering, and abundant in goodness and truth,
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel passa devant lui, et s''écria: L''Eternel, l''Eternel, Dieu miséricordieux et compatissant, lent à la colère, riche en bonté et en fidélité,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በፊቱ አልፎ። እግዚአብሔር፥ እግዚአብሔር መሐሪ፥ ሞገስ ያለው፥ ታጋሽም፥ ባለ ብዙ ቸርነትና እውነት፥

verses.en: Keeping mercy for thousands, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin, and that will by no means clear the guilty; visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, and upon the children's children, unto the third and to the fourth generation.
verses.fr: qui conserve son amour jusqu''à mille générations, qui pardonne l''iniquité, la rébellion et le péché, mais qui ne tient point le coupable pour innocent, et qui punit l''iniquité des pères sur les enfants et sur les enfants des enfants jusqu''à la troisième et à la quatrième génération!
verses.am: እስከ ሺህ ትውልድም ቸርነትን የሚጠብቅ፥ አበሳንና መተላለፍን ኃጢአትንም ይቅር የሚል፥ በደለኛውንም ከቶ የማያነጻ፥ የአባቶችንም ኃጢአት በልጆች እስከ ሦስትና እስከ አራት ትውልድም በልጅ ልጆች የሚያመጣ አምላክ ነው ሲል አወጀ።

verses.en: And Moses made haste, and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshipped.
verses.fr: Aussitôt Moïse s''inclina à terre et se prosterna.
verses.am: ሙሴም ፈጥኖ ወደ መሬት ተጐነበሰና ሰገደ።

verses.en: And he said, If now I have found grace in thy sight, O Lord, let my Lord, I pray thee, go among us; for it is a stiffnecked people; and pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for thine inheritance.
verses.fr: Il dit: Seigneur, si j''ai trouvé grâce à tes yeux, que le Seigneur marche au milieu de nous, car c''est un peuple au cou roide; pardonne nos iniquités et nos péchés, et prends-nous pour ta possession.
verses.am: አቤቱ በፊትህስ ሞገስን አግኝቼ እንደ ሆነ፥ ይህ አንገተ ደንዳና ሕዝብ ነውና ጌታዬ በመካከላችን ይሂድ፤ ጠማማነታችንንና ኃጢአታችንንም ይቅር በለን፥ ለርስትህም ተቀበለን አለ።

verses.en: And he said, Behold, I make a covenant: before all thy people I will do marvels, such as have not been done in all the earth, nor in any nation: and all the people among which thou art shall see the work of the Lord: for it is a terrible thing that I will do with thee.
verses.fr: L''Eternel répondit: Voici, je traite une alliance. Je ferai, en présence de tout ton peuple, des prodiges qui n''ont eu lieu dans aucun pays et chez aucune nation; tout le peuple qui t''environne verra l''oeuvre de l''Eternel, et c''est par toi que j''accomplirai des choses terribles.
verses.am: እርሱም አለው። እነሆ እኔ ቃል ኪዳን አደርጋለሁ፤ በምድር ሁሉ፥ በአሕዛብም ሁሉ ዘንድ እንደ እርሱ ያለ ከቶ ያልተደረገውን ተአምራት በሕዝብህ ሁሉ ፊት አደርጋለሁ፤ እኔም በአንተ ዘንድ የምሠራው ነገር የሚያስፈራ ነውና አንተ ያለህበት ይህ ሕዝብ ሁሉ የእግዚአብሔርን ሥራ ያያል።

verses.en: Observe thou that which I command thee this day: behold, I drive out before thee the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite.
verses.fr: Prends garde à ce que je t''ordonne aujourd''hui. Voici, je chasserai devant toi les Amoréens, les Cananéens, les Héthiens, les Phéréziens, les Héviens et les Jébusiens.
verses.am: በዚህ ቀን የማዝዝህን ነገር ጠብቅ፤ እነሆ እኔ አሞራዊውን ከነዓናዊውንም ኬጢያዊውንም ፌርዛዊውንም ኤዊያዊውንም ኢያቡሳዊውንም በፊትህ አወጣለሁ።

verses.en: Take heed to thyself, lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land whither thou goest, lest it be for a snare in the midst of thee:
verses.fr: Garde-toi de faire alliance avec les habitants du pays où tu dois entrer, de peur qu''ils ne soient un piège pour toi.
verses.am: በመካከልህ ወጥመድ እንዳይሆኑብህ አንተ በምትሄድባት ምድር ከሚኖሩ ሰዎች ጋር ቃል ኪዳን እንዳታደርግ ተጠንቀቅ፤

verses.en: But ye shall destroy their altars, break their images, and cut down their groves:
verses.fr: Au contraire, vous renverserez leurs autels, vous briserez leurs statues, et vous abattrez leurs idoles.
verses.am: ነገር ግን መሠዊያዎቻቸውን ታፈርሳላችሁ፥ ሐውልቶቻቸውንም ትሰብራላችሁ፥ የማምለኪያ ዓፀዶቻቸውንም ትቈርጣላችሁ፤

verses.en: For thou shalt worship no other god: for the Lord, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God:
verses.fr: Tu ne te prosterneras point devant un autre dieu; car l''Eternel porte le nom de jaloux, il est un Dieu jaloux.
verses.am: ስሙ ቀናተኛ የሆነ እግዚአብሔር ቅንዓት ያለው አምላክ ነውና ለሌላ አምላክ አትስገድ።

verses.en: Lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, and they go a whoring after their gods, and do sacrifice unto their gods, and one call thee, and thou eat of his sacrifice;
verses.fr: Garde-toi de faire alliance avec les habitants du pays, de peur que, se prostituant à leurs dieux et leur offrant des sacrifices, ils ne t''invitent, et que tu ne manges de leurs victimes;
verses.am: በዚያች ምድር ከሚኖሩ ሰዎች ጋር ቃል ኪዳን እንዳታደርግ፥ እነርሱ አምላኮቻቸውን ተከትለው ባመነዘሩና በሠዉላቸው ጊዜ እንዳይጠሩህ፥ ከመሥዋዕታቸውም እንዳትበላ፥

verses.en: And thou take of their daughters unto thy sons, and their daughters go a whoring after their gods, and make thy sons go a whoring after their gods.
verses.fr: de peur que tu ne prennes de leurs filles pour tes fils, et que leurs filles, se prostituant à leurs dieux, n''entraînent tes fils à se prostituer à leurs dieux.
verses.am: ሴት ልጆቻቸውንም ከወንድ ልጆችህ ጋር እንዳታጋባ፥ ልጆቻቸውም አምላኮቻቸውን ተከትለው ሲያመነዝሩ ከአምላኮቻቸው በኋላ ሄደው አመንዝረውም ልጆችህን እንዳያስቱ ተጠንቀቅ።

verses.en: Thou shalt make thee no molten gods.
verses.fr: Tu ne te feras point de dieu en fonte.
verses.am: ቀልጠው የተሠሩትን የአማልክት ምስሎች ለአንተ አታድርግ።

verses.en: The feast of unleavened bread shalt thou keep. Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread, as I commanded thee, in the time of the month Abib: for in the month Abib thou camest out from Egypt.
verses.fr: Tu observeras la fête des pains sans levain; pendant sept jours, au temps fixé dans le mois des épis, tu mangeras des pains sans levain, comme je t''en ai donné l''ordre, car c''est dans le mois des épis que tu es sorti d''Egypte.
verses.am: የቂጣውን በዓል ትጠብቀዋለህ። በአቢብ ወር ከግብፅ ወጥተሃልና በታዘዘው ዘመን በአቢብ ወር እንዳዘዝሁህ ሰባት ቀን ቂጣ እንጀራ ብላ።

verses.en: All that openeth the matrix is mine; and every firstling among thy cattle, whether ox or sheep, that is male.
verses.fr: Tout premier-né m''appartient, même tout mâle premier-né dans les troupeaux de gros et de menu bétail.
verses.am: ማኅፀንንም የሚከፍት ሁሉ የእኔ ነው፤ የከብትህም ተባት በኵር ሁሉ፥ በሬም ቢሆን በግም ቢሆን፥ የእኔ ነው።

verses.en: But the firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb: and if thou redeem him not, then shalt thou break his neck. All the firstborn of thy sons thou shalt redeem. And none shall appear before me empty.
verses.fr: Tu rachèteras avec un agneau le premier-né de l''âne; et si tu ne le rachètes pas, tu lui briseras la nuque. Tu rachèteras tout premier-né de tes fils; et l''on ne se présentera point à vide devant ma face.
verses.am: የአህያውንም በኵር በጠቦት ትዋጀዋለህ፤ ባትዋጀውም አንገቱን ትሰብረዋለህ። የልጆችህንም በኵር ሁሉ ትዋጃለህ። በፊቴም አንድ ሰው ባዶ እጁን አይታይ።

verses.en: Six days thou shalt work, but on the seventh day thou shalt rest: in earing time and in harvest thou shalt rest.
verses.fr: Tu travailleras six jours, et tu te reposeras le septième jour; tu te reposeras, même au temps du labourage et de la moisson.
verses.am: ስድስት ቀን ትሠራለህ፥ በሰባተኛውም ቀን ታርፋለህ፤ በምታርስበትና በምታጭድበት ዘመን ታርፋለህ።

verses.en: And thou shalt observe the feast of weeks, of the firstfruits of wheat harvest, and the feast of ingathering at the year's end.
verses.fr: Tu célébreras la fête des semaines, des prémices de la moisson du froment, et la fête de la récolte, à la fin de l''année.
verses.am: የሰባቱንም ሱባዔ በዓል ታደርጋለህ፥ እርሱም የስንዴ መከር በኵራት ነው፤ በዓመቱም ፍጻሜ የመክተቻ በዓል ታደርጋለህ።

verses.en: Thrice in the year shall all your menchildren appear before the Lord God, the God of Israel.
verses.fr: Trois fois par an, tous les mâles se présenteront devant le Seigneur, l''Eternel, Dieu d''Israël.
verses.am: በአንተ ዘንድ ያለው ወንድ ሁሉ በእስራኤል አምላክ በጌታ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በዓመት ሦስት ጊዜ ይታይ።

verses.en: For I will cast out the nations before thee, and enlarge thy borders: neither shall any man desire thy land, when thou shalt go up to appear before the Lord thy God thrice in the year.
verses.fr: Car je chasserai les nations devant toi, et j''étendrai tes frontières; et personne ne convoitera ton pays, pendant que tu monteras pour te présenter devant l''Eternel, ton Dieu, trois fois par an.
verses.am: አሕዛብን ከፊትህ አወጣለሁ፥ አገርህንም አሰፋለሁ፤ በአምላክህም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለመታየት በዓመት ሦስት ጊዜ ስትወጣ ማንም ምድርህን አይመኝም።

verses.en: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leaven; neither shall the sacrifice of the feast of the passover be left unto the morning.
verses.fr: Tu n''offriras point avec du pain levé le sang de la victime immolée en mon honneur; et le sacrifice de la fête de Pâque ne sera point gardé pendant la nuit jusqu''au matin.
verses.am: የመሥዋዕቴን ደም ከቦካ እንጀራ ጋር አትሠዋ፤ የፋሲካውም በዓል መሥዋዕት እስከ ነገ አይደር።

verses.en: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring unto the house of the Lord thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother's milk.
verses.fr: Tu apporteras à la maison de L''Eternel, ton Dieu, les prémices des premiers fruits de la terre. Tu ne feras point cuire un chevreau dans le lait de sa mère.
verses.am: በዚያም አርባ ቀንና አርባ ሌሊት ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር ነበረ፤ እንጀራም አልበላም፥ ውኃም አልጠጣም። በጽላቶቹም አሥሩን የቃል ኪዳን ቃሎች ጻፈ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Write thou these words: for after the tenor of these words I have made a covenant with thee and with Israel.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse: Ecris ces paroles; car c''est conformément à ces paroles que je traite alliance avec toi et avec Israël.
verses.am: በዚያም አርባ ቀንና አርባ ሌሊት ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር ነበረ፤ እንጀራም አልበላም፥ ውኃም አልጠጣም። በጽላቶቹም አሥሩን የቃል ኪዳን ቃሎች ጻፈ።

verses.en: And he was there with the Lord forty days and forty nights; he did neither eat bread, nor drink water. And he wrote upon the tables the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.
verses.fr: Moïse fut là avec l''Eternel quarante jours et quarante nuits. Il ne mangea point de pain, et il ne but point d''eau. Et l''Eternel écrivit sur les tables les paroles de l''alliance, les dix paroles.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ሙሴ ከሲና ተራራ በወረደ ጊዜ ሁለቱ የምስክር ጽላቶች በሙሴ እጅ ነበሩ፤ ሙሴም ከተራራው በወረደ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር ከእርሱ ጋር ስለ ተነጋገረ የፊቱ ቁርበት እንዳንጸባረቀ አላወቀም ነበር።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Moses came down from mount Sinai with the two tables of testimony in Moses' hand, when he came down from the mount, that Moses wist not that the skin of his face shone while he talked with him.
verses.fr: Moïse descendit de la montagne de Sinaï, ayant les deux tables du témoignage dans sa main, en descendant de la montagne; et il ne savait pas que la peau de son visage rayonnait, parce qu''il avait parlé avec l''Eternel.
verses.am: አሮንና የእስራኤልም ልጆች ሁሉ ሙሴን ባዩ ጊዜ፥ እነሆ የፊቱ ቁርበት አንጸባረቀ፤ ወደ እርሱም ይቀርቡ ዘንድ ፈሩ።

verses.en: And when Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come nigh him.
verses.fr: Aaron et tous les enfants d''Israël regardèrent Moïse, et voici la peau de son visage rayonnait; et ils craignaient de s''approcher de lui.
verses.am: ሙሴም ጠራቸው፤ አሮንም የማኅበሩን አለቆች ሁሉ ወደ እርሱ ተመለሱ፤ ሙሴም ተናገራቸው።

verses.en: And Moses called unto them; and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned unto him: and Moses talked with them.
verses.fr: Moïse les appela; Aaron et tous les principaux de l''assemblée vinrent auprès de lui, et il leur parla.
verses.am: ከዚያም በኋላ የእስራኤል ልጆች ሁሉ ቀረቡ፤ እግዚአብሔርም በሲና ተራራ የተናገረውን ነገር ሁሉ አዘዛቸው።

verses.en: And afterward all the children of Israel came nigh: and he gave them in commandment all that the Lord had spoken with him in mount Sinai.
verses.fr: Après cela, tous les enfants d''Israël s''approchèrent, et il leur donna tous les ordres qu''il avait reçus de l''Eternel, sur la montagne de Sinaï.
verses.am: ሙሴም ለእነርሱ ተናግሮ ከጨረሰ በኋላ በፊቱ መሸፈኛ አደረገ።

verses.en: And till Moses had done speaking with them, he put a vail on his face.
verses.fr: Lorsque Moïse eut achevé de leur parler, il mit un voile sur son visage.
verses.am: ሙሴም ከእርሱ ጋር ሲነጋገር ወደ እግዚአብሔር በገባ ጊዜ እስኪ ወጣ ድረስ መሸፈኛውን ከፊቱ አነሣ፤ በወጣም ጊዜ ለእስራኤል ልጆች የታዘዘውን ነገር ነገረ።

verses.en: But when Moses went in before the Lord to speak with him, he took the vail off, until he came out. And he came out, and spake unto the children of Israel that which he was commanded.
verses.fr: Quand Moïse entrait devant l''Eternel, pour lui parler, il ôtait le voile, jusqu''à ce qu''il sortît; et quand il sortait, il disait aux enfants d''Israël ce qui lui avait été ordonné.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች የሙሴን ፊት ቁርበት እንዳንጸባረቀ ያዩ ነበር፤ እርሱም ከእርሱ ጋር ሊነጋገር እስኪገባ ድረስ እንደ ገና በፊቱ መሸፈኛ ያደርግ ነበር።

verses.en: And the children of Israel saw the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses' face shone: and Moses put the vail upon his face again, until he went in to speak with him.
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël regardaient le visage de Moïse, et voyaient que la peau de son visage rayonnait; et Moïse remettait le voile sur son visage jusqu''à ce qu''il entrât, pour parler avec l''Eternel.
verses.am: ፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች የሙሴን ፊት ቁርበት እንዳንጸባረቀ ያዩ ነበር፤ እርሱም ከእርሱ ጋር ሊነጋገር እስኪገባ ድረስ እንደ ገና በፊቱ መሸፈኛ ያደርግ ነበር።

verses.en: And Moses gathered all the congregation of the children of Israel together, and said unto them, These are the words which the Lord hath commanded, that ye should do them.
verses.fr: Moïse convoqua toute l''assemblée des enfants d''Israël, et leur dit: Voici les choses que l''Eternel ordonne de faire.
verses.am: ሙሴም የእስራኤልን ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ ሰብስቦ እንዲህ አላቸው። ታደርጉ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ያዘዘው ቃል ይህ ነው፤

verses.en: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be to you an holy day, a sabbath of rest to the Lord: whosoever doeth work therein shall be put to death.
verses.fr: On travaillera six jours; mais le septième jour sera pour vous une chose sainte; c''est le sabbat, le jour du repos, consacré à l''Eternel. Celui qui fera quelque ouvrage ce jour-là, sera puni de mort.
verses.am: ስድስት ቀን ሥራ ይደረጋል፥ ሰባተኛው ቀን ግን ለእግዚአብሔር የዕረፍት ሰንበት የተቀደሰ ቀን ይሆንላችኋል፤ የሚሠራበትም ሁሉ ይገደል።

verses.en: Ye shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations upon the sabbath day.
verses.fr: Vous n''allumerez point de feu, dans aucune de vos demeures, le jour du sabbat.
verses.am: በማደሪያዎቻችሁ ውስጥ በሰንበት ቀን እሳትን አታንድዱ።

verses.en: And Moses spake unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which the Lord commanded, saying,
verses.fr: Moïse parla à toute l''assemblée des enfants d''Israël, et dit: Voici ce que l''Eternel a ordonné.
verses.am: ሙሴም ለእስራኤል ልጆች ማህበር ሁሉ አላቸው። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ብሎ ያዘዘው ነገር ይህ ነው፤

verses.en: Take ye from among you an offering unto the Lord: whosoever is of a willing heart, let him bring it, an offering of the Lord; gold, and silver, and brass,
verses.fr: Prenez sur ce qui vous appartient une offrande pour l''Eternel. Tout homme dont le coeur est bien disposé apportera en offrande à l''Eternel: de l''or, de l''argent et de l''airain;
verses.am: ከእናንተ ዘንድ ለእግዚአብሔር ቍርባንን አቅርቡ፤ የልብ ፈቃድ ያለው የእግዚአብሔርን ቍርባን ያምጣ፤ ወርቅና ብርም ናስም፤

verses.en: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats' hair,
verses.fr: des étoffes teintes en bleu, en pourpre, en cramoisi, du fin lin et du poil de chèvre;
verses.am: ሰማያዊም ሐምራዊም ቀይ ግምጃም፥ ጥሩ በፍታም፥ የፍየል ጠጕርም፤

verses.en: And rams' skins dyed red, and badgers' skins, and shittim wood,
verses.fr: des peaux de béliers teintes en rouge et des peaux de dauphins; du bois d''acacia;
verses.am: ቀይም የአውራ በግ ቁርበት፥ የአቆስጣም ቁርበት፥ የግራርም እንጨት፤

verses.en: And oil for the light, and spices for anointing oil, and for the sweet incense,
verses.fr: de l''huile pour le chandelier, des aromates pour l''huile d''onction et pour le parfum odoriférant;
verses.am: ለመብራትም ዘይት፥ ለቅብዓት ዘይትና ለጣፋጭ ዕጣን ቅመም፤

verses.en: And onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod, and for the breastplate.
verses.fr: des pierres d''onyx et d''autres pierres pour la garniture de l''éphod et du pectoral.
verses.am: መረግድ ለኤፉዱና ለደረት ኪስ የሚደረግ ፈርጥ ያምጣ።

verses.en: And every wise hearted among you shall come, and make all that the Lord hath commanded;
verses.fr: Que tous ceux d''entre vous qui ont de l''habileté viennent et exécutent tout ce que l''Eternel a ordonné:
verses.am: በእናንተም ዘንድ ያሉ በልባቸው ጥበበኞች ሁሉ መጥተው እግዚአብሔር ያዘዘውን ሁሉ ያድርጉ።

verses.en: The tabernacle, his tent, and his covering, his taches, and his boards, his bars, his pillars, and his sockets,
verses.fr: le tabernacle, sa tente et sa couverture, ses agrafes, ses planches, ses barres, ses colonnes et ses bases;
verses.am: ማደሪያውን፥ ድንኳኑንም መደረቢያውንም፥ መያዣዎቹንም፥ ሳንቆቹንም፥ መወርወሪያዎቹንም፥ ምሰሶቹንም፥ እግሮቹንም፤

verses.en: The ark, and the staves thereof, with the mercy seat, and the vail of the covering,
verses.fr: l''arche et ses barres, le propitiatoire, et le voile pour couvrir l''arche;
verses.am: ታቦቱን መሎጊያዎቹንም፥ የስርየት መክደኛውንም በእርሱም ፊት የሚሸፍነውን መጋረጃ፤

verses.en: The table, and his staves, and all his vessels, and the shewbread,
verses.fr: la table et ses barres, et tous ses ustensiles, et les pains de proposition;
verses.am: ገበታውን መሎጊያዎቹንም ዕቃውንም ሁሉ፥ የገጹንም ኅብስት፤

verses.en: The candlestick also for the light, and his furniture, and his lamps, with the oil for the light,
verses.fr: le chandelier et ses ustensiles, ses lampes, et l''huile pour le chandelier;
verses.am: መብራት የሚያበሩበትን መቅረዙን ዕቃውንም፥ ቀንዲሉንም፥ የመብራቱንም ዘይት፤

verses.en: And the incense altar, and his staves, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the door at the entering in of the tabernacle,
verses.fr: l''autel des parfums et ses barres, l''huile d''onction et le parfum odoriférant, et le rideau de la porte pour l''entrée du tabernacle;
verses.am: የዕጣኑን መሠዊያም መሎጊያዎቹንም፥ የቅብዓቱንም ዘይት፥ ጣፋጩንም ዕጣን፥ ለማደሪያውም ደጃፍ የሚሆን የደጃፉን መጋረጃ፤

verses.en: The altar of burnt offering, with his brasen grate, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,
verses.fr: l''autel des holocaustes, sa grille d''airain, ses barres, et tous ses ustensiles; la cuve avec sa base;
verses.am: ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት የሚሆነውን መሠዊያውን፥ የናሱንም መከታ፥ መሎጊያዎቹንም፥ ዕቃውንም ሁሉ፤ የመታጠቢያውን ሰንም መቀመጫውንም፤

verses.en: The hangings of the court, his pillars, and their sockets, and the hanging for the door of the court,
verses.fr: les toiles du parvis, ses colonnes, ses bases, et le rideau de la porte du parvis;
verses.am: የአደባባዩን መጋረጆች ምሰሶቹንም እግሮቻቸውንም፥ የአደባባዩንም ደጃፍ መጋረጃ፤

verses.en: The pins of the tabernacle, and the pins of the court, and their cords,
verses.fr: les pieux du tabernacle, les pieux du parvis, et leurs cordages;
verses.am: የማደሪያውን ካስማዎች፥ የአደባባዩንም ካስማዎች አውታሮቻቸውንም፤

verses.en: The cloths of service, to do service in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest's office.
verses.fr: les vêtements d''office pour le service dans le sanctuaire, les vêtements sacrés pour le sacrificateur Aaron, et les vêtements de ses fils pour les fonctions du sacerdoce.
verses.am: በመቅደስ ውስጥ ለማገልገል በብልሃት የተሠሩትን ልብሶች፥ በክህነት ያገለግሉበት ዘንድ የተቀደሱትን የካህኑን የአሮን ልብሶች፥ የልጆቹንም ልብሶች።

verses.en: And all the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.
verses.fr: Toute l''assemblée des enfants d''Israël sortit de la présence de Moïse.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ ከሙሴ ፊት ወጡ።

verses.en: And they came, every one whose heart stirred him up, and every one whom his spirit made willing, and they brought the Lord's offering to the work of the tabernacle of the congregation, and for all his service, and for the holy garments.
verses.fr: Tous ceux qui furent entraînés par le coeur et animés de bonne volonté vinrent et apportèrent une offrande à l''Eternel pour l''oeuvre de la tente d''assignation, pour tout son service, et pour les vêtements sacrés.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም ሰው ሁሉ ልቡ እንዳነሣሣው መንፈሱም እሺ እንዳሰኘው ለመገናኛው ድንኳን ሥራ ለማገልገያውም ሁሉ ለተቀደሰውም ልብስ ለእግዚአብሔር ስጦታ አመጡ።

verses.en: And they came, both men and women, as many as were willing hearted, and brought bracelets, and earrings, and rings, and tablets, all jewels of gold: and every man that offered offered an offering of gold unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Les hommes vinrent aussi bien que les femmes; tous ceux dont le coeur était bien disposé apportèrent des boucles, des anneaux, des bagues, des bracelets, toutes sortes d''objets d''or; chacun présenta l''offrande d''or qu''il avait consacrée à l''Eternel.
verses.am: ወንዶችና ሴቶችም ልባቸው እንደ ፈቀደ ማርዳዎችን፥ ሎቲዎችንም፥ ቀለበቶችንም፥ ድሪዎችንም፥ የወርቅ ጌጦችንም ሁሉ አመጡ፤ ሰዎችም ሁሉ የወርቅ ስጦታ ወደ እግዚአብሔር አቀረቡ።

verses.en: And every man, with whom was found blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats' hair, and red skins of rams, and badgers' skins, brought them.
verses.fr: Tous ceux qui avaient des étoffes teintes en bleu, en pourpre, en cramoisi, du fin lin et du poil de chèvre, des peaux de béliers teintes en rouge et des peaux de dauphins, les apportèrent.
verses.am: ሰማያዊም ሐምራዊም ቀይ ግምጃም፥ ጥሩ በፍታም፥ የፍየል ጠጕርም፥ ቀይ የአውራ በግ ቁርበትም፥ የአቆስጣ ቁርበትም ያላቸው ሰዎች ሁሉ አመጡ።

verses.en: Every one that did offer an offering of silver and brass brought the Lord's offering: and every man, with whom was found shittim wood for any work of the service, brought it.
verses.fr: Tous ceux qui présentèrent par élévation une offrande d''argent et d''airain apportèrent l''offrande à l''Eternel. Tous ceux qui avaient du bois d''acacia pour les ouvrages destinés au service, l''apportèrent.
verses.am: ስእለት የተሳለ ሁሉ የብርንም የናስንም ስጦታ ለእግዚአብሔር ቍርባን አቀረበ፤ የግራርም እንጨት ያለው ሁሉ ለማገልገያ ሥራ አመጣ።

verses.en: And all the women that were wise hearted did spin with their hands, and brought that which they had spun, both of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, and of fine linen.
verses.fr: Toutes les femmes qui avaient de l''habileté filèrent de leurs mains, et elles apportèrent leur ouvrage, des fils teints en bleu, en pourpre, en cramoisi, et du fin lin.
verses.am: በልባቸው ጥበበኞች የሆኑ ሴቶችም በእጃቸው ፈተሉ፥ የፈተሉትንም ሰማያዊውን ሐምራዊውንም ቀዩንም ግምጃ፥ ጥሩውንም በፍታ አመጡ።

verses.en: And all the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun goats' hair.
verses.fr: Toutes les femmes dont le coeur était bien disposé, et qui avaient de l''habileté, filèrent du poil de chèvre.
verses.am: ልባቸውም በጥበብ ያስነሣቸው ሴቶች ሁሉ የፍየልን ጠጕር ፈተሉ።

verses.en: And the rulers brought onyx stones, and stones to be set, for the ephod, and for the breastplate;
verses.fr: Les principaux du peuple apportèrent des pierres d''onyx et d''autres pierres pour la garniture de l''éphod et du pectoral;
verses.am: አለቆችም መረግድን፥ ለኤፉድና ለደረት ኪስ የሚገቡትንም ፈርጦችን፥

verses.en: And spice, and oil for the light, and for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense.
verses.fr: des aromates et de l''huile pour le chandelier, pour l''huile d''onction et pour le parfum odoriférant.
verses.am: ለመብራትም ለቅብዓት ዘይትም ለጣፋጭ ዕጣንም ሽቱንና ዘይትን አመጡ።

verses.en: The children of Israel brought a willing offering unto the Lord, every man and woman, whose heart made them willing to bring for all manner of work, which the Lord had commanded to be made by the hand of Moses.
verses.fr: Tous les enfants d''Israël, hommes et femmes, dont le coeur était disposé à contribuer pour l''oeuvre que l''Eternel avait ordonnée par Moïse, apportèrent des offrandes volontaires à l''Eternel.
verses.am: ከእስራኤል ልጆችም ያመጡ ዘንድ ልባቸው ያስነሣቸው ወንዶችና ሴቶች ሁሉ ሙሴ ይሠራ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ላዘዘው ሥራ ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር ስጦታ በፈቃዳቸው አመጡ።

verses.en: And Moses said unto the children of Israel, See, the Lord hath called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah;
verses.fr: Moïse dit aux enfants d''Israël: Sachez que l''Eternel a choisi Betsaleel, fils d''Uri, fils de Hur, de la tribu de Juda.
verses.am: ሙሴም የእስራኤልን ልጆች አላቸው። እዩ፥ እግዚአብሔር ከይሁዳ ነገድ የሆነውን የሆር የልጅ ልጅ፥ የኡሪ ልጅ ባስልኤልን በስሙ ጠራው።

verses.en: And he hath filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship;
verses.fr: Il l''a rempli de l''Esprit de Dieu, de sagesse, d''intelligence, et de savoir pour toutes sortes d''ouvrages.
verses.am: በሥራ ሁሉ ብልሃት በጥበብም በማስተዋልም በእውቀትም የእግዚአብሔርን መንፈስ ሞላበት፤

verses.en: And to devise curious works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,
verses.fr: Il l''a rendu capable de faire des inventions, de travailler l''or, l''argent et l''airain,
verses.am: የጥበብን ሥራ ያስተውል ዘንድ፥ በወርቅና በብር በናስም ይሠራ ዘንድ፥

verses.en: And in the cutting of stones, to set them, and in carving of wood, to make any manner of cunning work.
verses.fr: de graver les pierres à enchâsser, de travailler le bois, et d''exécuter toutes sortes d''ouvrages d''art.
verses.am: በፈርጥ የሚሆነውን የዕንቍ ድንጋይ ይቀርጽ ዘንድ፥ እንጨቱንም ይጠርብ ዘንድ፥ የብልሃት ሥራውንም ሁሉ ይሠራ ዘንድ።

verses.en: And he hath put in his heart that he may teach, both he, and Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.
verses.fr: Il lui a accordé aussi le don d''enseigner, de même qu''à Oholiab, fils d''Ahisamac, de la tribu de Dan.
verses.am: እርሱና የዳን ነገድ የሆነው የአሂሳሚክ ልጅ ኤልያብ ያስተምሩ ዘንድ በልባቸው አሳደረባቸው።

verses.en: Them hath he filled with wisdom of heart, to work all manner of work, of the engraver, and of the cunning workman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, and in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, even of them that do any work, and of those that devise cunning work.
verses.fr: Il les a remplis d''intelligence, pour exécuter tous les ouvrages de sculpture et d''art, pour broder et tisser les étoffes teintes en bleu, en pourpre, en cramoisi, et le fin lin, pour faire toute espèce de travaux et d''inventions.
verses.am: በአንጥረኛ፥ በብልህ ሠራተኛም፥ በሰማያዊና በሐምራዊ በቀይም ግምጃ በጥሩ በፍታም በሚሠራ ጠላፊ፥ በሸማኔም ሥራ የሚሠራውን፥ ማናቸውንም ሥራና በብልሃት የሚሠራውን ሁሉ ያደርጉ ዘንድ በእነርሱ ልብ ጥበብን ሞላ።

verses.en: Then wrought Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whom the Lord put wisdom and understanding to know how to work all manner of work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that the Lord had commanded.
verses.fr: Betsaleel, Oholiab, et tous les hommes habiles, en qui l''Eternel avait mis de la sagesse et de l''intelligence pour savoir et pour faire, exécutèrent les ouvrages destinés au service du sanctuaire, selon tout ce que l''Eternel avait ordonné.
